facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Talking to the Skull Kid on the stump to the left in the Lost Woods and playing Saria's Song rewards a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
After entering the Lost Woods, turn 
left and jump on the Stump. Talk to the Skull Kid and then play him "Saria's 
Song". He will give you a piece of heart!

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Playing an ocarina song with the two Skull Kids on the stump down the ladder to the right in the Lost Woods awards a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
After entering the Lost Woods, 
turn right. Head down the ladder and jump on the stump. Play a song with 
the two Skull Kids. Keep up with them and you will get a piece of heart...have a pen and paper ready.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Inside the small shed at the back of Lon Lon Ranch, pulling boxes reveals a crawlspace leading to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Go into Lon Lon Ranch and run to the
back. Go inside the small shed and pull the boxes until you see the 
crawlspace. Enter and recieve the Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Returning a white dog found at night in the back alley to the woman in one of the back alley rooms rewards a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Look for White Dogs in the pack of 
dogs at night (in the back alley). Take it to a woman in one of the rooms 
in the back alley. She will reward you with a piece of a heart for his safe 
return!

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Using the Boomerang or Hookshot allows Link to reach the ledge holding a Heart Piece in the Windmill.

evidence.quote:
Use the Boomerang
or Hookshot to fly up to the ledge containing the Heart Piece in the 
Windmill.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Asking Dampe to dig on soft soil spots during the night Grave Tour can uncover a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
At night, (not Midnight, 
the Grave Tour will be closed) enter the Graveyard and talk to Dampe. Ask
him to dig on the soft soil parts where he walks. Take at least 100 rupees
for insurance. Eventually, you'll find the heart piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Entering the tomb in the middle of the Graveyard, defeating the Zombie, and playing the Sun's Song makes a chest with a heart piece appear.

evidence.quote:
In the middle of the
Graveyard, there is a tomb that has another secret. Fall inside and defeat
the Zombie. Then, play the Sun's Song.  A chest containing a heart piece 
will appear.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Taking the owl's ride from Death Mountain lands Link on a roof in Kakariko Village, where dropping to an awning and entering the door leads to a heart piece beside a cow.

evidence.quote:
talk to the owl. He will give you a 
ride to Kakariko Village, and you'll land on a roof. Use C-Up to look 
around until you see an awning. Drop down and enter the door; the heart 
piece is next to a cow.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Winning in the Bombchu Bowling Game earns Link a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Bombchu Bowling 
Game. Keep winning until you recieve a piece of heart!

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Lighting a Deku Stick from Darunia's room and lighting the bottom level torches starts the statue spinning, after which throwing a bomb inside from the top yields a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Light a Deku Stick on fire as a
torch in Darunia's room. Run out and light the torches around the 
bottom level of the city. The Statue will start spinning. Run to the 
top and throw a bomb inside, you will recieve a piece of heart!

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Carrying the chicken before the bridge and gliding through the waterfall to the right leads to a secret area containing a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
There is a chicken before the
bridge. Pick it up and fly through the waterfall to your right. There 
is a secret area.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: In the fenced area outside Lake Hylia on Hyrule Field, bombing the upper-right quadrant reveals a hole where defeating a Deku Scrub allows Link to buy a Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

evidence.quote:
In the fenced-in area, throw a bomb in the 
upper-right quadrant. Drop into the hole and defeat the Deku Scrub 
for the chance to buy the Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Catching a 10 pound or larger fish as child Link in the Fishing Pond awards a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Catch a 10 pound fish or bigger
in the Fishing Pond as a child.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Gliding with a chicken toward the small cliff across the valley opposite the waterfall allows Link to reach a crate containing a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
There
is a crate on a small ledge opposite the waterfall. Grab the chicken
again and jump off the ledge. Force the controller forward and left. 
You need to hit a small cliff on the other side of the valley.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Carrying a chicken up Zora's River, ascending the ladder, and gliding with the second chicken leads to the ledge with the heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Take the Chicken from the beginning of 
Zora's River and travel up the river avoiding the Octoroks...climb the
ladder. Grab the next chicken and use it to fly down to the ledge with
the heart

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Carrying a chicken to the waterfall at the end of Zora's River and ascending the land bridge allows Link to jump to the piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Take the Chicken from the beginning 
and head to the waterfall at the end of Zora's River. Turn around as you 
reach it, and climb up the land bridge nearest to the heart. You can now
jump off the ledge and grab the piece of heart.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Lighting all the torches in Zora's Domain in rapid succession, including two behind the waterfall, reveals a chest holding a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Torches are located 
around Zora's Domain. Light them quickly starting with the one that is lit 
near the shop...and run into the waterfall, light those two as well. A chest will appear 
giving you another heart piece!

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Playing five upper-row songs for the frogs on Zora's River unlocks a bug-catching game that awards a heart piece upon completion.

evidence.quote:
After playing five of the 
songs on the upper row (Excluding the Song of Storms) on the subscreen,
you will be asked to play a "Bug-Catching" Game. Use the C-Buttons to 
make the frogs jump.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Hookshotting up to the roof near the seated man in Kakariko Village earns a piece of heart as a memento.

evidence.quote:
After getting the hookshot,
head back to the village and shoot up to the roof near the man sitting 
on it. He will give you a piece of heart as a "memento."

facts.subject: Magic Bean
facts.text: Magic Beans can be purchased from the merchant at the start of Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
Buy a Magic Bean
from the "Pig" at the beginning of Zora's River.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Riding the grown magic bean platform as adult Link allows Link to levitate up and smash a box holding a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Come back as an
adult to levitate up. Smash the box and take the Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Riding the magic bean platform or summoning Pierre to the roof of the Lakeside Laboratory allows Link to climb the ladder to a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
After planting a bean near
the corner of the Lakeside Laboratory, jump on as an adult and ride it
up the the roof. Climb up the ladder and get the heart piece on top!
You can also use Pierre (Scarecrow's Song) here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Dropping a bug into soft soil before planting a Magic Bean exposes a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Don't forget to put a
bug into the soft soil before you plant so you can defeat a Gold
Skulltula.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the tree stump near the fallen log at Zora's River awards a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the tree stump
near the fallen log upon your journey to the top of Zora's River.
Play the "Song of Storms" to recieve a heart piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Riding the magic bean platform in Death Mountain Crater and hookshotting down enables Link to collect a heart piece on the wall.

evidence.quote:
On the wall
to your right, you can jump on the magic bean "platform" and then 
hookshot down to collect the heart piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Jumping off the magic bean platform into the crater lets Link pick up a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Jump onto 
the Magic Bean "platform" and jump off to the crater to pick up 
the Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: As adult Link, jumping across ice platforms in frozen Zora's Fountain reaches a heart piece on the right side of the map.

evidence.quote:
After you get past Zora's
Domain as an adult, you'll notice everything is frozen over. Jump
from platform from platform to get the heart piece on the right side
of the map.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Using blue fire on the red ice panel in the fan room melts the red ice block holding a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Use blue fire and open the
other Red Ice panel with the "fan" in it. Use more blue fire to melt
the heart piece stuck inside one of the red ice blocks.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Sinking to the bottom of the center of Zora's Fountain with Iron Boots and the Zora's Tunic yields a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
After you get the Iron
Boots and Zora's Tunic, put them on and drop to the bottom of the 
center of Zora's Fountain. At the bottom is a piece of heart.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Bombing near the isolated tree to the right of Hyrule Castle reveals a hole where dropping in with Iron Boots lets Link pick up a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
walk near the tree away from the others.
Drop a bomb and fall into the hole. Put on the Iron Boots (you can do
it without the Zora's Tunic) to drop in and pick up the heart piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Diving to the bottom of the dive pool inside the Lakeside Laboratory using the Golden Scale yields a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Use the Golden Scale to dive to
the bottom of the Dive Pool in the Lakeside Laboratory.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Smashing the crate at the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory dive pool with the Iron Boots yields a Skulltula Coin.

evidence.quote:
While you are down there, smash the crate 
with the iron boots and get the Skulltula Coin!

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Racing Dampe inside his tomb after getting the Hookshot and finishing in under 1 minute awards a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Go into Dampe's Tomb
after you receive the Hookshot. Race him again and finish in under 1 
minute to recieve a heart piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Speaking to the person inside the House of Skulltula after gathering 50 Gold Skulltula coins rewards Link with a heart piece.

evidence.quote:
Around now you should 
have 50 Gold Skulltula coins. Talk to the person inside and he will
reward you with a heart piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth inside the Treasure Chest Game allows Link to see inside chests and win a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth
and "cheat" in the Treasure Chest Game. You will recieve a Piece of 
Heart.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Reaching the chest on the roof above the jail in Gerudo Fortress with the Longshot or Scarecrow's Song yields a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
When you 
are searching to free the carpenters, look on the roof above the jail
(near there). There is a treasure chest. Fire the Longshot at it and 
find another piece of heart. You can use Pierre with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Scoring 1,000 points or better on horseback at the Gerudo Fortress Archery Range wins a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Ride her along
the right wall of the fortress and you can go into the Archery Range.
Score 1,000 points or better (it's a cinch) and you win the piece of 
heart.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Planting a bean near the entrance of the Spirit Temple allows adult Link to ride it up to collect a piece of heart.

evidence.quote:
Plant a seed into the
ground near the entrance to the Spirit Temple (Use Requiem of Spirit). 
Come back as an adult and fly up to get the piece of heart.

facts.subject: Dampe's Grave Digging Tour
facts.text: The heart piece in Dampe's tour is placed randomly each visit and requires about 100 rupees while digging only on soil.

evidence.quote:
This location is random. It is 
located differently every time you enter. You'll need about 100 rupees
to be certain where the piece is. Only tell him to dig on the soil.

facts.subject: Zora's Domain Torches
facts.text: Lighting the torches requires lighting a Deku Stick at the shop torch, running to the circle of stones torch, relighting the shop torch, relighting the stone torch, and lighting both torches in the waterfall.

evidence.quote:
Start at the torches nearest to the shop,
and run like the wind to go and get the others. You'll eventually overlap. 
Here's what I did...A) Light the Deku Stick. B) Light the torch near the
circle of stones. C) Run back and light the torch near the shop. D) Light
the torch near the circle of stones again. E) Light the torches in the
waterfall.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern Red Ice
facts.text: In the Ice Cavern fan room, melting the opposite red ice wall from the one melted for the Iron Boots exposes the heart piece.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to melt the opposite wall you did when
you were looking for the Iron Boots. (The room with the fan where you melted
the red wall.)

facts.subject: Fishing Pond Big Fish
facts.text: The large fish stays underwater near the big log by the rear lilypads, and using the sinking lure disqualifies the player.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to stand near the lilypads in the rear
of the lake. The big fish usually stays underwater near the big log. You may 
have to catch the little fish that swims with him first. You can not use the 
sinking lure, or you will be disqualified.

facts.subject: Dampe Race
facts.text: When racing Dampe, wear the Goron Tunic, avoid fireballs, hug inside corners, roll frequently, and cross the final crevasse with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
When racing Dampe, make sure you put on 
the Fire Tunic. Don't get hit with the fireballs and always hug the inside 
corners. Roll as much as possible, and at the end, use the Longshot to fly
over the crevasse.

facts.subject: Bomb-Bag Upgrade
facts.text: Keep in mind the Bomb-Bag Upgrade is in here, too.

evidence.quote:
Keep in mind the 
Bomb-Bag Upgrade is in here, too!

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Come back when you are older, step on the plant, and leap off the ledge to get it.

evidence.quote:
Come back when you are older, step on the plant, and leap
off the ledge to get it.

facts.subject: Rolljump
facts.text: Rolling as you reach a ledge causes Link to jump slightly farther than normal.

evidence.quote:
Rolljump:  As you come to a ledge if you roll and are rolling when you run 
out of ground you'll jump slightly farther than normal.

facts.subject: Rolljump with Sword
facts.text: Swinging the sword in the air during a roll jump makes Link go slightly farther, but prevents grabbing onto ledges.

evidence.quote:
Rolljump/sword:  Roll jump and swing your sword in the air which will make
you go a little farther with proper timing unfortunately once you've drawn
your sword you wont be able to grab on to a ledge.

facts.subject: Deku Sticks
facts.text: Drawing your sword quickly puts away a burning Deku Stick before it burns out, saving it for attacks that deal double Kokiri Sword damage.

evidence.quote:
Saving deku sticks:  If you have a burning deku stick you can put it away
before it burns out and save it, the quickest way to put it away it so 
draw your sword.  Because let's face it why lose a stick to fire when you 
can lose it by breaking it on the enemy's face (for double the damage of 
the kokiri sword).

facts.subject: Backflip Draw
facts.text: Drawing the sword just after starting a backflip lets Link draw his sword without swinging it.

evidence.quote:
Backflip draw:  A useless/cool looking way to draw your sword while 
backfliping.  Just backflip and draw the sword just after starting the 
flip and Link will pull out his sword without swinging it.

facts.subject: Roll Draw
facts.text: Drawing the sword upon hitting the ground from a fall where you roll allows Link to draw without swinging.

evidence.quote:
Roll draw:  Another useless/cool looking way of drawing the sword.  The 
timing for it is a little harder but if you try to draw your sword as you 
hit the ground from a fall where you'll roll Link will draw his sword 
without swinging it and roll.

facts.subject: Lizalfos
facts.text: Stunning a Lizalfos with a Deku Nut followed by one jump attack with a Deku Stick sends it running.

evidence.quote:
The easiest method is to 
use a deku nut to stun him then one jump attack with a deku stick will send 
him running.

facts.subject: Lizalfos
facts.text: Holding the shield up while Z-targeting until a Lizalfos attacks allows you to jump attack it twice with the Kokiri Sword to drive it away.

evidence.quote:
Just Z-target while holding 
the shield up until they attack.  Once they attack and his your shield jump 
attack them.  After two jump attacks with the kokori sword the one you're 
fighting will run away.

facts.subject: Stalfos
facts.text: Stalfos can be stunned with Deku Nuts while attacking to interrupt their attacks.

evidence.quote:
Because they have a shield you 
can only stun them with deku nuts when they're attacking.  For any attack 
you can stop them at any point by using a deku nut.

facts.subject: Stalfos
facts.text: When fighting a Stalfos as child Link, the Boomerang can travel around its shield and stun it.

evidence.quote:
When you fight the 
stalfos as a kid you have this cool item called the boomerang that can go 
around their shield and stun them.  This simple fact makes the whole battle 
simple.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: Bait an Iron Knuckle's swing, step back, and jump attack after its axe gets stuck or after its second swing, then backflip away.

evidence.quote:
Just inch close 
enough that they swing and step back out of range of the swing, they'll 
either swing twice or swing once and get the axe stuck in the ground.  If it 
gets stuck immediately jump attack and wait until they pull it out to back 
flip out thus triggering the next attack.  If they swing twice after the 
second swing jump attack them back flip out, because you were in range 
they'll immediately swing again.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: When an Iron Knuckle's armor breaks off, targeting and shooting it with arrows while running away is a simple tactic.

evidence.quote: The can opener is kinda simple keep attacking, if they get hit durring an attack it'll stop their attack so they litterally won't get a hit in. The stupidly easy method is to target and run back/away as you shoot them with arrows.

facts.subject: Big Poe 04
facts.text: At the stream north of Hyrule Castle, back Epona into the far corner or ride through the bushes to spawn Big Poe 04.

evidence.quote: 04.) Go to the stream North of Hyrule castle.  Back Eponia into the corner...furthest from the castle.  If the poe appears take off after it, if not...ride forward hitting the bushes and it'll appear.

facts.subject: Big Poe 05
facts.text: Ride between the tree at the entrance of Lon Lon Ranch and the ranch itself to trigger Big Poe 05.

evidence.quote: 05.) Ride between the tree by the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch and the ranch...its self and a poe will appear

facts.subject: Big Poe 06
facts.text: Passing the corner of the stone wall toward Hyrule Castle causes Big Poe 06 to appear.

evidence.quote: 06.) Pass the corner of the stone wall (usually toward the castle) and a...poe will appear.

facts.subject: Big Poe 07
facts.text: Pass the lone silver rock near the stone wall to reveal Big Poe 07.

evidence.quote: 07.) Pass the lone silver rock near the stone wall and a poe will appear.

facts.subject: Big Poe 08
facts.text: Ride toward Lake Hylia through the woods next to Kokiri Forest and pass a center tree to spawn Big Poe 08.

evidence.quote: 08.) Ride toward Lake Hylia through the wooded area adjacent to Kokiri...Forest and as you pass one of the center trees a poe will appear.

facts.subject: Big Poe 09
facts.text: Ride through the middle of the bush patch outside the woods near Kokiri Forest to spawn Big Poe 09.

evidence.quote: 09.) On the out side of that wooded area ride through the middle of the...patch of bushes and a poe will appear.

facts.subject: Big Poe 10
facts.text: Ride past the sign directly in front of Hyrule Castle to spawn Big Poe 10.

evidence.quote: 10.) Ride past the sign directly in front of Hyrule castle and a poe will...appear.

facts.subject: Ghost Shop
facts.text: Turn in all 10 Big Poes for points to receive the fourth bottle and 500 rupees.

evidence.quote: I've caught all 10 and only used 20 arrows before...After exchanging the poes for...points on you card you'll get the fourth bottle (and if you don't spend any...money you'll have 500 rupees).

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: Win the shooting gallery in Kakariko Village to obtain the biggest quiver.

evidence.quote: Now head to Kakoriko and play the shooting gallery to get the biggest...quiver

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Visit the House of Skulltula to receive [PoH28] as the final reward.

evidence.quote: Swing by the house...of Skullita and get your last reward [PoH28].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 67
facts.text: Ride the magic bean plant near the gossip stone at Zora's River at night to find [GS067] on the wall.

evidence.quote: Ride your bean plant to where the ladder is near the gossip stone on it's...own platform.  Make sure it's night time and on the wall closest to Hyrule...field you'll see [GS067].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 68
facts.text: Near the entrance to Zora's Domain where it starts snowing, look up and left to find [GS068] on the wall.

evidence.quote: Make your way up stream to the entrance to...Zora's domain.  As it starts snowing look up and to your left and you'll...see [GS068]

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 69
facts.text: At Zora's Domain at night, stand at the waterfall edge to spot [GS069] on the wall to the left.

evidence.quote: Make sure it's night time when you go into Zora's domain and...go to the edge of the waterfall where you'll see [GS069] to your left on...the wall.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain Floating Ice
facts.text: In Zora's Fountain where Lord Jabu-Jabu used to be, collect [PoH29] sitting on a piece of floating ice.

evidence.quote: Head into where Jabu Jabu used to be and you'll see [PoH29] on a...piece of floating ice.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: The Ice Cavern contains 1 Piece of Heart and 3 Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: The Ice Cavern is pretty simple there is one piece of heart and 3 Gold...Skullitas.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain Pool Bottom
facts.text: Equip the Iron Boots to sink to the bottom of the pool in Zora's Fountain to obtain [PoH31].

evidence.quote: equip the iron boots and sink to the...bottom of the pool Lord Jabu Jabu used to be in and you'll find [PoH31].

facts.subject: Lakeside Laboratory Roof
facts.text: Ride the bean plant to the top of Lakeside Laboratory and climb the ladder to collect [PoH32].

evidence.quote: ride your plant to the...top of Lakeside Laboratory and climb the ladder to collect [PoH32].

facts.subject: Fishing Pond
facts.text: Catch the 19-21 pound middle fish at the Fishing Pond to receive the Golden Scale.

evidence.quote: Once there catch the middle...fish (19-21 pound fish) and collect the gold scale.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 73
facts.text: Sink to the bottom of the pool inside Lakeside Laboratory using Iron Boots to find [GS073] inside a crate.

evidence.quote: head back to the...Lakeside Laboratory and enter.  Put on the iron boots and sink to the...bottom of the water there where you'll find a crate with [GS073] inside.

facts.subject: Water Temple Skulltulas
facts.text: The Water Temple contains 5 Gold Skulltulas, 4 of which require the Longshot.

evidence.quote: As difficult as the Water Temple is known for being there are only 5 Gold...Skullitas.  Four of which require the longshot.

facts.subject: Fire Arrow Platform
facts.text: After obtaining the Longshot, shoot the sun, summon the scarecrow to the platform where the arrow landed, and Longshot to it to get the Fire Arrows early.

evidence.quote: After getting the longshot is your first available time to get the...fire arrows.  You don't have to complete the level just shoot the sun...walk down the ledge and...call the scarecrow to the platform where the arrow landed.  Now...longshot him.

facts.subject: Lake Hylia Pedestal
facts.text: Shoot an arrow at the sun from the pedestal next to the tree in Lake Hylia to make the Fire Arrows drop.

evidence.quote: when the scene...ends run to the pedestal next to the tree and shoot an arrow at the sun and...the fire arrows will drop.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 79
facts.text: Longshot onto the tree branch on the island in Lake Hylia at night to collect [GS079].

evidence.quote: go back to the tree and...longshot so you're standing on top of the one branch of the tree, now make...it night time and collect [GS079].

facts.subject: Link
facts.text: Arrive at Kakariko Village after completing the Water Temple to learn a new song.

evidence.quote: Make your way out and to Kakoriko...Village, when you get there you'll learn possible the most useful song...ever.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 80
facts.text: Inspect the back side of the fallen gate remains outside Ganon's Castle to find [GS080].

evidence.quote: before going into the temple of...time go to where Hyrule Castle used to be and you'll see Ganon's tower...Run to where the remains of the gate are laying down and on the back side...you'll see [GS080].

facts.subject: Great Fairy's Fountain
facts.text: Visit the Great Fairy Fountain at Hyrule Castle as Child Link to obtain Din's Fire.

evidence.quote: While you're at the Castle head in and get Din's fire (if you didn't...before)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 81
facts.text: Play the Song of Storms near the lone tree by the fence at Hyrule Castle to reveal a hole with [GS081].

evidence.quote: When you come out of the water on the far side of...the walkway you'll see a lone tree by the fence.  Play the Song of Storms...and a hole will appear with [GS081] inside.

facts.subject: Windmill
facts.text: Teach the Song of Storms to the musician inside the windmill in Kakariko Village to drain the well.

evidence.quote: warp to Kakoriko and head...into the windmill.  Teach the guy the Song of storms so he can teach it to...you in the future and the well will drain.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: The Bottom of the Well contains only 3 Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote:
fortunately there are only 3  
Gold Skullitas here and none of them are hard to find.

facts.subject: Zora's River Frogs
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time and Song of Storms for the frogs at Zora's River rewards a Piece of Heart [PoH33].

evidence.quote:
Head to Zora's River back to the frogs you played music for.  Play the Song 
of Time and after playing the Song of Storms they'll give you [PoH33].

facts.subject: Zora's River Frogs
facts.text: Winning the ocarina fly-eating game with the frogs at Zora's River rewards a Piece of Heart [PoH34].

evidence.quote:
Now 
talk to them again and they'll ask you to play an ocarina game where they  
eat the flies above their head, after winning you'll receive [PoH34].

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Ground
facts.text: The Gerudo Training Ground contains 8 locked doors and 8 keys, and the Ice Arrows cannot be missed.

evidence.quote:
!!!!!First and foremost it is NOT possible to miss the ice arrows there 
!!!!!are 8 locked doors and 8 keys.

facts.subject: Right Door Room
facts.text: Defeating two Lizalfos and a Beamos in the timed room through the right door yields a key.

evidence.quote:
Go to the right door first, there'll be two lizfos and a beamos in the room 
and you'll be timed to beat the three of them...After beating them you'll get a key (that's one).

facts.subject: Lava Pit Room
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time creates two blue blocks to reach a switch that clears the circle of fire, allowing Link to collect a key from the lowest pillar.

evidence.quote:
play the song of time making two blue blocks appear.  Now go to your left  
to the switch and step on it (it makes that circle of fire go away)...Climb up and collect the key  
(that's two).

facts.subject: Water Room
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time opens an underwater hole where collecting silver rupees using the Iron Boots grants a third key.

evidence.quote:
Play the Song of time opening the hole and  
jump into the water.  Use the iron boots to sink to the bottom and start  
collecting the rupees...After collecting the  
rupees you'll get another key (that's three).

facts.subject: Megaton Hammer Room
facts.text: Hitting wall pillars with the Megaton Hammer exposes an eye switch that drops a chest containing the fourth key.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll find a chest surrounded  
by fire along with some fire bats and lava slug enemies.  Kill the enemies  
and start hitting the pillars against the wall with the megaton hammer...another will expose an eye  
you can shoot on the wall to make another treasure chest drop (the one with 
your fourth key in it).

facts.subject: Statue Room
facts.text: Riding the rotating circular platform and shooting the statue's eyes unlocks a door on the catwalk above and drops a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote:
stand on the round platform and it starts  
moving around the room.  Aim at the center and shoot the eyes as they come  
in range and a treasure chest will drop and a door will unlock...Get the key from the chest (that's five)

facts.subject: Left Door Room
facts.text: Defeating 2 Stalfos within 1 minute in the sand and rock room through the left door yields a key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the first room and go onto the left  
door (opposite the side you went through the first time).  you'll be in a  
room with sand and rocks and you'll have 1 minute to kill 2 stalfos and get 
the key from the chest they drop

facts.subject: Wallmaster
facts.text: A Wallmaster will drop onto Link if he stands still too long in the middle section of the timed silver rupee room.

evidence.quote:
After killing them you'll be in a room where you'll immediately see a  
timer.  As expected you'll be collecting silver rupees.  the only thing to  
keep in mind is that the middle section has a wall master that will fall on 
you if stand still too long.

facts.subject: Wolfos Room
facts.text: Defeating four Wolfos and using the Lens of Truth reveals a hidden target above a fake door, leading to the catwalk above the statue room to collect a key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
As you walk in you'll be attacked by four  
wolfos.  After killing them use the lens of truth and you'll see a hole in  
the wall above the fake door...run in and collect the key 
from the chest (that's six).

facts.subject: Like Like Room
facts.text: Defeating three Like Likes behind the silver gauntlet block and using the Lens of Truth reveals a chest in the back right hole with a key.

evidence.quote:
push the silver gauntlet block (if you have the silver gauntlets) enter the 
room and you'll see three likelikes in three holes...Once 
they've been killed use the lens of truth and you'll see a treasure chest 
in each hole.  The back right hole has a key in side (that's seven).

facts.subject: Central Maze
facts.text: Climbing the fence wall inside the left locked door reveals a hidden key, and proceeding through the maze leads to the Ice Arrows at the center.

evidence.quote:
Unlock the door to your left and  
once you enter go to your immediate left and climb the fence wall into a  
hidden room with another key (that's either six or eight).  Continue  
through the maze in the direction you were heading and you'll get to the  
center where you'll get the ice arrows.

facts.subject: Haunted Wasteland Oasis
facts.text: Climbing to the bottom of the center oasis in the Haunted Wasteland reveals Gold Skulltula [GS085] on the wall.

evidence.quote:
When you get to the center oasis climb to the  
bottom and on the wall you'll see [GS085].

facts.subject: Haunted Wasteland Ghost
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth allows Link to follow the guide ghost across the Haunted Wasteland to Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote:
Climb back out and use the lens 
of truth to follow the ghost to Desert Colossus.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Bombing the cracked wall next to two trees at Desert Colossus grants Nayru's Love inside.

evidence.quote:
When you enter you'll see 
two trees next to a cracked wall to your front right, run over there (while 
avoiding the leavers) and bomb the wall, inside you'll get Naru's Love.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple Warp Song
facts.text: Entering the Spirit Temple and walking back outside teaches Link the song to warp there.

evidence.quote:
Now head to the giant statue in the wall and enter the temple.  Once inside 
walk back out and you'll learn the song to warp there.

facts.subject: Death Mountain Crater Warp Point
facts.text: Using a bug on the soft soil mound next to the Bolero of Fire warp point reveals Gold Skulltula [GS086].

evidence.quote:
Now play the Bolero of  
fire and you'll see next to the warp point a mound of soil, use and  
rebottle a bug to collect [GS086], now plant the bean and warp to Desert  
Colossus.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple Entrance Soil
facts.text: Using a bug on the soft soil mound to the left of the Spirit Temple entrance reveals Gold Skulltula [GS087].

evidence.quote:
To the left of the Spirit temple entrance you'll find the last  
mound of soil.  Use your bug to collect [GS087] and plan your last bean.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: There are five Gold Skulltulas in the Spirit Temple, three accessible as a child or adult and two requiring adult Link.

evidence.quote:
There are five Gold Skullitas in the temple three of which can be collected 
as a kid or as an adult (since you can backtrack as an adult).  The  
remaining two must be collected as an adult.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain Secret Hole
facts.text: Lifting the silver rock near Lord Jabu-Jabu's area with the Silver Gauntlets reveals a hole leading to invisible enemies, a ladder, and Gold Skulltula [GS091] on the left wall.

evidence.quote:
There's a  
silver rock that couldn't be bombed before lift it with the gauntlets and  
drop into the hole, after killing a series of invisible skullitas you'll  
find a ladder, climb to the top and kill one more skullita and on the wall  
to your left you'll see [GS091].

facts.subject: Death Mountain Crater Smoking Rock
facts.text: Riding the grown magic bean platform at Death Mountain Crater carries Link up around a smoking rock with a Piece of Heart [PoH35] on top.

evidence.quote:
Now play the Bolero of Fire and you'll  
see that the bean you had planted is now a platform that will take you up  
around one of the smoking rocks with [PoH35] on top.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus Crater
facts.text: Standing on the rock by the crater opposite the Spirit Temple entrance and playing the Song of Storms creates a fairy fountain.

evidence.quote:
On the opposite side of the 
Temple entrance from where you're standing you'll see a crater with a rock 
outside of the ground next to it.  Stand on the rock and play the song of 
storms to make a fairy fountain.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus Palm Tree
facts.text: Gold Skulltula [GS092] is found on the back of a palm tree at Desert Colossus at night.

evidence.quote:
On the back side of one of the palm trees 
(at night time) you'll see [GS092].

facts.subject: Desert Colossus Rock
facts.text: Riding the magic bean plant at night at Desert Colossus lets Link reach Gold Skulltula [GS093] on top of a rock.

evidence.quote:
Now head back to where you planted the 
magic beans as a kid and ride on the bean plant (be sure it's night time) 
as you pass one of the rocks you'll see [GS093] on top of it.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus Arch Platform
facts.text: Riding the bean platform under the upside-down U-shaped platform at Desert Colossus leads to the final Piece of Heart [PoH36].

evidence.quote:
After 
collecting the skullita head back to that bean platform and ride it one 
last time until it goes under the 'upside-down 'U' shaped platform".  On 
top you'll find [PoH36].  Congratulations you've collected all of the 
pieces of heart in the game.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple Statue Ledge
facts.text: Walking up the giant statue's right bicep and playing the scarecrow song summons Pierre to the ledge by the right hand to reach a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The hardest one to get is on the right side of the huge  
statue.  To get the scarecrow to appear on the ledge by the statue's right  
hand walk up the right bicep and play the song.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: The Shadow Temple contains a total of five Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote:
inside this temple there are a total of five Gold Skullitas  
(imagine that, you walk in with 95 and there are 5 more inside the level).

facts.subject: Shadow Temple Ship Screen
facts.text: Calling the scarecrow to the platform above the dragged block's starting location and using the Longshot allows Link to reach a Gold Skulltula on the ship screen.

evidence.quote:
The most frequently missed one is on the screen with the ship, you can call 
the scarecrow to the platform above where the block you dragged across the 
room started, and longshot the scarecrow.

facts.subject: Father of the Skulltula Family
facts.text: After collecting all 100 Gold Skulltulas, the father of the cursed family gives Link 200 rupees each time Link talks to him upon re-entering the screen.

evidence.quote:
With all 100 Gold  
Skullitas you now have infinite rupees since the father of the skullita  
family will give you 200 rupees every time you talk to him for the first  
time in that screen

facts.subject: Temple of Time
facts.text: Link receives the Light Arrows at the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: So head to the Temple of Time and you'll get the light arrows

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle Barriers
facts.text: The Shadow barrier must be completed before the Fire or Light barriers can be completed inside Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Make the first barrier you go through the shadow barrier,  
after that the order doesn't matter (actually you can go in any order but  
the shadow must be done before the fire or light barriers can be  
completed).

facts.subject: Shadow Barrier Room
facts.text: In the Shadow barrier room, killing the Like Like with an Ice Arrow and shooting the torch allows Link to cross and hit a switch that drops a chest with the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote:
shoot the  
likelike with one and it'll die in one hit.  Now shoot the torch to your  
right with a rife arrow and run like there's no tomorrow...Once you hit the switch a treasure chest will  
drop which you can hookshot to and get the gold gauntlets.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Tossing the pillar block outside Ganon's Castle reveals a Great Fairy Fountain granting a white lining around Link's hearts that reduces all damage by half.

evidence.quote:
Once you cross the bridge new bridge  
run to your left where you see a huge pillar like block...toss it aside and 
go in where you'll find a fairy fountain and you'll receive the white  
lining around your hearts making all damage to you reduced by half.

facts.subject: Ice Arrows
facts.text: The only good thing about the ice arrows is that they kill likelike's in one hit.

evidence.quote:
The only good thing about the ice  
arrows is that they kill likelike's in one hit.

facts.subject: Fairy Ocarina
facts.text: Saria gives Link the ocarina when he exits Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Now when you exit the forest Saria will give you the ocarina before you're allowed to completely leave.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS004
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS004 is found by rolling into the far right crate inside the room with the pots by the entrance.

evidence.quote: take the first right into the room with the pots.  Roll into the far right crate and kill [GS004].

facts.subject: Deku Seeds Upgrade
facts.text: Playing the Shooting Gallery game in the market awards the first Deku Seeds bullet bag upgrade.

evidence.quote: Walk to the building with the huge bulls-eye on the side and enter.  It's the shooting gallery, play the game and get the first upgrade for the Deku seeds.

facts.subject: Weird Egg
facts.text: Malon gives Link an egg when spoken to by the climbable vine on the Hyrule Castle screen.

evidence.quote: Walk back to the Hyrule Castle screen and you'll see Malon standing by the climbable vine.  Get the egg from her and put it on a C button.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH01
facts.text: Returning the white dog from under the sunrise-watching man to the lady in the alley awards Piece of Heart PoH01.

evidence.quote: avoid the other dogs as you walk to the corner under the guy looking for the sunrise.  The white dog will follow you as you wander around.  Go into the alley and return the fat lady's dog in exchange for [PoH01].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH02
facts.text: Winning the Treasure Chest Game yields Piece of Heart PoH02, which can be aided by watching chest seams for subtle pixel changes.

evidence.quote:
It's the Treasure Chest game...If you look closely  
at the seams of the treasure chest, you can see a few pixels change  
occasionally since the key spins around while it's in the chest and it's  
white, this will be your means of getting the piece of heart.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS005
facts.text: Rolling into the tree where the owl was perched at Hyrule Castle reveals Gold Skulltula GS005.

evidence.quote:
As you near the  
tree the owl will start talking to you, once he's finished roll into the  
tree he was on for [GS005].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS006
facts.text: Rolling into the first tree upon entering Kakariko Village reveals Gold Skulltula GS006.

evidence.quote:
Run across the field to Kakoriko village when you enter roll into  
the first tree (coincidentally the only tree) and kill [GS006].

facts.subject: Sun's Song
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in the back of the Graveyard grants entry to the Composer Brothers' tomb where the Sun's Song is learned.

evidence.quote:
Proceed to the back of the graveyard  
and play Zelda's Lullaby to get into the composer brother's tomb, learn the 
sun's song and head back.

facts.subject: Hylian Shield
facts.text: The Hylian Shield and Piece of Heart PoH03 are found under the graves in the Graveyard at night.

evidence.quote:
Once in the graveyard play the Sun's Song and  
make it night time (it's midnight so Dampe's gone to sleep).  Now get the  
Hylian shield and [PoH03] from under the graves.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS007
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS007 is located behind the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Go back into Kakoriko and 
walk to behind the skullita house where you'll find [GS007].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS008
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS008 is located on the back of the brick pillar at the construction building.

evidence.quote:
Go to where  
the building is being constructed and you'll see [GS008] on the back of the
brick pillar.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS009
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS009 is visible when turning around while standing in front of the guard on the stairs.

evidence.quote:
Now run up the stairs toward the guard but turn around when  
you're in front of him and you'll see [GS009].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS010
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS010 is found on the ladder of the lookout tower and can be shot with the slingshot.

evidence.quote:
show the guard Zelda’s  
letter and go to the look out where you'll see [GS010] on the ladder.  Shot
it with your slingshot and collect the token on your way up.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH04
facts.text: Jumping from the lookout tower onto the roof and speaking to the man sitting there rewards Piece of Heart PoH04.

evidence.quote: Now hold left and sidestep toward the left railing, jump as you get to it but keep holing left and link's screaming will be interrupted when he catches onto the seam of the fence nearest the building with the man sitting on it. Climb onto the fence then on to the building. Talk to the guy and get [PoH04].

facts.subject: Bottle
facts.text: Tossing all the stray Cuccos into the pen in Kakariko Village rewards a bottle.

evidence.quote:
start tossing  
the cuccos in the pen (I only explained that part cause they're the two  
hardest ones to get to).  Once you have the bottle run back to the  
graveyard.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS011
facts.text: Releasing bottled bugs into the dirt mound in the left corner of the Graveyard produces Gold Skulltula GS011.

evidence.quote:
Now take the bugs to the dirt mound in the left corner of the grave yard  
and collect [GS011] (remember to rebottle one of your bugs...you'll need  
them).

facts.subject: Adult's Wallet
facts.text: The Adult's Wallet is collected from the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
On your way out of Kakoriko swing by the house of Skullita and pick 
up your Adult's Wallet.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS012
facts.text: Rolling into the tree next to Talon's house at night reveals Gold Skulltula GS012.

evidence.quote:
run across the field to Lon Lon ranch  
(assuming it's night time when you enter) go to the only tree next to  
Talon's house and roll into it collecting [GS012].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS013
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS013 is found on a wooden section of the fence around the horse pen.

evidence.quote:
Make your way around 
the horse pen and you'll see a wooden section of the fence where you'll 
collect [GS013].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH05
facts.text: Moving the corner milk box inside the tall pillar and crawling through the crawl space reveals Piece of Heart PoH05.

evidence.quote:
Continue across the field avoiding the birds to the tall 
pillar.  Walk into it and pull the corner milk box out a little, go through 
the crawl space and collect [PoH05].

facts.subject: Epona's Song
facts.text: Talking to Malon in the middle of the horse pen teaches Epona's Song.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Malon in the middle of the 
horse pen and learn Eponia's song

facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch Bottle
facts.text: Winning Talon's Super Cucco minigame inside his house awards a second bottle.

evidence.quote:
go into Talon's house and win his cucco 
game to get the second bottle.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS014
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS014 is found behind the house to the immediate right upon entering Kokiri Forest at night.

evidence.quote:
Now go back to the lost woods (make sure it's  
night time when you enter).  Once there go behind the house to your  
immediate right and collect [GS014]

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS015
facts.text: Using bugs in the soil mound by the Kokiri Forest shop produces Gold Skulltula GS015.

evidence.quote:
by the shop use your bug in the soil to 
collect [GS015].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS016
facts.text: Taking the first two lefts in the Lost Woods leads to a mound of soil holding Gold Skulltula GS016.

evidence.quote:
Now enter the lost woods, take the first two lefts and  
you'll see another mound of soil; collect [GS016].

facts.subject: Bullet Bag Upgrade
facts.text: Scoring 100 points three times in a row on the tree target in the Lost Woods awards the biggest seed bag.

evidence.quote:
Go strait  
and strait again which will put a tree in front of you with a bulls-eye  
hanging from it.  Shoot thee perfect bull's-eyes (score 100 points three  
times in a row) and collect the biggest seed bag.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH06
facts.text: Playing the ocarina minigame with the two Skull Kids on the tree stump awards Piece of Heart PoH06.

evidence.quote:
Now jump down the ladder 
and you'll see two stalchilds on a long tree stump, play the ocarina with  
them and collect [PoH06].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS017
facts.text: Planting bugs in the soil mound near the two Business Scrubs in the Lost Woods yields Gold Skulltula GS017.

evidence.quote:
go left again and you'll see two business scrubs  
near a mound of soil.  Kill the scrubs and plant your bugs in the soil to  
receive [GS017].

facts.subject: Deku Stick Upgrade
facts.text: Wearing the Skull Mask and walking onto the stage inside the hidden hole in the tall grass awards the second Deku Stick upgrade.

evidence.quote:
Now run in the tall mesh near the tree till you fall in a 
hole.  Put on the skull mask and walk out on the stage and collect the  
second stick upgrade.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH07
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song for the Skull Kid while standing on the tree stump in the Lost Woods awards Piece of Heart PoH07.

evidence.quote:
Walk back into the lost woods and  
go left.  Stand on the tree stump and play Saria's song to collect [PoH07], 
show the stalchild the skeleton mask and he'll buy it.

facts.subject: Goron's Bracelet
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song for Darunia in his room on the bottom floor of Goron City grants the Goron's Bracelet.

evidence.quote:
Once there drop down to the bottom floor and play  
Zelda's lullaby to get into Durana's room.  Play Saria's song for him and  
collect the Goron's Bracelet.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH08
facts.text: Throwing a bomb into the giant spinning pot in Goron City yields Piece of Heart PoH08 when it stops on the happy face.

evidence.quote:
Turn and run to the spinning pot and throw it in.  
When the bomb goes off  the pot will start spinning if it lands on the 
happy face (it'll land on  whatever face it's on when the cut scene begins) 
you'll collect [PoH08].

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern Entrance
facts.text: Throwing the bomb flower down the cliff opens the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote:
exit Goron City and take a right where you'll see a bomb flower  
partially fenced in.  Pick and throw the bomb flower down below opening the 
entrance to Dodongo's cavern.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH09
facts.text: Backflipping over the fence opening above Dodongo's Cavern lands Link on the cliff edge to collect Piece of Heart PoH09.

evidence.quote:
Z-target so you can back flip over the lowered part in the fence  
landing you on the edge of the cliff above Dodongo's cavern.  Collect  
[PoH09]

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS018
facts.text: Using bugs in the mound of soft soil at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern releases Gold Skulltula GS018.

evidence.quote:
now hop off of the cliff  
and you'll see a mound of soil at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern, Use  
your bug there and collect [GS018].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS019
facts.text: In the baby Dodongo area, luring a Dodongo to blow up the bombable wall on the left opens the room containing Gold Skulltula GS019.

evidence.quote:
In the area with the first baby  
dodongos there's a bombable wall on the left before the ground becomes  
elevated, lure a dodongo there and kill them so their death explosion  
clears out the wall.  Now go into the next room and collect [GS019].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS022
facts.text: Bombing the strange wall along the trail toward Kakariko reveals Gold Skulltula GS022 on a climbable surface.

evidence.quote:
Take your bombs part of  
the way toward Kakoriko and you'll see a strange looking wall to your left, 
bomb it and there will be [GS022) (you can climb the wall it's on).

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS023
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS023 is located inside a crate right by the entrance to Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote:
Run  
in and you'll see a crate by the entrance, inside is [GS023].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH10
facts.text: Climbing down the wall indent to the right of a large cliff rock inside Death Mountain Crater yields Piece of Heart PoH10.

evidence.quote:
Go 
back out into the volcano and continue away from the way you came in and to 
the right of a large rock on the edge of the cliff.  Climb down the wall 
and into the indent where you'll find [PoH10].

facts.subject: Spin Attack
facts.text: Bombing the strange wall near the summit reveals a Great Fairy who bestows the sword spin technique.

evidence.quote:
Once outside bomb the strange  
looking wall and walk in there you'll find a Great Fairy.  After getting  
your sword spin go talk to the owl and let him take you to Kakoriko.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH11
facts.text: Dropping off the cucco lady's roof into the Cucco pen area leads to a wall crack with Piece of Heart PoH11.

evidence.quote:
He'll 
set you down on top of the roof of the cucco lady's house.  Go to the right 
where the cucco pin is and drop down where you'll find your self next to a  
crack in the wall leading to [PoH11].

facts.subject: Bomb Bag Upgrade
facts.text: The Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market offers a Bomb Bag upgrade and Piece of Heart PoH12 as prizes.

evidence.quote:
while  
you're there go to the bombchu bowling alley and pick up your first bomb  
bag upgrade and [PoH12].

facts.subject: Din's Fire
facts.text: Link can obtain Din's Fire as an optional spell at this point.

evidence.quote: Also, go get Din's fire though it's optional right now.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS024
facts.text: Rolling into the tree near the entrance rocks and owl reveals Gold Skulltula GS024.

evidence.quote:
Before bombing the rocks talk to the owl and roll into the tree exposing  
[GS024].

facts.subject: Magic Beans
facts.text: Magic beans can be purchased at Zora's River starting at 10 rupees and increasing by 10 rupees per bean up to 10 beans.

evidence.quote: Bomb the rocks and go buy five magic beans leaving you with 50 rupees (the next one cost 60 rupees). Go break the circle of rocks, cut down the bushes, and float through the water to get 10 more rupees and buy the 6th beans.

facts.subject: Singing Frogs
facts.text: Playing songs for the frogs on the log earns Link 50 rupees for each new song played.

evidence.quote:
Walk out on 
the log and play your four of the songs for the frogs (you get 50 rupees 
for each new song you play them so after the third you'll be maxed out but 
you don't really need the money anyway).

facts.subject: Soft Soil Patches
facts.text: Gold Skulltulas can still be gathered from soft soil holes even after planting Magic Beans in them.

evidence.quote:
!!!!!Remember you can still collect gold Skullitas from holes even after 
!!!!!you've planted the beans there.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH13
facts.text: Using a Cucco to glide past the ocarina platform to the high ledge allows Link to collect Piece of Heart PoH13.

evidence.quote:
Walk past the platform where you play the  
ocarina and jump using the cucco to glide you to the platform with the  
piece of heart.  To save trips try to land next to the piece of heart then  
get [PoH13].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH14
facts.text: Gliding with a Cucco from the Gossip Stone platform toward the isolated ledge in the water retrieves Piece of Heart PoH14.

evidence.quote:
Take this cucco and  
walk across the thin wood bridge to where the gossip stone sits alone on a  
circular platform.  Jump with the cucco toward the [PoH14] on it's own  
little ledge sticking out of the water.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS025
facts.text: Gold Skulltula GS025 appears at night on the ladder in the shallows near the entrance to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
jump into the shallows next  
to the ladder.  Once it's night time you'll see [GS025] on the ladder.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart PoH15
facts.text: Lighting all four torches in Zora's Domain simultaneously using a Deku Stick spawns Piece of Heart PoH15 behind the waterfall.

evidence.quote:
Light a Deku stick and run down to the unlit torch and light it  
(it's one that never goes out)...Once it's lit hug the wall and keep rolling till you're under the  
waterfall and light the two remaining torches.  When all four are lit at  
once you'll get [PoH15].

facts.subject: Silver Scale
facts.text: Winning the diving game by collecting the thrown rupees at the top of the waterfall rewards the Silver Scale.

evidence.quote:
play the diving game (you actually make money since it cost 30 and he  
throws 6-7 rupees worth 5 each).  Collect the rupees and go get the silver  
scale.

facts.subject: Ruto's Letter
facts.text: Diving through the underwater warp hole leads to Lake Hylia, where Link can grab a bottle containing a letter.

evidence.quote:
Now head dive into the hole and go to lake Hylia.  Grab the bottle  
with a letter in it and swim shore where you'll see two scarecrows.

facts.subject: Scarecrow's Song
facts.text: The scarecrow farthest from the shore at Lake Hylia asks Link to compose and play an 8-note song.

evidence.quote:
swim shore where you'll see two scarecrows.  The  
one farthest from the water will ask for an 8 note song so make one up.

facts.subject: Stone of Agony
facts.text: In Kakariko, walk back out and collect the Stone of Agony.

evidence.quote:
After getting  
your sword spin go talk to the owl and let him take you to Kakoriko....Walk back out and collect your Stone 
of Agony (very fitting name if you already know where everything is).

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: The cursed family turned into Skulltulas lives in the first house on the right when entering Kakariko Village from the main gate.

evidence.quote:
In Kakariko Village, there's a family that was cursed because of greed, and 
turned into Skulltulas.  The house they live in is the first house on your 
right as you enter the village from the main gate.

facts.subject: Adult's Wallet
facts.text: Freeing the first child after collecting 10 Skulltulas rewards the Adult's Wallet, allowing Link to carry 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: 10 Skulltulas: Adult's Wallet (allows you to carry 200 Rupees)

facts.subject: Stone of Agony
facts.text: Collecting 20 Skulltulas rewards the Stone of Agony, which alerts the player to nearby covered holes when using a Rumble Pak.

evidence.quote:
20 Skulltulas: Stone of Agony (using a Rumble Pak will alert you to nearby 
                                                              covered holes)

facts.subject: Giant's Wallet
facts.text: Collecting 30 Skulltulas rewards the Giant's Wallet, which allows carrying 500 Rupees.

evidence.quote: 30 Skulltulas: Giant's Wallet (allows you to carry 500 Rupees)

facts.subject: 10 Bombchus
facts.text: Collecting 40 Skulltulas rewards 10 Bombchus.

evidence.quote: 40 Skulltulas: 10 Bombchus (a speedy running bomb)

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Collecting 50 Skulltulas rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: 50 Skulltulas: A Piece of Heart (one fourth of a Heart Container)

facts.subject: Huge Rupee
facts.text: Collecting 100 Skulltulas rewards a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: 100 Skulltulas: A Huge Rupee (worth 200)

facts.subject: Soft Soil
facts.text: Dumping a bottle of bugs into a soft soil hole forces a Skulltula to come out.

evidence.quote:
There are also several soft soil holes in Hyrule.  
Dumping a bottle of bugs into the hole will force a Skulltula out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #1
facts.text: In Kokiri Forest at night in the past, a Gold Skulltula is on the back of the Know-It-All Brothers' House.

evidence.quote:
The only reason you need the Kokiri Emerald is so you can leave Kokiri Forest 
  and come back at night.  Look on the back of the Know-It-All Brothers' House.  
  Shoot it with the Slingshot.  After it dies, target it and use a jump-slash 
  attack to get high enough to grab it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #2
facts.text: In Kokiri Forest, drop a Bottle of Bugs into the dirt hole next to the Item Shop to reveal a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Next to the Item Shop, you'll see a small dirt hole.  Drop a Bottle of Bugs 
  on top of it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #3
facts.text: In Kokiri Forest at night in the future, a Skulltula is found on the backside of the House of Twins and can be retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
On the backside of the "House of Twins", you'll find a Skulltula that you can 
  Hookshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #4
facts.text: In the Lost Woods, take two left turns from the entrance and dump a Bottle of Bugs on the dirt hole to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As you enter the Lost Woods, take two left turns.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs on 
  top of the dirt hole in front of you.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #5
facts.text: In the Lost Woods, turn right, left, right, left, and left to reach a large grassy area, then dump a Bottle of Bugs on the dirt hole for a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As you enter the Lost Woods, turn right, then left, then right, then left, 
  then left once more, to a large grassy area.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs on the 
  small dirt hole in this area.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #6
facts.text: Plant a Magic Bean at the dirt hole in the Lost Woods as a child, then ride the grown plant to a nearby ledge in the future at night to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the past, plant a Magic Bean in the same location as Skulltula #5.  In 
  the future, hop on the plant and ride up to a nearby ledge.  The Skulltula's 
  up here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #7
facts.text: In the Sacred Forest Meadow hedge maze at night as an adult, climb the ladder, face left, and use the Hookshot to obtain the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Climb the single ladder in the hedge maze.  Face left and you should see 
  your target.  Hookshot him.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #8
facts.text: In the Deku Tree second floor Compass Room, activate the rising platforms and jump over to the left alcove for the Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Location: Second Floor, Compass Room...Activate the rising platforms, then hop over to the alcove on your left.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #9
facts.text: In the Deku Tree first basement wet room, a Skulltula is on a nearby grate and can be shot with the Slingshot before grabbing the token mid-air.

evidence.quote:
As you drop into the wet room, you'll see a Skulltula on a nearby grate.  
  Shoot it with the Slingshot (or jump-slash if you're daring), then leap out 
  and grab it mid-air.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #10
facts.text: In the Deku Tree first basement wet room, a Skulltula hangs on the vines behind you, reachable by shooting it with the Slingshot and climbing up.

evidence.quote:
As you drop into the we room, look behind you and you'll see a Skulltula 
  on the vines.  Shoot it with the Slingshot, then climb up to take the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #11
facts.text: In the Deku Tree first basement, blow open the weak wall with a Bomb, defeat the Skulltula with the Slingshot, and collect the token using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Place a Bomb to bust open the wall here, and enter the secret-ish room.  
  Kill the Skulltula with the Slingshot and retrieve it with the Boomerang.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #12
facts.text: In Hyrule Field between Hyrule Castle and Kakariko Village, place a Bomb at the base of a lonely tree to open a hole containing a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Between Hyrule Castle and Kakariko Village is a lonely tree.  Place a Bomb 
  at its base to open a hole.  Inside, destroy the Skulltula with the Slingshot 
  (or Bow) and retrieve the token with the Boomerang (or Hookshot).

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #13
facts.text: In Hyrule Field outside the Gerudo Valley entrance, bomb the center of a circle of rocks, drop down, burn the webs with fire, and find a Skulltula in a nook with a cow.

evidence.quote:
Outside the entrance to Gerudo Valley (west corner), there's a circle of 
  rocks.  Place a Bomb in the center and drop down the hole.  Use your fire 
  weapon to burn down the webs.  Find your Skulltula in the little nook with 
  the cow.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #14
facts.text: At Lon Lon Ranch as a child, roll into the lone tree beside the ranch house to knock loose a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the side of the ranch's house is a lone tree.  Roll into it to make a 
  Skulltula fall out of it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #15
facts.text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night in the past, a Skulltula is located on the back of the feeding shelter behind the horse corral.

evidence.quote:
Circle around the back of the horse corral to find a Skulltula on the back 
  of the feeding shelter.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #16
facts.text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night in the past, a Skulltula sits in a window of the ranch house and can be retrieved using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
On the ranch's house, you'll find a Skulltula making one of the windows its 
  home.  Use the Boomerang to retrieve its token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #17
facts.text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night in the past, a Skulltula is high on the rock wall to the right of the silo behind the corral, requiring the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Head around the corral to the silo in the back of the ranch.  To the right of 
  the silo, you'll find a Skulltula high on the rock wall.  Use the Boomerang 
  to retrieve its token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #18
facts.text: In Hyrule Castle Market guardhouse next to the drawbridge, roll into the crate beside the soldier to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the guardhouse right next to the drawbridge to Hyrule Castle.  Roll 
  into the crate sitting next to the soldier to find a Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #19
facts.text: On the Hyrule Castle Grounds outside the outer gate, roll into the lone tree to knock a Skulltula from its branches.

evidence.quote:
Outside the outer castle gate is a lone tree.  Roll into it to knock a 
  Skulltula from its branches.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #20
facts.text: Near the moat of Hyrule Castle, play the Song of Storms near a lone tree to open a hole, bomb the walls inside, and grab the Skulltula token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Near the moat of the castle is a lone tree.  Play the Song of Storms near it 
  and a hole will open up.  Drop down and use Bombs on the walls here.  One of 
  them has a Skulltula behind it.  Use the Boomerang to retrieve it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #21
facts.text: On the far side of the ruined outer gate at the Former Castle Grounds in the future, retrieve the Skulltula with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
On the far side of the ruined outer gate is a Skulltula.  Use the Hookshot to 
  retrieve it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #22
facts.text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, roll into the tree near the entrance to jostle loose a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The tree near the entrance of the village has a Skulltula in its branches at 
  night.  Roll into the tree to jostle it loose.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #23
facts.text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, a Skulltula is found on the window of the Skulltula House.

evidence.quote:
On the side of the Skulltula House, you'll see that one Skulltula didn't 
  wander far.  You'll find it on the window.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #24
facts.text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, a Skulltula sits within reach on the building under construction.

evidence.quote:
On the building that's under construction, you'll find a Skulltula easily 
  within reach.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #25
facts.text: Facing the gate to Death Mountain in Kakariko Village, a Skulltula is on the side of the house to the left where the graveyard kid lives.

evidence.quote:
Face the gate to Death Mountain and turn left.  The house to your left has a 
  Skulltula on the side.  This is the house where the little kid in the 
  graveyard lives.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #26
facts.text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, shoot the Skulltula on the ladder of the big lookout tower with the Slingshot and climb up to get the token.

evidence.quote:
This Skulltula hangs out on the ladder of the big lookout tower in the 
  center of town.  Slingshot it, then climb up to grab the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #27
facts.text: In Kakariko Village at night as an adult, Hookshot to the roof of the Skulltula House and then onto the roof of Impa's house to collect the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
You'll find this Skulltula on the roof of Impa's house.  To get there, stand 
  in front of the door of that very same house and Hookshot over to the roof 
  of the Skulltula House.  Then, Hookshot onto the roof of Impa's house.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #28
facts.text: In the Graveyard at night as a child, retrieve the token from the Skulltula on the right stone wall using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
As you enter the Graveyard, this Skulltula will be on the stone wall on the 
  right side.  Retrieve the token with the Boomerang.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #29
facts.text: In the Graveyard, dump a Bottle of Bugs into the dirt hole on the left side to force out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the left side of the Graveyard is a small dirt hole.  Dump a Bottle of 
  Bugs into the hole to force a Skulltula out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #30
facts.text: After clearing the boulder blocking Dodongo's Cavern on Death Mountain Trail, drop bugs from a bottle onto the soft earth patch to force out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After clearing the boulder blocking the entrance to Dodongo Cavern, you'll 
  see a patch of soft earth.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs on top of it and they'll 
  push out a Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #31
facts.text: Near the bottom of Death Mountain Trail, blow up the suspicious wall with a Bomb, destroy the Skulltula behind it, and climb the wall to reach it.

evidence.quote:
Near the bottom of the trail, there's a funny-looking wall.  Place a Bomb 
  to blow it up.  Destroy the Skulltula beneath and climb up the wall that 
  doesn't look climbable, but it is.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #32
facts.text: On Death Mountain Trail at night in the future, smash the red rock where a Bomb Flower once was using the Megaton Hammer to uncover a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the spot where there used to be a Bomb Flower, there's now a red rock.  
  Bash it with the Hammer to uncover a Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #33
facts.text: On the trail leading up to Death Mountain summit at night in the future, smash a red rock flush against the wall using the Megaton Hammer to unveil a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the trail leading up to the summit (where rocks rain down), smash up a red 
  rock that's sitting flush against the wall with the Megaton Hammer to unveil 
  a Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #34
facts.text: On the top floor of Goron City in the boulder room, bomb through the rocks to the far end and roll into the crate to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the top floor of Goron City is a passage that leads to a room full of 
  rocks.  Use Bombs to make your way to the far end.  Roll into the crate to 
  break it open and find the Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #35
facts.text: In Goron City as an adult, stand on the ropes in view of the pedestal where the Spiritual Stone of Fire rested and use the Hookshot to grab the Skulltula on its back.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, you'll find this Skulltula on the back of the pedestal 
  where the Spiritual Stone of Fire rested.  Stand on the ropes in view of it 
  and Hookshot it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #36
facts.text: Entering Death Mountain Crater from the summit entrance in the past, roll into the crate immediately inside to reveal a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
enter the crater by the entrance at the summit and as soon as you 
  get in, roll into the crate to find this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #37
facts.text: Warp to the Fire Temple in the past using the Bolero of Fire and drop a Bottle of Bugs into the nearby soft earth to force out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Use the Bolero of Fire to warp to the Fire Temple in the past.  There's a 
  spot of soft earth nearby.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs into the spot to force out 
  a Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #38
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern on the first floor southeast room with Baby Dodongos, destroy the weak wall with Bombs or a lured Baby Dodongo to reveal a room with a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
From the main entrance, enter the room to the southeast, which is a jagged 
  corridor with Baby Dodongos.  In this room is a weak wall.  Either blow up 
  the wall with Bombs or lure a Baby Dodongo there and kill it so it blows it 
  up for you.  In the room behind the wall is your Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #39
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern on the second floor staircase room, climb the lowered Bomb Flower stairs to find a Skulltula on the vine wall near the room exit.

evidence.quote:
From the main entrance, enter the room to the northwest, in which you have 
  to blow up several Bomb Flowers to lower a staircase.  Climb up the staircase 
  and walk around the path to the room's exit.  The Skulltula you're looking 
  for is on a vine wall near the exit.  Slingshot it, then climb up to claim 
  it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #40
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern first floor, pass through the giant Dodongo skull, turn right into the passage with wall structures, and blow up the bombable wall at the far end for a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After entering the giant Dodongo skull, turn right and enter a passage with 
  several wall structures.  At the far end of this room is a bombable wall.  
  You'll find a Skulltula behind that wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #41
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern second floor, re-enter after beating King Dodongo, ride the fast pillar to the second floor, and climb the left side of the raised staircase to reach the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Reenter the dungeon and ride up the fast-moving 
  pillar to the second floor.  Make your way around the second floor all the 
  way back to the room with the staircase that you needed to use Bomb Flowers 
  on (same room as Skulltula #36).  Now, the staircase is back up.  Climb up 
  the left side of the staircase and you can reach this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #42
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern first floor Baby Dodongo room as an adult, play the Scarecrow Song where Navi turns green to summon Pierre, then Hookshot up to reach the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the same room as Skulltula 
  #35 (with Baby Dodongos).  There's a point where Navi will turn green and 
  fly up to a spot on a ledge.  Play the Scarecrow Song to make Pierre appear.  
  Hookshot to him and you'll find the Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: After you waste it, it will drop a token, and make sure you collect this token because it is not enough just to kill it.

evidence.quote:
Waste it.  After that, it will drop a token.  Make sure you collect this 
token, because that's the important part.  It's not enough just to kill it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #85
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #85 is on the wall in a room with invisible spinning blades connected to the large open room.

evidence.quote: #85...Items: Longshot...Connected to the large open room is a room with invisible spinning blades...The Skulltula is on the wall here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #86
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #86 is located in one of the small alcoves in a room with two large panels with spikes that drop down.

evidence.quote: #86...Items: Longshot...Connected to the large open room is a room with two large panels with spikes...that drop down.  Find a Skulltula in one of the small alcoves.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #87
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #87 is located behind a huge skull whose top is on fire.

evidence.quote: #87...Items: Longshot...There's a room with a huge skull that's top is on fire...The Skulltula is behind that skull.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #88
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple room with the giant boat, Skulltula #88 is found on the left corner of the room facing the front of the boat.

evidence.quote: #88...Items: Longshot...In the room with the giant boat, you can find this Skulltula on the left...Either Longshot it, or...use the Scarecrow Song to get over there.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #89
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #89 is located behind three spinning skulls in a room reached after riding the boat and passing through the fire wall room.

evidence.quote: #89...Items: Longshot...After riding the boat, go through the room with fire walls....it leads to has three spinning skulls.  There is a Skulltula behind them.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #90
facts.text: At Gerudo Fortress at night, Skulltula #90 is on the furthest target at the archery range.

evidence.quote: #90...Items: Gerudo Membership Card, Longshot...Ride up to the archery range at the fortress and head to the furthest...target.  The Skulltula is on that target.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #91
facts.text: At Gerudo Fortress at night, Skulltula #91 is on the stone wall on the back of the fortress.

evidence.quote: #91...Items: Gerudo Membership Card, Longshot...This Skulltula is on the back of the fortress, on the stone wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #92
facts.text: In the Haunted Wasteland, Skulltula #92 is inside the stone structure with the Poe guide in plain sight.

evidence.quote: #92...Items: Longshot...Once you reach the stone structure with the Poe guide, head down inside it...The Skulltula will be in plain sight.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #93
facts.text: At Desert Colossus, dumping a bottle of bugs into the small dirt hole right by the entrance to the Spirit Temple forces Skulltula #93 out.

evidence.quote: #93...Items: Requiem of Spirit...Right by the entrance to the Spirit Temple is a small dirt hole...Bottle of Bugs onto the hole and they'll force the Skulltula out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #94
facts.text: At Desert Colossus at night, Skulltula #94 is located in a tree near the empty desert oasis.

evidence.quote: #94...Items: Longshot, Lens of Truth...Near the empty desert oasis, you'll find a Skulltula in a nearby tree...Longshot it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #95
facts.text: At Desert Colossus, planting a Magic Bean in the dirt hole in the past allows Link to ride the plant in the future and hop off near a rock to find Skulltula #95 at night.

evidence.quote: #95...Items: Requiem of Spirit...In the past, plant a Magic Bean in the dirt hole...Come back in the future...Hop off when it passes a rock to find a...Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #96
