facts.text: Push the ice block east, climb it to reach the silver rupee on the stone block, push the ice block east again to reach the alcove, melt the Red Ice with Blue Fire for another rupee, respawn the block off a cliff, push it south to reach the third rupee, push it west for the fourth rupee, and push it north onto the stone to get the final rupee and open the door.

evidence.quote: Go back to the ice block in the room, and grab it from it's east side and push forward. Now, climb on top of it, and use it to reach the silver rupee on top of the tall stone block. Go to the west side of the block, and push it east. Get on top of it, and climb into the small alcove. Use your remaining bottle of Blue Fire to melt the Red Ice and take the Silver Rupee inside. Drop back down out of the alcove and push the ice block to the north or south and off the cliff to make it respawn at the entrance to the room....Now, grab the ice block from it's north side and push it south. Jump onto the ice block and use it to reach the silver rupee on top of the rock. Now, grab onto the east side of the stone block and push it to the west. Climb on top of the ice block, and grab the silver rupee on top of the stone. Next, jump back down, and get on the south side of the ice block. Push it north. Grab the silver rupee from the stone that the ice block has to come rest on, and the door will open.

facts.subject: Block of Time
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time makes a Block of Time appear to help reach a bundle of Red Rupees hanging high above the ground.

evidence.quote: If you want that bundle of Red Rupees hanging high above the ground, then play the Song of Time here to make a Block of Time appear, which you can then use.

facts.subject: White Wolfos
facts.text: The White Wolfos can be killed in one hit with the Master Sword by backflipping away from its strike and landing an immediate Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: Allow the Wolfos to strike at you, then backflip out of it's way at the last minute, then use a Jump Attack as soon as you land. Even with the Master Sword, it dies in one shot.

facts.subject: Iron Boots
facts.text: Defeating the White Wolfos spawns a chest containing the Iron Boots, which allow Link to walk underwater.

evidence.quote: Once the White Wolfos is gone, then a chest will appear. Open it to get the Iron Boots, which let you walk underwater.

facts.subject: Serenade of Water
facts.text: Sheik appears after obtaining the Iron Boots to teach the Serenade of Water, which warps to the Water Temple in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: At this point, Sheik will appear and teach your the Serenade of Water, which will take you right to the Water Temple in Lake Hylia.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: A Piece of Heart is found at the bottom of the pool outside the Ice Cavern entrance by sinking with the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: As soon as you come out of the Ice Cavern, don your Iron Boots and drop down into the pool of water. Float to the bottom where you will find a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Zora Tunic
facts.text: King Zora rewards Link with the Zora Tunic, which enables breathing underwater, after being unfrozen with Blue Fire.

evidence.quote: Use your last remaining bottle of Blue Fire on King Zora to unfreeze him. Out of gratitude, he will give you the Zora Tunic, which lets you breath underwater.

facts.subject: Zora's Shop
facts.text: Using Blue Fire to unfreeze the entrance to Zora's Shop grants access to extra Zora Tunics and other items.

evidence.quote: If you have an extra bottle of Blue Fire, then you can use it to unfreeze the entrance to the Zora's Shop, which sells extra Zora Tunics, in addition to other useless trinkets.

facts.subject: Biggoron's Sword
facts.text: Transportation songs such as Serenade of Water and Bolero of Fire must not be used while delivering timed items like the Eyeball Frog and Eyedrops.

evidence.quote: Remember not to use any transportation songs. This means that you can't use the Serenade of Water when you're delivering the Eyeball Frog, or the Bolero of Fire when you're delivering the Eyedrops.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Bombing the south side of a lone golden tree northwest of Lon Lon Ranch opens a grotto where a Piece of Heart lies submerged underwater.

evidence.quote: Drop a bomb on the tree's south side to open a pit. Drop down the pit, and you'll find a deep pool of water with a Piece of Heart at it's bottom. Use the Iron Boots to sink down and reach the Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: A Piece of Heart sits atop the high tower of the Lakeside Laboratory roof.

evidence.quote: Once on the roof of the Observatory, you can begin climbing the ladder to the top of the high tower. Your old friends from Lon Lon Ranch, the Guay's, return here to harass you on your way up. They may accost you on the way up, they may not. It depends on chance, really. On top of the tower is a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Fishing Pond
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song on the northern edge of the Fishing Pond island summons Pierre, allowing Link to Hookshot over and enter the Fishing Pond early.

evidence.quote: Normally the Fishing Pond is inaccessible until you've restored Lake Hylia, but with the help of the Scarecrow's Song you can cheat a little bit. Go to the northern edge of the Fishing Pond's island, and Navi will flutter up and turn green. Play the Scarecrow's Song, and Pierre will appear. Pull yourself up to him with the Hookshot and enter the Fishing Pond.

facts.subject: Fishing Pond
facts.text: The largest fish at the Fishing Pond are located near the submerged log on the left and the reeds on the right.

evidence.quote: The biggest fish are found near the submerged log on the left side of the pond and the reeds on the right.

facts.subject: Fishing Pond
facts.text: Leaving and re-entering the Fishing Pond causes larger fish to respawn if the pond runs low.

evidence.quote: If the pond starts running low on larger fish, then leave it and re-enter, and they will respawn.

facts.subject: Gold Scale
facts.text: Catching a fish weighing at least fifteen pounds and showing it to the Fishing Pond Clerk awards the Gold Scale.

evidence.quote: Once you have captured a fifteen-pound fish (minimum), return to the Clerk and show him your fish.  He'll give you the Gold Scale.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Diving all the way to the bottom of the pool in the Observatory with the Gold Scale and speaking to the scientist rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: First, use the Gold Scale to dive down all the way down to the pool of water in the corner of the room.  Speak with the scientist, and he will be so impressed, he'll give you a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Rolling into the crate at the bottom of the Observatory pool while wearing Iron Boots reveals an underwater Gold Skulltula that can be killed with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Next, equip your Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the pool of water.  Roll into the crate at the bottom of the pool to reveal the game's only underwater Gold Skulltula.  Use the Hookshot to kill it and take it's token.

facts.subject: Water Temple Entrance
facts.text: Shooting the diamond switch above the sealed door on the north side of the island with the Hookshot opens the gate to the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: Go to the north side of the island, and you will find a door sealed by an iron grating.  Use the Hookshot to shoot the diamond switch above the door, and the gate will unseal itself.  Enter the gate to begin the next temple.

facts.subject: Water Temple
facts.text: Navigating the Water Temple requires adjusting the water level to reach doors on the three different levels of the central Vertical Hallway.

evidence.quote: The center of the dungeon consists of a tall room with many doors on it's three different levels, a literal "Vertical Hallway."  The twist in this dungeon is not trying to break through the three different levels of the dungeon, as in the Deku Tree, but in trying to adjust the water level in the dungeon so that you can reach certain doors on different levels of the Vertical Hallway.

facts.subject: Stone Block
facts.text: Sinking to the bottom of the right-hand hallway pool with Iron Boots allows pulling back a stone block set in the wall as far as it goes.

evidence.quote: Equip the Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the pool... Run down the hallway, and grab the stone block set in the wall directly in front of you (the path goes left and right here, but ignore this for now.  We'll get to it later on).  Grabbing the stone block, pull it back as far as it will go.

facts.subject: Stinger
facts.text: The Hookshot is the only weapon usable underwater and defeats Stingers in a single shot.

evidence.quote: The Hookshot is the only weapon that can be used underwater.  And lucky you, the Hookshot can also defeat Stingers in a single shot.

facts.subject: Stinger Tunnel
facts.text: Using the Hookshot on the targets above the spikes and ceiling pulls Link out of the water into the Compass room.

evidence.quote: Look up above the spikes to the ledge above them, and you will see a Hookshot target.  Pull yourself up to the target with the Hookshot.  Turn around and look up to the ceiling, and you will see three more Hookshot targets.  Pull yourself up to the one furthest away from you with the Hookshot, and you will pull yourself out of the water.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Detonating a bomb near the diamond switch lowers the water pillar temporarily to allow opening the chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: In the corner, there is a diamond switch.  Drop a bomb near the switch, then run over to the pillar of water.  When the bomb explodes, the switch will activate, temporarily lowering the pillar.  Open the chest to get the Compass.

facts.subject: Spike
facts.text: Spike enemies can be defeated by shooting them twice with the Hookshot, once to stun and once to kill.

evidence.quote: At the bottom, you'll likely encounter several new enemies called Spikes.  To defeat these, simply shoot them twice with the Hookshot; once to stun, once to kill.

facts.subject: Ruto
facts.text: Entering the east tunnel on the bottom floor marked by two torches leads to an encounter with Princess Ruto.

evidence.quote: It is on the east side of the room, marked by two torches (currently unlit thanks to that pesky water level).  Run down the tunnel's hall, and you'll meet Ruto again.

facts.subject: Water Switch One
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the Triforce plaque in the air pocket lowers the water level in the Water Temple to its lowest level.

evidence.quote: On the wall is a plaque inscribed with the Triforce.  Play Zelda's Lullaby, and the water level in the dungeon will lower.  This switch lowers the water level to the lowest level, and is therefore considered "Water Switch One."

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Defeating all Spike enemies in the Spike Room spawns a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: This room is jam-packed with Spike enemies.  Defeat them with two Hookshot attacks each, and a chest will appear.  Open it to get the Dungeon Map.

facts.subject: Door
facts.text: Shooting arrows through the lit torch onto the corner lanterns unseals the door in the bottom floor room where Ruto was met.

evidence.quote: Fire arrows through the torch onto the lanterns in the corners of the room to unseal the door.

facts.subject: Shell Blade
facts.text: Shell Blades are vulnerable when opening their mouths right before attacking, allowing them to be killed with a Hookshot shot inside.

evidence.quote: Shell Blades are invulnerable until just before they attack, when they briefly open their mouth.  When they do this, fire the Hookshot into their open mouth to kill it.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Defeating all the Shell Blades in the Shell Blade Room causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote: Defeat all of the Shell Blades, and a chest containing a Smell Key will appear.  Small Key in hand, return through the only door to the previous room.

facts.subject: Vertical Hallway
facts.text: Using a Bomb on the strangely-colored floor tile at the end of the south hallway reveals a water-filled pit leading to the bottom with Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: Go down the hallway, and use a Bomb to blast through the strangely-colored tile on the floor at the end of the hall, revealing a pit filled with water.  Switch to the Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the watery pit.

facts.subject: Shell Blade
facts.text: A Shell Blade to the west at the bottom of the watery pit can be defeated with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: When you land, head to the west and defeat a Shell Blade with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Switch
facts.text: Stepping on the switch on the next floor raises the water level slightly in that room and causes a Hookshot target to appear on the ledge above.

evidence.quote: On the next floor, climb up onto the ledge and step on the switch.  The water level will rise slightly (in this room only), and a Hookshot target will appear on the ledge above you.

facts.subject: Grating Switch
facts.text: A Super Spin Attack can hit the switch located on the other side of the grating to open it.

evidence.quote: The switch to open the grating is actually just on the other side of it.  Use a Super Spin Attack to reach it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Killing the Gold Skulltula just on the other side of the grating yields a token.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula just on the other side of the grating, and take it's token.

facts.subject: Stone Block
facts.text: On the west side of the chamber, push the stone block forward until it falls down a pit filled with water.

evidence.quote: Jump up onto the wooden platform, and grab hold of the stone block.  Push it forward until it falls down a pit filled with water.

facts.subject: Diamond Switch
facts.text: Striking the diamond switch on the right raises a timed pillar of water from the pit in the middle of the room.

evidence.quote: Climb out of the water at the top of the passage, and strike the diamond switch on the right.  A pillar of water will rise from the pit in the middle of the room.  Jump out onto the pillar, and then jump across to the other side of the pit before the time limit runs out.

facts.subject: Whirlpool Room Diamond Switch
facts.text: In the Whirlpool Room, pull yourself up to the alcove using the Hookshot target and shoot the corner of the diamond switch in the dragon statue's mouth with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Look in the mouth of the dragon's statue on the way down, and you will spot a diamond switch.  To the right of the dragon statue, there is a small alcove with a Hookshot target in it.  Pull yourself up to the alcove using the Hookshot target, and then stand on the edge of the alcove, as far away from the Dragon Statue as you can.  From here, you can just barely shoot the corner of the diamond switch with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Climb out of the pool behind the grating and open the chest to obtain a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Climb out of the pool and open the chest to get another Small Key.

facts.subject: Whirlpool Room Upper Diamond Switch
facts.text: Striking the diamond switch in the upper chest room reopens the grating below before time runs out.

evidence.quote: This small room contains another diamond switch, which reopens the grating below.  Strike it, then sink back down before time runs out.

facts.subject: Central Tower
facts.text: On the south side of the tower in the middle of the Vertical Hallway, enter through the locked door.

evidence.quote: Go to the south side of the tower in the middle of the room, and you'll find a locked door.  Go through it.

facts.subject: Water Switch Number Two
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby at Water Switch Number Two inside the Central Tower raises the water level to its second highest level and reveals a lower passage.

evidence.quote: You'll find Water Switch Number Two here, the switch that sets the water level it's second highest level.  Play Zelda's Lullaby to move the water level up.  A passage will appear down below; equip your Iron Boots and sink back down to the bottom level, and go down the passage.

facts.subject: Central Tower Lower Passage Switch
facts.text: Hitting the corner switch with the Hookshot releases six Spikes and three Shell Blades, which open a grating across from the switch when defeated.

evidence.quote: Nail the switch in the corner with the Hookshot, and a grating will open in the ceiling, releasing six Spikes and three Shell Blades.  Defeat them all, and a grating will open across from the diamond switch.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Floating up the newly opened passage leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Change back to the Kokiri Boots and float up the newly-opened passage.  At the top of the passage, get out of the water and open the chest to get a Small Key.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Blowing open the huge gash in the wall with Bombs leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Use Bombs to blow open the huge gash in the wall.  Enter the new opening, and open the chest on the other side to get another Small Key.

facts.subject: Water Pillar Room Switch
facts.text: Standing on the low water pillar and activating the diamond switch with the Hookshot or an arrow lifts the pillar through the ceiling shaft.

evidence.quote: Stand on the water pillar, and activate the diamond switch with the Hookshot or an arrow.  The water pillar will rise, lifting you through the shaft in the ceiling.

facts.subject: Tektite
facts.text: Charging up a Super Spin Attack while riding the rising water pillar allows you to eliminate the Tektite at the top of the shaft immediately.

evidence.quote: One of the easiest ways to kill it is to charge up a Super Spin Attack while you ride up, and unleash it as soon as you see the Tektite.

facts.subject: Water Switch Number Three
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque at Water Switch Number Three raises the water level to its maximum height.

evidence.quote: You've now found the final Water Switch, this one being Number Three, which raises the water level to it's maximum height (coincidentally, the level it was at when you first entered the dungeon).  Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque to raise the water level again.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the Waterfall-Elevator Room, a Gold Skulltula is positioned very high up on the wall to the right of the cliff.

evidence.quote: Run to the edge of the cliff, and if you look to your right then you can see a Gold Skulltula very high up on the wall.

facts.subject: Waterfall Elevators
facts.text: The top of the waterfall is reached by latching onto the descending elevators with the Hookshot and pulling yourself progressively higher.

evidence.quote: Look at the waterfall in front of you, and you will see that the elevators which steadily descend from above all have Hookshot targets on the front of them.  Reach the top of the waterfall by latching onto an elevator, then pulling yourself progressively higher, until you reach the top of the waterfall.

facts.subject: Dragon's Head Room Puzzle
facts.text: Shoot the diamond switch to raise and lower the dragon heads and latch onto their Hookshot targets, then shoot the switch while standing on a lowered head to ride it up to the alcove.

evidence.quote: To progress through this room, you'll have to make the dragon's heads throughout the room raise and lower by shooting the diamond switch in the middle of the room, which will reveal a number of Hookshot targets....Climb onto the lowered the dragon's head, then shoot the diamond switch while you are standing on the head of the statue.  The head will rise, letting you access the alcove on top of the room.

facts.subject: Like Like
facts.text: The Like Like behind the large spikes can be defeated by throwing bombs at it.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Like Like behind the large spikes by throwing bombs at it.

facts.subject: Alcove Spikes
facts.text: Use the Hookshot target on the ceiling near the door to pull yourself over the spikes blocking the path.

evidence.quote: Use the Hookshot target on the ceiling near the door to pull yourself over the spikes blocking the path.

facts.subject: Shadow Link
facts.text: Running around the island in the middle of the Serene Pool causes Dark Link to appear near the tree.

evidence.quote: Run to the island in the middle of the area, and keep running around the island until Dark Link appears near the tree.

facts.subject: Shadow Link
facts.text: Shadow Link cannot deflect attacks from the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: So the trick is to use an attack with a negative polarity; i.e., an attack that Dark Link can't perform.  This means using the Megaton Hammer.  He can't deflect the Megaton Hammer.

facts.subject: Shadow Link
facts.text: When fighting Shadow Link with regular sword attacks, do not Z-Target him.

evidence.quote: If you're a combat purist and refuse to use such an easy tactic, then the second-best way to beat him is to use regular sword attacks, but don't Z-Target him.

facts.subject: North Door
facts.text: Defeating Shadow Link causes the pool to disappear and unlocks the door on the north side of the room.

evidence.quote: After Shadow Link is defeated, then the pretty little pool will disappear and the door on the north side of the room will unlock.

facts.subject: Longshot
facts.text: Opening the chest in the Longshot Room yields the Longshot, which possesses double the range of the standard Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest in front of you to get the Longshot.  This excellent little item
has double the range of the standard Hookshot.

facts.subject: Block of Time
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time moves the Block of Time embedded in the floor behind the chest out of the way, allowing Link to drop down the pit on the other side.

evidence.quote:
Go around behind the chest to find a Block of Time embedded in the floor.  Play the Song of Time to move it
out of the way, and drop down the pit on the other side.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: In The River Wild, a Gold Skulltula hangs on the ceiling directly above the third whirlpool and can be collected from the bottom of the river using the Iron Boots and Longshot.

evidence.quote:
As you pass around the second corner in the river, you'll see the Gold
Skulltula hanging on the ceiling, directly above the third whirlpool.

Use the Iron Boots to come to a stop, and grab the Gold Skulltula and it's
token from the bottom of the river.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Shooting the golden eye switch near the fifth whirlpool with an arrow opens the grating across from the platform, revealing a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Near the fifth whirlpool, right at the final corner of the river, there is a
small platform that you can climb up on.  Get on this platform and shoot the
golden eye switch with an arrow.  The grating across from the platform will
open.  Use the Longshot on the chest inside to pull yourself over before the
time limit runs out and the grating closes.  Open the chest for a Small Key.

facts.subject: Whirlpool Room
facts.text: Exiting through the door in the alcove of the Whirlpool Room leads back to the Vertical Hallway.

evidence.quote:
Climb out of the water to the alcove with the door.  Go out the door back to
the Vertical Hallway.

facts.subject: Vertical Hallway
facts.text: Floating to the top floor of the main chamber of the Vertical Hallway allows access to the Waterfall-Elevator Room through the west door.

evidence.quote:
Once you're back in the main chamber,
float all the way back to the top floor and go back through the west door to
the Waterfall-Elevator Room.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: In the Waterfall-Elevator Room, a Gold Skulltula sits on the wall to the right and can be defeated and retrieved using the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Look on the wall to the right to see that pesky Gold
Skulltula that was just out of your reach last time.  Use the incredible reach
of the Longshot to kill it and steal it's token, then return to the Vertical
Hallway.

facts.subject: Water Level
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque in the room where Link met Ruto lowers the water level to its bottom level.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Iron Boots
and drop to the bottom level of the room, and go through the east hall back to
the room where you met Ruto.  Switch back to the Kokiri Boots and float all the
way up.  Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque to lower the water level
to it's bottom level.

facts.subject: Water Level
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque on the second level of the Central Tower sets the water level to its middle height.

evidence.quote:
Pull yourself up to the second level of the tower with the Longshot, and play
Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque to set the water level to it's middle
height.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Inside the Central Tower, a Gold Skulltula is located high up on the wall near the ceiling and can be killed and collected with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Climb onto the floating platform, and look high up on the wall, near
the ceiling of the tower, where you will spot a Gold Skulltula.  Use the
Longshot to kill it and take it's token, then go out the door to the second
level of the Vertical Hallway.

facts.subject: Grating
facts.text: Shooting the eye switch in the water with an arrow on the south side of the tower's exterior opens the grating covering the doorway.

evidence.quote:
Work your way around to the south side of the tower's exterior, where you will
find a doorway which is covered by a grating.  Shoot the eye in the water with
an arrow (that pesky Wizard arrives again to help Link defy the laws of
physics) to make the grating open.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Pushing the stone block forward in the passage on the south side of the tower opens a path to the right where a chest containing a Small Key is located.

evidence.quote:
Push the block forward until it stops, and then take a right down the passage
you just opened.  Open the chest to get a Small Key.

facts.subject: The Water Pillar Room
facts.text: Riding the water pillar to the third floor and passing through the top door leads back into the Vertical Hallway.

evidence.quote:
Ride the Water Pillar to the third floor, and go
through the door at the top.

facts.subject: Water Level
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby at the plaque raises the water level back to its maximum height.

evidence.quote:
Play Zelda's Lullaby at the plaque to raise the water level back to it's
maximum height.

facts.subject: Vertical Hallway
facts.text: Sinking to the bottom level of the Vertical Hallway with the Iron Boots reveals a doorway at the north end containing a deep pit that leads to a short hallway and a room with spikes.

evidence.quote:
Equip your Iron Boots, and sink all the way back down to the bottom level
(yeah, that's right, back to the bottom floor).  Once on the bottom level, head
for the north end of the room to find a doorway which contains a deep pit.
Enter the pit and sink down with the continued help of the Iron Boots.  At the
end of the pit, go down a short hallway then change back to the Kokiri Boots to
float to the surface.

facts.subject: The Not-As-Hard-As-It-Looks Room
facts.text: Equipping the Iron Boots to walk along the pond floor while watching out for boulders leads to the northeast corner where Link can float up to grab the northern ledge and exit through the door.

evidence.quote:
The easy way: Equip the Iron Boots and walk along the bottom of the pond,
watching out for Boulders.  Run to the northeast corner of the pond, and switch
back to the Kokiri Boots.  As you float to the surface, grab onto the ledge on
the north corner of the room and pull yourself up.

facts.subject: Water Level
facts.text: Bombing the northwest and northeast walls in the Stone Block Room reveals a hidden tunnel with a stone block that, when pushed into the pool of water, activates the switch and raises the water level.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the walls in the northwest
and northeast corners of the room to reveal a hidden tunnel which contains a
stone block....Push it forward until it falls in the pool of water,
pressing down on the switch and permanently activating it.  The water level
will now rise.

facts.subject: Water Pillar Triplets Room
facts.text: Stepping on the switch in the corner of the Water Pillar Triplets Room causes three water pillars to rise and unlocks the door across the room.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch in the corner, and three water pillars down in the pit will
rise, and the door across the room will unlock.

facts.subject: Water Pillar Triplets Room
facts.text: To cross the pit in the Water Pillar Triplets Room fastest, jump to the second water pillar and then jump straight for the door without jumping onto the third pillar.

evidence.quote:
To make it across the fastest, only jump
out to the second water pillar, then jump straight for the door.  You don't
need to jump on the third one.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: In the passage of water in The Not-As-Hard-As-It-Looks Room, a Gold Skulltula is located on the right wall above the water pit.

evidence.quote:
Run forward and into the passage of water (watch out for boulders that roll
along here).  Look to the right, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.  Take
it's token, then use the Iron Boots to drop down the water pit beneath the
Skulltula.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Opening the ornate chest in the Boss Key Room yields the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Open the ornate chest to get the Boss Key.

facts.subject: The Water Temple
facts.text: At the top level on the north side of the tower, using the Longshot on the dragon's head pulls Link up to go through the door behind the statue.

evidence.quote:
Head to the top level of the room, and go to the north side of the tower.  Use
the Longshot on the dragon's head to pull yourself up, and go through the door
behind the statue.

facts.subject: Blade Trap Room
facts.text: In the Blade Trap Room, climb the steep hill past three Blade Traps using the Kokiri Boots to reach the Boss Door.

evidence.quote:
This room contains a steep hill with three slow moving Blade Traps that strafe
slowly back and forth.  To get up the hill, you have to start climbing it using
the Kokiri Boots, and keep pressing forward....Once at the top of the ramp, enter the Boss Door.

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: During the Morpha boss fight, avoid entering the water and avoid standing on the four inner platforms to prevent Morpha from grabbing you with its arms.

evidence.quote:
For the duration of this boss fight, it's very important that you avoid
entering the water, since this will give the boss easy opportunity to attack
you.  You should also avoid standing on the four platforms on the inside of the
room, since this will allow Morpha to attack you from several sides

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: When Morpha's nucleus enters an arm, grab it with the Longshot and attack it with a Jump Attack using the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
When Morpha enters one of it's arms, this is your opportunity to attack.  Grab
it with the Longshot, and it will remained stunned long enough for you to
attack it once, maybe twice.  Which is why you should make that attack a Jump
Attack with the Biggoron Sword...If you don't have the Biggoron's Sword, then a Jump Attack with the
Megaton Hammer will do.

facts.subject: Heart Container
facts.text: After defeating Morpha, collect the Heart Container left behind in the dried up pool.

evidence.quote: Take the Heart Container it leaves behind in the now-dried up pool, then enter the beam of light to meet the Sage of Water: Ruto.

facts.subject: Ruto
facts.text: Ruto grants Link the Medallion of Water after entering the beam of light.

evidence.quote:
enter the beam of light to meet the Sage of Water: Ruto.  Ruto will give
you the Medallion of Water, and cancels your marriage plans

facts.subject: Lake Hylia
facts.text: After completing the Water Temple, Lake Hylia fills back up with water.

evidence.quote: Lake Hylia will now fill back up with water.

facts.subject: Fire Arrow
facts.text: Shoot an arrow directly into the sun at sunrise from the island plaque in Lake Hylia to make the Fire Arrows appear on the smaller island.

evidence.quote:
Run to the east side of the island, where you will find a plaque set into the
ground...So fire an arrow
directly into the sun, and the Fire Arrows will fall from the sky onto the
smaller island east of the larger one.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At nighttime atop the dead tree on Lake Hylia's main island, defeat the Gold Skulltula with the Longshot to obtain its token.

evidence.quote:
Return to the larger island, and use the
Longshot to pull yourself up to the top of the dead tree...Once you're at the top of the tree, make it nighttime to make a
Gold Skulltula appear on the top of the trunk.  Don't try to jump up and kill
it; just stand on the branch and use the Longshot.

facts.subject: Temple of Time
facts.text: Play the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote:
Once you have the Token, play the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of
Time.

facts.subject: Sheik
facts.text: Sheik teaches Link the Nocturne of Shadow upon entering Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Afterwards, Sheik will teach you the Nocturne of
Shadow.  This transportation song is the ONLY way to reach the Shadow Temple.

facts.subject: Dampe's Grave
facts.text: Pull Dampe's grave backward in Kakariko Graveyard to reveal a pit leading to Dampe's Amazing Cave Race Game.

evidence.quote:
Head for Dampe's Grave (it's the only gravestone with flowers on the left
aisle).  Pull it backwards to reveal a pit, and drop back down to Dampe's
Amazing Cave Race Game.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Finishing Dampe's race in under 1:00 by rolling and using the Longshot in the final room rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
you probably didn't win the Piece of Heart you get for finishing the race in under
1:00.  To accomplish this, you're going to have to follow the exact route you
followed before, only you'll have to roll the whole way (which is slightly
faster).  The other difference is, when you reach the last room (the large room
with the spiral ramp that rises up), use the Longshot from the bottom of the
room to pull yourself up to the door.

facts.subject: Dampe's Amazing Cave Race Game
facts.text: During Dampe's race, run forward dodging flames, turn right, turn left wide, pass between flames, turn left then right wide, turn right, left, left tight, right tight through the door, right, right, wide left, enter wide room through right door, left, wide right through door, right, tight left, ledge left wall, wide left, tight left into tall room, and Longshot to a torch near the top under one minute.

evidence.quote:
Immediately run forward, dodging the
flames that Dampe drops (he'll drop them the entire race - keep an eye out for
them).  Turn right at the halls end, taking the corner tight to dodge a flame.
Turn left at the next corner, taking the turn wide to dodge another flame.

Run forward between the pair of flames, running along the left side of the gap.
Turn left and then right immediately on the other side, taking the turn wide to
dodge another flame.  Turn right, then left, then left again, taking the turn
tight.  Take another tight turn on the other side, and go through the door.

Take a right on the other side, and another right, and then a wide left.  Run
along the left or right side of the tunnel, then enter the wide room.  Go
through the door on the right.  Take a left, then a wide right, then through
another door.  Run to the wall on the other side, then a right, then a tight
left.

Jump onto the ledge to your left, and hug the left wall as you run forward to
dodge more flames.  Take a wide left, then a tight left to enter a tall room
with a large pit in the middle.  Use the Longshot to latch onto one of the
torches near the top of the room, and pull yourself up.  If you make it under
one minute, then Dampe will give you a Piece of Heart for your efforts.

facts.subject: Windmill
facts.text: Going through the door past Dampe's race room and climbing the stairs leads back into the Windmill.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door on the other side of the room, climb up the stairs and
you'll find yourself back in the Windmill.

facts.subject: Musical Frogs
facts.text: Playing all basic songs for the Musical Frogs in Zora's River and finishing their minigame rewards two Pieces of Heart.

evidence.quote:
If you still haven't played all of the basic songs for the Musical Frogs in Zora's
River, and finished their minigame, then do so now.  The two Pieces of Heart
earned are more then worth it.

facts.subject: Kakariko Graveyard
facts.text: After warping with the Nocturne of Shadow as Young Link, run west and jump over the fence to return to the lower Graveyard and Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Young Link can't do much in or around the Shadow Temple, so run west as you
warp in and jump over the fence to return to the lower area of the Graveyard,
then run out to the Village.

facts.subject: Windmill
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms for the Organ Grinder in the Windmill as Young Link drains the well outside.

evidence.quote:
Go into the Windmill and play the Organ Grinder the Song of Storms, and the
well outside will drain.  If it doesn't work, it's because you're still Adult
Link, numb skull.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Dropping into the drained well reveals a passage at the bottom leading to the Bottom of the Well mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Once the well is drained, go outside and drop to it's
bottom.  You'll find a passage at the bottom.  Go through it.

facts.subject: Lens of Truth
facts.text: The Lens of Truth allows the player to see through the large number of fake walls and floors in the Bottom of the Well.

evidence.quote:
This is because of the large number of fake
walls and floors, which can only be seen through with the Lens.

facts.subject: Entrance Tunnel
facts.text: At the entrance, run forward and crawl through the small tunnel to reach the other side.

evidence.quote:
Run forward as you enter, and crawl through the small tunnel to it's other
side.

facts.subject: Big Skulltula
facts.text: Drop down the cliff on the other side of the tunnel and defeat the Big Skulltula hanging from the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
Drop down the cliff on the other side, and kill the Big Skulltula hanging from
the ceiling.

facts.subject: Fake Wall
facts.text: At the apparent dead end with a skeleton, walking forward passes right through the fake wall to the other side.

evidence.quote:
You'll reach an apparent
dead end, complete with a charming skeleton to emphasize the fact.  Just walk
forward, and you'll pass right through the wall to the other side.

facts.subject: Reservoir Pits
facts.text: To avoid falling through the numerous fake floors into pits, stay in the shallow water circling the room where no pits appear.

evidence.quote:
To avoid these floors, stay in the shallow water the
circles the room as much as possible.  No pits appear in these tracks.

facts.subject: Lower Room Ladder
facts.text: If you fall into the pits below the Reservoir, collect the Silver Rupees around the cesspool at the bottom of the ladder in the southwest corner to open the door returning upstairs.

evidence.quote:
If you
do happen to fall down one of the pits, then head for the southwest corner of
the large room beneath the Reservoir, climb up the ladder and go through the
door at the top to return to the southwest corner of this room.  You'll need to
gather the Silver Rupees around the cess pool at the bottom of the ladder
before the door will open.

facts.subject: Water Trench
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol painted on the floor drains the water from the trench.

evidence.quote:
After the second corner, run halfway down the hall until you reach a point
where there is a Triforce painted on the floor of the trench.  Stand on this
symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby, and the water in the trench will drain away.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Dropping into the drained pool near the entrance reveals a chest containing bombs and a narrow crawlspace.

evidence.quote:
Drop down into the pit, and you'll find
another narrow crawlspace that Young Link can fit through, and a chest (which
contains bombs... exciting).  Go through the crawlspace.

facts.subject: Dead hand Hallway
facts.text: In the Dead hand Hallway, defeat the Big Skulltula, climb the ivy wall, and go through the door at the other end.

evidence.quote:
Run forward, and kill the Big Skulltula that comes down.  Climb up the ivy-
colored wall to the next level and go through the door on the other end of the
room.

facts.subject: Deadhand
facts.text: Allow one of Deadhand's four hands to grab Link to summon him, break free by rotating the control stick and pressing buttons, then Z-Target his head and execute a Jump Attack when it lowers.

evidence.quote:
Notice the four giant
hands sticking out of the ground in the room.  Run near one, and it will grab
you, summoning Deadhand....Struggle free of the hand holding you by rotating the control
stick and slamming buttons, then Z-Target Deadhand's head.  Stand still (out of
the range of the hands), and wait for Deadhand to get near you, at which point
his head will lower to attack.  Execute a Jump Attack before Deadhand can
attack, and he will begin to run away, eventually sinking back into the ground.
Allow another hand to grab you, and repeat the process until Deadhand dies.

facts.subject: Deadhand Room Chest
facts.text: Defeating Deadhand spawns a chest containing the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Once Deadhand has died, open the chest that appears to find the Lens of Truth.

facts.subject: Lens of Truth
facts.text: Rapidly tapping the assigned C-button to toggle the Lens of Truth on and off allows you to use it without consuming Magic Power.

evidence.quote:
It steadily uses magic while activated, but there's a cool
trick you can use to avoid this: rapidly turn the Lens of Truth on and off by
tapping the assigned c-button, and it won't use any Magic Power.

facts.subject: Hidden Chest
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth behind the Lens of Truth chest reveals an invisible chest containing a huge rupee.

evidence.quote:
If you like, use the Lens to look behind the chest, and you'll find another,
invisible chest which contains a huge rupee.

facts.subject: East Trench Alcove Chest
facts.text: Climb out of the pit into the drained trench, run left toward the corner, and use the Lens of Truth to reveal an opening on the right containing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Climb out of the pit using the ivy on the opposite wall.  From the top of the
pit, run into the trench that was formerly filled with water.  Run to the left
towards the corner, and use the Lens of Truth to see an opening on the right.
Go through it and open the chest to get a Small Key.

facts.subject: Big Chest
facts.text: Continuing around the corner in the trench, use the Lens of Truth to locate an opening on the right leading into a room with a large pit and a Big Chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Go back out in the hall
into the trench, and go around the corner.  Use the Lens of Truth to see
another opening on the right, which leads to a room with a chest.  Run into the
room, using the Lens to watch out for the large pit in the floor.  Open the Big
Chest to get the Compass, then return to the trench.

facts.subject: West Trench Alcove Chest
facts.text: Heading back down the trench and taking a left around the corner, use the Lens of Truth to find an opening on the left wall concealing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Go back down the trench in the opposite direction, back around the corner and
to the end of the hall.  Take a left around the corner.  Use the Lens of Truth
to find another opening on the left wall just around the corner.  Go inside to
find another Small Key, then return to the trench.

facts.subject: Reservoir
facts.text: Further down the hall, use the Lens of Truth to spot an opening on the left wall leading to a locked door on the right.

evidence.quote:
Run further down the hall, and use the Lens of Truth halfway down the hall to
see an opening on the left.  Go through it.  Immediately on the other side,
there is a locked door on the right.  Go through it.

facts.subject: Skulltula Room East
facts.text: In Skulltula Room East, defeat four Keese, use the Lens of Truth to see a narrow ledge on the right crossing the pit, and retrieve the Gold Skulltula token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Kill all four of the Keese in the room, then activate the Lens of Truth.
You'll see a narrow ledge on the right, going around the pit in the center of
the room.  Go along this ledge to the other side, where you will find a Gold
Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang, then return to the
previous room.

facts.subject: Reservoir
facts.text: Reactivating the Lens of Truth in the small prison, run to the right and go through the locked door.

evidence.quote:
Reactivate your Lens of Truth, then run to the right.  On the other side of
this small prison, there is another locked door.  Go through it.

facts.subject: Skulltula Room West
facts.text: In Skulltula Room West, defeat the Deku Baba while avoiding flying pots, then kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall and collect its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Deku Baba in this room, and watch out for the pots.  They'll hurl
themselves at you, much like the tiles back in the Fire Temple.  Kill the Gold
Skulltula on the wall using the Boomerang and take it's token, then return to
the Reservoir.

facts.subject: Reservoir Pit Chest
facts.text: Follow the hall across from the opening in the wall, drop down the cliff, and open the chest at the bottom of the pit for a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Run down the hall directly across from this opening,
and drop down the cliff at the end of the hall.  Open the chest at the bottom
of the pit to get a Recovery Heart, then climb up the ivy wall.  Go through the
door at the top.

facts.subject: Southwest Coffin
facts.text: In the Coffin Room, defeat the Gibdos, light a Deku Stick at the nearby torch, and ignite the torch next to the southwest coffin to reveal a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Run into the room, and kill the Gibdos to the right.  Gibdos appear as mummies,
but are essentially the same as Redeads.  Once the Gibdos is dead, use the
torch near it to light a Deku Stick.  Run to the southwest corner of the room,
and light the torch next to the coffin in the corner.  The coffin will open,
revealing a Small Key.

facts.subject: Reservoir Alcove
facts.text: In the northeast corner of the Reservoir area, use the Lens of Truth to dodge the pit near the wall and crawl through the crawlspace in the alcove.

evidence.quote:
Run down to the end of this hall, to the northeast corner of the area.
Watch out for the pit near the wall here (use the Lens of Truth to dodge it).
Crawl through the crawlspace in the alcove in the northeast corner.

facts.subject: Tiny Room
facts.text: Exiting the crawlspace into the Tiny Room, go to the right and proceed through the locked door.

evidence.quote: Go to the right and through the locked door as you come out of the crawlspace.

facts.subject: Fire Keese
facts.text: Equip the Hylian Shield instead of the Deku Shield in the Pit Room to prevent Fire Keese from burning the Deku Shield to cinders.

evidence.quote:
Switch to the Hylian Shield if you're on the Deku.
Those Fire Keese can burn it to cinders in one hit.

facts.subject: Pit Room Enemies
facts.text: Use the Boomerang to defeat Fire Keese and Bombs on the Beamos while navigating around hidden pits using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth to see the pits in the room, and carefully kill all of
the enemies in the room without falling down.  Use the Boomerang to defeat the
Fire Keese, and a bomb on the Beamos.

facts.subject: Pit Room Corner Chest
facts.text: A chest in the corner of the Pit Room contains a replacement Deku Shield if yours gets burned.

evidence.quote:
If your Deku Shield is burned, then the
chest in the corner contains another one.

facts.subject: Like Like
facts.text: Link can defeat the Like Like in the Reservoir at close quarters.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Like Like by going kamikaze on it (at these close quarters you don't
have much choice)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Link can kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall in the Reservoir to take its token.

evidence.quote: kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.  Take it's token.

facts.subject: Pit Room
facts.text: Falling through one of the pits in the Pit Room leads down into the Cess Pool.

evidence.quote: Allow yourself to fall through one of the pits in the room.

facts.subject: Bomb Flowers
facts.text: Bomb Flowers can be used to blow up the rocks blocking the path south in the Cess Pool.

evidence.quote:
Run south from where you land, and use the Bomb Flowers to blow the rocks
blocking your path to pieces.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: After bombing the rocks blocking the torch-flanked hall and killing the Redead, Link can open the chest to get the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Blow the rocks out of your way with a Bomb, then run to the
end of the hall.  Kill the Redead, then open the chest to get the Dungeon Map.

facts.subject: Treasure Chest Game
facts.text: The Treasure Chest Game is entered through the door in the southeast corner of the Market at night, located to the left of the Bombchu Bowling Alley.

evidence.quote:
Play the Sun's Song to make it nighttime if you have to, then head for the door
in the southeast corner of the area.  It's to the left of the Bombchu Bowling
Alley, near the entrance to the back alley.  Go through it.

facts.subject: Treasure Chest Game
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth allows Link to see inside each chest and take the Small Key in each room without guessing.

evidence.quote:
Simply use the Lens of Truth to see the contents of
each chest, and take the Small Key in each room.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: The lone chest in the final room of the Treasure Chest Game contains a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
When you reach the last room
in the minigame, you will find a lone chest which contains a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Master Sword
facts.text: Taking the Master Sword in the Temple of Time returns Link to adulthood.

evidence.quote:
Return to the
Temple of Time and take the Master Sword to return to Adulthood.

facts.subject: Nocturne of Shadow
facts.text: Adult Link can play the Nocturne of Shadow to warp to the outside of the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Back on Adult Link, play the Nocturne of Shadow to return to the outside of the
Shadow Temple.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple Entrance
facts.text: Using Din's Fire while standing on the pedestal in the middle of the torches lights them all and opens the door to the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the pedestal in the middle of the torches and use Din's Fire
to light all of the torches... All of the lit torches will open the door to the Shadow Temple.  Go
through it.

facts.subject: Entrance Pit
facts.text: Link must use the Longshot on the far target to pull himself across the long pit near the entrance.

evidence.quote:
There is a long pit here, with a Longshot target on the other end.
Pull yourself across with the Longshot.

facts.subject: Carved Face Wall
facts.text: Running straight through the face carved in the wall leads into the Raven Room.

evidence.quote:
Run straight through the face carved
in the opposite wall into the next room.

facts.subject: Raven Statue
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals the skull that does not disappear, and pushing the Raven statue to face it opens the grating across the room.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth on the posts, and find the post
which has the skull that does not disappear when exposed to the Lens.  Use the
handle on the front of the Raven statue to push it so that the Raven faces the
"real" Skull... Once
the Raven is facing the proper skull, the grating on the other side of the room
will open.

facts.subject: Fake Face Wall
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth on the wall opposite the large pit reveals a fake face on the right leading down a hall and through a door.

evidence.quote:
Turn around and face the wall opposite the large pit, where you will see more
of those faces carved into the wall.  Use the Lens of Truth to find the fake
face on the right side of the wall.  Run through it, down the hall and through
the door at the other end.

facts.subject: Catacombs Fake Walls
facts.text: All fake walls in this section of the Catacombs have skulls with glowing blue eyes, whereas skulls with flashing blue eyes hold secret messages.

evidence.quote:
The wall in front of you has a skull with blue, glowing eyes.  Keep this detail
in mind; all of the fake walls in this next area will have glowing blue eyes.
The skulls with flashing blue eyes have secret messages.

facts.subject: Catacombs
facts.text: Heading through the glowing eye wall, going right around the corner, and using the Lens of Truth reveals a fake wall on the right leading to the Redead Room.

evidence.quote:
Run forward through the wall, and go right on the other side.  Run around the
corner, and use the Lens to see through a fake wall on the right.  Go through
the wall and through the door on the other side.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Defeating the Redead and the two Keese high above in the room causes the Dungeon Map to appear.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Redead in the room, and then look high above to find two Keese.  Kill
them as well, and a Dungeon Map will appear.  Take the Map, then turn around
and go back into the Catacombs.

facts.subject: Inside the Deku Tree
facts.text: The main body of Inside the Deku Tree is the interior of the Great Deku Tree's trunk, featuring four main levels: The Top Floor, The Main Floor, The Basement, and the Sub-Basement.

evidence.quote: The main body of the dungeon is the interior of the Great Deku Tree's trunk, and all of the other rooms in the dungeon stretch out from this central area.  The Trunk has four main levels: The Top Floor, The Main Floor, The Basement, and the Sub-Basement.

facts.subject: Deku Babas
facts.text: Deku Babas in the corners of the room drop Deku Sticks and/or Deku Nuts when defeated.

evidence.quote: Start by killing the Deku Babas in the corners of the room.  Hold your shield up with R while Z-Targeting to absorb their attacks.  Take the Deku Sticks and/or Deku Nuts that they drop.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest along the upper ledge of the Trunk contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Open the chest part of the way along the ledge to find the Dungeon Map.

facts.subject: The Trunk
facts.text: Continuing right along the ledge past the Dungeon Map chest leads to a door into the next room.

evidence.quote: Keep going right along the ledge and enter the door you come to.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: Defeat the Deku Scrub by reflecting the Deku Nut he fires back into his face and standing on his nest when he runs.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Deku Scrub by Z-Targeting him and reflecting the Deku Nut he fires back into his face.  The Scrub will then get up and start running around the room.  Don't chase him; go and stand on his nest.  When the Scrub attempts to return to his nest, he will walk right into you.

facts.subject: fall damage
facts.text: Pressing forward on the joystick as you land helps avoid fall damage.

evidence.quote: He will then open both of the doors in the room, and give you a useful hint for avoiding fall damage (press forward on the joystick as you land).

facts.subject: Scrub Room #1
facts.text: Going northeast through the door in Scrub Room #1 leads to the Slingshot Room.

evidence.quote: Go northeast through the door to the next room.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest on the far ledge past the falling gray platform in the Slingshot Room contains the Fairy Slingshot and Bullet Bag x30.

evidence.quote: Jump out to the gray platform, but quickly jump to the next ledge, as the platform will quickly begin to fall.  Open the chest to find the Fairy Slingshot (and the Bullet Bag x30 which goes with it, though it isn't mentioned in-game).

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Climbing the ivy wall to the right in the Slingshot Room leads to a chest containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Turn to the right and climb the ivy wall.  Open the chest for a Recovery Heart.

facts.subject: ladder
facts.text: Shooting down the ladder hanging above the entrance door with the Fairy Slingshot allows you to climb up and exit back to Scrub Room #1.

evidence.quote: Using the Fairy Slingshot, shoot down the ladder that hangs above the door.  Jump down and climb up the ladder, then go back through the door.

facts.subject: The Trunk
facts.text: Shooting down three Skullwalltullas on the ivy wall with the Slingshot allows climbing to the highest level of the Deku Tree, where continuing left leads to a door.

evidence.quote: Use the Slingshot to shoot down the three Skullwalltullas clinging to the ivy wall.  Once they are out of the way, climb the wall to the top, and then to the left to reach the highest level of the Deku Tree... keep going to the left until you reach a door.  Go through it.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Stepping on the switch next to the lantern raises three platforms that allow Link to reach a chest in the back of the room containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Turn to the right and step on the switch next to the lantern.  The three platforms in the center of the room will begin to rise.  Quickly jump along them to the ledge in the back of the room.  Open the chest to find the Compass.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest in the small northern alcove past the Big Skulltula contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Step on the switch again, and this time use the platforms to reach the small alcove in the northern part of the room.  Jump past the Big Skulltula and open the chest for a Recovery Heart.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Killing the Gold Skulltula in the back of the northern alcove yields a Gold Skulltula Token.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula in the back of the alcove to get the game's first Gold Skulltula Token.

facts.subject: door
facts.text: Catching a Deku Stick on fire from the lantern and using it to light the burned-out lantern unlocks the door in the Compass Room.

evidence.quote: Use a Deku Stick near the lantern, and it will catch on fire.  Use the flaming Deku Stick to light the burned out lantern, and the door will unlock.  Go through the door.

facts.subject: Big Skulltula
facts.text: Defeat the Big Skulltula by Z-Targeting it, waiting for it to spin around, and hitting it with a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: When you reach the second one, kill it by Z-Targeting it, and waiting for it to spin around.  Use a Jump Attack when it does this.

facts.subject: The Trunk Top Floor
facts.text: Jumping off the edge and landing directly on the bit of webbing on the first floor breaks through it into the sub-basement level of the Trunk.

evidence.quote: You're now going to have to jump off the edge and land on the bit of webbing, clear down on the first floor of the Trunk... If you land right on the webbing, you will break through it into the sub basement level of the Trunk.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula on the grating on the eastern side of the room drops a token when shot with the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Use your Fairy Slingshot to kill the Gold Skulltula on the grating on the eastern side of the room.  Jump out from the ledge to reach it, then climb back up onto the ledge.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula on the long ivy wall on the south side of the sub-basement drops a token when killed.

evidence.quote: Face the long ivy wall that you fell down to reach this area, on the south side of the room.  Kill the second Gold Skulltula, and climb up the wall to claim the token.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest behind the lantern on the southeast ledge contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Climb back up onto the southeast ledge once more, and open the chest behind the lantern to find a Recovery Heart.

facts.subject: web-covered door
facts.text: Burning the webs on the wall with a flaming Deku Stick lit from the lantern reveals a door on the southwest ledge.

evidence.quote: Light a Deku Stick on the lantern, then quickly jump out onto the pond so that you land on the shallow bit which Link can stand on without having to swim.  From there, jump to the southwest ledge, run past the Deku Baba and use the flaming Deku Stick to burn the webs on the wall, revealing a door.  Go through this door.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: In Scrub Room #2, deflect the Scrub's Deku Nuts with the Deku Shield and stand on his nest when he runs to defeat him and hear the hint '23 is number 1'.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Scrub in this room by deflecting the Deku Nuts he fires back at him with your Deku Shield (the Slingshot doesn't work, he just retreats back into the ground).  Once he starts running around the room, run to his nest and stand on it.  When he tries to return to his nest, he'll run right into you, thus defeating him.  He'll mention that "23 is number 1," which is actually a hint to solve the last puzzle before the boss.

facts.subject: west door
facts.text: Shooting the Silver Eye above the west door with the Fairy Slingshot unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: Shoot the Silver Eye above the west door with the Fairy Slingshot to unlock the door.  Go through the door to the next room.

facts.subject: underwater button
facts.text: Swimming down and holding A to touch the button on the left side of the pool directly beneath the rotating spikes lowers the water level considerably.

evidence.quote: On the left side of the pool, against the wall, directly beneath the rotating spikes, there is a button.  Swim over this button, then press and hold down A to swim down and touch the switch... Once the switch is activated, the water level in the pool will lower considerably.

facts.subject: floating platform
facts.text: Holding down R to crouch on the floating platform allows Link to safely pass under the rotating spikes across the pool.

evidence.quote: Quickly swim back to the room's entrance, and jump out to the floating platform.  Hold down the R button to make Link crouch as you pass under the rotating spikes.  On the other side of the pool, jump from the floating platform to the opposite ledge.

facts.subject: stone block
facts.text: Pushing the large stone block all the way to the right allows Link to jump onto it and reach the door.

evidence.quote: Kill the Big Skulltula, then move to the left side of the large stone block.  Follow Navi's instructions to push the block all the way to the right, then jump up onto the block, then jump up to the door.  Go through the door.

facts.subject: un-lit sconces
facts.text: Lighting the two un-lit sconces using a Deku Stick lit from the torch opens the door in the north side of the Torch Room.

evidence.quote: Kill the Deku Baba in the center of the room, then light a Deku Stick on the lit torch.  Use the flame to light the two un-lit sconces, which will open the door in the north side of the room.  Go through it.

facts.subject: Gohma Larva
facts.text: Gohma Larva drop from the ceiling when running in circles in the room's center, telegraph their charge attack by turning their eye red, and can be killed with single Jump Attacks.

evidence.quote: Run around in circles in the center of the room, which will provoke the Gohma Larva hanging from the ceiling to drop down.  Kill them with single Jump Attacks, but avoid their charge attack.  You know they are about to perform this when their eye turns red.

facts.subject: Small Nest
facts.text: Lighting a Deku Stick on the northern torches burns the webbing in the south part of the room, opening a crawl tunnel back to The Trunk.

evidence.quote: Light a Deku Stick on the torches near the north part of the room, and use the lit Deku Stick to burn the webbing in the south part of the room.  Enter the tunnel and crawl through to the other side.

facts.subject: stone block
facts.text: Pushing the stone block along its carved path off the cliff creates a shortcut back up to the upper level.

evidence.quote: Run to the left, and push the stone block along it's carved path and off the cliff.  Jump down, and go back to the southeast platform with the torch.  Light a Deku Stick on the torch, then jump back to the stone block.  Climb back up to the upper level

facts.subject: floor webbing
facts.text: Rolling over the floor webbing while holding a lit Deku Stick burns it away, opening a hole to drop to the lowest level.

evidence.quote: then run to the webbing covering the floor.  Roll over the webbing by running at it and pressing A.  The torch will make contact with the webbing as you roll, burning it away.  Drop down the new hole to the lowest level.

facts.subject: Parasitic Armored Arachnid GOHMA
facts.text: To stun Gohma and leave her vulnerable to sword attacks, shoot her in the eye with the Slingshot while her eye glows red.

evidence.quote: To stun Gohma and make her vulnerable to basic sword attacks, you must shoot her in the eye with the Slingshot while her eye glows red.

facts.subject: Parasitic Armored Arachnid GOHMA
facts.text: Shooting Gohma in the eye on the ceiling before she spawns Gohma Larva causes her to fall to the floor stunned for a long time.

evidence.quote: If you can shoot her in the eye before she is able spawn them, however, then she will fall to the floor and be stunned for a VERY long time.  You can easily get in three or four more Jump Attacks at this point, which are more then enough to shut down Gohma permanently.

facts.subject: Parasitic Armored Arachnid GOHMA
facts.text: Gohma leaves behind a Heart Container upon defeat.

evidence.quote: After Gohma is dead, take the Heart Container that she leaves behind, and enter the shimmering blue circle.

facts.subject: Great Deku Tree
facts.text: After listening to the Great Deku Tree's story outside the dungeon, he gives Link the Kokiri Emerald and asks him to seek the Princess of Destiny at Hyrule Castle.

evidence.quote: He gives Link the Kokiri Emerald, and makes one final wish: to seek out the other Spiritual Stones and prevent the "Evil Man from the Desert" (Ganondorf) from entering the Sacred Realm.  As his last piece of advice, the Deku Tree tells Link to go to Hyrule Castle and seek out the Princess of Destiny.

After 
the tree speaks it gives you the KOKIRI'S EMERALD.

facts.subject: three Deku Scrubs
facts.text: Hit the three Deku Scrubs in the order middle first, right second, and left last to defeat them and unlock the door to the boss.

evidence.quote: If you remember the hint from Scrub Room #2, then this will be an easy puzzle.  If you forgot, or weren't paying attention, then you have to kill them in order.  The middle one is first, the one on the far right goes second, and the one on the left goes last....After the three Deku Scrubs have disappeared, the door will unlock.

facts.subject: The Shadow Temple - Catacombs
facts.text: Run back through the fake wall, go right, then left around the next corner, use the Lens of Truth to pass through the wall flanked by two pots, run down the passage through another fake wall, go right and left at the next corner, use the lens to see through the final wall, and go through the door into the Deadhand Room.

evidence.quote: Run back through the fake wall, and go right on the other side, then left around the next corner.  Use the Lens of Truth to see through the wall flanked by two pots, and go through it.  Run down the passage and through another fake wall.  Go right and then left at the next corner, and use the lens to see through the wall at the other end of the hall.  Go through the wall and through the door on the other side.

facts.subject: Deadhand
facts.text: Let one of Deadhand's hands grab you so his body appears, struggle free, wait for his head to lower, and execute a Jump Attack before he can strike.

evidence.quote: Remember, allow one of his hands to grab you, and Deadhand's body and head will appear and move slowly towards you.  Struggle free of the hand holding you by rotating the control stick and slamming buttons, then Z-Target Deadhand's head.  Stand still (out of the range of the hands), and wait for Deadhand to get near you, at which point his head will lower to attack.  Execute a Jump Attack before Deadhand can attack, and he will begin to run away, eventually sinking back into the ground.

facts.subject: Deadhand
facts.text: The Biggoron Sword can kill Deadhand in only a few hits, though Jump Attacks tend to fly right past him.

evidence.quote: The Biggoron Sword can kill him in only a few hits.  The only problem with the Biggoron's Sword is that Jump Attacks tend to fly right past the Deadhand.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: After defeating Deadhand, open the chest that appears to obtain the Hover Boots, which allow you to walk on thin air for limited periods.

evidence.quote: After the Deadhand dies, then a chest will appear in the room.  Open them to get the Hover Boots, which let you walk on thin air for limited periods of times.

facts.subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
facts.text: In the Raven Room, run forward through the fake wall to the cliff, equip Hover Boots, and run off the cliff to the tongue-shaped ledge on the other side.

evidence.quote: Run forward through the fake wall, and then to the cliff.  Equip the Hover Boots, and run out off the cliff to the ledge on the other side (it's carved in the shape of a tongue).

facts.subject: Beamos
facts.text: Kill the Beamos by throwing a bomb or two into its head.

evidence.quote: Kill the Beamos by hurling a Bomb or two into it's head, then go to the wall on the right.

facts.subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
facts.text: The wall on the right near the Beamos is fake, leading through a door to the Gibdos Room.

evidence.quote: then go to the wall on the right.  It's actually fake.  Run through it and through the door on the other side.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Kill the pair of Gibdos in the Gibdos Room to make a chest appear containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Kill the pair of Gibdos in this room (if you missed them in the Bottom of the Well, Gibdos are more aggressive versions of Redeads).  A chest will appear upon their demise.  Open it to get the Compass.

facts.subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
facts.text: Run back through the fake wall, past the Beamos, and head through the fake wall to the north to reach the Scythe Room.

evidence.quote: Run forward back through the fake wall, and kill or dodge the Beamos.  Run north and through the wall north of the Beamos - it's another fake.

facts.subject: Scythe
facts.text: You can roll under the rotating Scythe blades if timed correctly.

evidence.quote: You can roll under the Scythe's blades if you time it correctly.

facts.subject: Silver Rupees
facts.text: Collect two Silver Rupees in the middle of the room in the Scythe's path, a third by Longshotting to the northwest target and jumping off the wood stack, a fourth in the west alcove, and a fifth in the northeast alcove.

evidence.quote: Run forward and grab the two Silver Rupees which lie in the middle of the room, directly in the Scythe's path...Now, run to the north wall, and use the Longshot to pull yourself up to the Longshot target in the northwest corner.  Jump off the stack of wood to grab another Silver Rupee...Go to the alcove in the west wall and grab another Silver Rupee, then go to the alcove in the northeast corner and grab another Silver Rupee.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees opens the grating in the southeast corner, revealing a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: The grating in the southeast corner will open, revealing a chest.  Open it to get a Small Key, then return through the door you came through in the south of the room.

facts.subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
facts.text: Bomb the rough wall to the east in the Raven Room to destroy the barrier covering the passage to the Guillotine Chamber.

evidence.quote: Run back through the fake wall, the bomb the rough wall to the east.  The barrier covering the passage behind it will be destroyed.  Run down the passage and through the door on the other side.

facts.subject: Big Skulltula
facts.text: Eliminate the Big Skulltulas hanging from the ceiling along the ramp series using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Run down the ramp in front of you, moving slowly to watch out for Big Skulltulas hanging from the ceiling.  Eliminate them with the Longshot.

facts.subject: Guillotines
facts.text: Run around each guillotine as it rises or roll under them to move quickly, watching for the Big Skulltula between the first and second blades.

evidence.quote: In front of you are a series of gigantic guillotines that drop down from the ceiling.  Run around each guillotine individually as they rise into the air.  Roll under them to move more quickly, if you're feeling nervous.  Watch out for the Big Skulltula which hangs between the first and second guillotines.

facts.subject: Wall Master
facts.text: Wait for the Wall Master to drop down and kill it completely until it burns on the ground, rather than knocking it off the cliff.

evidence.quote: Run around in a circle, waiting for the Wall Master to appear, and kill it when it drops down...Note that knocking the Wall Master off the cliff doesn't count.  You have to actually kill it and see it burn on the ground to work.

facts.subject: Stalfos
facts.text: After jumping past the three guillotines, hold up your shield on the small platform and attack only immediately after the Stalfos strikes.

evidence.quote: After the jump from the third guillotine, you will land on a small platform where you will have to combat a Stalfos...Remember to hold your shield up and only attack immediately after the Stalfos does.

facts.subject: The Shadow Temple - Guillotine Chamber
facts.object: The Shadow Temple - Invisible Scythe Room
facts.text: After defeating the Stalfos, use the Lens of Truth to spot invisible platforms to the east and north, jumping across them to reach a door.

evidence.quote: Once the Stalfos is out of the way, look to the east with the Lens of Truth to see an invisible platform.  Jump out to it again, and jump once more to a platform in the corner.  Still with the Lens of Truth on, look north and jump along more invisible platforms until you reach a door.  Go through it.

facts.subject: Lens of Truth
facts.text: Rapidly turning the Lens of Truth on and off prevents it from consuming magic.

evidence.quote: Remember, if you rapidly turn the Lens on and off, it doesn't consume magic.

facts.subject: Chests
facts.text: Beyond the grating in the Invisible Scythe Room are two chests containing a Blue Rupee and Arrows, with the second chest visible using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Go through it and kill the Gold Skulltula on the other side, as well as two chests which contain a Blue Rupee and Arrows (use the Lens to see the second chest).

facts.subject: Platform with Blade Traps
facts.text: From the rising and falling platform, jump to the narrow cliff halfway to its apex, head southwest to dodge the Blade Traps, collect four Silver Rupees, and bomb the Beamos to grab the fifth Silver Rupee.

evidence.quote: Jump out to this cliff when the rising/falling platform is about halfway to it's apex.  Run southwest along the cliff, where you will reach a wide platform which has a rotating set of Blade Traps and five Silver Rupees.  Grab four of the Silver Rupees by running around the platform, dodging the Blade Traps (there is a large gap between the pair that you can stand safely in).  The last Silver Rupee is underneath the Beamos.  Blow it up with bombs to reach it.

facts.subject: Stone Block
facts.text: Use the Lens of Truth to see the stone block embedded in the right wall, pull it out until it aligns with the smiling face on the floor, and push it forward to block both crushing spiked ceilings.

evidence.quote: Use the Lens of Truth and look to the right wall as you enter this room, and you'll see a stone block embedded in the wall.  Grab hold of the block and pull it out until it lines up with the smiling face carved into the floor.  Now, push the stone block forward until it prevents both of the crushing ceilings from falling.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula GS083
facts.text: Move around the stone block into a cell opening to the south, kill the Gold Skulltula, and retrieve its token with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Move around to the other side of the stone block, and look to the south where you will see an opening leading into one of the cells in the room.  Go inside and kill the Gold Skulltula, and take it's token with the Longshot.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Pull the stone block back, climb onto it to reach the north ledge, bridge across the crushing ceiling to step on the south switch, then cross to the northeast ledge chest to get a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Step on the switch on the south ledge, and a chest will appear on a ledge in the northeast corner.  Hop onto the crushing ceiling just to the north of the switch, and jump from the there to the ledge with the chest.  Open it to find a Small Key.

facts.subject: The Shadow Temple - Guillotine Chamber
facts.object: The Shadow Temple - Silver Rupee Room
facts.text: Head north along the narrow ledge, use the Lens of Truth to see the platform past the guillotine, jump as it rises, and jump across another horizontally moving platform to reach the door.

evidence.quote: Head north along the narrow ledge, where you will reach another timed jump involving a guillotine.  Use the Lens of Truth, and you will see the platform on the other side of the guillotine.  Wait for the guillotine to begin to rise, then jump to the platform.  Keeping the Lens of Truth on, look to the north to see another platform, this once moving to the left and right.  Jump out to it when it gets near enough, then jump to the ledge on the other side.  Go through the door.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Kill both Redeads in the room to make a chest appear containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Start by killing both of the Redeads in the room, and then open the chest that appears.  Keep your Lens of Truth activated to avoid the invisible spikes around the room.  The chest contains a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Door
facts.text: Collect all five Silver Rupees across the room using the Lens of Truth and Longshot targets to unseal the door on the west side.
