facts.text: Presenting the tenth Big Poe to the ghost shop man in Hyrule Castle Town rewards the fourth and final Empty Bottle along with 500 Rupees earned in total.

evidence.quote:
Enter the small room and 
present the final Poe to the ghost man, he will give you the fourth and final 
EMPTY BOTTLE in return for you work.  Coupled with the 500 Rupees you have 
already made from it

facts.subject: Froggy Minigame
facts.text: From left to right, the frogs in the Zora's River minigame correspond to controller inputs A, Left, Down, Up, and Right.

evidence.quote:
(from left to right, the frog buttons 
are A, left, down, up, right).

facts.subject: Froggy Minigame
facts.text: Successfully inputting the complete frog note sequence awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: left, A).  Doing this will net you a reward, the PIECE OF HEART [030].

facts.subject: Cucco Lady
facts.text: The Cucco breeding woman gives Link the Pocket Egg, which hatches into a Pocket Cucco after playing the Sun's Song twice.

evidence.quote:
She gives you the POCKET EGG which will hatch 
overnight just like the other egg.  After acquiring it, play the Sun's Song 
once, and then again to make the egg hatch into a POCKET CUCCO.

facts.subject: Cucco Lady
facts.text: Using the Pocket Cucco to wake sleeping Talon in a Kakariko house makes the Cucco happy, prompting the lady to reward Link with Cojiro.

evidence.quote:
In here you will find Talon sleeping on a bed.  Stand 
beside him with your new Pocket Cucco equipped on one of the C Buttons and use 
it...she gives 
you COJIRO, a special Blue Cucco which has stopped crowing entirely.

facts.subject: Sleeping Man
facts.text: Using Cojiro in front of the sleeping man by the stump in the Lost Woods rewards the Odd Mushroom.

evidence.quote:
There 
is a man sitting beside the stump here in this area...equip the blue Cucco 
Cojiro on one of your C-Buttons and then use it while standing in front of the 
man...gives 
you the ODD MUSHROOM.

facts.subject: Witch
facts.text: Delivering the Odd Mushroom within three minutes to the witch behind the Kakariko Village Potion Shop yields the Odd Medicine.

evidence.quote:
You now have three minutes to get to the Potion 
Shop in Kakariko Village...enter the other door back there, it will take you to a 
witch.  Use the Odd Mushroom while standing in front of her and she will give 
you the ODD MEDICINE.

facts.subject: Lost Woods Girl
facts.text: Giving the Odd Medicine to the girl standing at the stump in the Lost Woods yields the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote:
Go to where the man was sitting previously and there you 
will find a small girl.  Stand in front of her and use the Odd Medicine to 
acquire the POACHER'S SAW.

facts.subject: Master Craftsman's Son
facts.text: Crossing the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley with the Longshot and trading the Poacher's Saw to the man yields the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Approach the bridge which is 
totally broken and equip the Longshot.  Use the Longshot to hook onto the 
target on the other side and get across.  When you do this, go and speak to 
the fat guy here.  Equip the Poacher's Saw onto one of your C buttons and use 
it while standing in front of him.  He'll offer you the BROKEN GORON'S SWORD 
in return for the Poacher's Saw.

facts.subject: Deku Scrubs
facts.text: The three Deku Scrubs must be deflected and caught in the order 2, 3, 1 from left to right.

evidence.quote:
This is exactly what the Deku Scrub was talking about, there are 
three of them here and you have to catch them in the correct order.  That 
order was 2, 3, 1, from left to right.  So basically start by deflecting the 
Deku Nut back at the scrub in the middle, then the one on the far right and 
then the one on the far left.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: Queen Gohma is stunned by firing a Deku Seed into her eye using the Fairy Slingshot, allowing Link to slash her with his sword.

evidence.quote:
Hold the L/Z button to target her eye and tap the Fairy Slingshot button to fire a Deku Seed right 
into it, stunning the boss.  While the boss is stunned, run up to her and 
begin to slash her with your sword as many times as you possibly can.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: When Queen Gohma drops three eggs from the ceiling, a single strike kills each egg before it hatches.

evidence.quote:
After 
a few seconds she will drop three eggs down directly below where she is on the 
ceiling.  You now have a small amount of time to go and strike those eggs, one 
single hit will kill them however if you are not fast enough they will hatch 
into those little one eyed enemies you fought before.

facts.subject: Heart Container
facts.text: Defeating Queen Gohma rewards a full Heart Container, increasing Link's hearts to four.

evidence.quote:
When the battle is over there is a full HEART CONTAINER [001].  Your hearts 
have now been increased to four, that's pretty nice.

facts.subject: Kokiri's Emerald
facts.text: The Deku Tree gives Link the Kokiri's Emerald after speaking to him.

evidence.quote:
Listen to 
everything the Deku Tree has to say because it's all very important.  After 
the tree speaks it gives you the KOKIRI'S EMERALD.

facts.subject: Fairy Ocarina
facts.text: Saria gives Link the Fairy Ocarina at the western exit of Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
Simply run all the way west to the exit of the forest, a scene will 
take place between Link and Saria.  She will give Link the FAIRY OCARINA.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula appears behind the house in the southwest corner of Kokiri Forest only at night and can be collected with a jump attack.

evidence.quote:
Your destination is the southwest corner, go up the slope that 
lead you before to the fenced are and the crawlspace, but this time ignore the 
fences and go around behind the house up here to find a Gold Skulltula....To use the jump attack hold down the L/Z button and press 
the A button, Link will jump into the air a little and it should give him just 
enough height to grab hold of that GOLD SKULLTULA [004].  This enemy only 
appears in the village at night which is why you could not come here and get 
it before.

facts.subject: Hylian Shield
facts.text: The Bazaar in Hyrule Market sells a shield, but players should avoid purchasing it since the same shield can be obtained for free soon after.

evidence.quote:
The only noteworthy thing 
they sell here is the new shield however don't bother purchasing it at all, 
you're going to get the same shield soon enough, and for free.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: The Shooting Gallery targets appear in order: 1 center green, 2 left blue, 3 right blue, 4 center jumping green, 5 left blue and 6 right blue simultaneously, 7 and 8 right-to-left red, and 9 and 10 fast left-to-right red.

evidence.quote:
1 - The first one appears directly in the middle of the screen, a green one....2 - The second one is a blue one that moves in from the left side of the 
    screen toward the middle and stays just a bit to the left....3 - The third one comes in from the right side of the screen toward the 
    middle and stays just a bit right of the middle, a blue one....4 - The fourth is a green one which pops out of the middle, up into the air
    and then drops down, hit it at the highest point of the jump....5 - The next one is a blue Rupees similar to the second one however it comes
    from the left near the middle at the same time as number six
6 - Comes in at the same time as number five but from the right side, you
    have to hit both of them before they both exit the screen....7 - This is a red Rupee which moves at a moderate speed from the right side of 
    the screen to the left side of the screen, it will not stop.
8 - This is a red Rupee which moves at a moderate speed from the right side of 
    the screen to the left side of the screen, it will not stop.
9 - This is another red one which this time moves from the left side of the
    screen to the right side of the screen, quite quickly so aim fast.
10 - This is another red one which this time moves from the left side of the
     screen to the right side of the screen, quite quickly so aim fast.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Bringing the white dog found left of the main entrance back to the lady in the first door in the Back Alley at night rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Your goal is to find the fat lady's dog.  It may be 
randomized but for me, her dog was the white dog just left of the main 
entrance to town, left when you are looking directly at the entrance....Enter the first door with the 
dog following you (to get the dog to follow you simply walk up to it) and 
inside this house is the lady.  Assuming you brought her the correct dog she 
will reward you with your first PIECE OF HEART [001].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Rolling into the large tree directly in front of the entrance to Hyrule Castle causes a Gold Skulltula to drop down.

evidence.quote:
Note the large tree directly in front of 
you, what you want to do is run up to this tree and hit the A button to roll 
right into it.  You'll here the secret noise and a Gold Skulltula will drop 
out of the tree.  Defeat the enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [005].

facts.subject: Weird Egg
facts.text: Speaking to Malon beside the vine outside Hyrule Castle grants the Weird Egg.

evidence.quote:
Speak to the young girl beside you, next to the vine.  Twice if need be.  She 
should give you the WEIRD EGG.

facts.subject: Weird Egg
facts.text: The Weird Egg hatches into a Chicken in the morning after waiting through the night.

evidence.quote:
Stand 
at the top of the vines and just let the game sit through the night (game 
night I mean, not all night.)  In the morning when you hear the rooster, the 
egg you have will hatch into a CHICKEN.

facts.subject: Talon
facts.text: Equipping and using the Chicken beside Malon's sleeping father wakes him up.

evidence.quote:
At the end of the path you will find 
Malon's father there, sleeping on the job.  Since you can't wake him up by 
speaking to him, stand beside him and equip the Chicken.  Press the C button 
which corresponds to the Chicken and he'll be up and about in no time.

facts.subject: Waterfall Crawlspace
facts.text: Pushing two blocks off the ledge so one stacks on top of the other allows Link to jump to the waterfall crawlspace during the daytime.

evidence.quote:
Grab both blocks and push them off this ledge and that will allow 
you to get up close to the waterfall.  After you've pushed one block over the 
edge and the other block on top of the other one you can climb up on top of it 
and jump toward the waterfall.  Press the A button to crawl in through the 
crawlspace, note that you must go during the day, night will not work here.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: The Shooting Gallery costs 20 Rupees for fifteen shots to shoot down ten Rupees, awarding a free game for hitting eight targets and a Bullet Bag carrying 40 Deku Seeds instead of 30 for hitting all ten.

evidence.quote:
What you have to do in the Shooting Gallery is pay 20 
Rupees in order to begin the game.  You are given fifteen shots and you have 
to shoot down ten Rupees....If you manage to hit eight out of the ten targets then you will be rewarded 
with a free game, if you manage to hit ten out of the ten targets then you 
will be rewarded with a BULLET BAG for your Deku Seeds, this allows you to 
carry 40 Deku Seeds for use with your Fairy Slingshot instead of 30, and is 
quite a helpful item.

facts.subject: Death Mountain Trail
facts.text: Smashing the rock next to the bomb flower with the Megaton Hammer at night reveals Gold Skulltula 079.

evidence.quote: During the night you should hear something crawling around here, equip the Megaton Hammer and break the rock beside the bomb flower to find GOLD SKULLTULA [079].

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: Presenting the Broken Goron's Sword to Biggoron prompts him to give Link the Prescription for King Zora's Eyedrops.

evidence.quote: Make your way up the climbing wall and on your right at the top is the Biggoron.  Use the Broken Goron's Sword in front of him and he'll recognize it.  He says that before he can repair anything, he's going to need some Eyedrops from King Zora.  In return he gives you the PRESCRIPTION you need.

facts.subject: King Zora
facts.text: Using the Prescription in front of King Zora yields the Eyeball Frog, which must be delivered promptly to the Lake Hylia Laboratory.

evidence.quote: stand on the platform before the king and use the Prescription.  He will give you the EYEBALL FROG which is needed in order to fill the prescription, get it to the Lake Hylia Laboratory as soon as possible.

facts.subject: Lake Hylia Laboratory
facts.text: Handing the Eyeball Frog to the old man in the Lake Hylia Laboratory rewards Link with the World's Finest Eye Drops.

evidence.quote: Head for the lab and go inside, use the frog beside the old man here (approximate time remaining: plenty).  He'll give you WORLD'S FINEST EYE DROPS.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: Delivering the Eyedrops to Biggoron atop the mountain wall yields the Claim Check for the sword.

evidence.quote: Climb the wall after they are dead and use the Eyedrops in front of the Biggoron to get the CLAIM CHECK for the sword.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: Playing the Sun's Song roughly five times after handing over the Claim Check allows Link to receive the unbreakable Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song about five times or so and speak to him again to get the BIGGORON'S SWORD.

facts.subject: Biggoron's Sword
facts.text: Biggoron's Sword matches the attack power of the Giant's Knife without breaking, but prevents Link from using a shield simultaneously.

evidence.quote: The power of the sword is equivalent to that of the Giant's Knife except that unlike the knife, it cannot break.  Unfortunately you can't use it along with your shield, but with

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: The Gerudo Fortress shooting range costs twenty Rupees per round, requires Epona, and can only be entered during the daytime.

evidence.quote: The shooting range is located in the Gerudo Fortress, you must have Epona and head to the eastern area where all of the targets are located to begin.  The game can only be played during the day, the Gerudo to speak to will not appear at night.  Make sure you are on your horse when you speak to her and the game will begin.  The cost to play one round is twenty Rupees.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Each Horseback Archery attempt gives Link twenty arrows while Epona gallops on an automatic path, with target thresholds set at 1000 and 1500 points.

evidence.quote: You don't control the horse, it moves automatically and you simply fire.  You are given twenty arrows each time you try.  Prizes are awarded for 1000 and 1500 points.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Hitting pots earns 100 points each, while archery targets reward 100 points for the centre, 60 points for the middle ring, and 30 points for the edge.

evidence.quote: aim your bow and fire arrows at every single pot you pass, each one of them is worth 100 points.  After passing the last pot turn yourself forward and aim up at the target ahead of you.  Hitting the centre is worth 100 points, the outer circle is 60 points and the edge is 30 points.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Scoring 1000 points in Horseback Archery awards Piece of Heart 033.

evidence.quote: Your prize for successfully accumulating 1000 points is a PIECE OF HEART [033].

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Ground
facts.text: Accessing the Gerudo Training Ground requires paying ten Rupees to the guard on the southeastern side of Gerudo Fortress.

evidence.quote: The Gerudo Training Ground is located in the Gerudo Fortress, after you can walk around there freely, speak to the person on the southeastern side.  She'll let you enter the training ground for just a mere ten Rupees.

facts.subject: Entrance Room
facts.text: Shooting the eyeball switch located above the entrance door spawns a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Equip the Fairy Bow and do a 180 degree turn, above the door where you entered there is an eyeball switch, fire an arrow at it to spawn a small chest containing BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Stalfos Room
facts.text: Defeating the two Stalfos within the one-minute limit spawns a chest holding a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There are two Stalfos enemies in this room and you need to defeat them before the time limit of one minute runs out, obviously make sure you're using the Biggoron's Sword for this.  After killing them both a chest appears containing SMALL KEY, pick it up and go through the door beside the chest to enter the next hall.

facts.subject: Silver Rupee Boulder Hall
facts.text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees in the boulder room must be completed within a time limit of one minute and thirty seconds.

evidence.quote: In here you have one minute and thirty seconds to collect all the Silver Rupees.

facts.subject: Wolfos Room
facts.text: Defeating all four wolf enemies spawns a small chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Defeat the four wolf enemies in this room and then open the small chest appears to get a bunch of ARROWS.

facts.subject: Statue Eye Room
facts.text: Lighting up all four statue eyes in a circle with the Fairy Bow spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Jump down onto the platform in the centre and equip the Fairy Bow.  Shoot the eyeball of the statue and make your way around from left to right in a circle, shooting the eyeballs as you go along.  When all four of them are lit up a chest appears containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Statue Hammer Room
facts.text: Defeating all enemies in the statue hammer room spawns a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: There are a number of enemies in this room, all you really have to do is defeat them all and a chest will appear containing ARROWS.

facts.subject: Statue Hammer Room
facts.text: Stepping on the floor switch after smashing the statues lowers the flames around a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Shoot the eyeball switch to unlock the door and step on the button to lower the fire in the middle and allow you to open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Underwater Room
facts.text: Gathering all the underwater Silver Rupees using the Iron Boots and Longshot unlocks a small chest at the surface containing the fourth Small Key.

evidence.quote: When this is over, swim back up to the top and open the small chest to acquire the fourth SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Lizalfos Room
facts.text: Destroying the laser pillar with a Bomb after eliminating the two lizard enemies spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: When the two lizards are defeated, bomb the laser pillar and a chest appears with a SMALL KEY in it.

facts.subject: Song of Time Platform
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time creates blocks to reach an upper doorway leading to the sixth Small Key.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and some blocks will appear here.  use the Hover Boots to reach them and climb up.  Grab the sixth SMALL KEY and go through the door.

facts.subject: Upper Storage Hall
facts.text: Turning right past the door reveals a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Make a right here and it leads to a chest containing ARROWS.

facts.subject: Upper Storage Hall
facts.text: Opening the chest directly across from the doorway rewards Link with a Bombchu.

evidence.quote: Directly across from the door where you entered is a chest with a BOMBCHU in it.

facts.subject: Locked Door Maze
facts.text: Unlocking two consecutive doors on the left in the maze leads to a chest with a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: use two Small Keys to go through the locked door on your left and then the one after it as well, now you're down to four.  Open the chest to get a PURPLE RUPEE here.

facts.subject: Locked Door Maze
facts.text: Proceeding through the next two locked doors reveals a small chest with a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next locked door and the one after it, open the small chest containing a RED RUPEE.

facts.subject: Locked Door Maze
facts.text: Unlocking the subsequent door leads to a chest holding Arrows.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next door and open the chest to get ARROWS.

facts.subject: Ceiling Hidden Room
facts.text: Climbing the hidden fence wall spotted in the ceiling using the Lens of Truth leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Proceed through the door on the left which you unlocked and take a look at the ceiling with the Lens of Truth equipped, there is a hole up there.  Climb the fence wall and here you will find a chest containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: Targeting Queen Gohma's eye and firing a Deku Seed with the Fairy Slingshot stuns her, leaving her vulnerable to sword strikes.

evidence.quote: Hold the L/Z button to target her eye and tap the Fairy Slingshot button to fire a Deku Seed right into it, stunning the boss.  While the boss is stunned, run up to her and begin to slash her with your sword as many times as you possibly can.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: When Gohma scales the ceiling and drops three eggs, striking each egg once before it hatches eliminates the offspring.

evidence.quote: After a few seconds she'll drop three eggs down directly below where she is on the ceiling.  You now have a small amount of time to go and strike those eggs, one single hit will kill them however if you are not fast enough they will hatch into those little one eyed enemies you fought before.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: The ideal moment to shoot Gohma's eye is when she rears up on her back legs and her eye turns red.

evidence.quote: Target Gohma's eye and let her get close, while she is up on her back legs and the eye is red that is the best time to fire.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: Standing on the 45 degree slope bordering the path and central lava grants total immunity to all of King Dodongo's attacks.

evidence.quote: First of all you should acquaint yourself with the little 45 degree slope between the path you are on and the lava in the middle, while standing on this slope you are immune to all his attacks.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: Tossing a Bomb into King Dodongo's mouth while he inhales knocks him down, creating an opening for a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: What you have to do is lift a Bomb above your head while the boss is breathing in, and then throw it into his mouth.  When the Bomb explodes the boss drops down and that is your chance to hit him exactly once.  Use the Jump Attack when he falls.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: Dodging King Dodongo's roll attack is accomplished by standing on the sloping ledge.

evidence.quote: After the boss gets up he will roll down and around the corner, dodge this attack easily by standing on that little sloping area like I told you.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: King Dodongo requires only four standard hits or three Jump Attacks to be defeated.

evidence.quote: It should take only four hits to kill the boss with normal attacks, and as little as three with the Jump Attack.  He will never be able to use his fire breath as long as you always throw a Bomb into his mouth.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Reaching 1500 points in Horseback Archery awards the Biggest Quiver.

evidence.quote: Your prize for managing to get 1500 points, which is actually quite difficult, is the BIGGEST QUIVER which increases your maximum arrow carrying

facts.subject: Central Treasure Room
facts.text: The final locked room holds a giant chest containing the Ice Arrow.

evidence.quote: Inside the giant chest is the ICE ARROW, like the Fire Arrow it is a special elemental type of arrow you can shoot using the Fairy

facts.subject: Giant Octorok
facts.text: The Giant Octorok is stunned when hit with the Boomerang, exposing the weak green spot on its back to sword slashes.

evidence.quote: The weapon of choice for this battle is of course going to be the Boomerang so make sure it is equipped... When you hit the miniboss with your Boomerang, he is stunned for a moment but his only weakspot it on the back so you have to run around the circle and try to get his back before he starts up again.

facts.subject: Giant Octorok
facts.text: Getting hit by the Giant Octorok deals half a heart of damage, while the middle spikes deal a quarter heart of damage.

evidence.quote: If he hits you, you're going to lose half a heart piece and if the spikes along the middle thing hit you, you're going to lose a quarter heart piece.

facts.subject: Giant Octorok
facts.text: The Giant Octorok takes about three hits to defeat.

evidence.quote: He takes about three hits.

facts.subject: Pots
facts.text: All of the pots around Barinade's room contain Recovery Hearts.

evidence.quote: all of the pots around the room each contain a Recovery Heart which should be enough to get you back to full from being almost dead.

facts.subject: Barinade
facts.text: Barinade is vulnerable to the Boomerang, which must be used to sever its three ceiling tentacles before stunning its body and attacking with the sword.

evidence.quote: Use the L/Z button to lock onto the three things that attach the boss to the ceiling and hit all three of them individually with the Boomerang... Aim for the main body part and throw your Boomerang to stun it, if it turns blue then you know it's stunned. Slash it as much as possible with your sword until you can't hurt it anymore.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: During his first phase, the real Phantom Ganon emerges from a painting through a purple portal and can be struck by firing the Fairy Bow into the portal before he attacks.

evidence.quote: The other will jump out of the painting through a purple portal and shoot a huge electricity blast at the ground which goes in all directions... You should have been aiming your Fairy Bow the whole time, when the portal appears fire into the middle of the portal and Phantom Ganon will be hit, turning around and not attacking.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: Phantom Ganon transitions to his second phase after taking three hits.

evidence.quote: After three hits the second phase starts.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: In his second phase, Phantom Ganon's energy blasts can be deflected back at him with the Master Sword to stun him.

evidence.quote: What he does is float around and fire this energy blast at you. The energy blast can be deflected with the Master Sword back at him for damage.

facts.subject: Flare Dancer
facts.text: Targeting the Flare Dancer with the Hookshot pulls its core out of the flames so it can be attacked.

evidence.quote: Make sure you have the Hookshot equipped and target the Flare Dancing using the L/Z button. Hit the Hookshot button and you should be able to pull the actual, hit-able section of the boss out.

facts.subject: Flare Dancer
facts.text: The Flare Dancer is defeated after its core is caught and damaged about three or four times.

evidence.quote: four times and the miniboss will quickly fall victim to your blade.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Volvagia emerges randomly from one of nine holes and can be stunned and damaged using only the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: Forget absolutely every weapon and item for this battle with the one exception being the Megaton Hammer, it's your only weapon. There are nine holes in the field here and the boss will randomly pop out of one of them... After that you have a window to run up and slam him with the Megaton Hammer. Doing so will make him swing his flaming hair one more time and then drop, allowing you to go in with the hammer for a second hit.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Volvagia is defeated after about five or six successful hammer attack cycles.

evidence.quote: About five or six successful runs for the win.

facts.subject: Shadow Link
facts.text: Shadow Link mimics Link's attacks and deflects strikes easily if targeted with L/Z, so fighting without L/Z targeting prevents him from lining up deflections.

evidence.quote: First of all Shadow Link will mimic every attack that you do, so if you target him with L/Z and then keep using the overhead swing, you'll clash swords until the end of time. What you really want to do is avoid using L/Z targeting, that way he won't be able to line up his deflection swings as easily.

facts.subject: Shadow Link
facts.text: Using a stab attack against Shadow Link causes him to jump onto the sword and strike back every time.

evidence.quote: is to avoid using the stab, he'll jump on your sword and hit you every time.

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: Morpha's tentacles deal about one heart of damage on contact and upwards of three hearts if Link is grabbed.

evidence.quote: If one of them lands on you, you take about one heart worth of damage, but if one of them grabs hold of you, it can deal upwards of three hearts, this attack is very powerful!

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: Firing the Longshot at Morpha as it moves through a tentacle pulls the amoeba core out of the water where it can be attacked with sword slashes or Spin Attacks.

evidence.quote: Take aim near the end of the tentacle with your Longshot and fire at Morpha to suck it out of the water and leave it open to attack... After getting it out of the water you can attack with your sword. I recommend using the Spin Attack, the one where you press B after spinning the analog stick.

facts.subject: Deadhand
facts.text: Deadhand is lured out when Link is grabbed by one of the hands in the room, exposing its head to a Jump Attack when it lowers down.

evidence.quote: There are four hand things coming up in the corners or this room, when you get close to the hands they grab at you and hold you in place... It also has another side effect, it makes the boss appear... When he lowers his head down press the A button to do a Jump Attack for a good damage.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Striking one of Bongo Bongo's hands turns it blue and causes it to drop an arrow or a magic bottle.

evidence.quote: When you hit one hand it will turn blue and drop an item, either an arrow or a magic bottle, both of which you will be needing for this battle.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Equipping the Lens of Truth allows Link to see Bongo Bongo, shoot his eye with the Fairy Bow, and defeat him in two knockdowns using the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: Once both hands are hit then position yourself in the middle of the map, between them and facing them, and equip the Lens of Truth.  Only using this will you actually be able to see the boss.  Take aim with your Fairy Bow and fire at his eye.  When you do this the boss drops and you are free to go in with the Biggoron's Sword swinging like crazy.  The thing about this boss is that using the Biggoron's Sword, you only have to do this twice, the boss will die on the second set of sword swings, so this is why I say offensive is so good.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: Iron Knuckle attacks deal up to 4 hearts of damage, and dodging the attacks to perform jump attacks takes at least seven or eight hits to defeat him.

evidence.quote: His attacks can deal up to four hearts worth of damage.  He has two types of attacks, a double horizontal slash and a powerful over head slash.  The basic tactic for both of them is the same, avoid it and use the jump attack.
this guy, even using the jump attack it's at least seven or eight.

facts.subject: Twinrova
facts.text: In the first phase of Twinrova, deflecting an ice or fire beam with the Mirror Shield at the opposite sister advances the fight after two or three hits.

evidence.quote: In order to defeat the bosses what you have to do is deflect the beam of one boss and aim it at another boss.  The beam is constant so you'll be able to swing it around for a couple seconds in hope of hitting the other boss...Each of them must take two or three hits before the second phase begins.

facts.subject: Twinrova
facts.text: In Twinrova's second phase, absorbing three matching fire or ice attacks with the Mirror Shield blasts her out of the sky, requiring two knockouts with the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: You need to absorb three of the same elements in a row and then that will fire off a blast at the boss and knock her down...With the Biggoron's Sword you should only have to knock her out two times before she dies.

facts.subject: Twinrova
facts.text: Defeating Twinrova awards a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: Defeating the boss nets you a HEART CONTAINER after the scene, then as usual

facts.subject: Twinrova
facts.text: Defeating Twinrova leads to seeing the sages and receiving the Spirit Medallion.

evidence.quote: you will be brought to see the sages and be given the SPIRIT MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: Deflecting Ganondorf's energy blasts with the Biggoron's Sword, shooting him with a Light Arrow, and attacking with Jump Attacks defeats him in 3 knockdowns.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf will fire an energy blast at you, deflect it with your sword and he'll deflect it back.  Keep doing this over and over again until eventually it hits him.  At this point you have a very short window of time to bring up a Light Arrow and fire it at him...Doing this it will only take a mere three
knock downs to actually take him out, but the battle isn't over yet.

facts.subject: Ganon
facts.text: During the first phase against Ganon without the Master Sword, Link can roll under his legs and strike his tail with the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer, or stun his face with a Light Arrow.

evidence.quote: The first thing of course that you will notice when this battle begins is that you do not have your Master Sword for the fight, there are two weapons of choice here, obviously the Biggoron's Sword takes top place but given that you won't necessarily have it, the Megaton Hammer comes second...The tactic to use here is relatively simple, with whatever weapon you are using, roll under Ganon's legs and slash like crazy at his tail...The alternative to this is targeting his face with the L/Z button and firing a Light Arrow to stun him, then simply running around behind and doing the same thing.

facts.subject: Ganon
facts.text: Zelda returns the Master Sword at the battle's halfway point, and only a swing of the Master Sword can strike the final blow to defeat Ganon.

evidence.quote: At about the half way point Ganon will fall and Zelda will allow you to grab the Master Sword again...The battle can only be won with a swing of the
Master Sword, no other weapon will suffice.  Strike the final blow and...

evidence.quote: You will find this when going through...the Spirit Temple as an adult, it's...required in order to finish the temple.

evidence.quote: After getting the Odd Medicine from the...person in Kakariko Village, bring it back...to the Lost Woods and give it to girl....This item is part of the sidequest

facts.subject: Inner Garden Window

evidence.quote: Equip the Fairy Slingshot and aim right at the window, when you fire it a Red Rupee will pop out, that's worth twenty!

facts.subject: Princess Zelda
facts.text: Approaching and speaking with Princess Zelda gives Link Zelda's Letter.

evidence.quote: When you're ready then approach Princess Zelda and speak with her.  After a long speech she gives you a letter, ZELDA'S LETTER.

facts.subject: Impa
facts.text: Speaking with Impa at the exit of Hyrule Castle teaches Link the first song for the Fairy Ocarina.

evidence.quote: Leave Zelda and speak with the person at the exit, Impa.  She will teach you our first song for the Fairy Ocarina.

facts.subject: Super Cucco minigame
facts.text: Finding all three Super Cuccos in thirty seconds for ten Rupees earns Lon Lon Milk in an Empty Bottle from Talon.

evidence.quote: Speak with Talon and for ten Rupees you can challenge yourself to try to find all three Super Cuccos in thirty seconds....After you have located all three of the Super Cuccos, Talon will reward your with some LON LON MILK.  It's not actually the milk that is worth it but rather the EMPTY BOTTLE that you have after the milk is gone.

facts.subject: Tree Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Rolling into the only tree in the horse area reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields token 006.

evidence.quote: run up to the tree and roll into it to hear the secret sound and reveal a Gold Skulltula.  Defeat this enemy to acquire yet another GOLD SKULLTULA [006].

facts.subject: Stone Tower Crawlspace
facts.text: Moving the upper-right box and upper-left box inside the stone tower accesses a crawlspace leading to Piece of Heart 002.

evidence.quote: The upper right most box, the one beside the cow should be pulled down toward the door.  After one pull go to the other side and push it down.  Now grab hold of the box in the upper left corner, the corner you want to access and pull it to the right.  You should now be able to get to the crawlspace.  Press the A button to get into the crawlspace and at the end you will find a PIECE OF HEART [002].

facts.subject: Malon
facts.text: Using the Fairy Ocarina to play along with Malon in the middle of Lon Lon Ranch teaches Epona's Song.

evidence.quote: Use your Ocarina and she should teach you the notes to the song, play along with it and you will learn EPONA'S SONG.

facts.subject: Cow
facts.text: Playing Epona's Song beside a cow with an Empty Bottle yields free Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: Take an Empty Bottle and head over to a cow.  Stand beside it and whip out the Fairy Ocarina.  Play Epona's Song, up, left, right, up left, right and the cow will give you free Lon Lon Milk, as will other cows.

facts.subject: Feeding Area Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Visiting the feeding area behind the inner horse fence at night reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields token 007.

evidence.quote: Re-enter Lon Lon Ranch at night.  Make your way all the way around to the south side of the ranch, note on your map that there is kind of a little feeding area just along the edge of the horse fence, not the outer wall of the ranch, the inner fence.  What you want to do is go around behind this little area and there you will find another GOLD SKULLTULA [007], be sure to defeat it and add another token to the collection.

facts.subject: Tree Target
facts.text: Shooting the exact centre of the target circle three times in a row with the Fairy Slingshot awards a Bullet Bag upgrading seed capacity from 40 to 50.

evidence.quote: Whip out your trust Fairy Slingshot and fire a seed at the exact centre of the circle, you'll know you hit the centre if the number 100 pops up.  Hit it exactly three times in a row and something good will happen, a Deku Scrub will come out and give you another BULLET BAG, this time upgrading the amount of seeds you can carry from 40 to 50.

facts.subject: Wolf
facts.text: Target the wolf with L/Z, deflect its attacks with the R shield button, and perform a jumping slash with the A button right after it attacks.

evidence.quote: Target the wolf with the L/Z button and then while targeting hold your shield with the R button to deflect attacks.  Now when you think you have a clear shot, for example right after he attacks, press the A button to do the jumping slash which is quite powerful.

facts.subject: Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Dropping down the hole between ladders in Sacred Forest Meadow leads to a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: There is a hole down at the bottom of this area, when you drop down the hole you'll find a Fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Saria
facts.text: Ascending the large staircase to reach Saria results in learning Saria's Song.

evidence.quote: Return to that large staircase and ascend it to reach the top where you will find Saria.  She will teach you SARIA'S SONG which will

facts.subject: Ocarina Minigame
facts.text: Memorizing and playing back songs of five, six, and eight notes on the tree stump earns a Green Rupee, a Blue Rupee, and Piece of Heart 003.

evidence.quote: They will gradually move up to a song with five notes to it, simply listen and look at what they play and then play it yourself.  The prize for winning this is a GREEN RUPEE.  Agree to play again and this time you will have to follow along up to six notes instead of five.  Your reward for completing this challenge will be a BLUE RUPEE.  Finally there is one more that involves you playing and memorizing eight notes.  It shouldn't be too difficult and your reward for this far exceeds the previous two, you get a PIECE OF HEART [003] for completing it successfully.

facts.subject: Skull Kid Tree Stump
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song while standing on the tree stump rewards Link with Piece of Heart 004.

evidence.quote: Jump onto the tree stump and press the C button associated with your Fairy Ocarina.  Play Saria's Song while standing on this stump and the kid will give you yet another PIECE OF HEART [004].

facts.subject: Deku Scrub Merchant
facts.text: Deflecting a Deku Nut back at the scrub behind the pillars allows purchasing the Deku Stick Upgrade for 40 Rupees to carry 20 Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote: There you will find a Deku Scrub hidden behind one of the pillars.  Use your shield and deflect a Deku Nut back at him.  After doing so approach the Deku Scrub and speak to him.  You can purchase the DEKU STICK UPGRADE from this little scrub, for the low low price of 40 Rupees he will enable you to be able to carry around 20 Deku Sticks, it's well worth the price.

facts.subject: House Side Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Climbing the stairs to the right past the central tree at night reveals a Skulltula on the side of a house that yields token 008.

evidence.quote: When you have the first opportunity to make a right, do so and climb up the stairs.  Make a right at the top of the stairs and you will come across a Skulltula crawling on the side of the house, eliminate this enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [008].

facts.subject: Brick Wall Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Climbing past the central tree up to the brick area reveals a Skulltula crawling on the brick wall that yields token 009.

evidence.quote: climb the stairs straight ahead of you and turn around to find another set of stairs going even higher, up to that kind of brick area.  Here you will find another Skulltula crawling around on the brick wall, eliminate it and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [009].

facts.subject: Lookout Tower Ladder Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Firing two Deku Seeds at the Skulltula crawling on the tall tower ladder allows climbing up to acquire token 010.

evidence.quote: When you get up there move to the north side of that tall tower, then pull out your Fairy Slingshot and aim up at it.  Crawling around on the ladder is yet another Skulltula, fire two Deku Seeds at this enemy and then climb up the ladder to acquire the GOLD SKULLTULA [010].

facts.subject: Dampe Gravedigging Tour
facts.text: Paying Dampe 10 Rupees to dig on the dirt patches along the stone path can yield Piece of Heart 005.

evidence.quote: The old man Dampe should be wandering around the graveyard here, when you speak to him he offers to dig up a portion of the ground for the low low price of 10 Rupees.  The only purpose of doing this is to hope you acquire the PIECE OF HEART [005]...What you're trying to do is speak to him and have him dig while he's on the patches of dirt on the stone path, not the stone path itself, if you look you'll see them.

facts.subject: Royal Family Tombstone
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem destroys the large tombstone and reveals the entrance to the Royal Tomb.

evidence.quote: Now what you want to do is head over to the east side of the graveyard beside the large tombstone and stand on the Triforce emblem on the ground.  Use your Fairy Ocarina and play Zelda's Lullaby, which is left, up, right, left, up, right.  After doing this there is a large explosion and the tombstone is destroyed, revealing a path down into the ground.

facts.subject: Royal Tomb First Room Door
facts.text: Eliminating the four bats perched on the walls with the Fairy Slingshot unlocks the door in the Royal Tomb.

evidence.quote: What you will want to do is equip the Fairy Slingshot and use it to eliminate the four bats you see perched on the walls here.  After doing that the door will be unlocked and you can climb up the ledge and continue through it.

facts.subject: Royal Tomb Wall Inscription
facts.text: Playing the melody written on the wall inscription at the end of the Royal Tomb teaches the Sun's Song.

evidence.quote: When you reach the end of the tomb take a look at the inscription on the wall.  You will notice that below it there is some kind of melody already written on there, perhaps you should play it.  After doing so you learn the SUN'S SONG.

facts.subject: Pocket Cucco
facts.text: The Pocket Cucco hatches overnight after obtaining the Pocket Egg from the woman in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After speaking to the woman in Kakariko...wait overnight and it will hatch.

facts.subject: Pocket Egg
facts.text: As Adult Link, speak to the woman beside the chicken coop in Kakariko Village to receive the Pocket Egg.

evidence.quote: As Adult Link, head to Kakariko Village...and speak to the woman beside the chicken...coop and she will give you this item.

facts.subject: Prescription
facts.text: Link receives the Prescription from Biggoron on top of Death Mountain by bringing him the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote: You will get this from the Biggoron on...top of Death Mountain if you bring him...the Broken Goron's Sword originally.

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: Collecting a Purple Rupee adds fifty Rupees to Link's total accumulated Rupees.

evidence.quote: adds to your total accumulated Rupees,...this particular one gives fifty Rupees..

evidence.quote: adds to your total accumulated Rupees,...this particular one gives twenty Rupees.

facts.subject: Shadow Medallion
facts.text: After completing the Shadow Temple, Impa entrusts the Shadow Medallion to Link in the chamber.

evidence.quote: After completing the Shadow Temple then...and Impa will entrust this to Link.

facts.subject: Silver Gauntlets
facts.text: Young Link finds the Silver Gauntlets as the primary target in the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote: You will find these in the Spirit Temple...as Young Link, they are your primary...target when going through the temple.

facts.subject: Silver Gauntlets
facts.text: As an Adult, the Silver Gauntlets allow Link to push and pull extremely large objects with his bare hands.

evidence.quote: As an Adult, the Silver Gauntlets allow...you to push and pull extremely large...objects with your bare hands alone.

facts.subject: Silver Rupee
facts.text: Collecting Silver Rupees awards five Rupees and acts as a means to open locked doors.

evidence.quote: Not only do they give you five Rupees...means to open locked doors as well.

facts.subject: Silver Scale
facts.text: The Silver Scale is won in Zora's Domain by playing the Diving Game found down the tunnel to the left of the king.

evidence.quote: In Zora's Domain, go up to the king...find the Diving Game where you win it.

facts.subject: Silver Scale
facts.text: The Silver Scale extends Link's diving time from the normal 3 seconds to a total of 6 seconds.

evidence.quote: Instead of the normal three seconds, this...scale allows you to dive deeper under...the water for a total of six seconds.

facts.subject: Skull Mask
facts.text: Link can borrow the Skull Mask from the Happy Mask Shop after acquiring all three Spiritual Stones.

evidence.quote: After you have acquiried all three of...the Spiritual Stones, head back to the...Happy Mask shop and borrow this one.

facts.subject: Skull Mask
facts.text: Give the Skull Mask to the Skull Kid found by taking a left turn at the first fork in The Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Give it to the Skull Kid in The Lost...Woods, the one you find when you...make a left turn at the first fork.

facts.subject: Spirit Medallion
facts.text: After completing the Spirit Temple, Link appears in the chamber and receives the Spirit Medallion from Nabooru.

evidence.quote: After completing the Spirit Temple then...and the Gerudo gives this to you.

facts.subject: Spooky Mask
facts.text: Bring the Spooky Mask to the Kakariko Village Graveyard during the day and give it to the kid impersonating Dampe.

evidence.quote: Take it to the Kakariko Village Graveyard...during the day and give it to the kid...wandering around impersonating Dampe.

facts.subject: Stone of Agony
facts.text: Return to the house in Kakariko Village after collecting 20 Gold Skulltula tokens to receive the Stone of Agony.

evidence.quote: When you have collected 20 Gold Skulltula...tokens, return to Kakariko Village...and get this as a reward from the house.

facts.subject: Stone of Agony
facts.text: The Stone of Agony sends a rumble signal to the controller whenever a secret is nearby.

evidence.quote: This special item will send a rumble...signal to your controller whenever...there is some sort of secret nearby.

facts.subject: Water Medallion
facts.text: After completing the Water Temple, Ruto entrusts the Water Medallion to Link in the chamber.

evidence.quote: After completing the Water Temple then...and Ruto will entrust this to Link.

facts.subject: Weird Egg
facts.text: Malon gives Link the Weird Egg at Hyrule Castle past the Market when Link agrees to help wake up her father.

evidence.quote: Malon gives it to you when you agree...to go and help wake up her father...after the Market at the Hyrule Castle.

facts.subject: World's Finest Eye Drops
facts.text: Bring the Eyeball Frog to the research laboratory in Lake Hylia to receive the World's Finest Eye Drops.

evidence.quote: Bring the Eyeball Frog to the research...laboratory in Lake Hylia and the guy...there will give you this item for it.

facts.subject: Zelda's Letter
facts.text: Princess Zelda gives Link Zelda's Letter with her autograph after meeting her for the first time in Hyrule Castle.

evidence.quote: After meeting with Princess Zelda for the...first time in Hyrule Castle, she will...give you this letter with her autograph.

facts.subject: Zelda's Letter
facts.text: Giving Zelda's Letter to the guard in Kakariko Village allows Link to pass through the gate and up Death Mountain.

evidence.quote: Give it to the guard in Kakariko...Village and he will allow you to pass...through the gate and up up Death Mt.

facts.subject: Zora Mask
facts.text: The Zora Mask can be borrowed from the shop at any time after selling all four normal masks.

evidence.quote: After you have sold all four of the...normal masks you can then borrow this...one from the shop any time you want.

facts.subject: Zora Tunic
facts.text: King Zora gives Link the Zora Tunic after being unfrozen in Zora's Domain following completion of the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: After completing the Ice Cavern, head...back to Zora's Domain and un-freeze...the King of the Zora, he gives you this.

facts.subject: Zora Tunic
facts.text: Wearing the Zora Tunic allows Link to breathe underwater forever.

evidence.quote: The Zora Tunic is a special piece of...clothing for Link to wear that allows...him to breathe underwater forever.

facts.subject: Zora's Sapphire
facts.text: The Zora princess entrusts Zora's Sapphire to Link after completing Inside of Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

evidence.quote: After you complete the Inside of Jabu-...Jabu's Belly, then the Zora princess...will entrust this artifact to Link.

facts.subject: Graveyard
facts.text: Playing the Sun's Song in the secret grave beneath the fourth tombstone from the south on the second row makes a chest appear containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: The fourth tombstone from the right (south) is going to have a hidden path below it, drop down and defeat the zombie, then stand on those little steps and equip your Fairy Ocarina.  Play the Sun's Song, right, down, up, right, down, up and a treasure chest should appear right in front of you.  Open this treasure chest to get the PIECE OF HEART [006].

facts.subject: Graveyard
facts.text: Pulling back the tombstone with three small plants growing in front of it reveals a secret hole with a chest containing a free Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote: Return to where you enter the graveyard and head up toward the first tombstones, note that one of the ones right in front of you has three small plants growing in front of it.  What you want to do is grab hold of this tombstone with the A button and then pull it backward to reveal a secret hole.  Open the small chest here to acquire a HYLIAN SHIELD, the one I told you not to purchase before because you get it here for free.

facts.subject: Kakariko Village
facts.text: Gliding over the fence near the village entrance leads to a hole containing a small treasure chest with a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Notice that beside the large fence is a smaller fence that actually extends out further toward you, this fence you CAN barely glide over so do that now, you'll land beside a door... Jump down behind you and you'll land beside a hole, drop down into the hole and open the small treasure chest to acquire a RED RUPEE.

facts.subject: Cucco Lady
facts.text: Returning all seven Cuccos to the pen rewards Link with an Empty Bottle from the woman.

evidence.quote: Now all you have to do is find those two which you threw over the fence for later and that takes care of all seven.  Speak to the girl and she will reward you nicely with another EMPTY BOTTLE.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Collecting at least ten Gold Skulltula tokens frees the man on the right side of the House of Skulltula, who rewards Link with the Adult's Wallet.

evidence.quote: Assuming you have collected at least ten, the guy on the right side of the house will be free and he will reward you with the ADULT'S WALLET.

facts.subject: Hyrule Castle Town
facts.text: Rolling into the two crates at the back of the room right beside the drawbridge entrance reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: go through the door right beside the drawbridge entrance and begin filling this new wallet of yours with plenty of Rupees.  While you're here there is a Skulltula you can collect which was not mentioned before, note the two crates at the back of the room?  Run into them and roll with the A button to break them open, one will reveal a Skulltula inside.  Defeat this enemy in order to acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [011].

facts.subject: Death Mountain Trail Gate
facts.text: Showing Zelda's Letter to the guard beside the northern gate in Kakariko Village causes him to open the gate to Death Mountain.

evidence.quote: Approach the guard beside the gate at the north side of town.  Equip Zelda's Letter on one of your C buttons and use it while standing directly in front of the guard.  After seeing the letter the guard has no choice but to open the gate for you and allow you to pass

facts.subject: Darunia
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song for Darunia in Goron City prompts him to give Link the Goron's Bracelet, which allows picking up bombs from Bomb Flowers.

evidence.quote: After speaking with him, stand in front of the large Goron and play Saria's Song.  The Goron will be so happy that you played the song, and offers the Spiritual Stone of Fire if you head for the Dodongo's Cave and rid it of all the monsters.  He also gives you the GORON'S BRACELET which will allow you to pick up bombs from Bomb Flowers and use them.

facts.subject: Goron City
facts.text: Lighting all four torches outside Darunia's room causes the large pot in the middle of Goron City to spin.

evidence.quote: When all four of the torches are lit, the large pot in the middle begins to spin around and around.

facts.subject: Goron City
facts.text: Lighting the Bomb Flowers on the upper level opens a secret shortcut tunnel leading from Goron City to the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: climb the stairs and light the two torches on the next level up.  After doing that go down the hall past the torches and light the Bomb Flowers here.  What you have just done is blast open a secret tunnel which takes you to the Lost Woods, a great shortcut from Goron City.

facts.subject: Death Mountain Trail
facts.text: Throwing a bomb from the Bomb Flower over the cliff blasts away the boulder blocking the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Grab a bomb from the Bomb Flower, hold up on the analog stick and press A to throw it over the edge.  The camera should change to give you a view of Dodongo's Cavern, if you threw the bomb correctly then it will completely blast the boulder blocking the entrance to bits.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Throwing a bomb from a Bomb Flower destroys the sturdy entrance door of Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Right away you are greeted by a strong sturdy door which will not allow you to pass.  The solution to this is simple, just grab one of the bombs out of the Bomb Flowers and throw it at the door, the explosion should make short work of it.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Blowing open the destructible wall with an exploding slug leads to a room where a Gold Skulltula is found on the wall behind a torch.

evidence.quote: Kill at least one of these enemies near the door and allow it to explode, revealing a secret path.  Take this secret path into a room with a single torch... There is a Skulltula here on the wall, defeat it and use the jumping attack to acquire another GOLD SKULLTULA [012].

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Dragging a statue onto the large blue button holds it down and keeps the gate blocking the door open.

evidence.quote: climb up onto the higher platform where you will find a large blue button.  When you step on this button the gate blocking the door disappears... What you have to do is grab hold of one of those statues on the side using the A button, and drag it on top of the button so it holds the button down, then you are free to climb up to the doorway and go through it without any problem.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: The two Lizalfos in the locked room can be defeated by blocking an attack with the shield and countering with a jump attack while targeting.

evidence.quote: This room is the battlefield for a duel between you and two sword wielding lizard monsters... A safe way to win is to simply block an attack then go in with one of your own, defending and them using the jump attack by locking on and pressing the A button is an effective tactic

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: A Deku Scrub inside Dodongo's Cavern sells Deku Sticks for 15 Rupees apiece.

evidence.quote:
This scrub will sell you Deku Sticks at 15 
Rupees apiece, you'll need a few but I'm sure you likely already have some.

facts.subject: Torch puzzle
facts.text: Lighting all three unlit torches with a lit Deku Stick opens the door at the end of the hall.

evidence.quote:
Whip out a Deku Stick and then light it on fire 
using the torch in this room, use that Deku Stick to light all of the other 
three torches and that will open the door at the end of the hall.

facts.subject: Cracked wall
facts.text: Blasting open the cracked wall beside the platform reveals a large treasure chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Grab 
a bomb from out of the Bomb Flower and use it on the cracked wall beside you, 
this wall will crumble and reveal a large treasure chest inside.  Open the 
chest to acquire the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Enormous chest
facts.text: Defeating the living statue enemy with a bomb and sword slash allows Link to open an enormous chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
You can only kill it with a bomb and it 
only comes alive once you touch it, so the solution is to throw a bomb at it, 
then when the bomb glows red, slash the enemy with your sword and run like 
hell.  That should take care of him no problem.  Open the enormous chest and 
you will receive the COMPASS for this dungeon, that will come in handy, now we 
can start using more accurate directions, keep an eye on your minimap.

facts.subject: Bomb Flower chain
facts.text: Placing a bomb in the empty middle space between the Bomb Flowers sets off a chain reaction that lowers the central structure into stairs.

evidence.quote:
there is a single Bomb 
Flower growing near the door you just came through, and there is no 
Bomb Flower growing in the exact middle of all the other ones.  The solution 
of course is to take the bomb from out of the flower beside the door and set 
it down in that empty space.  When the bomb explodes it will also ignite the 
two bombs on its left and right, and then they will ignite the next two etc.  
Eventually when all is said, done, and blown up, those explosions weakened the 
concrete structure in the middle and now you can climb up the stairs.

facts.subject: Climbable wall
facts.text: Above the stairs, a Gold Skulltula crawls on the wall above a normal Skulltula and can be defeated using the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
When you arrive you'll notice that there is a Skulltula crawling around on the 
wall which you can kill with a Jump Attack, and above it is a Gold Skulltula 
which you can kill using your Fairy Slingshot.  This wall is climb-able, so 
climb up and grab your GOLD SKULLTULA [013] then head through the door.

facts.subject: Pillar chest
facts.text: A small chest located on a pillar with a Bomb Flower contains a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote:
drop down onto the pillar with the Bomb Flower and the small chest 
containing a RED RUPEE.

facts.subject: Bomb wall
facts.text: To blast down the wall at the top of the ladder, Link must hold a bomb until it flashes rapidly and wait approximately one second before throwing it.

evidence.quote:
Your timing for this next thing has to be perfect, 
lift a bomb above your head and wait.  Let it start flashing red and keep 
holding it.  When it starts flashing extremely fast, wait approximately one 
second or so and then throw the bomb at the wall at the top of the ladder.  It 
should blast it down.

facts.subject: Eyeball switches
facts.text: Shooting the eyeball switches above the doors with the Fairy Slingshot extinguishes the blocking flames.

evidence.quote:
Equip your Fairy Slingshot and aim it up at the eyeball above the door at the 
end here.  Now that the flames have been extinguished, jump across to the door 
on the other side and proceed through the hall....Extinguish the flame by using your Fairy Slingshot to fire up at the eyeball 
above the door.  After the flame has been extinguished, jump to the platform 
and aim left.  There is another eyeball in here which will extinguish the 
second flame.

facts.subject: Large treasure chest
facts.text: A large treasure chest contains the Bomb Bag, which comes equipped with a maximum carrying capacity of 20 bombs.

evidence.quote:
here inside the 
large treasure chest you will find the BOMB BAG.  The Bomb Bag allows you to 
place bombs yourself rather than relying on Bomb Flowers, this particular bag 
comes equipped with a maximum carrying capacity of 20 bombs.

facts.subject: Bridge wall chest
facts.text: Blasting open the wall past the large bridge reveals a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Use your 
newly acquired Bomb Bag to blast open this wall and reveal a small chest 
containing a BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Giant skull mouth
facts.text: Dropping a bomb into each of the two bridge gaps illuminates both eye cavities and opens the giant skull's mouth.

evidence.quote:
Now on your way back, note that there are two gaps 
in the bridge.  Stand right at the edge of the first gap and use a bomb.  Drop 
it down the gap and wait for it to explode.  It should land in the eye cavity 
and make the little secret noise.  Now do the same thing, drop another bomb 
down the other bridge gap and when both eyes are illuminated, the mouth opens.

facts.subject: Statue
facts.text: Behind a movable statue in the north room of the cavern lies a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote:
Drop a bomb beside the statue in this room, kill it if you wish but all 
that matters is that it gets out of the way because behind it is another GOLD 
SKULLTULA [014].  Grab the token and leave the room.

facts.subject: Small treasure chest
facts.text: Opening the small treasure chest through the west door yields Bombs.

evidence.quote:
When 
you're ready, head through the west door and open the small treasure chest 
here to acquire BOMBS.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: Standing on the 45 degree slope between the path and central lava grants immunity to all of King Dodongo's attacks.

evidence.quote:
First of all you should 
acquaint yourself with the little 45 degree slope between the path you are on 
and the lava in the middle, while standing on this slope you are immune to all 
his attacks.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: Throwing a bomb into King Dodongo's mouth as he breathes in stuns him for a Jump Attack, taking as few as three Jump Attacks or four normal attacks to defeat him.

evidence.quote:
He stops and begins to suck in air for 
his fire breath attack which launches a blast of fire down the path and around 
the corner.  What you have to do is lift a bomb above your head while the boss 
is breathing in, and then throw it into his mouth.  When the bomb explodes the 
boss drops down and that is your chance to hit him exactly once.  Use the Jump 
Attack when he falls....It should take only four hits to kill the boss with normal 
attacks, and as little as three with the Jump Attack.  He will never be able 
to use his fire breath as long as you always throw a bomb into his mouth.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: Defeating King Dodongo leaves behind a Heart Container in the middle of the room.

evidence.quote:
When the boss is defeated he will roll himself into the lava in 
the middle of the map and then just die, solidifying it in the process.  Grab 
the HEART CONTAINER from the middle of the room and take the warp back 
outside.

facts.subject: Spinning urn
facts.text: Throwing bombs into the spinning urn until it lands on the happy face causes a Piece of Heart to pop out.

evidence.quote:
What you have 
to do is stand at the side here and throw bombs from your Bomb Bag into the 
urn.  If you manage to get one in successfully then the urn will spin around 
in circles even faster and more wildly.  Note the three different expressions 
on the side of it, one happy, one neutral and one angry.  Your goal is to spin 
it so it lands on the happy face and when it does, a PIECE OF HEART [007] will 
pop out.

facts.subject: Rolling Goron
facts.text: Stopping the rolling Goron by detonating a bomb under him inside the tunnel rewards Link with the Big Bomb Bag, which carries 30 bombs instead of 20.

evidence.quote:
Notice that on the 
north side there is kind of an underpass, a closed in tunnel that the Goron 
passes through.  Drop a bomb from your Bomb Bag in the middle of this tunnel 
and time it so that the bomb explodes just as the Goron is rolling over top of 
it.  For doing this successfully the Goron rewards you with the BIG BOMB BAG 
which allows you to carry 30 bombs instead of a mere 20.

facts.subject: Rock maze
facts.text: At the end of the rock maze past the three medium rocks are two chests each containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
On the west side of the path there are three medium sized rocks sitting in 
your way.  Take a bomb out of your new, larger Bomb Bag and place it in front 
of these three rocks to blast them out of the way.  This path now leads you 
through a little tunnel.  At the end of this tunnel you will find a kind of 
rock maze....At the end you will find two 
chests containing a PURPLE RUPEE, and another PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Crate
facts.text: Smashing the crate behind the two chests at the end of the rock maze reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Behind these two 
treasure chests is a crate, smash the crate by rolling into it with the A 
button to reveal a Skulltula.  When you defeat the enemy you can pick up the 
GOLD SKULLTULA [015].

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: Blowing up the weak wall on the right after the fence ends reveals a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: As you leave the city stick to the wall on your left which will eventually turn into a fence.  When the fence on your left ends, take a look at the wall on your right to find a weak area of wall.  Blow it up using one of your bombs and inside you will find a chest containing a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Placing a bomb in front of an awkward section of the right wall on Death Mountain Trail opens a path to Gold Skulltula [016].

evidence.quote: Make your way up the trail while keeping an eye on the right wall, when you reach a section that looks a little bit awkward, equip your bombs and place a bomb in front of that section of wall.  The wall breaks open and reveals a very small path that leads only to a Skulltula.  Defeat the enemy with your Fairy Slingshot and then you can climb the wall it was clinging to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [016].

facts.subject: Lon Lon Milk
facts.text: Playing Epona's Song in front of the cow inside the hidden hole under a large rock fills Empty Bottles with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: You will come across a large rock in your path and when you destroy this rock it reveals a hole underneath.  Drop down this hole to find three things, Rupees, health and a cow.  If you like since you probably aren't using them for anything else, you can fill those two Empty Bottles with Lon Lon Milk by standing in front of the cow and playing Epona's Song on your Fairy Ocarina.

facts.subject: Spin Attack
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the Great Fairy's Fountain summons the Fairy of Power, granting a magic meter and the magic Spin Attack.

evidence.quote: Similar to what you did in the graveyard, stand on the Triforce emblem and play Zelda's Lullaby.  The combination is of course left, up, right, left, up, right.  The Fairy of Power comes out of the water and grants you a sword technique.  You finally have a magic meter now and can use the magic Spin Attack.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Rolling into the crate directly on the left upon entering Death Mountain Crater reveals Gold Skulltula [017].

evidence.quote: The first thing you are going to want to do here is roll into the crate directly on your left when you enter.  A Skulltula pops out of the crate when it smashes and you can kill it and then pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [017].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Climbing down the wall below the thin board in Death Mountain Crater leads to an opening holding Piece of Heart [008].

evidence.quote: Descend down this wall and as you go you should notice an opening in the middle, get below it and climb up to reach the inner section.  Here you will find another PIECE OF HEART [008].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Dropping from the roof where the owl leaves Link onto the chicken coop roof cover allows access to a secret entrance with Piece of Heart [009].

evidence.quote: Directly below you should be kind of a little roof cover thing for the chicken coop, what you want to do is walk very slowly and hang off the edge, then drop onto this roof cover.  Beside you is a secret entrance into the house, take it.  Grab the PIECE OF HEART [009] here and then leave the house, I guess you could use that cow to get some Lon Lon Milk if you really wanted.

facts.subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
facts.text: The Bombchu Bowling Alley costs 30 Rupees per game and offers randomized prizes including Bombchus, Piece of Heart [010], and the Biggest Bomb Bag.

evidence.quote: Next door to the Shooting Gallery, the Bombchu Bowling Alley is now open for business.  Head there now, each game costs 30 Rupees and you'll likely be playing a lot so be sure to bring a lot of money with you.  Here's how it works, there are a number of prizes which are randomized.  The prizes are Bombs, Purple Rupee, Bombchus, PIECE OF HEART [010] and BIGGEST BOMB BAG, the final two are obviously the ones you'll really be working toward.

facts.subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
facts.text: For the third Bombchu Bowling target, stand two or three black notches left of the middle arrow and throw at a 45 degree angle to the upper right.

evidence.quote: Instead stand exactly where you would stand if it was on the far left, about two or three black notches left of the middle arrow.  Now tap the analog stick on a 45 degree angle to the upper right, or northeast then let loose.

facts.subject: Hyrule Castle Guard
facts.text: Approaching the gate guard at Hyrule Castle and giving him ten Rupees allows Link to pass through.

evidence.quote: If you want to save ten Rupees you can climb up the vine and drop down behind the gate, or you can just approach the guard and give him ten Rupees, he'll let you through.

facts.subject: Din's Fire
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the Great Fairy's Fountain behind the rock at Hyrule Castle teaches the Din's Fire technique.

evidence.quote: Just past the gate there is a fork in the road and the path leading right leads to a large rock.  Now that you have bombs, pull one out of your bag and use it to destroy this rock standing in your way, then enter the crawlspace behind it.  This turns out to be one of the Great Fairy's Fountains...Play Zelda's Lullaby, left, up, right, left, up, right and a Fairy will appear in front of you.  She teaches you the DIN'S FIRE technique.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Blowing up the rock directly west of the drawbridge leading into Hyrule Castle Town reveals a hole with a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Directly west of the drawbridge leading into Hyrule Castle Town there is a  
rock just sitting out there in the field, take out one of your bombs and use 
it to blast that rock to bits.  Drop down the hole that you find below the 
rock and open the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Taking a right at the first fork and a left at the second in The Lost Woods leads to a boulder concealing a hole with a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Enter The Lost Woods here.  Make a right at the first fork and a left at the 
second.  Here you will come across a boulder which you can blow up using one 
of your bombs.  Down below it you will find a chest containing BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: In a hole beneath a rock in The Lost Woods, the Deku Scrub on the left sells the Deku Nut Upgrade for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote: There are two Deku Scrubs here, fire your Fairy Slingshot at both of them.  The one on the right is useless however the one on the left sells you the DEKU NUT UPGRADE for only 40 Rupees.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At night in Kakariko Village, Gold Skulltula [018] is found crawling on the back wall of the large house on the north side.

evidence.quote: Make your way down to Kakariko Village, but before you actually go into the village, make sure it's night time.  When you enter the village, take a look on the back of the large house on the north side, it should be right near you.  Here you will find another GOLD SKULLTULA [018] crawling around on the back wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Rolling into the tree on the left near the entrance of Zora's River makes a Skulltula fall out, rewarding GOLD SKULLTULA [019] when defeated.

evidence.quote:
Run up and roll into it to make a 
Skulltula fall out of the tree.  Defeat this enemy and you will receive GOLD 
SKULLTULA [019].

facts.subject: Magic Bean
facts.text: A man sitting along the path offers to sell Link a MAGIC BEAN for ten Rupees.

evidence.quote:
He offers to sell you a MAGIC BEAN for ten Rupees, and that's a pretty good 
deal, so take him up on his offer and buy one.

facts.subject: Magic Bean
facts.text: Each Magic Bean purchased increases in price by ten Rupees, costing a total of 550 Rupees to buy all of them.

evidence.quote:
Every Magic Bean that 
you buy is more expensive than the last by ten Rupees...If you wish to buy 
all of them now it's going to cost you a total of 550 Rupees so you would be 
making a few trips back and forth to fill your adult wallet.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Dropping down the hole in the platform leads to a chest containing a RED RUPEE.

evidence.quote:
At the 
bottom open the chest to receive a RED RUPEE.

facts.subject: Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Blowing up the large boulder surrounded by small rocks with a bomb reveals the entrance to a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote:
Here you will find a large boulder surrounded by small rocks.  If you place a 
bomb beside this boulder and blow it up, it will reveal the way to a Fairy 
Fountain in case you need to restore your health or anything like that.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Link can jump and glide down with a Cucco to reach PIECE OF HEART [011].

evidence.quote:
Now from here you can jump and glide down to get the PIECE OF 
HEART [011].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Jumping down and gliding west with a Cucco from the highest path allows Link to obtain PIECE OF HEART [012].

evidence.quote:
When you turn 
around and face west you will see another heart piece, jump down with the 
Cucco so that you can glide and grab hold of the PIECE OF HEART [012].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: On the ladder directly below where the Piece of Heart was collected, defeat the enemy to pick up GOLD SKULLTULA [020].

evidence.quote:
On the kind of northwest part of this little land bridge area, 
directly below where you collected the Piece of Heart there is a ladder and on 
that ladder is an enemy.  Defeat this enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA 
[020].

facts.subject: Frogs
facts.text: Standing on the log and playing Saria's Song, Zelda's Lullaby, the Sun's Song, or Epona's Song rewards Link with a PURPLE RUPEE for each song.

evidence.quote:
Stand on this 
place and pull out your Fairy Ocarina.  Play Sari's Song and the frogs will 
reward you with a PURPLE RUPEE.  Play Zelda's Lullaby to get a PURPLE RUPEE, 
then the Sun's Song to get a PURPLE RUPEE and finally Epona's Song to get a 
PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: After collecting twenty Skulltulas, a man in the House of Skulltula gives Link the STONE OF AGONY.

evidence.quote:
There should be another guy here with a 
broken curse since you have collected twenty Skulltulas.  He gives you the 
STONE OF AGONY, a special item which makes your controller rumble when a 
special secret is nearby.

facts.subject: Zora's Domain
facts.text: Standing on the grey square in front of the waterfall and playing Zelda's Lullaby opens the entrance to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
When you stand in front 
of the waterfall you will find a special grey square, whip out your Fairy 
Ocarina on this particular spot and play the song which connects you to the 
royal family, Zelda's Lullaby (left, up, right, left, up, right.)

facts.subject: Diving Game
facts.text: Playing the Diving Game costs 20 Rupees and requires diving to collect all five Blue Rupees.

evidence.quote:
You will have the option of playing the Diving
