Game for 20 Rupees.  The Diving Game is one of the easiest minigames ever, 
your goal is to jump down into the water and collect all five of the Blue 
Rupees.

facts.subject: Silver Scale
facts.text: Collecting all five Blue Rupees in the Diving Game rewards Link with the SILVER SCALE, allowing him to dive for six seconds rather than three seconds.

evidence.quote:
After successfully collecting all five Blue Rupees, head back up to where you 
started the game and speak to the Zora there once again.  The Zora will reward 
you with a SILVER SCALE which allows you to dive for six seconds rather than a 
mere three seconds, this means of course that you can go deeper as well.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Lighting the final two torches behind the waterfall causes a large treasure chest to appear containing PIECE OF HEART [013].

evidence.quote:
Behind the waterfall are two final torches and when these are lit, a large 
treasure chest will appear...Open the chest to get PIECE OF HEART [013].

facts.subject: Letter
facts.text: At the start of Lake Hylia, swimming down to the bottom allows Link to acquire the LETTER.

evidence.quote:
When you reach Lake Hylia you should notice something on the bottom of the 
lake directly in front of you at the start.  Swim down and pick it up to 
acquire the LETTER.

facts.subject: Fishing Pond
facts.text: Speaking to the man at the counter of the Fishing Pond allows Link to go fishing for 20 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
Speak to the guy at the counter and tell him you wish to go fishing, it only 
costs 20 Rupees.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Catching a ten pound fish at the Fishing Pond rewards Link with PIECE OF HEART [014].

evidence.quote:
Once you eventually catch this fish go back and talk to the guy at the 
counter, as a reward for the ten pound fish you get PIECE OF HEART [014].

facts.subject: Scarecrow's Song
facts.text: Playing any eight notes on the Ocarina in front of the lower scarecrow causes the scarecrow to memorize the tune.

evidence.quote:
Stand in 
front of the lower scarecrow and play your Ocarina.  Any tune consisting of 
eight notes that you play, the scarecrow will memorize and you have to 
memorize it as well.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: During the night, a Skulltula appears on one of the pillars on the island, yielding GOLD SKULLTULA [021] when eliminated.

evidence.quote:
Swim over to this island and play the Sun's Song if it isn't 
nighttime already right now.  During the night a Skulltula appears on one of 
these pillars, eliminate it and then grab the GOLD SKULLTULA [021].

facts.subject: Box
facts.text: Link can glide with a Cucco to a southwest cliff ledge and roll into the box to obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: With Cucco in hand, jump off the cliff and glide down toward that ledge. When you land, throw the Cucco against the wall in an effort to try and keep it here, then roll into the box and grab the PIECE OF HEART [015].

facts.subject: Soft Soil Hole
facts.text: Releasing bugs over the soft soil hole on the lower ledge causes a Skulltula to emerge, which yields a Gold Skulltula when defeated.

evidence.quote: Release the little bugs on top of the hole and they will crawl into it, after that a Skulltula will jump out. Defeat this enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [022].

facts.subject: Waterfall
facts.text: Swimming behind the waterfall to the north leads to a ladder that ascends to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Swim behind the waterfall to the north and in the middle you will come across a ladder leading up. Basically all this does is lead up to a PIECE OF HEART [035] in a small area.

facts.subject: King Zora
facts.text: Presenting the Letter in a bottle to King Zora moves him aside and leaves Link with an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Stand on the platform in front of him and use the Letter in the bottle. After this is said and done, the king will move, revealing the path to the next dungeon and you will also receive the EMPTY BOTTLE which had the Letter inside.

facts.subject: Tree
facts.text: Rolling into the tree at the southeast corner knocks down a Skulltula that yields a Gold Skulltula when killed.

evidence.quote: Run up to the tree and roll into it, this should knock down yet another Skulltula which you can kill and grab the GOLD SKULLTULA [023].

facts.subject: Great Fairy's Fountain
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem inside the Great Fairy's Fountain grants the Farore's Wind spell.

evidence.quote: Head inside and stand on the Triforce emblem, you need to whip out your Fairy Ocarina and play Zelda's Lullaby. What you learn here for the Great Fairy is a technique called FARORE'S WIND. This technique can be sued to create and warp to warp points in the game's many dungeons.

facts.subject: Octorok
facts.text: Octoroks cannot be killed with a sword, but deflecting their attacks back at them with the Deku Shield will kill them.

evidence.quote: The Octoroks on the other hand (funnel mouthed things that pop out of the water) cannot be killed with your sword, similar to the Deku Scrubs. Remember that you should still have your Deku Shield, equip that now and use it to deflect the attacks of the Octoroks back at them and kill them.

facts.subject: Throat Switch
facts.text: Shooting the dangling object on the ceiling with the Fairy Slingshot opens the door to the next area.

evidence.quote: What you have to do is walk back and equip your Fairy Slingshot. Use it to fire up at that little thing dangling down from the roof of his mouth and the path will open.

facts.subject: Jellyfish
facts.text: Jellyfish enemies hurt Link if attacked normally, but bombs will defeat them.

evidence.quote: The first thing to note in this particular room is that you cannot kill the weird jellyfish things, in fact you will be hurt yourself in the process if you try. Just leave them be for the moment. If for some reason you really want it dead, then bombs will get the job done.

facts.subject: Vine Wall
facts.text: Shooting the Skulltula high on the vine wall with the Fairy Slingshot and raising the water level allows Link to climb up and collect a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: There is a Skulltula on this wall, higher up. Equip your Fairy Slingshot and fire at it until the enemy is dead. Now jump onto the yellow button in the middle and this will raise the water level up. Use this to get high enough to reach the vine, and climb up to acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [024].

facts.subject: Ceiling Button
facts.text: Throwing Princess Ruto into the ceiling button opens the door at the end of the hall.

evidence.quote: In the middle of the hallway just past here, there is a button on the ceiling. No need to equip your Fairy Slingshot, just hurl the princess up there to hit it and open the door at the end of the hall.

facts.subject: Emerging Creatures
facts.text: Charging a Spin Attack until it turns orange will kill the emerging underground creatures in one hit.

evidence.quote: Long creatures which pop out of the ground and chase after you. The normal sword is ineffective but I find that if you use the charge up Spin Attack, to the point where it goes orange, it will kill them in one hit, and maybe more than one of them at a time.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Defeating the four aquatic enemies using two Slingshot shots in the air or one bomb underground spawns a large chest containing the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: There are two methods of dealing with them that work that I know of: first of all, if they are floating in the air then stand back and fire at them with your Fairy Slingshot. Doing this requires you to hit them two times. If they are swimming underground then stand back and throw bombs at them, this will kill them in a single hit. Once all four of the enemies have been dispatched, a large chest appears at the centre of the room. Open this chest to acquire the BOOMERANG.

facts.subject: Blue Button
facts.text: To keep the blue switch depressed and the door open, jump onto the button while holding Ruto and set her down before stepping off.

evidence.quote: On the opposite side there is a blue button which opens the door into the next room. If you jump off this button then the door will close again. The solution is as follows: hold Ruto over your head and jump onto the button. Before getting off of it, put her down and then get off, it will stay down.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Targeting the descending enemy with the Boomerang defeats it in four hits and reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: The solution is to get close and use L/Z targeting immediately right when it is coming down to hit it, before it hits you. After four hits the enemy is defeated and another large chest appears in this room. Open the treasure chest to acquire the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Defeating all bubbles within forty seconds reveals a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: You have forty seconds to defeat all of the bubbles in this room, you can throw the princess at them, you can throw your Boomerang at them, you can even just run into them like an idiot but I find the most effective method of dealing with them is to just use the good old fashioned sword. Once they have all been defeated within the time limit, a large chest will appear in the middle of the room containing the COMPASS for the dungeon.

facts.subject: Wall
facts.text: Defeating the closest Skulltula on the wall allows Link to retrieve a Gold Skulltula using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Equip your Boomerang and aim it at the enemy closest to you on the wall. After it has been defeated you can throw the Boomerang and it will retrieve the GOLD SKULLTULA [025] for you.

facts.subject: Wall
facts.text: Shooting the farther Skulltula to the right with the Boomerang allows Link to retrieve another Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Aim right and there is another Skulltula further away, shoot it with the Boomerang and use it to collect the GOLD SKULLTULA [026].

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: A large chest reached past the rolling boulder contains the Kokiri Sword.

evidence.quote: Start running east and then make a right...This will lead you to a large chest which contains the...KOKIRI SWORD.

facts.subject: four treasure chests
facts.object: Blue Rupee, Recovery Heart, Green Rupee
facts.text: Four treasure chests inside the house beside the circle of rocks contain a Blue Rupee, a Recovery Heart, a Blue Rupee, and a Green Rupee.

evidence.quote: There are four treasure chests in this room...open them all to acquire a BLUE RUPEE, a RECOVERY HEART, a BLUE RUPEE...pathetic GREEN RUPEE.

facts.subject: water platforms
facts.text: Jumping across all three square platforms on the water awards a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Jump across all three of these platforms...water to get a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: raised platform
facts.text: Crossing two bridges from the building east of Link's house leads to a raised platform with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: leads to a bridge, cross this bridge and the other bridge...raised platform with a girl and a Blue Rupee on it.

facts.subject: blue Rupees
facts.text: Blue Rupees are worth five Rupees apiece.

evidence.quote: these are worth five Rupees apiece.

facts.subject: shield
facts.text: Purchasing the shield requires accumulating 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote: accumulate the 40 Rupees that you will need.

facts.subject: Giant Octorok
facts.text: The Giant Octorok is stunned with the Boomerang and can be damaged with sword slashes on its green weak spot on its back, taking about three hits.

evidence.quote: When you hit the miniboss with your Boomerang, he is stunned for a moment but his only weakspot it on the back so you have to run around the circle and try to get his back before he starts up again...The green spot will open up and you can slash it with your sword...He takes about three hits.

facts.subject: Floor button
facts.text: A floor button must be held down by placing one of the two wooden boxes on it.

evidence.quote: Grab one of the two boxes on the side here and them come back over.  You'll notice a button on the floor here, jump on it while carrying a box and then put the box down on the button to hold it down.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 027
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 027 is crawling on a wall and can be killed using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: find the Skulltula crawling around on the wall here and kill it with your Boomerang.  Climb the wall to get GOLD SKULLTULA [027].

facts.subject: Door switch
facts.text: The switch on the ceiling behind a glass panel must be hit by throwing the Boomerang around the glass.

evidence.quote: The problem is that there is a  glass panel in your way that means you can hit it straight on with the Fairy Slingshot, you have to use the Boomerang...Stand all the way back and target with L/Z and throw.  It should go around the glass but there's no guarantee it will hit the button.

facts.subject: Barinade chamber pots
facts.text: All of the pots around the room during the Barinade battle contain a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: The first thing to note is that if you're low on health, all of the pots around the room each contain a Recovery Heart which should be enough to get you back to full from being almost dead.

facts.subject: Barinade
facts.text: To defeat Barinade, target and sever its three ceiling attachments with the Boomerang, stun the main body with the Boomerang to slash it, and kill the detached spinning jellyfish enemies with one Boomerang hit each before finishing off the stunned core with sword slashes.

evidence.quote: Use the L/Z button to lock onto the three things that attach the boss to the ceiling and hit all three of them individually with the Boomerang...Aim for the main body part and throw your Boomerang to stun it, if it turns blue then you know it's stunned.  Slash it as much as possible with your sword until you can't hurt it anymore...target the enemies individually and throw you Boomerang at them, it will kill them in one hit.  After all those little enemies are defeated then you can stun the boss and keep attacking with your sword.

facts.subject: Barinade
facts.text: Defeating Barinade leaves a Heart Container on the ground before the warp portal.

evidence.quote: After all those little enemies are defeated then you can stun the boss and keep attacking with your sword.  The enemies never respawn so you are free to keep stunning and attacking until the boss eventually dies.  Grab the HEART CONTAINER on the ground here and then step into the warp portal.

facts.subject: Zora's Sapphire
facts.text: After defeating Barinade and taking the warp portal back to Zora's Domain, agree to acquire the Spiritual Stone to receive Zora's Sapphire.

evidence.quote: Grab the HEART CONTAINER on the ground here and then step into the warp portal.  It will take your back to Zora's Domain, say that you wish to acquire the Spiritual Stone and you will be given ZORA'S SAPPHIRE.

facts.subject: Lost Woods grotto
facts.text: In a hole in the Lost Woods reached by turning right then left from the entrance, bugs can be captured by slashing the grass next to the chest.

evidence.quote: When you enter, make a right and then a left.  There should be a hole in the ground here, drop down and fill all three of your Empty Bottles with bugs, you can find bugs if you slash the grass down here beside the chest.

facts.subject: Sacred Meadow grotto chest
facts.text: Bombing the center of the first area in Sacred Meadow reveals a hole where defeating two wolf enemies causes a chest with a Purple Rupee to appear.

evidence.quote: Place a bomb in the centre of this first area to reveal a hole in the ground and drop down.  There are two wolf enemies which you have to kill here and after they have been defeated a small treasure chest appears containing a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 028
facts.text: Releasing bugs into the soft soil hole found by turning left twice and heading south from the Lost Woods entrance causes Gold Skulltula 028 to emerge.

evidence.quote: Make a left at the very beginning and then in this next large area make a left again and head south.  In front of you should be a hole in the ground to plant something in...use the Empty Bottle with a bug in it, the bugs will dig down into the hole and a Gold Skulltula will pop out, defeat this enemy to acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [028].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 029
facts.text: Dropping bugs into the soft soil hole next to a Deku Scrub in the Lost Woods causes Gold Skulltula 029 to pop out.

evidence.quote: Make a left and then make another left to reach an area with two Deku Scrubs.  Beside one of them you will find another hole in the ground, drop some bugs into it and GOLD SKULLTULA [029] will pop out of the ground.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 030
facts.text: Using an Empty Bottle with a bug in it on the hole beside the orange-roofed shop in Kokiri Forest causes Gold Skulltula 030 to pop out.

evidence.quote: In Kokiri Forest again make your way over to the orange roofed shop, beside the shop you will find a hole in the ground.  Use one of your Empty Bottles with a bug in it to make a GOLD SKULLTULA [030] pop out of the hole.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 031
facts.text: Inside the Deku Tree on B1, bombing the northwest wall in the upper-left room reveals Gold Skulltula 031, which must be defeated using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Head inside the Deku Tree and drop down the hold right at the very beginning.  Make your way to the upper left room on B1 here, you will find a special wall which must be bombed here that leads northwest...look around on the walls to find the golden one.  You have to use your Boomerang to defeat it and acquire the GOLD SKULLTULA [031].

facts.subject: Hyrule Field grotto chest
facts.text: Blowing up a rock in the middle of trees with spinning flower enemies while traveling southwest toward Lake Hylia reveals a hole with a chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: On your way there you will likely pass through a number of trees with many of those spinning flower enemies, and in the middle of these trees is a rock.  Blow it up and go down to find a RED RUPEE in the small chest.

facts.subject: Business Scrub
facts.text: A Deku Scrub inside a bombed hole within a fenced area near Lake Hylia sells Piece of Heart 016 for ten Rupees after being stunned with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Place a bomb here in the middle and drop down the hole that appears.  Defeat the Deku Scrub using your Boomerang and then speak to it.  The scrub will sell you the PIECE OF HEART [016] for the astounding price of only ten Rupees, you'd be a fool to pass this up.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 032
facts.text: Inside a bombed hole in the circle of stones northeast of Gerudo Valley on Hyrule Field, burn the spider web with Din's Fire and use the Boomerang to acquire Gold Skulltula 032.

evidence.quote: Take out a bomb and place it in the middle of this circle to blow a hole in the ground.  Drop down the hole and note three spider webs.  Behind one of them you will see a Gold Skulltula and some pots and grass and stuff, this is the one you want.  Equip Din's Fire on one of your C Buttons and use it while standing beside the spider web...Aim up at the web in the corner and use your Boomerang to acquire the GOLD SKULLTULA [032].

facts.subject: Hyrule Castle drawbridge moat
facts.text: After witnessing the cutscene near the drawbridge of Hyrule Castle, dive into the water under the drawbridge to retrieve the Ocarina of Time.

evidence.quote: When you do there should be some kind of cutscene which occurs when you get near the drawbridge.  Watch the scene and then jump into the water under the drawbridge.  Dive under the pick up the OCARINA OF TIME.

facts.subject: Princess Zelda
facts.text: Princess Zelda teaches the Song of Time after Link retrieves the Ocarina of Time from under the drawbridge.

evidence.quote: Dive under the pick up the OCARINA OF TIME.  She will also teach you the SONG OF TIME as well.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 033
facts.text: Bombing beside the tree near the east castle wall along the bridge to Kakariko Village opens a hole where Gold Skulltula 033 can be collected from the wall with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: What you have really been looking for this whole time is the tree, across the bridge leading toward Kakariko village, but directly beside the east wall to the castle on your left.  Place a bomb beside the tree to blast a hole in the ground, then drop down through that hole.  At the bottom there is a normal Skulltula for you to defeat and then you can use your Boomerang to take out the GOLD SKULLTULA [033] on the wall here.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Speaking to the freed person in the House of Skulltula after acquiring more than thirty Gold Skulltulas rewards the Giant's Wallet, which holds up to five hundred Rupees.

evidence.quote: Enter the house and speak with the person here who has been recently freed assuming you have more than thirty Gold Skulltulas.  The person will give you a GIANT'S WALLET which is a special new wallet that allows you to hold a maximum of up to five hundred Rupees!

facts.subject: Kakariko Village grotto chest
facts.text: Bombing east of the center tree in Kakariko Village reveals a hole with two zombies that spawn a chest containing a Huge Rupee worth two hundred Rupees upon defeat.

evidence.quote: Now head a bit east from the three until you seem to be in the exactly middle of everything and the controller should be rumbling, place a bomb here to blast open a hole and then drop down through it.  There are two zombies down here in this area that you are going to have to defeat, then once you do a small chest will appear.  Open the small chest to get a HUGE RUPEE which is worth a whopping two hundred Rupees

facts.subject: Windmill
facts.text: In the room above the stairs leading to the graveyard in Kakariko Village, stand on one of the four grey posts around the spinning platform and throw the Boomerang to collect Piece of Heart 017.

evidence.quote: climb the stairs beside it.  There is a door at the top of the stairs for you to go through.  There is some form of spinning platform here, don't really worry about that for now.  Look up a little and you should see a heart piece in this room.  What you need to do is climb onto one of those four grey coloured posts that surround the spinning thing in the middle and throw your Boomerang to acquire this PIECE OF HEART [017].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Releasing bugs into the hole in the northwest corner of the graveyard at night reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Inside the graveyard head for the northwest corner and there you will find a hole in the ground.  Empty one of your bug jars onto the hole and then a GOLD SKULLTULA [034] will pop out for you to defeat.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the southeast wall of the graveyard at night and can be killed with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Head over to the southeast side of the graveyard and look up on the wall, there you should see a GOLD SKULLTULA [035] for you to kill with your Boomerang, same deal for grabbing the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Dropping bugs into the hole in front of Dodongo's Cavern on Death Mountain Trail causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote: Just up the trial a little bit, in front of the Dodongo's Cavern you will come across a hole in the ground.  Use one of your bottles that have bugs in them and put them in the hole to make GOLD SKULLTULA [036] appear.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the giant staircase room of Dodongo's Cavern, climbing the vine on the left side leads to a small alcove where a Gold Skulltula crawls on the wall.

evidence.quote: Head down beside the staircase on the left side and there should be a vine you can climb up.  At the top is a small alcove where the GOLD SKULLTULA [037] is crawling around on the wall, use your Boomerang to get it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night, a Gold Skulltula crawls on the second-floor window to the left and can be defeated using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: You must enter the Lon Lon Ranch during the night in order to do this....Take a look up on your left at the window on the second floor, you should see a Skulltula crawling around on there.  Aim your Boomerang up at the window and throw it to defeat the enemy and acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [038].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula crawls along the outer wall around the southwest corner of Lon Lon Ranch at night.

evidence.quote: Next you will want to make your way down to the southwest corner of the ranch.  Run along the outer wall and keep your eye on it, around the southwest corner like I said you will come across the GOLD SKULLTULA [039].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At Gerudo Valley at night, a Gold Skulltula is found crawling above the waterfall to the right of the entrance bridge.

evidence.quote: Be sure that you enter the valley during the night.  As you cross the bridge at the entrance take a look on your right and crawling above the waterfall here is indeed yet another Skulltula.  You must defeat this enemy using your Boomerang and then use it again to retrieve the GOLD SKULLTULA [040].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the back of the house at Lake Hylia at night.

evidence.quote: When you arrive there you are going to want to make sure it is night time when you enter Lake Hylia....when you step onto the bridge, turn around immediately and take a look on the back of the house, if it's night time then you should see a GOLD SKULLTULA [041] on there.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Emptying a bug jar into the beanstalk hole on the other side of the house at Lake Hylia reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: That's not all either, on the other side of the house you will find another one of those beanstalk holes.  Take one of your bug jars and empty it onto the hole to make a Skulltula pop out.  Defeat the GOLD SKULLTULA [042].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At Zora's Fountain at night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the wall near the huge log on the right.

evidence.quote: Make a right when you reach Zora's Fountain and climb up onto the huge log....During the night you will see a GOLD SKULLTULA [043] on the wall.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Collecting forty Gold Skulltulas rewards Link with the Bombchu at the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: For acquiring forty Skulltulas you are rewarded with the BOMBCHU.

facts.subject: Keaton Mask
facts.text: Selling the Keaton Mask to the soldier guarding the northern exit in Kakariko Village yields 15 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Set the mask to one of your C Buttons and then equip it, after doing that speak with the soldier guarding the north exit and he will pay you 15 Rupees for the mask

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: Wearing the Skull Mask in the underground grotto of the Lost Woods allows Link to receive the Deku Stick upgrade from the Deku Scrub on the right.

evidence.quote: At the bottom take a few steps forward so that you are overlooking all the Deku Scrubs under the ground and equip the Skull Mask.  They will quickly pop out of the ground and start running around.  Speak with the Deku Scrub on your right in order to get the next DEKU STICK UPGRADE.

facts.subject: Skull Mask
facts.text: Wearing the Skull Mask on the small stump in the Lost Woods allows Link to sell it to the Skull Kid for ten Rupees.

evidence.quote: Now head back to the entrance of The Lost Woods and make a left turn.  Here you will find the Skull Kid up on the pillar.  Jump onto the small stump here and press the A button while wearing the mask, Skull Kid will give you ten Rupees for it.

facts.subject: Spooky Mask
facts.text: Wearing the Spooky Mask and speaking to the kid walking around the Graveyard sells the mask for full price.

evidence.quote: Head for the Graveyard and you will find some kind walking around here, equip the Spooky Mask and speak to him, he'll buy the mask for full price.

facts.subject: Bunny Hood
facts.text: Selling the Bunny Hood to the man running laps around Lon Lon Ranch completely fills Link's wallet with Rupees.

evidence.quote: Take the BUNNY HOOD from the shop and leave town.  Head southwest from Hyrule Town to Lon Lon Ranch, there is a man running laps around the ranch.  Once you find this man speak to him while wearing the Bunny Hood and he will pay you for it.  Basically what he does is just give you money until your wallet is full

facts.subject: Happy Mask Shop
facts.text: Completing the mask trading sidequest allows Link to borrow the Mask of Truth to listen to Gossip Stones.

evidence.quote: There is also a special bonus, you are now free to borrow the MASK OF TRUTH whenever you want to.  The Mask of Truth allows you to listen to all those Gossip Stones placed conveniently around the world

facts.subject: Song of Time
facts.text: The Song of Time is played on the Ocarina using the button combination right, A, down, right, A, down.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time which you just learned (right, A, down, right, A, down).

facts.subject: Adult Link
facts.text: Link officially transforms into Adult Link after obtaining the Master Sword in the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: SWORD.  You have now officially transformed into Adult Link, a world awaits.

facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch
facts.text: Ingo allows Link to ride a horse at Lon Lon Ranch for ten Rupees with a one minute timer.

evidence.quote: Speak to Ingo and he will offer to let you ride one of his horses for a mere ten Rupees, you should agree to this.  A one minute timer will appear.

facts.subject: Epona's Song
facts.text: Playing Epona's Song with the notes up, left, right, up, left, right causes Epona to run toward Link.

evidence.quote: Bring up your Ocarina and play Epona's Song (up, left, right, up, left, right) and when you do this Epona the horse will automatically run toward you.

facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch
facts.text: Challenging Ingo to a horse race around the fenced area requires a bet of 50 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Speak to Ingo and he will ask if you want to bet 50 Rupees on a race, you certainly do.  When the race begins you will have to do one lap around the fenced area against Ingo.

facts.subject: Epona
facts.text: Using carrots to run toward either outer wall allows Epona to jump the fence and escape Lon Lon Ranch onto Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote: use a couple of carrots and run toward either outer wall and Epona will jump the fence and jump out of Lon Lon Ranch entirely.  With Epona on the field you can now get from place to place much easier than you could before

facts.subject: Song of Storms
facts.text: Playing the Ocarina for the music box man in the windmill teaches the Song of Storms, played with A, down, up, A, down, up.

evidence.quote:
Speak to the crazy guy with the music box in here and then 
while standing in front of him, take out your Ocarina.  He will teach you a 
very special song, the SONG OF STORMS which is played with the following 
combination: A, down, up, A, down, up.

facts.subject: Pocket Egg
facts.text: The Pocket Egg given by the Cucco breeder hatches into a Pocket Cucco after playing the Sun's Song twice.

evidence.quote:
She gives you the POCKET EGG which will hatch 
overnight just like the other egg.  After acquiring it, play the Sun's Song 
once, and then again to make the egg hatch into a POCKET CUCCO.

facts.subject: Cojiro
facts.text: Waking Talon with the Pocket Cucco in Kakariko Village and returning it to the breeder rewards Cojiro.

evidence.quote:
In here you will find Talon sleeping on a bed.  Stand 
beside him with your new Pocket Cucco equipped on one of the C Buttons and use 
it.  Talon should wake up and then when you talk to him, he should mention 
something about going back to the ranch....After speaking with her, use the Pocket Cucco and assuming it woke up Talon, 
it will be happy like she asked.  As a reward for what you have done she gives 
you COJIRO, a special Blue Cucco which has stopped crowing entirely.

facts.subject: Crate
facts.text: Rolling into the crate on the ledge reached by the magic bean platform in the Graveyard yields Piece of Heart 018.

evidence.quote:
Make your way to the northwest area where you planted the sprout as Young Link, there is not a platform here which when stepped on, raises you up to the ledge.  Roll into 
the crate to destroy it and you will get a PIECE OF HEART [018].

facts.subject: Dampe
facts.text: Following Dampe through his underground crypt without falling behind earns a large chest containing the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
If you manage to follow him all the way through to the end 
without being left behind that he places a large treasure chest in front of 
you which contains the HOOKSHOT.

facts.subject: Time Blocks
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time removes the two stacked blocks found past Dampe's race room.

evidence.quote:
There are two blocks in this room piled on top of one another.  What you need 
to do to get past this is play the Song of Time on your Ocarina, (right, A, 
down, right, A, down.)

facts.subject: Dampe
facts.text: Completing Dampe's race in less than one minute rewards Piece of Heart 019.

evidence.quote:
Agree to his race once again, this time we 
are going to do everything we can to finish in under one minute, that is the 
goal....If your time was in fact less than one minute then you are rewarded with the 
PIECE OF HEART [019].

facts.subject: Man on Roof
facts.text: Hookshotting from the Potion Shop roof to the purple roof allows Link to speak to the man sitting there for Piece of Heart 020.

evidence.quote:
From where I told you to stand, near the wall between the 
stairs and the gate, fire your Hookshot at the little bit of red roof you can 
see from here and you should be able to pull yourself up onto the Potion Shop.  
Now run to the other side of the roof and hook across to the purple roof with 
the guy sitting on it.  Speak to him and he will give you PIECE OF HEART 
[020].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 044
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 044 crawls at night on the high wall of the house attached to the chicken coop in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Climb the stairs and hook onto the roof of the House of Skulltula.  From there 
turn around and face south, hook onto the house with the chicken coop attached 
to it.  During the night you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [044] crawling around 
on the wall up here.

facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch Obstacle Course
facts.text: Finishing the Lon Lon Ranch horse obstacle course in 50 Seconds or better awards a cow delivered to Link's house in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
When you 
speak to Malon while riding the horse two times, she will offer to let you 
race and obstacle course.  The time to beat is 50 Seconds and she says that if 
you beat it you will get a present....Assuming you 
get a time of 0:49 or better then Malon will give you a present, she says it 
is too big to give you so she'll have it delivered to your home.  The present 
is in fact a whole cow that now lives in your house in Kokiri Forest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 045
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 045 is on the wall past the arch on the path leading up to Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Return to Hyrule Castle town and 
make your way through the Market up toward Ganon's Castle.  Follow the path 
around and under the arch.  When you get through the arch turn around and 
there you will see the GOLD SKULLTULA [045] crawling around on the wall, get 
it using your Hookshot.

facts.subject: Odd Mushroom
facts.text: Using Cojiro to wake the sleeping man in the Lost Woods yields the Odd Mushroom, which expires if not delivered within three minutes.

evidence.quote:
equip the blue Cucco 
Cojiro on one of your C-Buttons and then use it while standing in front of the 
man.  He offers to give you an item which will go bad if you don't deliver it 
quickly, I think we have time to make a quick detour.  Accept his offer and he 
gives you the ODD MUSHROOM.  You now have three minutes to get to the Potion 
Shop in Kakariko Village.

facts.subject: Odd Medicine
facts.text: Trading the Odd Mushroom to the witch behind the Kakariko Potion Shop grants the Odd Medicine.

evidence.quote:
Climb the stairs and enter the other door back there, it will take you to a 
witch.  Use the Odd Mushroom while standing in front of her and she will give 
you the ODD MEDICINE.

facts.subject: Poacher's Saw
facts.text: Giving the Odd Medicine to the girl where the sleeping man was in the Lost Woods rewards the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote:
Go to where the man was sitting previously and there you 
will find a small girl.  Stand in front of her and use the Odd Medicine to 
acquire the POACHER'S SAW.

facts.subject: Mido
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song for the elf boy blocking the path past the sequence of right, left, right, left makes him move.

evidence.quote:
From the entrance of the Lost Woods again, make a right, then a left, then a 
right, then a left.  When you try to make that last left, you'll find there is 
a small elf boy blocking the path similar to back at the very beginning of the 
game.  Getting by him is simple, simply stand beside the boy and pull out your 
Ocarina.  Play Saria's Song for him and he will move.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 046
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean platform in the Lost Woods brings Link up to Gold Skulltula 046.

evidence.quote:
In the area after this 
make a left again and you will come across that small part of the forest where 
you planted a Magic Bean when you were a kid.  Step on the Magic Bean platform 
and it will take you up to a GOLD SKULLTULA [046].

facts.subject: Club Moblin
facts.text: The club-wielding leader at the end of Sacred Forest Meadow alternates slamming his club left, right, and left, and dies to three sword slashes.

evidence.quote:
Make your way through this area to the end where you 
will find kind of the boss of these enemies, he wields a large club.  This 
enemy slams it down on the left, then the right, then left and that's his 
pattern.  It takes three sword slashes to kill him.

facts.subject: Minuet of Forest
facts.text: Reaching the top of the stairs past the club moblin in Sacred Forest Meadow triggers a scene where Link learns the Minuet of Forest.

evidence.quote:
Once you get past this 
enemy there is a scene at the top of the stairs.  You will learn the MINUET OF 
FOREST here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling on the wall near the entrance trees and can be defeated with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Take aim to your right where there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [047] crawling around on the wall and defeat it using the Hookshot, then grab the token.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: A small chest on a tree branch near the entrance contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Walk out onto the branch and jump to the other tree branch, there you will find a small chest with a SMALL KEY inside of it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located beside the door opposite the entrance in the main room.

evidence.quote: Run across to the opposite side of the room and climb up, while standing beside the door look to your right and use the Hookshot to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [048].

facts.subject: Blue Bubble
facts.text: Firing the Hookshot at the blue flame skull extinguishes its fire so it can be damaged by the sword.

evidence.quote: While this enemy is covered in fire he cannot be harmed, target him with the L/Z button and fire your Hookshot to remove the fire and then feel free to dispatch him normally with the sword.

facts.subject: Stalfos
facts.text: Stalfos attacks deal two entire hearts of damage, and waiting to block their attack before executing an A button jump attack works well to defeat them.

evidence.quote: Not only do these (the Stalfos) fight very well, their attacks deal two entire hearts of damage, you have to have a good defense while fighting these enemies as well as a good offense... Wait for the enemy to attack, block it and hit the A button to do a jump attack, this should work quite well and allow you to defeat them with minimal damage.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeating the two Stalfos reveals a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Once the two enemies are dead open the small chest to get a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Time Block
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) causes the block obstructing the northwest hallway to disappear.

evidence.quote: Stand in front of this block and play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down.)  The block will disappear and you can go through the door.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Defeating the blue flame skull unlocks the doors and reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: In the next room whip out the Hookshot and fire it at the skull to remove its blue fire, then kill it.  This will unlock the doors and reveal a large chest containing the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Red Switch
facts.text: Stepping on the red button lowers the water level in the courtyard.

evidence.quote: Upon landing step on the red button to lower the water level and then jump off the balcony.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: A small chest at the end of the drained well tunnel contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Jump 
down into it, get the Recovery Hearts and run to the end of the tunnel to find 
a small chest containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Recovery Heart
facts.text: A small chest on the raised land in the water contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest to get a RECOVERY HEART and then take a few steps in front of it to find GOLD SKULLTULA [049] 
crawling around on the wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling on the wall just past the Recovery Heart chest in the courtyard.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest to get a RECOVERY HEART and then take a few steps in front of it to find GOLD SKULLTULA [049] 
crawling around on the wall.  Use your Hookshot to get the token and then jump 
down and go through the door which takes you back to the main hall again.

facts.subject: Blue Bubble
facts.text: Blocking a blue flame skull with the shield will knock away its blue flame.

evidence.quote:
In the next 
room you will be attacked immediately by one of the blue flame skulls, since 
you probably don't have time to use your Hookshot note that blocking it with 
your shield will also knock away the blue flame.

facts.subject: Block Puzzle
facts.text: Pull the first block backward, push it forward into the wall, then push it from the obstructed hallway side until it drops into place.

evidence.quote:
Grab it with the A button and pull backward until it is aligned 
with the path in the direction you were moving previously before Navi 
interrupted you.  Now push the block up in that direction until you eventually 
hit the wall.  At that point turn around and go down the hall which the block 
was obstructing previously, make your way around to the same block again but 
from a different side.  Push it along until the end where it drops down a 
little, this means you have done it correctly, listen for the confirmation 
sound.

facts.subject: Block Puzzle
facts.text: Pull the second block out, drop down to push it from the lower hallway, then return upstairs to push it along until it drops into place.

evidence.quote:
At the first fork look left to find another block, just a different colour 
this time... After 
you've got it out as far as you can drop down to the lower area and head to 
the hall which had the original block.  Climb up the ladder here and make a 
right, then a right again.  Push the second block as far as it will go, then 
turn around and go back up again.  Now that the second block is aligned in the 
hall, push it along to the end where it will drop down and you'll hear a 
sound.

facts.subject: Fairy Bow
facts.text: Defeating the reviving Stalfos pair by lowering both with two jump attacks before finishing them reveals a large chest containing the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote:
The trick to winning here is to hit the 
first Stalfos with two jump attacks, then hit the second Stalfos with two jump 
attacks.  Now both of them only have one more jump attack before they die, 
quickly kill one and then move onto the other, with only one hit you can kill 
it before the second has a chance to revive.  Doing this makes a large chest 
appear containing the FAIRY BOW, a very important item you will need.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Shooting all three paintings with the Fairy Bow causes the Poe to appear, and defeating it lights a torch and spawns a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Do this to all three paintings when they have the Poes in them and 
the Poe will come out.  Go down to the bottom of the stairs and battle it, it 
takes three jump attacks with your Master Sword to kill them.  When the Poe 
dies it lights the torch and a chest appears containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Shooting all three paintings and defeating the second Poe lights a torch and spawns a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Shoot your Fairy Bow at all three paintings 
in this room as well, then kill the Poe when it appears.  Once again a torch 
is lit and a large chest appears.  This large chest contains the COMPASS for 
the dungeon.

facts.subject: Bundle of Arrows
facts.text: Shooting the eyeball on the wall above the ladder by the first large green block spawns a small chest containing a Bundle of Arrows.

evidence.quote:
If you go back to where 
that first large green block was, and climb the ladder you will find an 
eyeball on the wall.  Shoot it to make a small chest appear containing a 
BUNDLE OF ARROWS, that's right, just arrows.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Shooting the eyeball above the door untwists the hallway, leading to a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Just outside the twisted 
hallway turn around and look above the door to see an eyeball there.  Shoot it 
with your Fairy Bow to untwist the twisted hallway... Anyway head through the hallway 
which is no longer twisted and jump down.  Here you will find a fancy chest 
which contains the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling high on the wall past the raised stone object with two Recovery Hearts.

evidence.quote:
Ahead of you is a raised stone object with two Recovery Hearts on it.  Jump to 
this thing and walk slowly to the end.  Equip your Hookshot and aim it up at 
the wall, there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [050] crawling around on the wall.  If you 
have been following the guide up to this point then congratulations, you now 
officially have exactly half of the game's total Gold Skulltulas.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeating the charging hand enemy and its smaller splits spawns a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
After it is defeated it splits into little hands.  
At that point just kill them off with the Hookshot or use the Spin Attack or whatever.  
A small chest appears now containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Eyeball Switch
facts.text: Shooting an arrow through the torch from the moving pillar heats the arrow to melt the ice on the eyeball switch.

evidence.quote: Wait until the pillar moves you around to the east side, there the torch will be in between the eyeball and your arrow so that when you shoot the arrow, the fire will heat it up and allow it to melt the ice.

facts.subject: Small Chest
facts.text: A small chest past the falling ceiling room contains a BUNDLE OF ARROWS.

evidence.quote: Go up and open the chest to get a BUNDLE OF ARROWS and then take the north door into the next room.

facts.subject: Poe Block Puzzle
facts.text: Pushing together the picture of the Poe requires using only four blocks within one minute, leaving the middle block unused.

evidence.quote: You have one minute to push together a picture of the Poe, the block in the middle is not used, you only need four.

facts.subject: Meg
facts.text: When the four copies of the Poe sister appear, targeting the one that does a quick turn and hitting it with the Hookshot damages the real boss.

evidence.quote: A split second after all four of them appear, one of them will do a quick turn, and that is the real one.  Auto target that one with the L/Z button and fire your Hookshot at it.

facts.subject: Small Chest
facts.text: Rotating the basement room clockwise three times reveals a button, and rotating it two more times clockwise leads to a small chest containing a BUNDLE OF ARROWS.

evidence.quote: Push the room clockwise three times and an opening will appear which leads to a button, go press it.  After pressing the button rotate it clockwise another two times and enter the room with the Skulltula.  Kill the Skulltula and open the small chest to get a BUNDLE OF ARROWS.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling on the wall in the rotating basement room.

evidence.quote: There is a also a GOLD SKULLTULA [051] crawling around on the wall in this room.

facts.subject: North Hall
facts.text: Rotating the room clockwise once more to press the second button, followed by twice clockwise to press the final button, opens the north hall leading to the boss.

evidence.quote: Leave the room and rotate clockwise once more, a second button will be available to push.  Now rotate the room for the last time, twice clockwise and hit the third and final button.  This opens up the north hall which takes you to the Big Key door and to the boss.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: In the first phase, shooting an arrow into the middle of the purple portal hits the real Phantom Ganon before he can attack.

evidence.quote: One of these two enemies will get to the edge of the painting and suddenly turn around, this is the fake.  The other will jump out of the painting through a purple portal and shoot a huge electricity blast at the ground which goes in all directions, being at the edge of the field is still the safest place for this.... when the portal appears fire into the middle of the portal and Phantom Ganon will be hit, turning around and not attacking.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: Phantom Ganon's electricity blast deals two hearts of damage, and the boss enters his second phase after taking three hits.

evidence.quote: avoid the attack which deals two hearts worth of damage each hit.... After three hits the second phase starts.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: In the second phase, Phantom Ganon fires energy blasts that can be deflected back at him using the Master Sword.

evidence.quote: What he does is float around and fire this energy blast at you.  The energy blast can be deflected with the Master Sword back at him for damage.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: Defeating Phantom Ganon leaves behind a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: After Phantom Ganon is hit by the blast run up to him and begin slashing with your sword as much as possible.  Repeat this pattern until dead.  After the battle there is a scene, grab the HEART CONTAINER and take the warp

facts.subject: Forest Medallion
facts.text: Taking the warp portal out of the Forest Temple awards Link the Forest Medallion.

evidence.quote: portal out of the dungeon.  You will also acquire the FOREST MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found on top of the southeast house with two pillars in Kokiri Forest, retrieved using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Return to Kokiri Forest and play the Sun's Song to make it change to night time here.  Head for the southeast house with the two pillars coming out of the top and up there you will see GOLD SKULLTULA [052].  Get it from up there using your Hookshot.

facts.subject: Prelude of Light
facts.text: Returning to the Temple of Time to meet Sheik teaches Link the Prelude of Light.

evidence.quote: return to the Temple of Time, there you will meet Shiek again and you will learn PRELUDE OF LIGHT.

facts.subject: Pierre
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song for the Scarecrow at Lake Hylia as an adult enables Pierre to provide assistance whenever the song is played nearby.

evidence.quote: As an Adult, get   on Epona and head down to Lake Hylia where you will find the Scarecrow.  Play the Scarecrow's Song while standing beside him and he'll say that anytime you play that song from now on, if Pierre is near then he will help you.

facts.subject: Big Poes
facts.text: Catching Big Poes requires riding Epona and using the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote: First of all, in order to catch the Big Poes you must be riding Epona and you must have the Fairy Bow.

facts.subject: Ghost Shop
facts.text: Each Big Poe turned in earns 100 points, requiring a total of ten Big Poes to reach 1000 points for a special prize.

evidence.quote: He says that you'll get a special prize once you reach 1000 points, and since each Poe nets you 100 points, that means you must collect a total of ten.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe appears when riding Epona directly south along the path from the Hyrule Castle Town gate.

evidence.quote: The very first Big Poe is found simply by getting on Epona right at the gate to Hyrule Castle Town and riding down the path directly to the south.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe is located near the stream in the northwest corner of Hyrule Field, west of the entrance to Hyrule Castle Town.

evidence.quote: The next one we're going to get is over west of the entrance to Hyrule Castle Town, beyond the wall head for the northwest corner of the field and follow the stream down, just away from it a bit and you should find the next BIG POE.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe appears when heading north from the path fork located southeast of the Gerudo Valley entrance.

evidence.quote: After this we are going to want to head for the entrance to Gerudo Valley.  Southeast from there a little bit is a fork in the path kind of which splits into two, three if you count the one you are coming from.  At this point if you go north you should manage to find the third BIG POE.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe appears when approaching the tree right outside the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: Notice that just outside the entrance to the ranch there is a tree, when you approach this tree another BIG POE is going to appear, this will be your fourth.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe appears near the tree in front of the Kakariko Village entrance when riding back from the river.

evidence.quote: Turn around and ride back toward the tree in front of the Kakariko Village entrance, if you're lucky the BIG POE will appear there, if not it will likely appear over the river out of reach.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe appears near the rock at the fork where three paths meet between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Notice a big ugly "y" shape made by the paths in between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest?  Your destination is the fork in the path where all three of them meet, there you will find a rock and when you approach the rock, the sixth BIG POE will appear.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe appears when running through the grass shrubs beside a green tree south of the fork between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: As you make your way south from here you will notice a green tree and beside this tree are a bunch of little grass shrubs.  Run through these shrubs and the next BIG POE should appear.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: An eighth Big Poe appears when riding through the trees slightly east of the previous shrub location between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Ride through the forest, through the area a bit east of here and you should be able to find yet another BIG POE, that covers eight of them.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: A Big Poe appears at the bend along the east side of the boomerang-shaped stone wall east of Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: east of Lon Lon Ranch there is a stone wall which curves in the shape of a boomerang.  Get on the east side of this wall, the lower side and ride your horse directly along the edge of it.  At the bend in the middle, the ninth BIG POE will appear and you will be able to capture it.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: The tenth Big Poe appears when riding past the lone tree north of the fork southeast of Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote: Well north of that fork there is a lone tree and when you ride past this tree, the tenth BIG POE will appear and allow you to capture it.

facts.subject: Ghost Shop
facts.text: Presenting all ten Big Poes to the ghost shop owner yields 500 Rupees and the final Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Enter the small room and present the final Poe to the ghost man, he will give you the fourth and final EMPTY BOTTLE in return for you work.  Coupled with the 500 Rupees you have already made from it, the reward is reasonably nice all things considered.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Speaking to the man in the upper right corner of the House of Skulltula after collecting at least 50 Gold Skulltulas rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: The reason I suggest you head for Kakariko Village is because at this point, you should have collected at least 50 Gold Skulltulas.  Enter the House of Skulltula here, yes you can still do it while you are an adult.  Speak to the guy in the upper right corner and he will give you a PIECE OF HEART [021].

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: Hitting all ten randomized Rupees with the Fairy Bow at the Kakariko Shooting Gallery rewards Link with the Big Quiver, increasing arrow capacity from 30 to 40.

evidence.quote: Your goal is to anticipate and hit all ten of the Rupees once again, except this time using your Fairy Bow.  If you can manage to hit all ten then you will be rewarded with the BIG QUIVER, a special item which allows you to carry a total of 40 Arrows instead of 30.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: Hitting at least eight out of ten Rupees at the Shooting Gallery awards a free game.

evidence.quote: Keep in mind that if you manage to hit at least eight out of ten, you are still given a free game after that to try out your luck once more.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Rolling into the tree in the centre of Kakariko Village near the entrance as Young Link at night causes a Gold Skulltula to drop down.

evidence.quote: See the tree in the centre of town right near the entrance?  Run up to it and roll into the tree, GOLD SKULLTULA [053] will drop down and then you can grab the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: After playing the Minuet of Forest, climbing the ladder in front of the Forest Temple and looking left reveals a Gold Skulltula on the wall, retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: simply play the Minuet of Forest which will teleport you to the area right in front of the Forest Temple.  Head down from here past that enormous enemy and go up the ladder straight ahead.  Up top here turn left and you will see the GOLD SKULLTULA [054] crawling around on the wall, use your Hookshot to get it.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart [022]
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean plant above Dodongo's Cavern allows Link to jump off to the north and collect PIECE OF HEART [022].

evidence.quote: When you get up to Dodongo's Cavern, get onto the Magic Bean plant and ride it up. Jump off to the north almost immediately above the cave and grab the PIECE OF HEART [022] which was sitting up there.

facts.subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [055]
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow Song in Dodongo's Cavern summons a scarecrow that Link can Hookshot to in order to reach GOLD SKULLTULA [055].

evidence.quote: Play the Scarecrow Song while standing beside it and a scarecrow will appear up there. Stand back and shoot your Hookshot to grab onto the scarecrow and get up there, now you can snag GOLD SKULLTULA [055].

facts.subject: small treasure chest
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms inside the circle of stones outside Goron City reveals a hole with a chest containing a HUGE RUPEE.

evidence.quote: In front of the entrance there is a circle of stones and when you stand in the middle of this circle you should be able to feel the controller rumble. Instead of setting down a bomb here, what you want to do is take out your Ocarina and play the Song of Storms (A, down, up, A, down, up). Suddenly a hole will appear underneath you and you'll drop down to an area with a small treasure chest, inside this chest is a HUGE RUPEE.

facts.subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [056]
facts.text: Crossing one of the suspended ropes in Goron City reveals GOLD SKULLTULA [056] on the back of the platform, obtainable using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Cross one of the ropes which will give you a view of the back of that panel and there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [056] on the back, you can get it using your Hookshot.

facts.subject: Goron
facts.text: Stopping the rolling Goron with a bomb and asking about both dialogue options rewards Link with the heat-resistant GORON TUNIC.

evidence.quote: Equip your bombs and drop one so that it explodes as he rolls over it, then he'll begin to talk to you. Speak to him again and he'll go on about the Fire Temple, then start crying. At that point you have to ask him about both options which appear, one after the other. Once you do that the Goron gives you the GORON TUNIC which is heat-resistant and will allow you to pass through really hot areas like the Death Mountain Crater without worrying about burning to death.

facts.subject: giant Goron
facts.text: A giant Goron on the same floor sells the GIANT'S KNIFE, though the weapon breaks easily after very little use.

evidence.quote: Take the southwest path on this same floor and it will lead you to a giant Goron, it seems he has recently finished his weapon and he is willing to sell you the GIANT'S KNIFE, a new weapon for Link. You may think this is great, however the knife will break quite easily after very little use, so what you want to do is just let it sit in your inventory for now, we'll utilize its power later when it will be more useful.

facts.subject: statue
facts.text: Dragging backward the statue in Darunia's room reveals the secret path leading into the Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: Enter Darunia's room, the one to the north at the very bottom of the city and grab hold of the statue at the top of the room. Drag it backward and this will reveal the secret path leading into the Death Mountain Crater.

facts.subject: Link
facts.text: Crossing the collapsed bridge in Death Mountain Crater using the Hookshot triggers a scene where Link learns the BOLERO OF FIRE.

evidence.quote: Equip your Hookshot and shoot it at the pole just ahead of you, this will pull you across to the complete section of the bridge. As you start walking forward a scene occurs where you learn the BOLERO OF FIRE.

facts.subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [057]
facts.text: Dropping bugs into the small soft soil hole in Death Mountain Crater causes GOLD SKULLTULA [057] to emerge.

evidence.quote: Approach the small hole just beside you and drop the bugs into it, a GOLD SKULLTULA [057] will pop out of the hole for you to defeat.

facts.subject: Magic Bean plant
facts.text: Riding the grown Magic Bean plant in Death Mountain Crater allows Link to hop off and collect PIECE OF HEART [023].

evidence.quote: Step onto the Magic Bean plant which is now fully grown and it will lift you up, after a couple of seconds you'll pass by the PIECE OF HEART [023] which you can get simply by hopping off and picking up.

facts.subject: Magic Bean plant
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean plant in Death Mountain Crater also passes Piece of Heart [008] for players who missed it earlier.

evidence.quote: If you stay on the platform it also takes you past Piece of Heart [008] which was somewhat difficult to get, so if you missed it before you can get it quite easily now.

facts.subject: small treasure chest
facts.text: Pressing the button in Darunia's room opens the cage where a Goron is trapped, revealing a small treasure chest containing a SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: Keep jumping across until you reach a button which opens the gate beside you. Speak to the Goron in the cage and then open the small treasure chest behind him to acquire a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: small treasure chest
facts.text: Bombing the door on the right side of the enormous room and hitting the button inside frees a Goron and reveals a small chest with a SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: When you get to the door on the right side, take out one of your bombs and place it in front of the door. Head through the door and step on the buttons which opens up the cage. Speak to the Goron inside and then open the small treasure chest behind him to get a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: Opening the cage on the opposite side of the room allows Link to open a small chest behind the Goron to receive another SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: Return to the previous room and head across to the opposite side, there is a normal door there which leads to a hall and a cage with another Goron inside, open the cage and speak to him. Open the small chest behind him to get yet another SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [058]
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time creates a blue block leading to an upper room where defeating the Like Like lets Link kill GOLD SKULLTULA [058].

evidence.quote: Notice that outside of this hall, above the door that you just went through is one of those blue blocks. Stand near it and take out your Ocarina, play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and the block appears right in front of you. Climb up on top of the block and proceed through the door up top here...When the monster has been defeated then you can kill the GOLD SKULLTULA [058].

facts.subject: block
facts.text: Pushing the block over the edge onto the ground and jumping on it causes a blast of fire to launch the block up into another room.

evidence.quote: Drop down onto the pillar and push the block over the edge. Wait until the block is safely on the ground and then jump down onto it. There will be a blast of fire which launches it up into another room, use your Small Key and continue.

facts.subject: crystal
facts.text: Dropping a bomb onto the crystal temporarily extinguishes the fire on the fence so Link can climb up before the fire returns.

evidence.quote: Stop at the first platform and move over so that you are above that crystal thing, what you need to do is take out a bomb, drop it on the crystal and then quickly climb up to the fence which is on fire. Climb it quickly before the crystal returns to its original state and the fire returns.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Stepping on the button in the enclosed area of the rolling boulder room frees a Goron and reveals a chest containing a SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: If you stay along the wall eventually you will come to a little enclosed area with a door, head through the door and step on the button to open up the cage for the Goron, then get the SMALL KEY from the chest behind the Goron.

facts.subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [059]
facts.text: Striking the dead end wall in the rolling boulder room until it makes a different noise and blasting it with a bomb reveals GOLD SKULLTULA [059].

evidence.quote: Strike the wall here with your sword until it makes a different noise, then pull out your bombs and blast the wall. In here you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [059].

facts.subject: small treasure chest
facts.text: Stepping on a button in front of another cage in the boulder room frees a Goron and yields another SMALL KEY from the small treasure chest.

evidence.quote: Eventually you should come across a cage with a button in front of it, step on the button to open the cage and then speak to the Goron. Open the small treasure chest behind him to get another SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: large treasure chest
facts.text: Climbing over the metal gate past the moving wall of fire allows Link to drop down to a large treasure chest containing the DUNGEON MAP.

evidence.quote: Instead of going through the door however, note the metal gate on the other side of this ledge, you can climb over it and drop down to a large treasure chest which contains the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 60 is on the climbable wall reachable by playing the Scarecrow Song and Hookshotting up.

evidence.quote:
Play the Scarecrow Song and a scarecrow 
will appear on the platform above you, use the Hookshot to get up there with 
him.  From here fire the Hookshot to get across to the other side onto the 
platform which rises up.  At the top you'll be in a room with a wall you can 
climb, at the top there you will come across GOLD SKULLTULA [60] on the wall, 
get it with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 061 is located on the wall immediately to the left in the room above the climbable wall.

evidence.quote:
Now climb up that wall and into the next room.  
Immediately take a look on your left here and you will find another GOLD 
SKULLTULA [061] just relaxing on the wall there.

facts.subject: Huge Rupee
facts.text: Stepping on the button and Hookshotting to the pillar at the top of the steep slope allows reaching a small chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Step on the button and then run to the bottom of the slope, whip out 
the Hookshot and fire it at the pillar at the top of the slope, this will pull 
you up and give you time to reach the small chest which happens to contain a 
HUGE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Bombing the crack on the platform leads to a Goron cage containing a small chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Place a bomb on the crack and drop down to the hall below 
which leads you to another Goron cage, step on the button to open it and then 
speak to the Goron.  Open the small chest to get a SMALL KEY and then climb up 
the chain link wall where you dropped down a moment ago.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Navigating across the pillars above leads to another Goron cage containing a small chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
From there just make your way across from one to the 
next until you reach the cage of the Goron, speak with him and then open the 
small chest to acquire another SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Following the right wall of the pillar maze room leads to a door with a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Stay along the right wall unless there is fire in your way, 
on this wall you will reach a door, go through it and open the large chest to 
acquire the COMPASS for the dungeon.

facts.subject: Flare Dancer
facts.text: Pull the core of the Flare Dancer out with the Hookshot when it jumps out, slash it, and strike it with a charged Spin Attack as it flees.

evidence.quote:
When the Flare Dancer actually jumps out of the middle that is your chance.  Make 
sure you have the Hookshot equipped and target the Flare Dancing using the L/Z 
button.  Hit the Hookshot button and you should be able to pull the actual, 
hit-able section of the boss out.  Now it is entirely harmless and you are 
free to begin slashing away....As it runs around charge 
up the maximum power Spin Attack and move toward the boss, the instant it 
freaks out to turn around, let loose for good damage.  Do this about three or 
four times and the miniboss will quickly fall victim to your blade.

facts.subject: Megaton Hammer
facts.text: Following the thin path after stepping on the button leads to a large chest containing the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
Step on the button and run along the thin path that leads around to the 
large treasure chest at the top, you have more than enough time, it's just a 
matter of being careful not to fall that makes it difficult.  When you reach 
this large chest, open it up to get the MEGATON HAMMER.

facts.subject: Megaton Hammer
facts.text: Pounding the block between the torches with the Megaton Hammer transforms the floor into a staircase so a box can be placed on the switch.

evidence.quote:
After doing that, equip your Megaton 
Hammer and pound the block in the centre of that lowered area, the one right 
between the torches.  When this is done, the whole ground should transform 
into a staircase.  Pick up one of the two small boxes and jump down to the 
bottom.  Step on the button and then set down the box on top of it.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time moves the block to allow pounding a rusted button, freeing a Goron with a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the edge here and equip your Ocarina, you need to play the Song of 
Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) to move the block across from you.  Jump 
across and grab the edge, then pound the rusted button down with the hammer to 
open the cage below you.  Speak with the Goron and then get the SMALL KEY from 
the tiny treasure chest behind him.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 062 is crawling on the wall in the room with flying floor tiles and a huge blob.

evidence.quote:
In the room past this 
one, hold the R button to bring up your shield again and protect yourself from 
the floor tiles, then eliminate the huge blob from a distance.  There is a 
GOLD SKULLTULA [062] crawling around on the wall in here for you to kill

facts.subject: Bombs
facts.text: Defeating the second Flare Dancer causes a small chest containing Bombs to appear.

evidence.quote:
after that just head through the door here to encounter yet another Flare 
Dancer....After defeating the enemy a small chest appears 
containing BOMBS, what a nice treat.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Pounding the rusted button down with the Megaton Hammer frees a Goron whose cell contains the Boss Key chest.

evidence.quote:
Head through the door and pound the 
button down using the Megaton Hammer.  Speak to the Goron and then open the 
chest behind him to acquire the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: The Megaton Hammer is used to strike the boss twice after it emerges from one of nine holes indicated by gathering flames.

evidence.quote:
Forget 
absolutely every weapon and item for this battle with the one exception being 
the Megaton Hammer, it's your only weapon.  There are nine holes in the field 
here and the boss will randomly pop out of one of them.  You can tell which 
one he is going to pop out of by seeing where the flames after gathering.  
When the boss pops out, keep your distance a bit, he will sweep around the 
proximity with some kind of flaming dragon hair.  After that you have a window 
to run up and slam him with the Megaton Hammer.  Doing so will make him swing 
his flaming hair one more time and then drop, allowing you to go in with the 
hammer for a second hit.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Dodge the boss's flying fire attack by running continuously, and avoid large shadows on the ground when rocks fall from above.

evidence.quote:
He will use one of two attacks, either he will fly 
around the field breathing fire at you or he will drop rocks from above.  The 
fire one can be dodged simply by running and not stopping, being careful never 
to stay in his line of vision.  The rock one is even easier, they make large 
shadows before they fall so stay away from the shadows.

facts.subject: Heart Container
facts.text: A Heart Container appears where the boss's skull disappears.

evidence.quote: Grab the HEART CONTAINER which appears where the skull disappears and then

facts.subject: Fire Medallion
facts.text: Stepping into the warp portal triggers a scene where Link acquires the Fire Medallion.

evidence.quote: step into the warp portal for a scene where you acquire the FIRE MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 063 appears at night on the southwest wall reachable by riding the Magic Bean platform up and jumping off.

evidence.quote:
When you get into Zora's River, make your way up the path until your come to 
the Magic Bean platform.  Step on this platform and allow it to take you up to 
that area, high above the others with the hole in the ground and where there 
was a Cucco wandering around previously, at the top of that long ladder.  The 
Magic Bean platform doesn't actually stop there so you are going to have to 
jump off as you pass by.  Once you land, take a look to the southwest, if you 
don't see anything crawling on the wall then play the Sun's Song so that it 
changes to night, the GOLD SKULLTULA [063] will only appear on the wall during 
the night.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 064 can be grabbed with the Hookshot at night by standing on the fence of the bridge near the end of the river.

evidence.quote:
Make your way along toward the end of the river, and when you reach the bridge 
which takes you across, just before those funny land bridges, stand on the 
normal bridge and look to the north.  Look up at the top of the wall during 
the night and there you should see the Skulltula.  You cannot reach it with 
your Hookshot normally, what you have to do is hop up onto the fence below it, 
and use you Hookshot from there.  This way you will be able to reach the GOLD 
SKULLTULA [064].

facts.subject: waterfall
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the waterfall opens the entrance leading into Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
From here make your way up across the land bridges and stand 
in front of the waterfall, play Zelda's Lullaby to open it up and go through.

Zora's Domain it seems is completely covered in ice

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Jumping across the spinning ice platforms heading east over the water leads to Piece of Heart 024.

evidence.quote:
Instead of seeing 
Jabu Jabu here you will find a slab of ice which runs up and out over the 
water.  Run along this ice and jump down to the ice platforms floating in the 
water.  The ones which lead east take you in the direction of a Piece of 
Heart, however it isn't meant to be easy....jump to one of the spinning platforms and just stay on it until it goes 
around, and then jump to get the PIECE OF HEART [024].

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees in the spinning ice fan room opens the gate.

evidence.quote: From the entrance where you came in, go left and break the three icicles to find the fourth Silver Rupee.  Lastly from the entrance go right and climb up to the gate, you can jump off from here to acquire the fifth and final Silver Rupee which will open the gate.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 065
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 065 is found high on the wall in the spinning ice fan room where the icicles were broken.

evidence.quote: Before you leave the room, head back over to where you broke the icicles and look up on the wall, there you will see a GOLD SKULLTULA [065].

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
