facts.text: Melting the red ice encased around the large treasure chest with Blue Fire yields the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Cross the walkway and you'll come to a large hunk of red ice with a large treasure chest frozen inside it.  Use the Blue Flame to melt the ice and open the chest to get the DUNGEON MAP for this semi-dungeon.

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: Melting the red ice on the pillar and breaking the pot reveals a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Turn around and jump to that pillar with the red ice hunk on it.  Use the Blue Fire to melt it and then beak the pot, you should find a PURPLE RUPEE inside.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Melting the red ice on the right reveals a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Melt the red ice on your right and then open the large chest to acquire the dungeon's COMPASS.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart 025
facts.text: Melting the red ice on the left side reveals Piece of Heart 025.

evidence.quote: Next melt the red ice on the left side and pick up the PIECE OF HEART [025].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 066
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 066 is located on the wall above where Piece of Heart 025 was found.

evidence.quote: PIECE OF HEART [025]. ... Equip your Hookshot and then look up above where you got the Piece of Heart to find GOLD SKULLTULA [066].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 067
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 067 is found crawling on the left wall past the entrance of the large block puzzle room.

evidence.quote: From the entrance go left and then look left to find yet another GOLD SKULLTULA [067] crawling around on this wall here, be careful though because the ground doesn't entirely cover the area and it's very possible to fall down and wind up at the beginning of the dungeon again.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: To collect the Silver Rupees in the sliding block room, push the block west, climb it for the second, push it north and melt red ice for the third, then respawn the block, push it south for the fourth, and push it west for the fifth to open the gate.

evidence.quote: Push it west in the direction you are moving when you enter the room and hen climb on top of it and get the second Silver Rupee from the pillar.  After this push the block north and then climb up it, use the Blue Fire to melt the red ice and get the third Silver Rupee... This time push the block south and climb up onto it to get the next Silver Rupee.  Push it west following this and climb up onto it, you should be able to pick up the fifth Silver Rupee easily which opens the gate.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: To reach the exit ledge after the block respawns at the entrance, push the block west, south, and west to reach the Blue Fire, then push it south, east, and south to jump up to the opened gate hallway.

evidence.quote: When it respawns at the entrance to the room, push it west, then south, then west.  Jump from the block up to the blue torch and some bottles with Blue Fire.  Jump back down and push it south, then east, then south.  From here you should be able to jump from the block up to the hall where the gate opened.

facts.subject: White Wolfos
facts.text: The wolf miniboss can be defeated by blocking its attack with the shield and executing a jumping attack with the A button while its guard is down.

evidence.quote: use your shield constantly and attack the wolf only after he attacks you.  The jumping A button attack works great because you don't have to manually lower you shield to use it, just hit A after defending against one of his attacks when the wolf's guard is down.

facts.subject: Iron Boots
facts.text: Defeating the wolf miniboss causes a large treasure chest to appear in the center of the room containing the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: When the wolf is defeated a large chest appears in the middle of the room, it contains IRON BOOTS.

facts.subject: Serenade of Water
facts.text: After acquiring the Iron Boots, a scene plays where Link learns the Serenade of Water.

evidence.quote: After this there is another scene where you learn the SERENADE OF WATER.

facts.subject: Zora Tunic
facts.text: Using Blue Fire to thaw King Zora frees him and rewards Link with the Zora Tunic, which allows breathing underwater.

evidence.quote: Use the Blue Fire to free him and then speak to the king.  As a way of saying thank you, he will give you the ZORA TUNIC which allows you to breathe underwater.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart 026
facts.text: Bombing the base of the lone yellow tree northwest of Lon Lon Ranch opens a grotto where sinking to the bottom with Iron Boots yields Piece of Heart 026.

evidence.quote: Instead ride the horse northwest of the ranch and step beside the lone yellow tree.  When you get off you should feel your controller rumbling when you stand beside the tree.  Place a bomb there at the base and it will blast a hole in the ground.  Down here is a small body of water, what you need to do is swim into it and equip the Iron Boots.  You will sink down to the bottom and acquire a PIECE OF HEART [026].

facts.subject: Piece of Heart 027
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean plant beside the Lakeside Laboratory to the roof and climbing the ladder leads to Piece of Heart 027.

evidence.quote: When you arrive there, make your way over to the laboratory thing beside the bridge and step on the Magic Bean plant.  When it rises up, jump off immediately onto the roof of the house and climb the ladder... At the top here you will find PIECE OF HEART [027].

facts.subject: Golden Scale
facts.text: Catching the enormous fish swimming around the broken logs in the center of the Fishing Pond weighing at least fifteen pounds awards the Golden Scale, enabling diving for nine seconds.

evidence.quote: Your goal is to catch the fish in the very middle of the pond, the enormous one swimming around the broken logs and stuff, it's pretty much always in the same place... This fish should be at least fifteen pounds or more, which will net you the reward GOLDEN SCALE and allow you to dive underwater for nine seconds as opposed to six.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 068
facts.text: Rolling into the crate at the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool reveals Gold Skulltula 068.

evidence.quote: Equip the Iron Boots and jump into the water, have your Hookshot equipped as well.  At the very bottom, roll into the crate down here and a GOLD SKULLTULA [068] will pop out, you can kill it using the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart 028
facts.text: Diving to the very bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool using the Golden Scale and speaking to the scientist awards Piece of Heart 028.

evidence.quote: Now swim to the very bottom of this pond using your new Gold Scale, not you Iron Boots and speak to the man to acquire PIECE OF HEART [028].

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Standing beside the water spray and firing an arrow at the crystal switch allows opening the large chest to obtain the Compass.

evidence.quote: Up here there is a crystal and a large chest which cannot be opened due to a water spray.  What you need to do (well actually there are tons of solutions) is stand beside the water spray and chest, then fire an arrow from your Fairy Bow at the crystal.  Open the large chest while it is momentarily available to get the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Using a spinning sword attack to defeat the spike traps when they transform into small rocks spawns a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: What you need to do is simply run away from them until they transform into small rocks, this is their alternate form.  While in this form you can simply perform a spinning sword attack to destroy them all and spawn a large treasure chest.  Inside the chest you will find the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

facts.subject: Water Temple
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby beside the Triforce symbol plaque lowers the water level.

evidence.quote: In this room on one of the walls there is a Triforce symbol plaque that you can see.  What you want to do is stand beside this symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby on your Ocarina.  This will lower the water level.

facts.subject: Water Temple
facts.text: Aligning the center flame with the corner torches and firing arrows through it ignites the torches and unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: Stand at the entrance of this room so that the torch in the middle is aligned in your view with one of the torches in the corner and then equip your Fairy Bow.  You're done this before, when you fire an arrow through a flame the arrow becomes engulfed in flames itself, this is how you light the torches in the corners.  Once the torches are lit the door opens up and you can go through.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeating all three clam enemies with sword strikes before they charge spawns a small chest in the center of the room containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: When you get close to one of them they open up but then after a split second, they charge at you.  What you have to do is run up to them and be ready to swing your sword right away before they charge, it only takes a single hit to kill them.  After all three of them are dead then a small chest appears in the centre of the room containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Water Temple
facts.text: The Water Temple is located underwater in the middle of Lake Hylia on the north side of the centre island, and reaching the gate requires equipping the Iron Boots and the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: The Water Temple is located in the middle of Lake Hylia, on the north side of the centre island but underwater.  You need to equip the Iron Boots and the Hookshot and then jump down to the gate.

facts.subject: Deku Shield
facts.text: The Deku Shield is located on the lower shelf on the right side of the shop and can be purchased for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
You'll find the Deku Shield located on 
the lower shelf on the right side, select it and purchase it if you have 40 
Rupees.

facts.subject: evil plants
facts.text: Defeating the evil plant enemies will most likely yield a Deku Stick.

evidence.quote:
You will most likely acquire a Deku Stick after defeating this 
enemy.

facts.subject: plants
facts.text: The plant enemies inside the Deku Tree drop Deku Nuts when defeated.

evidence.quote:
These enemies will drop Deku Nuts, another new item which you can use to stun 
your enemies.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Opening the large chest at the top of the path yields the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
At the top of the path you will come across a 
large chest.  Open this chest to acquire the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: The defeated Deku Scrub drops a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Grab the Recovery Heart that the Deku Scrub drops and proceed 
through the door that just opened, not the one you came through.

facts.subject: large treasure chest
facts.text: A large treasure chest contains the Fairy Slingshot, which comes with 30 Deku Seeds.

evidence.quote:
The item inside 
turns out to be the FAIRY SLINGSHOT.  The Fairy Slingshot fires Deku Seeds, 
you are given 30 of them automatically to start with and you can find many 
more just by slashing grass and stuff.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: A treasure chest in a small hidden room reached by climbing the vine contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Before going back to the door note the vine beside this 
chest that you can climb up, it leads to a small hidden room with a treasure 
chest containing RECOVERY HEART.

facts.subject: large treasure chest
facts.text: Inside the large treasure chest across the raised platforms is the Compass for the dungeon.

evidence.quote:
There is a large treasure chest here and inside it you will find the 
COMPASS for the dungeon.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: Opening the small chest on the southern ledge awards a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
This time jump from the first platform, to the second platform and then jump 
south to the other ledge.  Open the small chest here to get a RECOVERY HEART 
from it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Defeating the Gold Skulltula on the wall yields the Gold Skulltula 001 token.

evidence.quote:
When the 
enemy has been defeated it will drop an item.  This is GOLD SKULLTULA [001] 
token that proves you killed it.

facts.subject: spider web
facts.text: The spider web in the center of the main room breaks when Link falls onto its middle from a great height.

evidence.quote: Now what you have to do is jump down all the way to the very bottom, remember that spider web in the middle of the room when you came in? Well it's time to break that web, and you break it by falling from such a huge distance down on top of it right in the middle.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Shooting the Gold Skulltula on the vine with two slingshot shots allows Link to collect Gold Skulltula 002.

evidence.quote:
Fire two shots at it to 
kill the monster and then climb up the vine to grab the GOLD SKULLTULA [002].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Shooting the Gold Skulltula on the water gate twice lets Link jump and grab Gold Skulltula 003 in mid air.

evidence.quote:
Take out your 
handy dandy Fairy Slingshot and fire two shots at the enemy to kill it.  Now 
jump from the ledge with the big button toward the water gate and grab the 
GOLD SKULLTULA [003] in mid air.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: The chest next to the torch yields a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest beside the torch to get a RECOVERY HEART and then whip out one 
of your many Deku Sticks.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub Brothers
facts.text: The Deku Scrub reveals that the brothers must be punished in the order 2, 3, 1.

evidence.quote:
The scrub tells you that you cannot defeat the brothers unless you punish them in the 
right order.  The correct order is 2, 3, 1.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: The Deku Scrub drops a Recovery Heart when defeated.

evidence.quote:
The scrub will drop a Recovery Heart for you 
to pick up but you still can't get out of this room.

facts.subject: eyeball switch
facts.text: Firing the Fairy Slingshot at the eyeball above the door removes the bars and unlocks the door.

evidence.quote:
Here's the trick, equip 
your Fairy Slingshot and aim up at the eyeball above the door.  Fire away at 
the eyeball and the bars will disappear, the door will be unlocked.

facts.subject: underwater button
facts.text: Diving and pressing the underwater button on the south wall lowers the water level so the moving platform passes under the rolling spike log.

evidence.quote:
Jump into the water 
and dive under, take a look along the south wall to find an underwater button 
and when you swim up to it, the button is automatically pressed.  Now with the 
button pressed the water level in this room drops and the moving platform is 
lower than the rolling spike log.

facts.subject: torches
facts.text: Lighting all the torches in the room with a Deku Stick unlocks both doors.

evidence.quote:
Your 
goal is to equip a Deku Stick and light it on fire, then use it to light all 
of the torches in this room.  This will unlock both doors, head north now.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: A small chest in the underwater room contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Here you will find a small chest containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 069
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 069 is located behind a closed gate that can be triggered by a 360-degree spin attack or a charged sword spin.

evidence.quote: Stand by the gate, twirl your analog stick 360 degrees and press the attack button to hit the crystal, if this doesn't work then simply hold down the attack button until your sword turns orange.  Eliminate the GOLD SKULLTULA [069] here.

facts.subject: water level
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby beside the Triforce symbol raises the water level higher.

evidence.quote: There is a Triforce symbol here, stand beside it and play Zelda's Lullaby in order to raise the water level up even higher.

facts.subject: chest behind cracked wall
facts.text: Blasting a hole in the cracked wall in the room where Link first met Ruto reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Blast a hole in the wall here where the large crack is and open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: barred door
facts.text: Firing an arrow through the unlit torch unlocks the barred door on the north side.

evidence.quote: There are bars across it, but an unlit torch beside it.  Fire an arrow through this torch to unlock the door.

facts.subject: hole in ceiling
facts.text: Defeating all enemies in the submerged hall opens a hole in the ceiling where another Small Key can be acquired.

evidence.quote: Hitting the spikes once will make them revert to their stone form after which you can kill them easily, the shell enemies are no different than they were before.  After defeating all of them a hole in the ceiling opens up on the other side, swim up there and acquire another SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: moving waterfall platforms
facts.text: Platforms move downward with the waterfall, requiring Link to hook from one moving platform to the one above it before being knocked off by the water until reaching the top panel.

evidence.quote: Here's how this works, on the other side there are platforms which move downward along with the waterfall and then go around behind it underwater before popping out at the top again.  You cannot stand on them once they are covered by the waterfall it will knock you off, so your goal is to hook onto one while it's moving down and then when you get onto it, quickly hook onto the one above, and then maybe the one above that, all the way until you are able to hook onto the panel at the top that connects to the other side of the room.

facts.subject: statue crystal puzzle
facts.text: Solving the statue room requires lowering the water to hook north, climbing over the statue, hitting the crystal to hook east, and shooting the crystal a fifth time while on the statue head to rise up.

evidence.quote: The solution is to hit the crystal in the middle again so the water level drops and then hook onto the panel on the wall to the north.  Climb over the statue and hit the crystal in the middle again.  Hook onto the statue to the east and then hit the crystal yet again, for the fourth time.  Jump onto the statue head and while standing on it, shoot the crystal for a fifth and final time, it will rise up with you on it.

facts.subject: Shadow Link
facts.text: Avoiding L/Z targeting prevents Shadow Link from easily deflecting swings.

evidence.quote: First of all Shadow Link will mimic every attack that you do, so if you target him with L/Z and then keep using the overhead swing, you'll clash swords until the end of time.  What you really want to do is avoid using L/Z targeting, that way he won't be able to line up his deflection swings as easily.

facts.subject: Shadow Link
facts.text: Using sword stabs against Shadow Link will cause him to jump on Link's sword and hit him.

evidence.quote: One thing to note is to avoid using the stab, he'll jump on your sword and hit you every time.

facts.subject: large treasure chest
facts.text: The large treasure chest in the room following Shadow Link contains the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Open the large treasure chest in this room and Link will acquire the LONGSHOT, an upgrade for your Hookshot which allows you to hook onto thing which are twice as far away.

facts.subject: blue block
facts.text: Standing beside the blue block behind the Longshot chest and playing the Song of Time displaces it.

evidence.quote: Notice that one of the floor panels behind the chest here is different from the rest, it's one of those blue blocks you've seen before which can be displaced simply by standing beside it and playing the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down).

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 070
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 070 can be grabbed from the wall near the whirlpool using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Walk up to the next whirlpool and use your Longshot to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [070] off of the wall.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: Shooting the eyeball switch opens a gate leading to a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Take a look at the wall and fire an arrow from the Fairy Bow at the eyeball switch, then jump across to grab the ledge where the gate opened and open the small chest to get a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 071
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 071 is located high toward the ceiling inside the central structure and can be reached using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Instead use the Longshot and aim it up toward the ceiling, off in the distance is a GOLD SKULLTULA [071] but since the reach of this thing is so good, you can get it from here.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: Pushing the block into place along the southern path leads to a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Follow the path to the end and push the block forward until it drops into place.  Make a right and open the small chest to acquire a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 072
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 072 is found on one of the walls in the room with the waterfall and moving platforms.

evidence.quote: This will bring you back to the room with the waterfall and the moving platforms.  On one of the walls here you will find GOLD SKULLTULA [072], make sure to get that one.

facts.subject: block switch puzzle
facts.text: Bombing the east and west walls allows pushing and pulling the block into the water to land on the switch and raise the water level.

evidence.quote: When they are taken care of, bomb the walls here on both the east and west sides.  Go down through the broken wall on the left side and push the block until it goes no further, go through the east side and pull it out, then go back to the west side and push it until it falls in the water and lands on the switch.

facts.subject: timed water jets
facts.text: Stepping on the button raises water jets, requiring Link to jump across the first jet and then the left jet before the timer drops the gate.

evidence.quote: Step on the button to raise the water jets up and jump across them, you only need to jump across two: the first one and then the left one.  Go through the door quickly before the timer runs out and the gate drops down again.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 073
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 073 is located on the wall in the rolling boulder room.

evidence.quote: Equip your Iron Boots and jump into the water after a rock rolls by, get the GOLD SKULLTULA [073] from the wall and drop down under the water below it.

facts.subject: coloured chest
facts.text: The enormous coloured chest behind the locked door contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: At the end of this hall, take off the boots and float up, then open the locked door here.  This enormous coloured chest of course contains the BOSS KEY for the dungeon.

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: Morpha deals about one heart worth of damage if a tentacle lands on Link, and upwards of three hearts if a tentacle grabs hold of him.

evidence.quote: If one of them lands on you, you take about one heart worth of damage, but if one of them grabs hold of you, it can deal upwards of three hearts, this attack is very powerful!

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: Firing the Longshot near the end of a tentacle pulls Morpha out of the water and leaves it open to sword attacks.

evidence.quote: Take aim near the end of the tentacle with your Longshot and fire at Morpha to suck it out of the water and leave it open to attack.

facts.subject: Lake Hylia
facts.text: Using the Longshot to hook to the tree top at Lake Hylia, walking to the end of the branch, and turning around allows Link to claim Gold Skulltula 074.

evidence.quote: Use it to hook onto the top and pull yourself up so that you land on the long branch.  There is a Gold Skulltula here beside you but you cannot get it from here, cross the branch to the end and turn around.  Use your Longshot to aim at it and claim the GOLD SKULLTULA [074].

facts.subject: Lake Hylia
facts.text: Shooting the morning sun with the Fairy Bow right after the morning cock-a-doodle-doo when the lake water rises causes the Fire Arrow to descend.

evidence.quote: It says that when the water in the Lake Rises, aim for the morning sun.  Do as it says, just after you hear the cock-a-doodle-doo of morning, take aim with your Fairy Bow and fire up at the sun.  When you do, a special item will descend down from above.  Swim over and pick up the FIRE ARROW.

facts.subject: Hyrule Castle
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms by the isolated tree south of the castle garden entrance reveals a secret hole with three bombable walls concealing Gold Skulltula 075.

evidence.quote: South of this place there is a large tree which stands by itself, stand beside it and play the Song of Storms (A, down, up, A, down, up) to reveal a secret hole.  Drop down this hole and bomb all three weak walls here.  Behind one of them you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [075].

facts.subject: Zora's River
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the log in front of the frogs in Zora's River rewards Piece of Heart 029.

evidence.quote: Stand on this log and play the Song of Storms (A, down, up, A, down, up) to have them give you a PIECE OF HEART [029] as a reward.

facts.subject: Zora's River
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time while standing on the log in front of the frogs in Zora's River causes them to give Link a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: After doing this stay where you are an play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and they will pop up again to give you a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Zora's River
facts.text: Completing the grown frogs minigame with the button sequence A, left, right, down, left, right, down, A, down, A, down, right, left, A rewards Piece of Heart 030.

evidence.quote: The solution is as follows: (A, left, right, down, left, right, down, A, down, A, down, right, left, A).  Doing this will net you a reward, the PIECE OF HEART [030].

facts.subject: Windmill
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms inside the windmill shack accelerates the windmill and drains the water from the well.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms in there (A, down, up, A, down, up) and it will cause the windmill to speed up, draining the water out of the well.

facts.subject: Triforce symbol
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol lowers the water level in the Bottom of the Well.

evidence.quote: At the other end you will find a Triforce symbol on the ground, stand on it and pull out your Ocarina.  Play Zelda's Lullaby while standing on this thing to lower the water level.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Dropping into the hole near the entrance room reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote: Return to the entrance of this room and drop down the hole, open the small chest to acquire some BOMBS and then crawl into the crawlspace.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Defeating the Dead Hand miniboss reveals a large chest containing the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: After the miniboss is defeated, open the large chest to acquire the LENS OF TRUTH.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Hidden doors down the halls to the left and right in the main room lead to two chests that both contain a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Check both left and right of this just a couple steps down the halls in both directions to find other hidden doors leading to two chests which both contain SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Passing through the hidden door on the right along the left hall leads to a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Follow the hall around the corner and through the hidden door on the right to find a large chest containing the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Heading down the hall past the two orange flame torches and through the rocks leads to a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: When you reach the middle here, collect as many Silver Rupees as you possibly can and then go down the hall past the two orange flame torches and through the rocks to find a large chest with the DUNGEON MAP in it.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Jumping down in front of the gate along the left hallway leads to a small chest containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Half way down this hallway make another left and move toward the gate, then jump down in front of it.  Open the small chest here to get a RECOVERY HEART and then climb the vines behind the chest.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Lighting the torches beside the coffins with Deku Sticks reveals a Small Key inside one of the coffins.

evidence.quote: After doing that whip out the Deku Sticks (remember those) and light the torches beside the coffins.  You'll get a lot of bats flying at you but one of them will contain another SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Inside the corner jail cell of the middle area is a small chest containing a Deku Nut.

evidence.quote: When you get in here, check the one jail cell in the corner for a small chest containing DEKU NUT.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Defeating the flower and possessed urns behind the northwest locked door allows Link to collect Gold Skulltula 076 using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Open the locked door on the northwest side, defeat the flower and the possessed urns and then use your Boomerang to get GOLD SKULLTULA [076].

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Following the perimeter edge path using the Lens of Truth in the northeast room allows Link to retrieve Gold Skulltula 077 using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Equip the Lens of Truth to see the path going around the edge.  Walk along this path and use your Boomerang to get GOLD SKULLTULA [077].

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Opening the small chest in the room beyond the northeast crawlspace yields a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open the small chest here to get a BLUE RUPEE and then go through the door.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Defeating the blob monster reveals Gold Skulltula 078 on the wall to claim with the Boomerang, alongside a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: In this room quickly defeat the disgusting blob monster and then use your Boomerang to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [078] from the wall, there is also another BLUE RUPEE in the treasure chest.

facts.subject: Bottom of the Well
facts.text: Bombing the cracked lump past the hole on the left at the north end of the main room reveals a small chest with a Deku Nut inside.

evidence.quote: You can pass the hole on the left and then bomb that weird lump wit ha crack in it to reveal a small chest with a DEKU NUT inside.

facts.subject: Hyrule Market
facts.text: Paying 10 Rupees to play the night treasure chest minigame in Hyrule Market and using the Lens of Truth to choose the key chest five consecutive times rewards Piece of Heart 031.

evidence.quote: Speak to the man and give him the 10 Rupees he wants in order to play the game then use the DOOR KEY you get to enter the next room.  There are two chests here and you have to guess the correct one.  This is easy, simply equip the Lens of Truth and open the chest with the key now, and four more times after this.  Your reward for cheating is the PIECE OF HEART [031]

facts.subject: Water Temple
facts.text: After the battle is over, get the Heart Container from between two pillars.

evidence.quote: After the battle is over, get the HEART CONTAINER from between two pillars down at

facts.subject: Broken Goron's Sword
facts.text: Trade the Poacher's Saw to the man across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley to obtain the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
He'll offer you the BROKEN GORON'S 
SWORD in return for the Poacher's Saw.

facts.subject: Nocturne of Shadow
facts.text: Link learns the Nocturne of Shadow during a scene upon entering Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
When you arrive here there is a scene.  Here is where you will learn the 
NOCTURNE OF SHADOW, the song which will warp you to the Shadow Temple, our 
next destination but only after we complete the Biggoron Sword sidequest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Break the rock beside the bomb flower at night using the Megaton Hammer to find Gold Skulltula [079].

evidence.quote:
During the night you should hear 
something crawling around here, equip the Megaton Hammer and break the rock 
beside the bomb flower to find GOLD SKULLTULA [079].

facts.subject: Prescription
facts.text: Biggoron gives Link the Prescription to get Eyedrops from King Zora.

evidence.quote:
He says that before he can repair anything, he's going to need some 
Eyedrops from King Zora.  In return he gives you the PRESCRIPTION you need.

facts.subject: Eyeball Frog
facts.text: Presenting the Prescription to King Zora yields the Eyeball Frog.

evidence.quote:
stand on the platform before the king and use the Prescription.  He 
will give you the EYEBALL FROG which is needed in order to fill the 
prescription, get it to the Lake Hylia Laboratory as soon as possible.

facts.subject: World's Finest Eye Drops
facts.text: Using the Eyeball Frog beside the old man in the Lake Hylia Laboratory yields the World's Finest Eye Drops.

evidence.quote:
Head 
for the lab and go inside, use the frog beside the old man here (approximate 
time remaining: plenty).  He'll give you WORLD'S FINEST EYE DROPS.

facts.subject: Claim Check
facts.text: Giving the Eyedrops to Biggoron atop Death Mountain Trail earns the Claim Check.

evidence.quote:
Climb the wall after they are dead and use the 
Eyedrops in front of the Biggoron to get the CLAIM CHECK for the sword.

facts.subject: Biggoron's Sword
facts.text: Playing the Sun's Song about five times and speaking to Biggoron grants the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Play the 
Sun's Song about five times or so and speak to him again to get the BIGGORON'S 
SWORD.

facts.subject: Nocturne of Shadow
facts.text: Playing the Nocturne of Shadow (left, right, right, A, left, right, down) warps Link to the graveyard.

evidence.quote:
to get there simply play the 
Nocturne of Shadow (left, right, right, A, left, right, down) on your Ocarina 
and it will take you to the graveyard.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple Entrance
facts.text: Casting Din's Fire from the center platform in the graveyard lights all torches to open the Shadow Temple entrance.

evidence.quote:
Jump onto the 
centre platform and equip the Din's Fire spell, use it here and every last one
of the torches will be lit.  Now the door to the Shadow Temple is open.

facts.subject: Large Chest
facts.text: A large chest behind hidden doors in the Shadow Temple contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Open the large chest in this room to acquire the 
DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

facts.subject: Dead Hand
facts.text: Two jump attacks with the Biggoron's Sword are enough to defeat the miniboss.

evidence.quote:
If you have the Biggoron's Sword then two jump 
attacks alone will be enough to take this enemy down.

facts.subject: Large Chest
facts.text: Defeating the miniboss spawns a large treasure chest containing the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote:
When you kill him, a 
large treasure chest appears in this room which contains the HOVER BOOTS, 
special shoes which allow you to hover above the ground but give absolutely no 
traction.

facts.subject: Skull Pillars
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth identifies the only real skull pillar, and pointing the statue toward it opens the door.

evidence.quote:
equip the Lens of Truth and take a 
look at the pillars surrounding the statue in the middle.  One of them will 
not disappear when you look at it, all of the others will.  Push the object 
coming out the side of the statue to point in the direction of the real skull 
and the door will open.

facts.subject: Large Chest
facts.text: Defeating the two mummies causes a large treasure chest containing the Compass to appear.

evidence.quote:
totally waste the two 
mummies in order to make a large treasure chest appear.  Inside this chest is 
the dungeon's COMPASS.

facts.subject: Treasure Chest
facts.text: Collecting all Silver Rupees in the spinning sickle room opens a gate to a small chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Once you have all of the Silver Rupees, 
go through the now-open gate and check inside the little treasure chest to get 
a SMALL KEY from it.

facts.subject: East Path Wall
facts.text: The eastern wall must be destroyed with a bomb to reach the locked door beyond.

evidence.quote:
There is one more path you haven't take it, but instead of simply walking 
through the wall, you must destroy it using a bomb.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Eliminating all enemies in the spinning death blade sickle room opens a gate to a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
When all 
enemies are eliminated the gate will open and you can go inside to find a BLUE 
RUPEE in the chest and a GOLD SKULLTULA [080] crawling on the wall.

facts.subject: Wall
facts.text: Gold Skulltula [080] is crawling on the wall inside the gated alcove of the hidden sickle room.

evidence.quote:
When all 
enemies are eliminated the gate will open and you can go inside to find a BLUE 
RUPEE in the chest and a GOLD SKULLTULA [080] crawling on the wall.

facts.subject: Laser Turret
facts.text: The fifth Silver Rupee in the moving platform area is revealed by blowing up the central laser turret.

evidence.quote:
Jump across again and begin collecting the 
Silver Rupees here in this area, the fifth one can be found by blowing up the 
laser turret in the centre here.

facts.subject: Spike Platforms
facts.text: Pushing the movable block along the track under the spike platforms stops both from dropping down.

evidence.quote:
Pull it out from the wall and place it on the 
track.  Begin pushing it along below the spike platforms.  When you get past 
the first one, push it only a little bit so it blocks the second one, bit is 
still partially under the first one.

facts.subject: Small Chest
facts.text: A small chest inside the right-hand jail cell contains Arrows.

evidence.quote: Make a right into the jail cell and open the small chest to get ARROWS.

facts.subject: Jail Cell
facts.text: Gold Skulltula [081] is located inside the cell opposite the arrow chest.

evidence.quote:
Turn around and enter the opposite cell, here you will find GOLD SKULLTULA 
[081].

facts.subject: Small Chest
facts.text: Hopping across the spike platform to the ledge reveals a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Hop over 
the spike thing to the opposite side and open the small chest containing BLUE 
RUPEE.

facts.subject: Small Chest
facts.text: Stepping on the floor button spawns a small chest on the opposite side containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
After that turn around and step on the button, it makes a small chest 
appear on the opposite side.  Go back across to it and open the chest to get a 
SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Small Chest
facts.text: A small treasure chest in the invisible spikes room yields a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Open the small treasure chest to 
acquire a BLUE RUPEE and then proceed through the western door.

facts.subject: Flaming Skull
facts.text: Gold Skulltula [082] is found behind the flaming skull.

evidence.quote:
Behind 
the flaming skull you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [082], be sure to get that.

facts.subject: Flaming Skull
facts.text: Blowing up the flaming skull with a Bomb Flower drops a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
notice there are some Bomb Flowers in this room, lift up 
one of the bombs and throw it on top of the flaming skull in order to blow it 
up.  A SMALL KEY will fall out of the broken wreckage for you to pick up.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A hidden small chest containing arrows appears in the zombie room when viewed using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Eliminate the two zombies in this room and then equip the Lens of Truth to see a hidden small chest containing ARROWS.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Defeating both mummies allows opening a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open the small chest here and collect the BLUE RUPEE from inside after you kill both of the mummies.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Blowing up the lump near the door reveals a small chest visible with the Lens of Truth that contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: After doing this equip your bombs and blow up that weird lump near the door. When you do so, equip the Lens of Truth and you'll see a small chest containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song allows Link to Longshot across to a platform holding Gold Skulltula 083.

evidence.quote: When you reach the top take out your Ocarina and play the Scarecrow's Song. One will appear on the platform across from you, use the Longshot to grab hold of him and swing over to another GOLD SKULLTULA [083].

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Throwing bombs into the three spinning skulls destroys them and reveals Gold Skulltula 084 on the wall.

evidence.quote: Throw three of them into the three spinning skulls and they will explode into quite a few Rupees. After collecting them check the wall for another GOLD SKULLTULA [084].

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Defeating the invisible Floormaster in the south room makes a small chest appear containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: You'll need to equip the Lens of Truth once again because there is an invisible Floormaster enemy in this room. Once defeated a small chest will appear containing SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A small chest in the spiked wall room contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open up the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE, then open up the large coloured chest to get the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A large colored chest in the spiked wall room contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Open up the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE, then open up the large coloured chest to get the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Each attack from Bongo Bongo deals at least 2 hearts of damage.

evidence.quote: Each one of this attacks deals at least two hearts worth of damage, possibly more.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Shooting one of Bongo Bongo's hands turns it blue and causes it to drop an arrow or a magic bottle.

evidence.quote: When you hit one hand it will turn blue and drop an item, either an arrow or a magic bottle, both of which you will be needing for this battle.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Stunning both hands, revealing the eye with the Lens of Truth, and shooting it allows defeating Bongo Bongo in two sets of Biggoron's Sword swings.

evidence.quote: The thing about this boss is that using the Biggoron's Sword, you only have to do this twice, the boss will die on the second set of sword swings, so this is why I say offensive is so good.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Defeating Bongo Bongo leaves a Heart Container on the ground.

evidence.quote: Collect the HEART CONTAINER from the ground and step into the warp portal.

facts.subject: Link
facts.text: Stepping into the warp portal after the temple takes Link to the sages and awards the Shadow Medallion.

evidence.quote: This will take you to the sages and net you the SHADOW MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Gerudo Valley
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 085 is found at night behind the big stone arch opposite the carpenter.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song so that it becomes night time and then look behind the big stone arch opposite the carpenter to find GOLD SKULLTULA [085].

facts.subject: Gerudo Valley
facts.text: Breaking all rocks near the carpenter using the Megaton Hammer reveals a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: After doing that break all the nearby rocks using the Megaton Hammer and you'll find a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Gerudo Valley
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 086 is found behind the tent at night.

evidence.quote: Check behind the tent at night and there you will find GOLD SKULLTULA [086].

facts.subject: Gerudo's Fortress
facts.text: Breaking a wooden crate on the roof outside reveals a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Break the wooden crate here and inside you'll find a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Gerudo's Fortress
facts.text: A large treasure chest reached by firing the Longshot over the gate contains Piece of Heart 032.

evidence.quote: Inside the large chest is a PIECE OF HEART [032].

facts.subject: Gerudo
facts.text: Defeating the Gerudo woman in the first carpenter's room yields a Small Key to open the jail cell.

evidence.quote: She drops a SMALL KEY when defeated, use it to open the jail cell beside you and free the prisoner.

facts.subject: Gerudo
facts.text: Defeating the Gerudo woman near the second carpenter awards a Small Key to free him.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Gerudo who drops down to get another SMALL KEY and then open the carpenter's cell and speak with him to set him free.

facts.subject: Gerudo's Fortress
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 087 appears on the east wall at night outside near the high single square ledge.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song on your Ocarina to make it night time and when you do, a GOLD SKULLTULA [087] will appear on the wall right beside you. This is on the east wall by the way.

facts.subject: Gerudo
facts.text: Defeating the Gerudo woman by the third jail cell awards a Small Key used to save the third carpenter.

evidence.quote: Down the ramp there third jail cell is found, defeat the Gerudo woman to get a SMALL KEY and then use it to save the third carpenter.

facts.subject: Gerudo
facts.text: Defeating the Gerudo woman by the fourth carpenter's cell awards a Small Key to save him.

evidence.quote: Get the SMALL KEY from the Gerudo and save him.

facts.subject: Gerudo's Fortress
facts.text: Saving all four carpenters triggers a scene granting the Gerudo's Membership Card.

evidence.quote: After this there is a scene and you get the GERUDO'S MEMBERSHIP CARD. Now you can freely move about the fortress without being thrown in jail.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Hitting a pot awards 100 points, while target centers give 100 points, outer circles give 60 points, and edges give 30 points.

evidence.quote: aim your bow and fire arrows at every single pot you pass, each one of them is worth 100 points... Hitting the centre is worth 100 points, the outer circle is 60 points and the edge is 30 points.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Accumulating 1000 points at the Horseback Archery game awards Piece of Heart 033.

evidence.quote: Your prize for successfully accumulating 1000 points is a PIECE OF HEART [033].

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Earning 1500 points in Horseback Archery awards the Biggest Quiver, increasing maximum arrow carrying capacity to 50 arrows.

evidence.quote: Your prize for managing to get 1500 points, which is actually quite difficult, is the BIGGEST QUIVER which increases your maximum arrow carrying capacity to 50 arrows.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Playing one round of Horseback Archery costs twenty Rupees, is only available during the day, and gives twenty arrows.

evidence.quote: The game can only be played during the day, the Gerudo to speak to will not appear at night... The cost to play one round is twenty Rupees... You are given twenty arrows each time you try.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 088
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the northern target at night.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song to make it night time.  Ride the horse to the north end and you will see that there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [088] on the northern target.

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Ground
facts.text: A Gerudo woman allows entry to the Gerudo Training Ground for 10 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Speak to her and she'll let you into the Gerudo Training Ground for a mere 10 Rupees, it's totally optional.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Shooting the eyeball switch above the entrance door spawns a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: above the door where you entered there is an eyeball switch, fire an arrow at it to spawn a small chest containing BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeating the two Stalfos within the one minute time limit spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There are two Stalfos enemies in this room and you need to defeat them before the time limit of one minute runs out, obviously make sure you're using the Biggoron's Sword for this.  After killing them both a chest appears containing SMALL KEY, pick it up and go through the door beside the chest to enter the next hall.

facts.subject: Silver Rupees
facts.text: You must collect all five Silver Rupees within one minute and thirty seconds.

evidence.quote: In here you have one minute and thirty seconds to collect all the Silver Rupees....The fifth Silver Rupee is located at the top of this hill.

facts.subject: Arrows
facts.text: Defeating the four wolf enemies causes a small chest containing Arrows to appear.

evidence.quote: Defeat the four wolf enemies in this room and then open the small chest appears to get a bunch of ARROWS.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Shooting all four statue eyes in a circle causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote: Shoot the eyeball of the statue and make your way around from left to right in a circle, shooting the eyeballs as you go along.  When all four of them are lit up a chest appears containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Smashing the statues with the Megaton Hammer, shooting the eye switch, and stepping on the button allows you to open a chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote: After doing this equip the megaton Hammer and smash all the statues at the sides of the room.  Shoot the eyeball switch to unlock the door and step on the button to lower the fire in the middle and allow you to open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time, diving with Iron Boots, and collecting the underwater Silver Rupees rewards a Small Key from a small chest.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and they will disappear.  Equip the Iron Boots and drop down the hole to the bottom.  Your goal is to collect all the Silver Rupees and it will make it a lot easier if you defeat the enemies first....When this is over, swim back up to the top and open the small chest to acquire the fourth SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeating the two lizard enemies and bombing the laser pillar reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: When the two lizards are defeated, bomb the laser pillar and a chest appears with a SMALL KEY in it.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time on the button platform summons blocks to climb up to a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and some blocks will appear here.  use the Hover Boots to reach them and climb up.  Grab the sixth SMALL KEY and go through the door.

facts.subject: Arrows
facts.text: Making a right leads to a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Make a right here and it leads to a chest containing ARROWS.

facts.subject: Bombchu
facts.text: Directly across from the door is a chest with a Bombchu inside.

evidence.quote: Directly across from the door where you entered is a chest with a BOMBCHU in it.

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: Unlocking the first two locked doors on the left leads to a chest with a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: use two Small Keys to go through the locked door on your left and then the one after it as well, now you're down to four.  Open the chest to get a PURPLE RUPEE here.

facts.subject: Red Rupee
facts.text: Continuing through the next two locked doors reveals a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next locked door and the one after it, open the small chest containing a RED RUPEE.

facts.subject: Arrows
facts.text: Passing through the next door leads to a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next door and open the chest to get ARROWS.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Climbing the fence wall into the ceiling hole found using the Lens of Truth leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Proceed through the door on the left which you unlocked and take a look at the ceiling with the Lens of Truth equipped, there is a hole up there.  Climb the fence wall and here you will find a chest containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Ice Arrow
facts.text: Inside the giant chest at the end of the locked room is the Ice Arrow.

evidence.quote: Inside the giant chest is the ICE ARROW, like the Fire Arrow it is a special elemental type of arrow you can shoot using the Fairy Bow.

facts.subject: Bombchu
facts.text: A carpet merchant in the desert sells Bombchus for 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Follow it and equip the Hover Boots, they will allow you to run onto the magic carpet and speak to the guy.  He sells Bombchus for 200 Rupees, not worth it, but whatever.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 089
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 089 is located inside the small stone structure in the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote: When you reach a small stone structure, drop down.  Defeat the GOLD SKULLTULA [089] there and then equip the Fire Arrows.

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: Lighting both torches inside the stone structure with Fire Arrows spawns a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Use them to light both torches in this room and spawn a small chest with a PURPLE RUPEE inside.

facts.subject: Nayru's Love
facts.text: Bombing the cracked wall between two trees reveals a Great Fairy Fountain where you learn Nayru's Love by playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem.

evidence.quote: Begin by heading north and taking a look between two trees for a wall with a crack in it.  Bomb this wall to reveal a Great Fairy Fountain, somewhere you haven't been in a long time.  This is where you will learn the third spell, Naryu's Love.  Prove your royal connections by standing on the Triforce emblem and playing Zelda's Lullaby.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 090
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 090 is on the back of the palm tree at night across from the dry oasis.

evidence.quote: Take a look on the back of the palm tree across from you at night, there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [090] on the back of it.

facts.subject: Requiem of Spirit
facts.text: Leaving the Spirit Temple triggers a scene where Sheik teaches you the Requiem of Spirit.

evidence.quote: Leave the temple for a scene.  Sheik will teach you the REQUIEM OF SPIRIT.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 091
facts.text: Dropping bugs into the hole in front of the Spirit Temple entrance reveals Gold Skulltula 091.

evidence.quote: In front of the door to the temple there is a hole there.  Drop your bugs into the hole to find GOLD SKULLTULA [091].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 092
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean plant at night takes you across Gold Skulltula 092 on top of a large rock mound.

evidence.quote: step on the Magic Bean plant.  Make sure it's night time, about half way through its flight you'll come across GOLD SKULLTULA [092] on top of a large rock mound.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart 034
facts.text: Piece of Heart 034 is located on top of the arch in front of the entrance near the end of the Magic Bean flight.

evidence.quote: Near the end of the flight, on top of the arch in front of the entrance is PIECE OF HEART [034].

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Hitting the crystal with the Boomerang lowers the bridge and gives access to a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Stand at the edge and equip the Boomerang.  Aim for the left side of the room and throw, it should come back around and hit the crystal on the other side.  This will cause the bridge to fall down.  Open the chest for a BLUE RUPPE and go through the door.

facts.subject: Anubis
facts.text: Anubis is weak to fire and can be engulfed in flames by shooting the crystal with the Slingshot when it is standing in front of the door.

evidence.quote: The enemy is weak to fire.  Notice that on the right side there is a crystal that when hit, creates fire in front of the door.  What you have to do is run to the middle of the room and jump to the left so the other enemy is standing in front of the door.  Shoot the crystal from here with your Slingshot and it will engulf Anubis in flames.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 093
facts.text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees lowers the bridge, allowing you to reach Gold Skulltula 093 with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: When you have all five the bridge drops down.  Go to the other side of the room and use your Boomerang to get GOLD SKULLTULA [093].

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Lighting both torches with Din's Fire allows you to open a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Since you can't use the Fire Arrows as Young Link, you'll have to ignite both of the torches here using the Din’s Fire spell.  Turn around and open the chest to get a SMALL KEY and then proceed through the door on the same side as the torches you ignited.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula 094
facts.text: At the top of the climbable wall, looking down reveals Gold Skulltula 094 on the wall, obtainable with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: At the very top, turn around and look down to see a GOLD SKULLTULA [094] on the wall, get it with the Boomerang.

facts.subject: Bombchu
facts.text: Hitting the crystal on the side of the room spawns a chest containing a Bombchu.

evidence.quote: Look up at the side of the room to see a crystal, hit it and a chest appears containing a BOMBCHU, there should also be another chest here with a BLUE RUPEE in it.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Hitting the crystal on the side of the room also reveals another chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Look up at the side of the room to see a crystal, hit it and a chest appears containing a BOMBCHU, there should also be another chest here with a BLUE RUPEE in it.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Lighting both torches on the square platform in the center of the room with Din's Fire reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Stand on this platform and use Din's Fire to light both the torches beside you.  A large chest appears here, possibly right where you are standing, open it up and collect the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees ignites a torch, which can be used with Deku Sticks to light the three other torches in the room and unlock a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Climb around the room and collect all five of the Silver Rupees.  When you do this a torch sets on fire, you're going to need that.  Equip the Deku Stick and light it one fire, there are three torches in this room to light using the Deku Stick as well.  When you light them all, open the chest to get a SMALL KEY and then head onward.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 095 is located above the locked door and can be retrieved using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Turn around and look above the door, equip the Boomerang and get the GOLD SKULLTULA [095].

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: The Iron Knuckle deals up to four hearts of damage per attack and takes at least seven or eight jump attacks to defeat as a child.

evidence.quote: His attacks can deal up to four hearts worth of damage.  He has two types of attacks, a double horizontal slash and a powerful over head slash.  The basic tactic for both of them is the same, avoid it and use the jump attack...It takes a hell of a lot of hits to defeat this guy, even using the jump attack it's at least seven or eight.

facts.subject: Silver Gauntlets
facts.text: A large treasure chest outside the door behind the Iron Knuckle's throne contains the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: After he is defeated, head through the door behind the throne.  It leads you outside where you will have to listen to that stupid owl.  After doing so be very careful to avoid falling off the ledge and open the large treasure chest to acquire the SILVER GAUNTLETS.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce emblem spawns a treasure chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Defeat the wolf monster and then stand on the Triforce emblem and play Zelda's Lullaby to spawn a treasure chest.  Use the Longshot to hook onto the treasure chest and open it up to acquire the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time beside the blue block reveals Gold Skulltula 096 behind it.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time beside the blue block in the middle on the left (right, A, down, right, A, down).  Behind it you will find the next GOLD SKULLTULA [096].

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: A small treasure chest in the room past the boulder area contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There is only a small treasure chest in this room containing a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Mirror puzzle
facts.text: Rotating the central mirror so the light shines on the third sun opens the way, while the other suns spawn trapped chests.

evidence.quote: After the enemy is defeated, grab hold of the thing in the middle and rotate it so that the light shines on the third sun, ignore the treasure chests that come out of the other ones, they are trapped chests.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 097 is located on a platform across from the torch ledge at the top of the stairs and can be reached using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: There is a GOLD SKULLTULA [097] right beside him and you can take it out using the Longshot from this ledge.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol on the statue's hand spawns a chest in the other hand containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Equip the Hover Boots and run along the air to land in the hand of the statue, there is a Triforce symbol here, stand on it and play Zelda's Lullaby to spawn a treasure chest.  Use the Longshot to grab hold of the chest in the other hand and launch to it.  Open the chest to acquire a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: A chest on the platform across from where the Hover Boots were used contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Climb back up the staircase that you were just on once again, and notice that across from where you used the Hover Boots, there is now another chest.  Longshot to it and open it for a BLUE RUPEE, then equip the Megaton Hammer and pound the rusted button down to open the door below, drop down and go through.

facts.subject: Recovery Heart
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals two hidden treasure chests in the hallway, each containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: In this next hallway equip the Lens of Truth and you'll see two treasure chests, one contains a RECOVERY HEART and the other contains a RECOVERY HEART as well.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: The Iron Knuckle can be defeated in four jump attacks when using the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: Another battle against an Iron Knuckle occurs in this room, but with the Biggoron's Sword it takes only a mere four jump attacks to kill him, and the range is much longer, so overall this enemy is much much easier.

facts.subject: Mirror Shield
facts.text: A large treasure chest outside contains the Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote: Leave the room and go outside, here you will find a large treasure chest containing the MIRROR SHIELD.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Reflecting the beam of light onto the sun on the wall using the Mirror Shield unlocks the door leading to a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There is a beam of light coming into the room, stand in the beam with the Mirror Shield equipped and reflect the light up to the sun on the wall.  This will unlock the door beside you and allow you to go through and get SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Shooting the eye switch behind the bombable door, Longshotting to the ceiling panel, and pressing the button on the high platform unlocks the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: When it explodes equip the Fairy Bow and the Longshot, fire an arrow at the eyeball behind the door and then Longshot to the panel on the ceiling, you should land on a platform.  Jump from this platform to the other platform and step on the button, then drop down and open the chest to get the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Sorceress Sisters Twinrova
facts.text: In phase one of Twinrova, Link must deflect one sister's elemental beam attack with the Mirror Shield onto the other sister, hitting each two or three times.

evidence.quote: In order to defeat the bosses what you have to do is deflect the beam of one boss and aim it at another boss.  The beam is constant so you'll be able to swing it around for a couple seconds in hope of hitting the other boss...Each of them must take two or three hits before the second phase begins.

facts.subject: Sorceress Sisters Twinrova
facts.text: In phase two, Link must absorb three identical elemental attacks in a row with the Mirror Shield to blast Twinrova out of the sky, requiring two knockdowns with the Biggoron's Sword to defeat her.

evidence.quote: You need to absorb three of the same elements in a row and then that will fire off a blast at the boss and knock her down...With the Biggoron's Sword you should only have to knock her out two times before she dies.

facts.subject: Sorceress Sisters Twinrova
facts.text: Defeating the boss Twinrova rewards Link with a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: Defeating the boss nets you a HEART CONTAINER after the scene, then as usual

facts.subject: Spirit Medallion
facts.text: Link is brought to see the sages and receives the Spirit Medallion after completing the temple.

evidence.quote: you will be brought to see the sages and be given the SPIRIT MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart [036]
facts.text: Piece of Heart 036 is found in the exact center at the very bottom of the deep water in Zora's Fountain by sinking with the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: Stand on the ice and equip the Iron Boots, jump down into the deep water.  In the exact centre at the very bottom you will find PIECE OF HEART [036], the final piece of heart which will bring your total heart containers up to twenty.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Lifting the large rock outside the cave with the Silver Gauntlets at night and using the Lens of Truth leads to a ladder where Gold Skulltula 098 is on the left wall.

evidence.quote: In front of the cave there is a large rock, lift it up using the Silver Gauntlets and drop down.  Equip the Lens of Truth so you can see the Skulltulas here.  Climb the ladder at the end and look at the wall on your left to find GOLD SKULLTULA [098].

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 099 is located on the wall to the left along the path leading from the king's room to the top of the waterfall.

evidence.quote: From the king's room that the path leading to the top of the waterfall and look to your left, there you should see another GOLD SKULLTULA [099].

facts.subject: Light Arrow
facts.text: Warping to the Temple of Time triggers a scene where Link is granted the Light Arrow.

evidence.quote: First before you do anything, play the Prelude of Light and warp to the Temple of Time.  Here you will trigger a scene, when it is all over Link will be granted the LIGHT ARROW which allows you to fire arrows of light from your Fairy Bow.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula 100 appears at night behind one of the rocks near the climbable wall after breaking them with the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: As you approach the top, in the path were all the rocks are before the climbable wall, break the rocks using your Megaton Hammer.  During the night, the final GOLD SKULLTULA [100] will appear on the wall behind one of these rocks.

facts.subject: Huge Rupee
facts.text: Speaking to the guy in the middle of the House of Skulltula rewards Link with a Huge Rupee that can be collected an infinite number of times.

evidence.quote: Enter the House of Skulltula and speak to the guy in the middle, your reward for all this work is a pathetic HUGE RUPEE.  The only redeeming fact is that you can leave the house and come back to get an infinite number of them, but the real reward is the accomplishment.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: Defeating the wolf enemy in the green emblem room reveals a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Defeat the wolf enemy in this room and open the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: green emblem room torches
facts.text: Shooting a Fire Arrow at the torch above the door and using Din's Fire to light the other four torches unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: Shoot a Fire Arrow at the torch above the door and then use Din's Fire to light the other four torches around you. Head through the door that opens up.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest on the left side at the start of the purple emblem room contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: At the beginning of this room you will see a chest on your left containing a BLUE RUPEE, you can Longshot to get over there if you wish.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: Standing on the button on the ice platform spawns a treasure chest containing the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Stand on the button to spawn a treasure chest then turn around and Longshot to it. The chest contains GOLDEN GAUNTLETS, an upgrade to the Silver Gauntlets which allow you to lift very heavy objects with your bare hands.

facts.subject: Great Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Lifting the enormous rock at the end of the path left of the rainbow bridge reveals a Great Fairy who outlines hearts in white to double Link's health total.

evidence.quote: Leave the castle and make a left at the bottom of the rainbow bridge, follow this path to the end and lift up that enormous rock to reveal another Great Fairy Fountain. She will outline all of your hearts in white which doubles you health total, it will now take twice as many hits to kill you than before, one of the most helpful upgrades in the game.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: In the blue circle room, the chest on the right contains a Recovery Heart, while the chest on the left freezes Link.

evidence.quote: Next, open the chest on the right to get a RECOVERY HEART but not the one on the left as it will just freeze you.

facts.subject: blue circle room block puzzle
facts.text: Under a two-minute limit, push the far block right and down into the hole, then push the other block right, up, and left to climb it, melt the red ice, and hammer the rusted button.

evidence.quote: You've got two minutes to do the following, grab hold of the block further away from you and push it to the right, and then down so it falls into the hole....After that push the other block right, up and then left. Climb on top of it and melt the red ice up here, use the Megaton Hammer to pound down the rusted button and then go through the door at the top.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: After defeating the fiery slugs and hitting the crystal through the gate, open the chest to obtain Bombchus.

evidence.quote: In the next room defeat the fiery slugs and then hit the crystal through the gate with your sword. Open the chest which contains Bombchus and equip them.

facts.subject: orange circle room gate
facts.text: Throwing a Bombchu through the hole at the top of the gate hits the crystal on the other side and unlocks the gate.

evidence.quote: Now look up at the top of the gate to see a hole, throw a Bombchu through there and it will hit the crystal on the other side, unlocking the gate.

facts.subject: orange circle final room sun emblem
facts.text: Shooting a Fire Arrow at the ceiling web allows Link to stand in the light beam and reflect light with the Mirror Shield at the correct sun emblem, while wrong emblems summon a hand.

evidence.quote: In the final room, equip a Fire Arrow and aim it up at the ceiling, shoot the web and then stand in the beam and reflect the light with your Mirror Shield to reflect light at the correct sun emblem. If you hit one of the wrong ones, be ready to move and avoid the hand that comes down to grab you.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Eliminating the Skulltula and three bats in the yellow room allows Link to open the center chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote: there is a Skulltula as well as three bats to eliminate in this room. Once you've done so, open the chest in the middle of the room to get a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Triforce symbol chest
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol drops a chest with a Small Key and opens the door.

evidence.quote: Stand on it and play Zelda's Lullaby on your Ocarina, a chest drops with another SMALL KEY and the door opens.

facts.subject: coloured chest
facts.text: Defeating the two Stalfos in the tower structure allows Link to open the coloured chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Defeat them and open the coloured chest to acquire the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: Deflect Ganondorf's energy blasts with a sword until one strikes him, stun him with a Light Arrow, and slash him on the center platform with the Biggoron's Sword across three knockdowns.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf will fire an energy blast at you, deflect it with your sword and he'll deflect it back. Keep doing this over and over again until eventually it hits him. At this point you have a very short window of time to bring up a Light Arrow and fire it at him. When he goes down either roll across to the middle platform with the Hover Boots equipped, or Longshot to Ganondorf himself and slash with the Biggoron's Sword....Doing this it will only take a mere three knock downs to actually take him out, but the battle isn't over yet.

facts.subject: Ganon
facts.text: Link can roll under Ganon's legs to slash his tail with the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer, or stun his face with a Light Arrow to get behind him.

evidence.quote: The tactic to use here is relatively simple, with whatever weapon you are using, roll under Ganon's legs and slash like crazy at his tail. Roll out of the way to avoid his sword swings and repeat this pattern over and over again....The alternative to this is targeting his face with the L/Z button and firing a Light Arrow to stun him, then simply running around behind and doing the same thing.

facts.subject: Ganon
facts.text: The final blow against Ganon must be delivered with a swing of the Master Sword, as no other weapon will suffice.

evidence.quote: The battle can only be won with a swing of the Master Sword, no other weapon will suffice. Strike the final blow and...

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: Playing the Shooting Gallery in Hyrule Market costs 20 Rupees, granting fifteen shots to hit ten Rupees.

evidence.quote: What you have to do in the Shooting Gallery is pay 20 Rupees in order to begin the game. You are given fifteen shots and you have to shoot down ten Rupees.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: Hitting eight out of ten targets awards a free game, while hitting all ten targets rewards Link with a Bullet Bag that increases Deku Seed capacity from 30 to 40.

evidence.quote: If you manage to hit eight out of the ten targets then you will be rewarded with a free game, if you manage to hit ten out of the ten targets then you will be rewarded with a BULLET BAG for your Deku Seeds, this allows you to carry 40 Deku Seeds for use with your Fairy Slingshot instead of 30, and is quite a helpful item.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: If you can manage to hit all ten then you will be rewarded with the BIG QUIVER, which allows you to carry a total of 40 Arrows instead of 30.

evidence.quote: If you can manage to hit all ten then you will be rewarded with the BIG QUIVER, a special item which allows you to carry a total of 40 Arrows instead of 30.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Activating the crystal switch in the icy floor with a bomb makes the ice blocks containing the Piece of Heart disappear so you can grab it.

evidence.quote: Now, before you leave the room, check the icy floor to find just the tip of a crystal switch hiding down there. Place a bomb right there to activate it. This will make the ice blocks containing the Piece of Heart above to disappear. Go grab it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song summons Pierre to an alcove, allowing Link to Hookshot up and kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Play your Scarecrow's Song and Pierre will appear up there. Hookshot up and kill the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Shooting the crystal switch near the entrance alcove causes the ice block containing a Gold Skulltula under the red iced alcove to disappear.

evidence.quote: Now, go back to the alcove where you entered and look around for a crystal switch. Shoot it to make the ice block containing a Gold Skulltula under the red iced alcove disappear. Go there and kill the Skulltula.

facts.subject: Iron Boots
facts.text: Defeating the Stalfos in the concealed room allows Link to open a chest containing the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: Kill or ignore the Ice Keese as you go through the tunnel, and enter the concealed door to find yourself in a really weird room, where you'll fight a Stalfos. Kill it, and open the chest to get the IRON BOOTS.

facts.subject: Serenade of Water
facts.text: Sheik teaches Link the Serenade of Water in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Sheik will teach you the SERENADE OF WATER as well.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Hookshotting the targetable wall engraving causes a chest to appear that contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Hookshot the wall engraving that you can L-Target to make a chest appear. Open it for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Defeating the two Lizalfos that appear near the wall engraving reveals a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Enter the door and kill the Spike by Hookshotting it, then slashing. Approach the wall engraving and two Lizalfos will appear. Kill them, then open the chest that appears for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Longshot
facts.text: Hookshotting the wall engraving in the small elevated room makes a treasure chest appear containing the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Hookshot the wall engraving to make a treasure chest appear. Open it for the LONGSHOT.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Lighting the torch with Din's Fire opens the gate and kills the Gold Skulltula behind it so you can collect the token.

evidence.quote: At the end, you'll find another gate which can only be opened by lighting the torch. Use Din's Fire to light the torch and kill the Gold Skulltula there, so just collect the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Longshotting through the ceiling hole and breaking the crates reveals a Gold Skulltula.
