evidence.quote: Longshot up through the hole in the ceiling, and break the crates up here to find a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Longshotting the wall engraving makes a small chest fall down containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: This will reveal a crystal switch. Hit it to open up another grating in the ceiling. Go there and Longshot up. Longshot the wall engraving to make a small chest fall down. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located near the ceiling by the second whirlpool of the underground river.

evidence.quote: Look up near the ceiling to find a Gold Skulltula. Longshot it and its token.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Lighting all torches with Din's Fire from atop the geyser opens the gate to a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: At its top, use Din's Fire to light all the torches to open the gate. Quickly jump over and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Breaking the crates in the room beyond the Dodongo hallway reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In here, break the crates to find a Gold Skulltula. Kill it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Lighting the torches with Fire Arrows and summoning Pierre allows Link to access a room with a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.

evidence.quote: Shoot the torches with Fire Arrows to light them (you're too far away to use Din's Fire, I believe). Now, play your Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre, and Longshot to him. Kill the Stalfos, then enter the small room that used to be blocked by a gate. Look up to see the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby at the Triforce symbol opens a gate leading to a chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: See the Triforce symbol? Play Zelda's Lullaby there to open the nearby gate. Go through that and open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Defeating Dead Hand after draining the water yields a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Head back to where you entered and jump into the now-empty hole in the ground. Go through the crawlspace, climb up, and enter the door to fight the Dead Hand. Once it's killed, open the chest for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Bombing the cracked dirt mound reveals a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Now, find the mound of dirt around here that has...a crack in it, and bomb it. Pick up the SMALL KEY and head back to the main room.

facts.subject: Lens of Truth
facts.text: In the southeastern corridor past the ReDeads, opening the chest yields the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Step into the central area down here, and take the southeastern corridor (the one with all the blue fires) to find some ReDeads. Stun them with the Sun's Song and grab the LENS OF TRUTH from the chest, to avoid fighting those deadly things.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found at the end of the northwestern corridor guarded by Big Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: Take the northwestern corridor while having the Lens of Truth on to fight some Big Skulltulas. Take them down as you progress and get the Gold Skulltula at the end.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the left room of the central jail chamber, defeating the invisible enemies and pulling back the gravestone reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Enter the left door in here and use the Lens of Truth to take out all the invisible enemies. Once they're gone, pull the gravestone back to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Following the invisible path in the right room of the central jail leads to an alcove with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Put on the Lens of Truth to see an invisible path. Take it to the alcove and pick up the SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden behind the statue to the right in the locked room past the grating.

evidence.quote: Head to the back of this room and look behind the statue to the right to find a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Bird Statue
facts.text: Twisting the bird statue so its beak faces the skull that does not disappear when viewed with the Lens of Truth opens the gate ahead.

evidence.quote: To begin with, see the bird statue and the skull pillars surrounding it? Use the Lens of Truth to find the skull that doesn't disappear when seen, and twist the statue around so its beak faces that skull. This will open the gate ahead.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeating the Gibdos behind the fake skull barricade makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: In here, kill the Gibdos to make a chest appear. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees and defeating the Big Skulltula opens the cage and unseals the exit, revealing a chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Your objective is to collect all five Silver Rupees here. It should be obvious on how to get these. Enter the cage that opens and kill the Big Skulltula there. By now, if you've killed them all, the door back out should've opened up. Open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Defeating the four ReDeads reveals a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Use the Sun's Song to stun them first to be safe, then kill them one by one. The door back out will open, and a chest will appear. Open it for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Hover Boots
facts.text: Defeating the Dead Hand unlocks a chest containing the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote: Go through the door and fight the Dead Hand. After it's dead, open the chest for the HOVER BOOTS.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: A small chest located through a pit under a face panel on the wall contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Approach it to fall through the floor. Put on the Lens of Truth to find a small
chest and an invisible Big Skulltula. Open the chest for a Small Key, then go
back up, to where the Beamos is.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: In the invisible scythe statue room, a chest contains a Blue Rupee or a replacement Hylian Shield if lost to the Like Like.

evidence.quote:
Go through, open the chest for a Blue Rupee (Hylian Shield
if you lost it from the Like Like), and open the invisible chest for a Small
Key.

facts.subject: invisible chest
facts.text: In the scythe statue room, an invisible chest behind the gate contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Go through, open the chest for a Blue Rupee (Hylian Shield
if you lost it from the Like Like), and open the invisible chest for a Small
Key.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees below the large room makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
Collect all the Silver Rupees down here, avoiding the Beamos and spike
traps, to make a chest appear...Open it for 
some arrows, if you're low.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the cell room with ceiling spike traps, a Gold Skulltula is found in the cell to the left after pushing the block underneath the traps.

evidence.quote:
Now that
they're both blocked, enter the cell to your left after passing the block to
find a Gold Skulltula. You'll have to Longshot its token.

facts.subject: cell chest
facts.text: A chest inside the cell across from the Gold Skulltula contains arrows.

evidence.quote: Now, head into the cell across from here to find a chest. Open it for more arrows.

facts.subject: south chest
facts.text: Above the cells on the south side, a chest contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Go
to the south side and open the chest there for a Blue Rupee, then step on the
switch to make another chest appear.

facts.subject: switch chest
facts.text: Stepping on the switch above the cells spawns a chest reachable via a spike trap containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
step on the
switch to make another chest appear. Use one of the spike traps to reach it, 
and open it for a Small Key.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: Defeating the ReDeads in the invisible spikes room spawns a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Kill the ReDeads here as you navigate through invisible spikes to make a 
treasure chest appear. Open it for a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: shrine chest
facts.text: Killing both Stalfos in the shrine room makes a chest containing a Red Rupee appear.

evidence.quote:
Approach the center of the shrine here to fight a Stalfos. Kill it, then climb up to
fight another one. Once both are killed, a chest will appear. Open it for a
Red Rupee.

facts.subject: invisible chest
facts.text: In the room reached past the fan corridor, an invisible chest guarded by ReDeads contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Play the Sun's Song to stun the
ReDeads, then open the invisible chest here for a Small Key.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the ReDead room off the fan corridor.

evidence.quote:
Kill the ReDeads
to get them out of the way. Longshot the Gold Skulltula then go back.

facts.subject: revealed chest
facts.text: In the hidden alcove room, defeating the Gibdos reveals a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this next
room, kill the Gibdos and open the revealed chest for a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Bombing the dirt piles in the Gibdo room reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Now, see
the piles of dirt on the corners of this room? Bomb them to find a Gold 
Skulltula and an invisible chest containing arrows.

facts.subject: invisible chest
facts.text: Bombing the dirt piles in the Gibdo room reveals an invisible chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Now, see
the piles of dirt on the corners of this room? Bomb them to find a Gold 
Skulltula and an invisible chest containing arrows.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located under the bridge created by exploding bomb flowers across the boat ride water.

evidence.quote:
Look across the "water" here to
spot some bomb flowers. Snipe them with arrows to blow them up, in turn blowing
up the structure, creating a bridge. Cross it halfway, then turn around and
look down to find a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: skull pots
facts.text: In the west room of the invisible maze with rotating skull pots, a Small Key is located behind the pots.

evidence.quote:
In this room of huge skull pots rotating
around, go behind them to find a Small Key.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Defeating Dead Hand in the southern torture room makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
Repeat until he's dead. Open the chest that appears
for some arrows.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: In the room behind the north locked door, the small chest contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Open the small chest for a Blue Rupee, and the large colorful one for the BOSS
KEY.

facts.subject: large colorful chest
facts.text: In the room behind the north locked door, the large colorful chest contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Open the small chest for a Blue Rupee, and the large colorful one for the BOSS
KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the room before Bongo Bongo's boss door, a Gold Skulltula is on an invisible platform reachable using the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots.

evidence.quote:
In this seemingly empty room, you'll see the boss door ahead of you,
and a Gold Skulltula seemingly crawling in the middle of nowhere. Put on your
Lens of Truth and Hover Boots and head over to the platform the Gold Skulltula
is on.

facts.subject: entrance chests
facts.text: Upon entering the Gerudo Training Grounds, open both chests for arrows and Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, once you enter, 
open both chests here for some arrows and Bombchus, then find the eye switch.

facts.subject: timed room chest
facts.text: Defeating all enemies in the right room within one minute spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Inside, you'll have to kill all the enemies in under a minute...After they're 
all dead, open the chest that appears for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: water room chest
facts.text: Collecting all underwater Silver Rupees reveals a chest above the surface containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Once they're all collected, a chest will appear 
above the surface. Surface and open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle chest
facts.text: Defeating the Iron Knuckle in the quicksand room allows opening a chest for a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
After he's dead,
open the chest for a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Silver Rupees route
facts.text: To collect the Silver Rupees in 1 minute and 30 seconds: move forward and Longshot up, fall to the rupee, Longshot back up, take a right then left and slash icicles for the second rupee, double back and walk off the edge to grab the edge for the third rupee, Longshot up in front of the fire wall for the fourth rupee, then take a right and two lefts to kill a Freezard for the fifth rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this room, you'll have 
to collect all the Silver Rupees in 1 minute and 30 seconds. Here's an in-depth 
step-by-step guide to getting them all.

- Move forward and Longshot up. Fall to the Silver Rupee, then Longshot back
 up.
- Take a right, then a left. Slash the icicles for the second Silver Rupee.
- Double back and head to the end. Carefully walk towards the Silver Rupee off
 the edge and grab the edge to get the Silver Rupee.
- To your left is a fire wall. Stand in front of it and Longshot up to the 
 Silver Rupee.
- Take a right then two lefts to find a Freezard. Kill it to get another Silver
 Rupee.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Defeating the Stalfos and Big Skulltulas within one minute spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Defeat the Stalfos and Big Skulltulas here within a minute
to make a chest appear containing some arrows.

facts.subject: statue chest
facts.text: Firing arrows into all 4 eyes of the statue makes a chest containing Bombchus appear.

evidence.quote:
Jump down and look at the statue. Fire arrows into all four of its eyes to make
a chest appear. Open it for some Bombchus.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Defeating an Iron Knuckle and Torch Slugs in under one minute makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll have to defeat an Iron Knuckle 
and some Torch Slugs in under a minute...Open the chest that
appears when you clear it for some arrows.

facts.subject: fire chest
facts.text: Cooking a Bombchu for about 3 seconds to trigger the switch above the door spawns a chest in the fire containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Bring out a Bombchu, hold
it for about three seconds, then release it. It should explode on or near the
crystal switch, activating it, and making a chest appear in the fire. Find a
switch on the ground to lower the fires, and collect the last SMALL KEY from
the chest.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: An Iron Knuckle can be defeated by L-Targeting him, throwing about ten Bombchus at him in rapid succession to make the armor fall off, then shooting five arrows to finish him off.

evidence.quote:
A great tip I read 
from Kirby021591's guide is that you can L-Target the Iron Knuckle and throw
about ten Bombchus at him in rapid succession to make the armor fall off, then
shoot five arrows to finish him off, so try doing that method.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: In the Gerudo's Training Ground, breaking a crate reveals a rusted switch that can be hammered to make a big chest appear containing the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Break it to find a rusted switch.
Hammer it to make a big chest appear above you...Open it for ICE
ARROWS!

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: At the entrance of the Spirit Temple as Adult Link, a chest up the stairs contains Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
Enter the temple as Adult Link. Go up the stairs and open the chest for some
Bombchus.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Bombing a rock to the right of the hall reveals an eye switch that makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
look
to the right of the hall to see a rock. Bomb it to find an eye switch. Shoot it
and open the chest that appears for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Shooting the crystal switch on the pillar makes another chest appear containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
on the pillar, is a crystal switch sticking out.
Shoot it to make another chest appear containing more Bombchus.

facts.subject: Torch Slug
facts.text: Torch Slugs can be defeated by stunning them with Deku Nuts, jump striking them to extinguish their fire, and jump striking them two or three more times.

evidence.quote:
take out the Torch Slugs by first stunning them with Deku Nuts
(they're actually useful? =O ) and then jump striking them to take away their
fire, then jump strike them two or three more times to defeat them.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest in the room to the left of the eye switch contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Open the chest in this new room to get the DUNGEON MAP

facts.subject: Anubis
facts.text: Anubis can be killed with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
kill the Anubis
with Din's Fire.

facts.subject: Gibdo
facts.text: Gibdos can be stunned with Sun's Song and slashed to death.

evidence.quote: Stun the Gibdo with Sun's Song and slash it to death.

facts.subject: Eye switch
facts.text: Using a Bombchu to destroy the rock across the pit reveals an eye switch that creates an ice block over the pit when shot.

evidence.quote:
use a Bombchu to destroy it. Yep, it'll cross the pit. This will
reveal an eye switch. Shoot it to make an ice block appear over the pit.

facts.subject: Stalfos
facts.text: The Stalfos on the spinning platform can be pushed off and killed by slashing him when he is near the edge.

evidence.quote:
duel a Stalfos. Quite a
challenge as Young Link, but you can push him off by slashing him when he's
near the edge, killing him easily.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: The chest in the room following the spinning platform Stalfos contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door that opens. (It points you to
it.) Open the chest here for a Small Key.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Defeating the Baby Dodongos and the Beamos at the top spawns a chest containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote: the Baby Dodongos and the Beamos for a chest containing Bombchus.

facts.subject: Sun face
facts.text: Destroying the section of wall with a Bombchu shines light onto the floor sun face, making a small chest appear on a ledge.

evidence.quote:
Send a Bombchu up there to destroy
part of the wall, shining light onto the sun face on the floor, making a small
chest appear on a ledge.

facts.subject: Big chest
facts.text: Shooting the eye switch on the side of the statue reveals a big chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Drop down and shoot
it to reveal a big chest. Open it for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Frozen eye switch
facts.text: The frozen eye switch to the south can be melted by getting underneath it and using Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Can't use Fire Arrows as Young Link, so get under it and use
Din's Fire.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Shooting the eye switch in the hole makes a chest appear containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the eye switch in the hole to make a chest appear
containing a Small Key.

facts.subject: Blue switch
facts.text: Placing the box on the blue switch on the statue's hand keeps the door open.

evidence.quote:
Place the box on the blue switch to
keep a door opened back up where you were.

facts.subject: Sun blocks
facts.text: Pushing sun blocks into the light can open doors, summon a chest with a Heart inside, or summon Wallmasters.

evidence.quote:
push/pull sun blocks into the light shining through
until you open the door ahead...Other sun blocks open the door you came out of, summon
a chest with a Heart inside, and summon Wallmasters.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: To defeat the Iron Knuckle as Young Link, approach him, backflip as he begins to slash, jump slash when he is open, and backflip away.

evidence.quote:
Approach, as soon as he starts to slash, backflip,
jump slash when he's open, and backflip again. Repeat until he's dead.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: The chest outside past the Iron Knuckle contains the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote:
grab the
SILVER GAUNTLETS from the chest.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Longshotting to the ledge chest revealed by the sun face earlier yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Remember the chest that
appeared on a ledge earlier ago? Longshot to it and open it for a Small Key.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Pushing the sun block south of the crystal switch into the light creates an ice block high above that leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Push/pull the sun block south of the crystal switch to the light. This
will make an ice block appear high above. Longshot up there, then find the Gold
Skulltula on another ice block and Longshot it and its token.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Killing all the Beamos with Bombs spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Immediately
kill all the Beamos with Bombs, and a chest containing arrows will appear.

facts.subject: Song of Time
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time twice near the blue blocks makes a small box appear to hold down the blue switch.

evidence.quote:
move toward the blue
blocks and play the Song of Time twice to make a small box appear. Grab it and
place it on the blue switch to keep the door ahead open.

facts.subject: Freezing trap chest
facts.text: Slashing the trap chest that would otherwise freeze Link causes the door to open.

evidence.quote:
slash the chest here (yeah, slash it) to make a door
open. Enter the door. (That chest, when opened, would've frozen you.)

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: The chest outside past the second Iron Knuckle contains the Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote:
Grab the MIRROR SHIELD from the chest, then head
back in.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Killing the Gibdo in the room unlocked with the Mirror Shield allows Link to open the chest for the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gibdo there and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol on the statue's left hand makes a chest appear behind crates below containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
See the Triforce symbol on the statue's left hand? Roll over
to it using the Hover Boots, then play Zelda's Lullaby to make a chest appear
behind some crates below. Drop down, break them, and open the chest for a Blue
Rupee.

facts.subject: Three unlit torches
facts.text: Shooting Fire Arrows at all three unlit torches lights them and opens the eastern door on the 2nd floor.

evidence.quote:
look for three unlit torches. Shoot Fire Arrows at all of them to
light them, opening the eastern door in this room on the 2nd floor.

facts.subject: Sun faces
facts.text: Lighting the sun faces with the Mirror Shield spawns Wallmasters that open the floor gate once defeated.

evidence.quote:
light the sun faces with the Mirror 
Shield to spawn the rest of the Wallmasters. Kill them one by one to make the
gate on the floor open up.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the ceiling of the west room and can be collected with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Just look up towards the ceiling to
see a Gold Skulltula. Longshot it and its token

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Killing or letting the purple Leever disappear causes a chest to appear containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
start fighting Leevers until a purple (?)
Leever appears. Kill it or let it disappear to make a chest appear. Climb up and 
Longshot to the chest for a Purple Rupee as your prize.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Collecting the remaining Silver Rupees under the rocks makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Bomb/hammer the remaining rocks for the last two Silver
Rupees to make another chest appear. Open it for a Small Key.

facts.subject: Song alcoves
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Storms, and Zelda's Lullaby in sequence in the matching alcoves opens the door behind the Moblin.

evidence.quote:
play the Song of Time in this
small alcove to open another alcove. Head in there, play Epona's Song to open
another, play the Sun's Song in the next, the Song of Storms in the next, and
finally Zelda's Lullaby in the last...Anyway, doing this will
open the door behind the Moblin.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: In the Big Skulltulas room, killing all the Big Skulltulas allows opening the chest for a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
kill all the Big Skulltulas immediately, then open the
chest for a Purple Rupee.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the room with the Big Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula in here as well.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: A chest through the small hole as Young Link contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Go up the stairs and through the small hole. Open the chest for a Small Key, then exit the temple and return as Adult Link.

facts.subject: Recovery Heart
facts.text: An invisible chest across from the east stairwell contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Hover across using the Hover Boots and find an invisible chest. Open it for a Recovery Heart.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: An invisible chest near the second mirror contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Before heading back, see the bars near the second mirror? There's an invisible chest containing a Small Key there.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Tricking the Iron Knuckle into destroying the wall structures reveals two Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: Inside is an Iron Knuckle. Now, before killing it, trick it into destroying the structures on the walls. This will reveal two Gold Skulltulas.

facts.subject: Bombchus
facts.text: A chest in the Spirit Trials of Ganon's Castle contains Bombchus.

evidence.quote: In this next room, kill the Green Bubble and open the chest for some Bombchus.

facts.subject: Golden Gauntlets
facts.text: Reflecting light onto the sun face just right of the barred-up door makes a chest containing the Golden Gauntlets appear.

evidence.quote: Reflect light at the sun face just right of the barred-up door and a chest will appear. Open it for the GOLDEN GAUNTLETS.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: The sun face to the southwest when facing the door holds a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: the sun face to your southwest when facing the door holds a chest with a Small Key

facts.subject: Great Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Visiting the Great Fairy Fountain near Ganon's Castle doubles Link's defense.

evidence.quote: Now that you have the Golden Gauntlets, you can exit Ganon's Castle and visit the Great Fairy Fountain nearby to get your defense doubled.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: A Small Key can be picked up above the door in the Forest Trials after Longshooting to the torch.

evidence.quote: Longshot to the torch above the door. Now, either wait for the fan to stop blowing, or put on your Iron Boots and walk over to pick up the Small Key.

facts.subject: Arrows
facts.text: Shooting the eye switch inside the fan on the right spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote: In this room, look into the fan on the right to spot an eye switch. Shoot it for a chest containing arrows.

facts.subject: Bombs
facts.text: Shooting a Fire Arrow at the frozen eye switch makes a chest containing Bombs appear.

evidence.quote: You will notice a frozen eye switch in one of the fans. Shoot a Fire Arrow at it to make a chest containing Bombs appear.

facts.subject: Song of Time
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time twice with Iron Boots on makes an Armos fall onto the blue switch below to open the door ahead.

evidence.quote: Put on the Iron Boots and play the Song of Time twice. This will make an Armos fall onto the blue switch below, opening the door ahead.

facts.subject: Fire Trials
facts.text: The Goron Tunic should be put on before entering the Fire Trials.

evidence.quote: Enter the Fire Trials, the door with the red medallion. Put on your Goron Tunic before entering.

facts.subject: Red Rupee
facts.text: Melting red ice in the Water Trials reveals a chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: The main red ice to look for is the ones that are blocking the way forward, but another red ice has a chest containing a Red Rupee.

facts.subject: Block Puzzle
facts.text: To collect the Silver Rupees in the Water Trials, push the further block from the entrance into the rock and then into the hole, then push the other block south, east, and north.

evidence.quote: To do that, push the further block from the entrance door into the rock, then into the hole. Next, push the other block south, then east, then north.

facts.subject: Arrows
facts.text: Shooting the bomb flower far to the right in the Shadow Trials makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote: shoot the bomb flower far to the right to make a chest appear. Longshot to it and open it for arrows.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Shooting the eye switch on the invisible path in the Shadow Trials makes a chest containing a Small Key appear.

evidence.quote: return to spot an eye switch. Shoot it to make a chest containing a Small Key appear.

facts.subject: Light Trials
facts.text: The Light Trials entrance is behind a giant stone that must be picked up and thrown.

evidence.quote: Last but not least, enter the Light Trials, the door with the yellow medallion. Where is it? It's behind a giant stone that you'll have to pick up and throw.

facts.subject: Ice Blocks
facts.text: Slashing the right torch removes the ice blocks blocking the fake wall in front of the Light Trials power source.

evidence.quote: Look with the Lens of Truth to see a fake wall ahead, but it's blocked by ice blocks. Slash the right torch to end up removing those blocks.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Defeating two Stalfos in Ganon's Tower lowers the flames surrounding a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: where you're faced with two Stalfos. After defeating them, the door ahead will open and the flames surrounding the chest will lower. Open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Big Bullet Bag
facts.text: The Big Bullet Bag is obtained from the Mad Scrub's shooting game in Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Kill Gold Skulltula #4 in Kokiri Village, and the Big Bullet Bag from the Mad Scrub's shooting game in Lost Woods.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Heart Piece #1 is obtained from the Skull Kid choir in Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #1 from the Skull Kid choir and a Deku Stick upgrade from a Business Scrub under the bridge to Hyrule Field, both in Lost Woods.

facts.subject: Deku Stick Upgrade
facts.text: A Deku Stick upgrade is obtained from a Business Scrub under the bridge to Hyrule Field in Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #1 from the Skull Kid choir and a Deku Stick upgrade from a Business Scrub under the bridge to Hyrule Field, both in Lost Woods.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltula #5 is located in the guard shack in Castle Town.

evidence.quote: In Castle Town, kill Gold Skulltula #5 in the guard shack, and win the Biggest Bullet Bag from the shooting gallery.

facts.subject: Biggest Bullet Bag
facts.text: The Biggest Bullet Bag is won from the shooting gallery in Castle Town.

evidence.quote: In Castle Town, kill Gold Skulltula #5 in the guard shack, and win the Biggest Bullet Bag from the shooting gallery.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Heart Piece #2 is obtained in Castle Town by giving the obese lady her dog back.

evidence.quote: Kill Gold Skulltula #6 from a tree at Hyrule Castle Grounds, then get Heart Piece #2 in Castle Town by giving the obese lady her dog back.

facts.subject: Bottle
facts.text: The first bottle is obtained at Lon Lon Ranch by finding Talon's Super Cucco.

evidence.quote: Get your first bottle at Lon Lon Ranch by finding Talon's Super Cucco, then kill Gold Skulltulas #7 and #8, get Heart Piece #3 in the silo, and learn Epona's Song by talking to Malon enough times.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Heart Piece #3 is located in the silo at Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: Get your first bottle at Lon Lon Ranch by finding Talon's Super Cucco, then kill Gold Skulltulas #7 and #8, get Heart Piece #3 in the silo, and learn Epona's Song by talking to Malon enough times.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Heart Piece #4 is obtained from the lone Skull Kid standing on a stump.

evidence.quote: Learn Saria's Song, then get Heart Piece #4 from the lone Skull Kid standing on a stump.

facts.subject: Adult's Wallet
facts.text: The Adult's Wallet is obtained from the Gold Skulltula house in Kakariko.

evidence.quote: Get the Adult's Wallet from the Gold Skulltula house in Kakariko, get your second bottle from the Cucco lady by gathering her Cuccos, then kill Gold Skulltulas #12 through #16 at night.

facts.subject: Bottle
facts.text: The second bottle is obtained from the Cucco lady in Kakariko by gathering her Cuccos.

evidence.quote: Get the Adult's Wallet from the Gold Skulltula house in Kakariko, get your second bottle from the Cucco lady by gathering her Cuccos, then kill Gold Skulltulas #12 through #16 at night.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Heart Piece #5 is obtained by having Dampe dig it up in Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #5 by having Dampe dig it up, Gold Skulltula #17, and the Hylian Shield under a grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

facts.subject: Hylian Shield
facts.text: The Hylian Shield is found under a grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #5 by having Dampe dig it up, Gold Skulltula #17, and the Hylian Shield under a grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Heart Piece #6 is found underneath another grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Learn the Sun's Song, get Heart Piece #6 underneath another grave, then head up Death Mountain.

facts.subject: Goron's Bracelet
facts.text: Link gets the Goron's Bracelet in Goron City.

evidence.quote: Head up to Goron City, get the Goron's Bracelet, Heart Piece #7 by bombing the pot once it starts spinning (light the torches), and Gold Skulltula #18.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Heart Piece #7 is obtained in Goron City by lighting the torches and bombing the pot once it starts spinning.

evidence.quote: Head up to Goron City, get the Goron's Bracelet, Heart Piece #7 by bombing the pot once it starts spinning (light the torches), and Gold Skulltula #18.

facts.subject: Lost Woods
facts.text: Link can purchase a Deku Nut Upgrade for 40 Rupees in the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Get a Deku Nut Upgrade for 40 Rupees in Lost Woods

facts.subject: Fishing Hole
facts.text: Catching a 10 lb. fish at the Fishing Hole awards Heart Piece #15.

evidence.quote: fish for a 10 lb. fish at the Fishing Hole to get Heart Piece #15.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Salesman
facts.text: All 10 Magic Beans can be purchased at Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
Kill Gold Skulltula #25 at Zora's River, buy all 10 Magic Beans, and plant
one at Magic Bean Plot #1.

facts.subject: Lost Woods
facts.text: Wearing the Mask of Truth in a hole in the Lost Woods yields a Deku Nut Upgrade.

evidence.quote:
use the Mask of Truth to get
a Deku Nut Upgrade in a hole in Lost Woods.

facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch
facts.text: Winning Malon's horse race at Lon Lon Ranch rewards Link with a cow for his house in Kokiri Village.

evidence.quote:
win Malon's horse race in
Lon Lon Ranch to get a cow for your house in Kokiri Village. (Free milk!)

facts.subject: Fishing Hole
facts.text: Catching a big lunker fish in the Fishing Hole at Lake Hylia earns the Golden Scale.

evidence.quote:
fish for a big lunker in the Fishing Hole to get 
the Golden Scale.

facts.subject: Frogs
facts.text: Heart Pieces #27 and #28 are obtained from the frogs at Zora's River.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Pieces #27 and #28 from the frogs at Zora's River.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: Delivering the World's Greatest Eye Drops to Biggoron results in him fixing the Broken Goron's Sword over 2 days to grant the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Get the World's Greatest Eye Drops from the Lake Hylia scientist, then take
them to Biggoron. Have him fix the Broken Goron's Sword for 2 days to give you
the Biggoron's Sword.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Clearing the first part of the Spirit Temple as Young Link yields the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote:
Clear the first part of the Spirit Temple as Young Link, killing Gold
Skulltulas #93 through #96, and getting the Silver Gauntlets.

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Clearing the Gerudo Training Grounds rewards Link with the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote: Clear the Gerudo Training Grounds to get the Ice Arrows.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Collecting four Heart Pieces assembles a new Heart, contributing toward a maximum total of 20 hearts from 36 Heart Pieces and boss Heart Containers.

evidence.quote:
There are 36 Heart Pieces located within the game, and when combined with the
Heart Containers from bosses, will make up a total of 20 hearts for your health.
Every four pieces will assemble a new Heart for your health.

facts.subject: Skull Kids
facts.text: Standing on the stump facing two Skull Kids in the Lost Woods and repeating their notes on the Ocarina three times rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to where the target is, and in a corner are two 
Skull Kids with flutes. Stand on the stump and pull out either Ocarina while 
facing them and they'll want you to play a little game. You must play the 
notes they play. If you successfully do it three times (doesn't have to be
consecutively), they'll give you a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Back Alley Woman
facts.text: At night, finding the white dog near the house with the man looking out the window and returning it to the woman in the Back Alley rewards Piece of Heart #2.

evidence.quote:
Make sure it's night time... Head into one 
of the houses in the Back Alley to see an obese woman in a white and blue 
striped shirt. She claims her dog is loose and wants her dog back. Head back 
into the main Market, and look for the white dog near the house with the man 
looking out his window. The dog will follow you. Bring the dog back to the 
woman and she'll give you this Piece.

facts.subject: Silo
facts.text: Moving the crates inside the silo at the back of Lon Lon Ranch opens access to a crawlspace containing Piece of Heart #3.

evidence.quote:
Head into the silo at the back of the ranch and you'll see a bunch
 of crates hiding a crawlspace. Move the crates in such a way so you can reach 
 the crawlspace... behind 
 the crawlspace lies the Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Skull Kid
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song on an Ocarina while standing on the stump before the Skull Kid left of the Lost Woods entrance awards Piece of Heart #4.

evidence.quote:
Head left from the entrance of Lost Woods to find a Skull Kid with
 a flute. Stand on the stump in front of him, whip out any Ocarina you might 
 have, and play Saria's Song. He'll give you this Piece in return.

facts.subject: Dampe
facts.text: Paying Dampe 10 Rupees to dig on dirt patches in Kakariko Graveyard at night eventually unearths Piece of Heart #5 at a random location.

evidence.quote:
Making sure night has just arrived (like, right after you hear the
 howl of a wolf) Dampe will be out wandering the graveyard. For 10 Rupees, 
 he'll dig where he stands... Let him dig once on each section of dirt until he digs up 
 the Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Royal Family's Tomb
facts.text: Pulling the second left gravestone facing away from the Royal Family's Tomb reveals a hole where playing the Sun's Song on the steps after killing the Redead reveals a chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Facing away from the Royal Family's Tomb, pull the second left 
 gravestone to reveal a hole. Drop down, kill the Redead, then play the Sun's
 Song on the steps to reveal a chest with this piece.

facts.subject: Spinning Pot
facts.text: Lighting all torches on the bottom level makes the large pot spin, and throwing a bomb into it from the second level that lands on the happy face releases a Piece of Heart and Rupees.

evidence.quote:
First, light all the torches at the bottom level to make the large
 pot spin. Get on the second level and throw a bomb into the pot. If it lands 
 on the happy face, a Piece of Heart and a lot of Rupees will pop out.

facts.subject: Death Mountain Crater Alcove
facts.text: Stepping slowly off the north wall allows Link to grab the climbable wall and reach an alcove containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Step off the north wall slowly so you'll grab the climbable wall.
 Head into the alcove with the Piece.

facts.subject: Chicken Coop Cage
facts.text: Dropping off the east side of the building where the owl drops Young Link leads onto the chicken coop and through a door to a Piece of Heart inside a cage.

evidence.quote:
Drop off the east side of the
 building, land on top of the chicken coop, and head through the door to 
 acquire this Piece inside a cage.

facts.subject: Business Deku Scrub
facts.text: Planting a bomb in the center of the fence enclosure near the Lake Hylia entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Business Deku Scrub who sells a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head over to the entrance to Lake Hylia, (marked by a box of high
 and low fences) and plant a bomb in the center of the box to reveal a Secret 
 Cave. Inside is a Business Deku Scrub who sells you this Piece.

facts.subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
facts.text: Winning the Bombchu Bowling Alley minigame awards random prizes including a Purple Rupee, Bombs, Bombchus, a Bomb Bag Upgrade, and a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head into the Bombchu Bowling Alley, which is the two-story
 building. In here you have to use Bombchus to make them scurry to the holes. ... Winning gets you a random prize. Among them are: Purple Rupee, Bombs, 
 Bombchus, Bomb Bag Upgrade, and this Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Isolated Pillar
facts.text: Climbing the ladder and gliding with a Cucco allows Link to reach an isolated pillar holding a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the ladder, then pick
 up the other Cucco at the top. Use it to fly over to a pillar with this Piece
 on it.

facts.subject: Waterfall Ledge
facts.text: Gliding from the top bridge near the waterfall with a Cucco reaches the west ledge with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head all the way to the waterfall with a Cucco in hand, get on the
 top bridge, then glide over to the west ledge with this Piece on it.

facts.subject: Waterfall Torch Chest
facts.text: Using a Deku Stick to light all torches quickly starting from the King's room stairs and ending behind the waterfall reveals a treasure chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Use a Deku Stick to light the torch at the bottom of the stairs
 from the King's room first, then use this torch as a starting point to light 
 all the other torches quickly. The final two torches are behind the waterfall. 
 If successful, a treasure chest containing this Piece will appear behind the
 waterfall.

facts.subject: Fishing Pond
facts.text: Catching a fish of at least 10 lbs at the Fishing Pond and presenting it to the fisherman awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head to the Fishing Pond on the east side of the lake and catch a
 fish of at least 10 lbs. Taking it to the fisherman will get you this Piece.

facts.subject: Cliff Platform Crate
facts.text: Flying down from the cliff with a Cucco to a platform with a crate yields a Piece of Heart inside the crate.

evidence.quote:
Grab the Cucco, then at the cliff, fly down to the platform with a
 crate on it. The crate contains this Piece.

facts.subject: Waterfall Alcove
facts.text: Jumping behind the waterfall at the bottom of the valley leads to a ladder and an alcove containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Jump behind 
 the waterfall and reach the ladder. ... At the top of the 
 ladder is an alcove with this Piece inside.

facts.subject: Graveyard High Ledge
facts.text: Planting a Magic Bean in the graveyard dirt as Young Link allows Adult Link to ride the grown plant to a ledge with a crate holding a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
While Young Link, head into the Graveyard and plant a Magic Bean on
 the plot of dirt. Return as Adult Link and ride the now-grown plant to reach a
 ledge with a crate containing this Piece.

facts.subject: Windmill High Platform
facts.text: Exiting Dampe's race onto the high ledge inside the windmill lets Link ride a rotating ledge to reach a Piece of Heart on a high platform.

evidence.quote:
Finish Dampe's race in the graveyard and you'll end up on a high
 ledge inside the windmill. Use a ledge on the machine to carry you to this
 Piece on a high platform.

facts.subject: Dampe's Race
facts.text: Completing Dampe's race in under a minute rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Finish Dampe's race in under a minute and he'll give you this
 Piece.

facts.subject: Rooftop Man
facts.text: Hookshotting from the windmill entrance fence to the gray-roofed house allows Link to receive a Piece of Heart from the man on the roof.

evidence.quote:
Head up to the entrance of the windmill, hop onto the fence nearby,
 and Hookshot to the house with the gray roof. On top is a man who will give 
 you this Piece for climbing up here.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern Entrance Ledge
facts.text: Planting a Magic Bean at the entrance of Dodongo's Cavern as Young Link allows Adult Link to ride the grown plant to a ledge with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
While Young Link, plant a Magic Bean on the plot of soil right at
 the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern. Return as Adult Link and ride the grown 
 plant to a ledge with this Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Ice Platform
facts.text: Jumping across the floating pieces of ice where Jabu-Jabu used to reside in Zora's Fountain leads to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
In the fountain, jump across the floating pieces of ice where
 Jabu-Jabu used to be to reach this Piece.

facts.subject: Laboratory Roof
facts.text: Riding the grown Magic Bean plant near the Laboratory lets Link jump onto the roof and climb the ladder to a Piece of Heart at the top.

evidence.quote:
While Young Link, plant a Magic Bean on the plot of dirt near the
 Lab. Return as Adult Link and ride the plant. Jump off onto the roof, then 
 climb the ladder being careful with the Guays, and the Piece of Heart will be 
 at the top.

facts.subject: Lakeside Laboratory Pool
facts.text: Diving down 9 meters into the water with the Golden Scale and speaking to the old man in the Laboratory earns a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Laboratory, talk to the old man, then dive into the water
 with the Golden Scale. Dive down to 9 meters, then talk to the old man again
 and he should give you this Piece.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Visiting the Skulltula house after capturing 50 Gold Skulltulas rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Requirements: 50 Gold Skulltulas captured

How to get: Visit the Skulltula house after you get 50 Skulltula tokens, and
 you'll get this Piece.

facts.subject: Frogs in Zora's River
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms for the frogs in Zora's River rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
How to get: Play the Song of Storms for the frogs in the river and they'll give
 you this Piece.

facts.subject: Frog Fly-Catching Minigame
facts.text: Completing the fly-catching minigame by playing corresponding Ocarina notes for the frogs in Zora's River awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Using the Ocarina, play notes corresponding to each frog 
 so that they can catch the flies above them...Finishing the minigame will 
 get you this Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Treasure Box Shop
facts.text: Paying 10 Rupees at the Treasure Box Shop at night and using the Lens of Truth to find small keys opens the final chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Requirements: Lens of Truth, 10 Rupees...Enter the Treasure Box Shop during night...use the Lens of Truth to see which treasure
 chest holds the small key needed to continue. Keep doing this to reach the 
 end, which has a treasure chest containing this Piece.

facts.subject: Magic Plant
facts.text: Planting a Magic Bean near the Triforce stand in Death Mountain Crater as Young Link allows Adult Link to ride the Magic Plant to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Enter Death Mountain Crater from Goron City, and head to the
 Triforce stand. You'll see a plot of dirt. Warp here as Young Link and quickly 
 plant the Magic Bean on it, and return here as Adult Link. Ride the Magic 
 Plant to this Piece.

facts.subject: Ice Blade Room
facts.text: In the Ice Cavern ice blade room, melting the east red ice wall and then the left block of red ice with Blue Fire reveals a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Grab some blue fire in the ending room of the Cavern, then melt the
 east red ice wall in the ice blade room. Inside, melt the left block of red
 ice to get this Piece.

facts.subject: Northeastern Room
facts.text: In Master Quest's Ice Cavern northeastern room, placing a bomb on the crystal switch tip through the icy floor makes the ice blocks disappear to reveal a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
In the northeastern room, look around the icy floors to find the 
 tip of a crystal switch poking through. Place a bomb there to activate it. 
 This will make the ice blocks containing the Piece of Heart to disappear, so 
 grab it.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain Underwater Floor
facts.text: Sinking to the bottom of Zora's Fountain using the Iron Boots while wearing the Zora Tunic yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Zora Tunic so you won't drown, and use the Iron Boots to
 sink to the bottom. Find the Piece under there.

facts.subject: Hyrule Field Secret Cave
facts.text: Bombing the lone tree west of Hyrule Castle reveals a Secret Cave where sinking to the water bottom with Iron Boots yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
West of Hyrule Castle, plant a bomb at the lone tree where there's
 trees surrounded by a river. It'll open a Secret Cave. Head inside, and sink
 to the bottom of the water with the Iron Boots. The Piece is down here.

facts.subject: Gerudo Fortress Roof Chest
facts.text: At the very top of Gerudo Fortress, Link can Longshot directly to a giant treasure chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
At the very top of the fortress is a giant treasure chest. Get to
 a point where you can Longshot directly to the chest. Open this chest for this
 piece.

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Scoring 1000 points in the Horseback Archery minigame behind Gerudo Fortress while on Epona rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Behind the Fortress, through a long path, is a secluded area which
 is basically the Horseback Archery game. Talk to the Gerudo while on your
 horse and get 1000 points. You'll get this piece in return.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus Arch
facts.text: Planting a Magic Bean at Desert Colossus as Young Link and riding the plant as Adult Link allows Link to jump off at the arch for a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Desert Collosus as Young Link and plant a Magic Bean on
 the plot of dirt. Return as Adult Link and ride the plant, jumping off at the
 arch where this Piece is located.

facts.subject: Lost Woods Target Practice
facts.text: Scoring three perfect hits of 100 points each on the Lost Woods target with the Fairy Slingshot earns a bullet bag upgrade holding 40 Deku Seeds.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bullet bag made by the Deku Scrub who runs the
 Lost Woods target practice game. This holds 40 Deku Seeds; 10 more than what 
 you normally carry...Use the Fairy Slingshot to score three perfect hits on the target
 in Lost Woods (100 per hit).

facts.subject: Business Deku Scrub
facts.text: Deflecting a Deku Nut back at the Business Deku Scrub under the bridge in Lost Woods lets Link purchase an upgrade to carry 20 Deku Sticks for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 20 Deku Sticks instead of 10...A business Deku Scrub should be behind one of the pillars. Deflect 
 a Deku Nut back at him with the Deku Shield and he'll surrender. In return, 
 he'll give you the upgrade at a cost of 40 Rupees.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: Shooting all Rupees with the Fairy Slingshot in the Hyrule Market Shooting Gallery awards a bullet bag upgrade holding 50 Deku Seeds.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bullet bag that can be won in Hyrule Market's
 Shooting Gallery if you already got the first upgrade. This holds 50 Deku 
 Seeds...In the Shooting Gallery, use the Fairy Slingshot to shoot all the
 Rupees in one game.

facts.subject: Hot Rodder Goron
facts.text: Stopping the Hot Rodder Goron with a Bomb under the enclosure in Goron City rewards a bomb bag upgrade allowing Link to carry 30 Bombs.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bomb bag that'll allow you to carry 30 Bombs...Head to Goron City, and stop the Hot Rodder Goron with a Bomb
 while under the enclosure. He'll give you this in return.

facts.subject: Business Deku Scrub
facts.text: In a Secret Cave revealed by bombing a boulder outside Sacred Forest Meadow, a Business Deku Scrub sells an upgrade to carry 30 Deku Nuts for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 30 Deku Nuts...After exiting the Sacred Forest Meadow, blast the boulder with a 
 Bomb to reveal a Secret Cave. Drop in to find two Business Deku Scrubs. One 
 will sell you this upgrade for 40 Rupees.

facts.subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
facts.text: A bomb bag upgrade that lets Link carry 40 Bombs can be won as a random prize at the Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bomb bag that lets you carry 40 Bombs...In Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market, this is one of the
 random prizes you can win.

facts.subject: Forest Stage
facts.text: Talking to the leader of the Deku Scrubs at the Forest Stage in Lost Woods while wearing the Skull Mask rewards an upgrade to carry 30 Deku Sticks for free.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 30 Deku Sticks...Get the Skull Mask from the Happy Mask Shop, then take it to the
 Forest Stage in Lost Woods...Talk to the leader of the Deku Scrubs here 
 while wearing the Skull Mask, and he'll give you this upgrade for free.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: Hitting Queen Gohma's eye with the Fairy Slingshot stuns her, allowing Link to slash her eye repeatedly.

evidence.quote: Hit the eye with the Fairy Slingshot to stun her, then get up to her eye and slash at the eye repeatedly.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: When Queen Gohma crawls to the ceiling and drops eggs, Link should break the eggs before the Larvae hatch.

evidence.quote: Once she's at the ceiling, she'll drop eggs that contain her offspring. Break the eggs before the Larvae hatch so that you won't have any trouble.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: Queen Gohma can be quickly defeated in one sequence by stunning her with the Fairy Slingshot, jump slashing with a Deku Stick, and repeatedly pressing B while holding R without locking on.

evidence.quote: Stun her with the Fairy Slingshot, then jump slash with a Deku Stick to do a lot of damage. Afterwards, hold R while facing her (without locking on) and press B repeatedly to stab her to death. This method should only require one sequence.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: If Queen Gohma reaches the ceiling to lay eggs, shooting her red eye with the Fairy Slingshot knocks her back to the ground.

evidence.quote: If by chance you don't kill her in time, when she's at the ceiling laying eggs, shoot her in the eye while it's red with the Fairy Slingshot, and she'll fall to the ground, open for another attack.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: Defeating Queen Gohma rewards a Heart Container and creates a warp light.

evidence.quote: Either way, after she's dead, a light and HEART CONTAINER will appear. Make sure you pick up the Container before leaving by stepping into the light.

facts.subject: Great Deku Tree
facts.text: After defeating Queen Gohma, the Great Deku Tree gives Link the Kokiri Emerald before dying.

evidence.quote: He'll talk to you a bit more, give you the Kokiri Emerald, and then die. (Due to the curse.) Head out, and Mido will blame you for the Deku Tree's death.

facts.subject: Saria
facts.text: Saria stops Link as he exits Kokiri Forest to the west and gives him the Fairy Ocarina.

evidence.quote: Check on a few things, and then leave the Kokiri Forest by heading west. While leaving, Saria will stop you and talk to you. After giving you the FAIRY OCARINA, she'll let you leave.

facts.subject: Know-it-All Brothers' House
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind the Know-it-All Brothers' House at nighttime.

evidence.quote: Now before heading forward, wait until it's nighttime, then head back into Kokiri Forest. Look behind the Know-it-All Brothers' House for a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Lost Woods Target
facts.text: Hitting the center of the target three times with the Fairy Slingshot makes a Deku Scrub award the Big Bullet Bag, expanding Deku Seed capacity to 40.

evidence.quote: Whip out your Fairy Slingshot and try to hit the center of the target three times. If you do, a Deku Scrub will pop out and give you a BIG BULLET BAG, which allows you to carry 40 Deku Seeds, as opposed to 30 for your Slingshot.

facts.subject: Skull Kids
facts.text: Playing along with the songs of the two Skull Kids three times on the Fairy Ocarina rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Get on the lone stump and pull out your Fairy Ocarina while facing them. They'll ask you to follow along with their songs. If you do it successfully three times, (you may need a piece of paper to write down their songs) they'll give you a Piece of Heart

facts.subject: Business Deku Scrub
facts.text: Under the bridge leading to Hyrule Field, a Business Deku Scrub sells a Deku Stick upgrade to carry 20 sticks for 40 Rupees after you deflect a nut back at him.

evidence.quote: Head under the bridge and you will find a Business Deku Scrub. Deflect a Nut back at him and he'll give you a DEKU STICK UPGRADE, allowing you to carry 20 now. (Note: You must have 40 Rupees before you can get this.)

facts.subject: Guard House Crate
facts.text: Rolling into the crate next to the guard inside the town gate guard house breaks it and reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: As soon as you enter the Town gates, head into the guard's house... You see the guard standing there? Roll (press A while running) into the crate next to him to break it and reveal the Skulltula.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: Hitting all the Rupees in the Shooting Gallery with the Fairy Slingshot for 20 Rupees awards the Biggest Bullet Bag, increasing seed capacity to 50, and hitting at least 8 targets earns a free game.

evidence.quote: In here, you must hit all the Rupees that appear with your Slingshot. If successful, you'll get the BIGGEST BULLET BAG; an item that lets you carry 50 Deku Seeds... Each game costs 20 Rupees, so try your best and make sure you have a lot of Rupees. (Note: If you hit at least 8 targets, you'll get a free game. Make sure you do that!)

facts.subject: Castle Grounds Tree
facts.text: Rolling into the lone tree in the Castle Grounds knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: While waiting, roll into the lone tree you see to knock down another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 006 out of 100)

facts.subject: Richard's Owner
facts.text: Returning the white dog found near the house with the man looking out the window to the woman in the Back Alley at night rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Head into the Back Alley (via heading left once reaching the Shooting Gallery) and continue walking through until you see a rather obese woman complaining that her dog is loose... Head back into the main Market, and look for the white dog near the house with the guy looking out his window. The dog will automatically follow you. Bring the dog back to the woman's house and she'll give you a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Malon
facts.text: Talking to Malon in the Castle Grounds gives Link an Egg to find her dad.

evidence.quote: You should see the red-haired girl (Malon) here now, singing a song. Talk to her, and she'll give you an EGG, as long as you find her dad.

facts.subject: Talon
facts.text: Using the Cucco that hatches from Malon's egg during daytime wakes Talon up in the Castle Grounds.

evidence.quote: It should be daytime by now, and the egg should've hatched. Use the CUCCO that hatched from it to wake up Talon, then talk to him. He'll run back to Malon all in a worry.

facts.subject: Courtyard Window
facts.text: Firing a Deku Seed into the right window before speaking to Princess Zelda rewards a Red Rupee worth 20 normal Rupees.

evidence.quote: Before talking to her, fire a Deku Seed into the right window for a Red Rupee – worth 20 normal Rupees.

facts.subject: Princess Zelda
facts.text: Princess Zelda explains her dream and gives Link a Letter with her signature.

evidence.quote: Talk to Princess Zelda and she'll tell you a story about her dream. After the lengthy explanation, (make sure to pick the top option whenever given it) she'll tell you to get the two other Spiritual Stones (Kokiri Emerald is one of them), and also give you a LETTER with her signature.

facts.subject: Impa
facts.text: Impa escorts Link out of Hyrule Market and teaches him Zelda's Lullaby.

evidence.quote: Head out and Impa, Zelda's bodyguard will escort you out of Hyrule Market nicely, after teaching you ZELDA'S LULLABY, which is very important in the game.

facts.subject: Super Cucco Minigame
facts.text: Finding three Super Cuccos within the time limit in Talon's minigame for 10 Rupees rewards a Bottle filled with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: Inside is Talon, with a bunch of Cuccos. Talk to him and he'll ask you to play a game at the cost of 10 Rupees. You have to find three Super Cuccos (they look the same as ordinary ones) within a limited time... If you do get all three, Talon will reward you with a BOTTLE of Lon Lon Milk.

facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch Tree
facts.text: Rolling into the lone tree left of Talon's house knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: At the left of the house that had Talon inside is a lone tree with a couple crates beside it. Roll into the tree to knock another Gold Skulltula off.

facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch Silo
facts.text: Moving crates at the back of the silo reveals a corner crawlspace leading to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Head into the silo at the back. You'll see two cows and a bunch of crates at the far end. Move the crates in such a way so that the crawlspace in the corner is revealed. Head through the crawlspace to find a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Malon
facts.text: Talking to Malon three times inside the corral and equipping the Fairy Ocarina in front of her teaches Link Epona's Song, which causes cows to fill an empty bottle with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: Head out of the silo and head inside the corral and talk to Malon three times. (She should say something about singing a song together on the third time.) After that, equip the Fairy Ocarina in front of her. She'll teach you EPONA'S SONG for your trouble. facts.subject: Lon Lon Ranch Feeding Pen
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula appears on the back of the horse corral feeding pen at night.

evidence.quote: Exit the ranch, then enter again once night arrives. Head to the back of the horse corral and you'll see a Gold Skulltula on the back of the feeding pen. Kill it.

facts.subject: Kokiri Shop Dirt Plot
facts.text: Dropping a bottle of bugs onto the soft dirt plot east of the Kokiri Shop causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote: Once back in the forest, head to the dirt plot to the east of the Kokiri Shop. Drop your Bottle of Bugs on the patch of dirt and they'll burrow right into the little hole in the center... A Gold Skulltula should pop out. Kill it and collect its token.

facts.subject: Lost Woods Dirt Plot
facts.text: Dropping bugs onto the soft dirt plot reached by going left and left from the Lost Woods entrance reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head left from the entrance, then head left again to reach another plot of dirt. Drop some more bugs from your bottle (you should've caught another one at the first plot of dirt) and yet another Gold Skulltula will pop out.

facts.subject: Meadow Gate Dirt Plot
facts.text: Dropping bugs onto the patch of dirt behind a Deku Scrub in the grassy area reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head into the right entrance, then left, then left again. You'll be at a grassy area. Behind one of the Deku Scrubs is yet another patch of dirt. Drop the bugs here to make a Gold Skulltula pop out.

facts.subject: Deku Brothers Door
facts.text: Hitting the three Deku brothers in the correct sequence opens the door leading to Queen Gohma.

evidence.quote: Harm them in the correct sequence and they'll open the door to Queen Gohma.

facts.subject: Moat Blocks
facts.text: Pushing the two bull head blocks into the moat indentation allows Link to climb up and jump to the alcove entrance.

evidence.quote: Near where Talon was are two blocks with bull heads on them. Push these blocks over to the moat where the indentation leads to. The second block fits over the first one. Once you have them at the correct spot, you should hear a jingle. Climb up the blocks and jump across to the alcove.

facts.subject: Deku Nut Upgrade 2

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 40 Deku Nuts!...From the Kokiri Forest

 Find the Forest Stage, then showcase the Mask of Truth to the group...NOTE: You can NOT get this upgrade after pulling out the Master Sword for the
first time. It's a strange glitch that Nintendo hasn't bothered to fix for
some reason. Make sure you get the upgrade before becoming Adult Link.

facts.subject: Big Quiver

evidence.quote:
This is upgrade is a Big Quiver, allowing you to hold 40 Arrows
 for your Bow...Head to Kakariko Village as Adult Link, and enter the Shooting
 Gallery...Hit all the Rupees to get this upgrade.

facts.subject: Biggest Quiver
facts.text: Acquiring 1500 points in the Horseback Archery Game at Gerudo's Fortress rewards the Biggest Quiver upgrade, allowing Link to hold 50 Arrows.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is the Biggest Quiver, allowing you to hold 50 Arrows
 for your Bow...Acquire 1500 points (very hard) in the Horseback Archery Game at
 Gerudo's Fortress.

facts.subject: Deku Sticks

evidence.quote:

 upgrades that'll let you carry more. Adult Link can't use these...They can either be bought or taken from certain Deku Babas.

facts.subject: Deku Nuts
facts.text: Deku Nuts can either be bought or taken from certain Deku Babas.

evidence.quote: Gotten: They can either be bought or taken from certain Deku Babas.

Gotten: The ability to carry bombs hides in Dodongo's Cavern, the second

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After clearing the Water Temple, shoot the sun right as morning arrives

facts.subject: Ice Arrows

evidence.quote: Gotten: Your prize for clearing the difficult Gerudo Training Grounds.

facts.subject: Light Arrows

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After clearing all the temples and getting all the medallions, return
 to the Temple of Time and Zelda will give these to you.

facts.subject: Fairy Slingshot

evidence.quote: Adult Link can't use this...Gotten: In the Deku Tree dungeon.

facts.subject: Fairy Ocarina

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After clearing the Deku Tree, attempt to leave Kokiri Forest and Saria

 Castle Town.

evidence.quote:

 Graveyard) and he will give you this.

facts.subject: Longshot
facts.text: The Longshot is obtained in the Water Temple and replaces the normal Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Once you get this, it replaces the normal Hookshot...Gotten: In the Water Temple.

facts.subject: Boomerang
facts.text: The Boomerang is obtained in the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon for Young Link.

evidence.quote: Gotten: In the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon for Young Link.

facts.subject: Lens of Truth
facts.text: The Lens of Truth is obtained in the Bottom of the Well sub-dungeon for Young Link.

evidence.quote: Gotten: In the Bottom of the Well sub-dungeon for Young Link.

facts.subject: Magic Beans

evidence.quote:
Gotten: The guy who eats beans in Zora's River. He sells them at ever-rising
 prices. He holds up to 10 Magic Beans.

facts.subject: Fairy Bow

evidence.quote:
Fairy Bow...This is a projectile attack for Adult Link. It currently holds 30
 arrows...Gotten: In the Forest Temple.

facts.subject: Din's Fire

evidence.quote:
The Great Fairy of Magic in Hyrule Castle Grounds gives you this 
 ability. Her fountain is found behind a boulder in a cranny.

The Great Fairy of Magic in Zora's Fountain gives you this ability. Her

facts.subject: Nayru's Love

evidence.quote:
The Great Fairy of Magic at the Desert Colossus gives you this ability.
 Her fountain can be found behind a cracked wall between two palm trees, close
 to the entrance to the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote:
You get this bottle by finding all the Cuccos for the lady in Kakariko

 Shop in Hyrule Market.

facts.subject: Kokiri Sword

evidence.quote: At the end of the mini-maze with the boulder in Kokiri Village.

facts.subject: Master Sword
facts.text: The Master Sword is waiting in the Temple of Time after getting the three Spiritual Stones.

evidence.quote:
It's waiting for you in the Temple of Time after getting the three
 Spiritual Stones.

Much more powerful than the Master Sword, but it easily breaks. It

evidence.quote:
By completing the

 shop and free him then, instead of having to go through the Ice Cavern.

facts.subject: Deku Shield

evidence.quote:
This can withstand
 many attacks, but burns up on contact with fire....Gotten: Buy it at the Kokiri Shop.

evidence.quote:
There are two ways. You can buy it at the Bazaar in Hyrule Market, 
 or you can get it for free in the Graveyard by pulling the gravestone with 
 flowers in front, then dropping down the hole and opening the chest.

facts.subject: Mirror Shield

evidence.quote:
After defeating the other Iron Knuckle as Adult Link, you'll find
 a chest containing this on the left hand of the Desert Collosus.

facts.subject: Bigger Bullet Bag

evidence.quote:
This holds 40 Deku Seeds; 10 more than what you

 hit).

evidence.quote:
This is a bullet bag that can be won in Hyrule Market's
 Shooting Gallery. This hold 50 Deku Seeds; very helpful indeed.
Gotten: In the Shooting Gallery, shoot all the Rupees in one try.

This holds 20

 Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: This is a wallet able to hold 99 Rupees....Link has this as you begin the game.

evidence.quote:
This is a bomb bag that lets you carry 40 Bombs....In Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market, this is one of the random 
 prizes you can win.

facts.text: After defeating the Iron Knuckle mini-boss as Young Link, a chest containing the Silver Gauntlets is found on the right hand of the Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After defeating the Iron Knuckle mini-boss as Young Link, you'll find a 
 chest containing these on the right hand of the Desert Collosus.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: In the Shadow trials room in Ganon's Castle. (Spirit Trials in Master
 Quest.)

evidence.quote: It takes four pieces to complete one.

evidence.quote: Gotten: This is gotten after beating Gohma from inside the Great Deku Tree.

The Skull Kid who you played Saria's Song to wants this 
 mask.

The little kid seen in Kakariko Graveyard by the day wants this

Given to you by the Cucco lady in Kakariko Village.

This allows you to see into people's minds....and will also let

In order to make the Cucco happy, have it wake up someone lazy,

This is given to you

This is an odd potion made from the mushroom you brought to

This is the saw the punk guy left behind in Lost Woods. The young

The guy in Gerudo Valley
 gives you this in exchange for his Poacher's Saw.

The Biggoron on top of Death
 Mountain needs some eye drops for his eye irritation before he can mend the

This fresh ingredient for the eye drops will spoil quickly! King

This item will go bad very soon! Take it to the Biggoron on the

A large key which unlocks a large door leading to the boss of a

 capture all 10 Big Poes in Hyrule Field and give them to the Ghost Shop,

facts.subject: Big Poe

 fire can melt away red ice. Usually found in Ice Cavern, but can also be sold

As soon as you enter Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest, head left until

When you enter Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest, head right, left,
 right, left, then left. This hole is here behind a Business Scrub.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Plot

evidence.quote:
Right by the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern in Death Mountain Trail is
 this hole.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Plot

evidence.quote: In Kakariko Graveyard, this hole is up on the upper ground.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Plot
