evidence.quote: This one is right beside the Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Plot
facts.text: In Gerudo Valley, grab a Cucco and fly down to the very bottom of the cliff over to the left to find a plot.

evidence.quote:
In Gerudo Valley, grab a Cucco and fly down to the very bottom of the
 cliff over to the left to find this plot.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Plot
facts.text: Once Bolero of Fire is learned, warp Young Link to the Fire Temple with it to find a plot of dirt.

evidence.quote:
Once you have learned Bolero of Fire, warp Young Link to the Fire
 Temple with it and you'll find this plot of dirt.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Plot
facts.text: Once Desert Colossus is reached as Adult Link and Requiem of Spirit is learned, warp Young Link there to find a plot of dirt.

evidence.quote:
Once you have reached the Desert Colossus as Adult Link and learned
 the Requiem of Spirit, warp Young Link over here and you'll find this last 
 plot of dirt.

facts.subject: Adult's Wallet
facts.text: Collecting 10 Skulltulas gives the Adult's Wallet, which lets Link carry 200 Rupees as opposed to the previous 99.

evidence.quote:
10 Skulltulas: Gives you the Adult's Wallet, which lets you carry 200 Rupees,
 as opposed to the previous 99 that you could carry.

facts.subject: Stone of Agony
facts.text: Collecting 20 Skulltulas gives the Stone of Agony, which rumbles with the Rumble Pak whenever something secret is nearby.

evidence.quote:
20 Skulltulas: Gives you the Stone of Agony. If you have the Rumble Pak, it
 will rumble whenever there is something secret nearby.

facts.subject: Giant's Wallet
facts.text: Collecting 30 Skulltulas gives the Giant's Wallet, which lets Link carry 500 Rupees as the final Rupee upgrade.

evidence.quote:
30 Skulltulas: Gives you the Giant's Wallet, which lets you carry 500 Rupees.
 This is the final Rupee upgrade.

facts.subject: Bombchu
facts.text: Collecting 40 Skulltulas gives 10 Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
40 Skulltulas: Gives you 10 Bombchus, and you probably have them already,
 leaving this prize to be almost useless.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Collecting 50 Skulltulas gives a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: 50 Skulltulas: Gives you a Piece of Heart, and is a very good prize.

facts.subject: Huge Rupee
facts.text: Collecting all 100 Gold Skulltulas cures the final member of the family and gives a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
There are 100 Gold 
Skulltulas in the game, and getting them all cures the final member of the 
family and gives you a special prize....100 Skulltulas: Gives you a Huge Rupee, which is worth 200 Rupees.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the Compass Room of the Second Floor in Great Deku Tree, a Gold Skulltula is in the left alcove after raising the platforms.

evidence.quote:
In the Compass Room of the Second Floor, head into the left
 alcove after raising the platforms.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Master Quest Great Deku Tree, break open the large crate right beside the treasure chest that contained the Dungeon Map by rolling into it to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Right beside the treasure chest that contained the Dungeon Map is a
 large crate. Break it open by rolling into it to reveal this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the first basement watery room of Great Deku Tree, a Gold Skulltula is on the vines leading back up to the First Floor.

evidence.quote:
There's a Gold Skulltula on the vines leading back up to the
 First Floor in the first basement's watery room. Kill it with the Fairy
 Slingshot then climb up to get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Master Quest Great Deku Tree Compass room, throw a bomb or set a Bombchu to blow up the rocks atop the climbable vines to reach a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the Compass room (formerly known as the Slingshot room in OoT),
 there's some vines to climb that lead to rocks. Throw a bomb up there as it's
 ready to explode/set a Bombchu to blow them up, then climb up and retrieve the
 Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Great Deku Tree, another Gold Skulltula is on the eastern grate in the watery basement room.

evidence.quote:
There's another Gold Skulltula on the eastern grate in the
 same room. Kill it from a distance then jump over to the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Master Quest Great Deku Tree gravestone room, step on the blue switch to light torches, burn the northwest webbing with a Deku Stick, and enter the door to Boomerang the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the room with four torches and a bunch of gravestones, kill the
 Keese there so they won't give you trouble, and step on the blue switch to
 light the torches as long as the switch is pressed. Light a Deku Stick and
 take it to the northwest webbing to burn it. Enter the door, kill the enemies,
 and Boomerang the Skulltula and its token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Kokiri Forest at night, a Gold Skulltula is behind the Know-it-all Brothers house, the westernmost hut in the village.

evidence.quote:
Once back at the village at night, at night, you'll find this Gold
 Skulltula behind the Know-it-all Brothers house, the westernmost hut in the
 village.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the Hyrule Market guard house, roll into the crate next to the guard to break it and release a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter the walls of town, head into the guard's
 house. Roll into the crate next to the guard here to break it and release this
 Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: On Hyrule Castle grounds, rolling into the lone tree where the owl sat knocks down a Gold Skulltula from its branches.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you reach the castle grounds, there's a lone tree in
 plain sight. (The one the owl was on.) Roll into the tree to knock down a Gold
 Skulltula from its branches.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Beside Talon's house at Lon Lon Ranch, rolling into the lone tree knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Beside Talon's house, there's a lone tree with a few crates. Roll
 into the tree to knock down this Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At Lon Lon Ranch, a Gold Skulltula lies behind the horse corral.

evidence.quote: Behind the horse corral the Gold Skulltula lies.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Dropping a bottle of bugs onto the plot of dirt beside the Kokiri Shop causes a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
Head to the the plot of dirt beside the Kokiri Shop and drop the
 bottle of bugs onto the dirt plot. As long as one bug burrows straight into 
 the hole, a Gold Skulltula will pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: After entering Lost Woods, head left twice to find a plot of dirt and drop bugs on it to pop out a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Once you enter the Lost Woods, head left twice to find a plot of
 dirt. Drop the bugs on it, and another Gold Skulltula will pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Lost Woods, go right, left, right, then left twice to reach a grassy area and drop bugs on the dirt plot behind a Deku Scrub to make a Gold Skulltula pop out.

evidence.quote:
Once you enter Lost Woods, head right, left, right, then left twice
 to reach a grassy area. There's a plot of dirt behind a Deku Scrub. Drop bugs
 on the plot of dirt to make this Gold Skulltula pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Kakariko Village, rolling into the lone tree near the entrance knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The lone tree near the entrance hides this Gold Skulltula. Roll
 into the tree to knock it down.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In Kakariko Village, a Gold Skulltula sits near the window on the south side of the Skulltula House.

evidence.quote:
On the south side of the Skulltula House, a Gold Skulltula sits
 near the window.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #014
facts.text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula sits on the middle pillar of the building being constructed in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: Up on the building being constructed, it sits on the middle pillar.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #015
facts.text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula is located on the north wall of a house near the entrance to Death Mountain Trail in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Near Death Mountain Trail's entrance, there's a house with a Gold
 Skulltula on the north wall of it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #016
facts.text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula sits on the ladder of the watchtower south of the Death Mountain Trail entrance in Kakariko Village, and it can be killed with two shots from the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
South of Death Mountain Trail's entrance sits a watchtower. There's 
 a Gold Skulltula sitting on the ladder of the tower. Kill it with two shots 
 from the Slingshot and climb up the ladder to retrieve the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #017
facts.text: In Kakariko Graveyard at nighttime in the past, dropping bugs onto a light plot of dirt causes a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
In the graveyard is a light plot of dirt. Drop bugs onto it and a
 Gold Skulltula will pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #018
facts.text: In the past on Death Mountain Trail, destroying the boulder near the Goron City entrance reveals a patch of dirt where dropping bugs makes a Gold Skulltula pop out.

evidence.quote:
Above the boulder, near the entrance to Goron City, is a bomb flower. Pick a 
 bomb from it and throw it down to the boulder to destroy it and open Dodongo's 
 Cavern. It'll also reveal a patch of dirt. Drop some bugs on the patch to 
 make this Skulltula pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #019
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern in the past, blowing up a weak wall to the right past the southeastern entrance reveals a big steel door hiding a Gold Skulltula behind it.

evidence.quote:
Blow open the southeastern entrance in the main room, then head
 through. There's a weak wall to the right. Blow it up with a bomb or a Baby
 Dodongo, then open the big steel door for a Gold Skulltula behind it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #019 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, lighting the unlit mid-air torches opens a door to the north where a Gold Skulltula is found inside one of the crates.

evidence.quote:
In the room with mid-air torches (where the spike traps used to be
 in OoT), pull the blocks under each torch, then light a Deku Stick using a lit
 torch. Light the unlit mid-air torches (now on blocks) to open a door to the
 north. Go through that, kill the enemies, then find this Skulltula inside one
 of the crates.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #020
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern in the past, a Gold Skulltula is located on the vine beside the Skullwalltula after climbing the lowered giant staircase.

evidence.quote:
Head to the northwest entrance (unlock the gates first), and head
 to the staircase surrounded by bomb flowers. Place a bomb in the gap of bomb
 flowers and it'll start a chain reaction when it blows up, lowering the giant
 staircase. Climb up it, then kill the Gold Skulltula on the vine beside the 
 Skullwalltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #020 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, bombing rocks in the first Lizalfos room leads to a path overlooking the second Lizalfos room where a Gold Skulltula is waiting at the end.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the room you first fought some Lizalfos once you get the
 Bombs. You'll see a sort of "wall" of bombable rocks. Bomb some of them and
 jump to the path overlooking the second Lizalfos room. The Gold Skulltula is
 waiting at the end.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #021
facts.text: In Dodongo's Cavern in the past, a Gold Skulltula is found behind a breakable wall past the right entrance inside the giant Dodongo head.

evidence.quote:
Head inside the giant Dodongo head, then head to the right
 entrance. Past the walls is a breakable wall. Plant a bomb by it then head 
 through the door behind it. Defeat the Armos (optional, but it helps) and kill
 this Gold Skulltula here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #021 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, unlocking the door in the Poe-filled room leads to a room where a Gold Skulltula is positioned high in a corner within reach of the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
In the Poe-filled room, there's a locked door to the north. To open 
 it, place a bomb/bomb flower underneath the nearby bomb flower on the wall.
 This will cause a chain reaction with the other bomb flowers and activate a
 switch to open the door. Inside, kill all the enemies, then find the Gold 
 Skulltula high in a corner so you can Boomerang it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #022
facts.text: On Death Mountain Trail at nighttime in the past, bombing a discolored wall near the exit to Kakariko Village reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Near the exit to Kakariko Village is a discolored wall. Bomb it,
 kill the Gold Skulltula, then climb up the normal wall to collect the token.

facts.subject: boulder maze small chests
facts.text: In Goron City, the boulder maze room on the top level contains two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each.

evidence.quote:
On the top level, there's a room filled with boulders. Blast the
 brown boulders with Bombs and try to get through this maze to find a Gossip 
 Stone, two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each, and a crate with this 
 Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #023
facts.text: In Goron City in the past, a Gold Skulltula is hidden inside a crate in the boulder maze on the top level.

evidence.quote:
On the top level, there's a room filled with boulders. Blast the
 brown boulders with Bombs and try to get through this maze to find a Gossip 
 Stone, two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each, and a crate with this 
 Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #024
facts.text: In Death Mountain Crater in the past, breaking the crate right upon entering from the summit entrance releases a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter the crater from the summit entrance, break the
 crate to release this Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #025
facts.text: In Zora's River in the past, rolling into the first tree seen when entering from Hyrule Field knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The first tree you see when you enter the River from Hyrule Field
 hides a Gold Skulltula. Roll into the tree to knock it down.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #026
facts.text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula is found on the ladder near the waterfall at the end of Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
At the end
 where the waterfall is, drop down to where the ladder is and you'll find a 
 Gold Skulltula on it. Kill it with the slingshot then climb up the ladder to
 retrieve the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #027
facts.text: At nighttime in the past, a Gold Skulltula is located on one of the pillars on the far left island in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote:
Head to the far left island with pillars and find this Skulltula on
 one of those pillars.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #028
facts.text: In Lake Hylia in the past, dropping bugs on the plot of dirt right by the Lakeside Laboratory causes a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
Right by the Lakeside Laboratory is a plot of dirt. Drop some bugs
 on it and a Gold Skulltula will pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #029
facts.text: In Zora's Fountain in the past, rolling into the tree on the island behind Jabu Jabu knocks a Gold Skulltula off its branches.

evidence.quote:
Behind Jabu Jabu is an island. Roll into the tree on the island to
 knock this Gold Skulltula off its branches.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #030
facts.text: In Jabu-Jabu's Belly in the past, a Gold Skulltula is found on the vines near the opening after falling down the hole after Princess Ruto.

evidence.quote:
After falling down the hole after Princess Ruto, head toward the
 next opening and you'll find this Gold Skulltula on the vines. Kill it with 
 the slingshot, then hit the switch in the gap to raise the water level so you 
 can reach the vines to collect the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #030 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Jabu-Jabu's Belly, blowing up rocks on the wall in the northwestern room off the crossroads reveals a Gold Skulltula whose token can be retrieved with the Boomerang while atop a water jet.

evidence.quote:
In the crossroads room, take the northwestern room when it's open.
 There are Tailpasarans and Shaboms here, along with a Skullwalltula hidden in
 a rock. Kill them all, then look around the walls for some rocks. Place a 
 Bombchu underneath them to blow them up and the Gold Skulltula hiding inside.
 To get the token, step on the switch to make a water jet rise where you're
 standing. At this point, use the Boomerang to grab the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #031
facts.text: In Jabu-Jabu's Belly in the past, dropping down the hole where the green tentacle was located leads to a high ledge with a Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
After clearing the hallway room of all the tentacles, head back to
 the room filled with holes. Head down the hole the green tentacle used to be 
 at to drop down to the room where you first picked up Ruto, except on a higher 
 ledge. The Gold Skulltula is on the wall here.

facts.subject: Skull Kid
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song on the ocarina while standing on the stump in front of the lone Skull Kid in the Lost Woods rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Head all the way back to the entrance of Lost Woods. Head left from here to find a lone Skull Kid with a flute. Step onto the stump in front of him and play Saria's Song on your Ocarina. He will be so pleased with the melody that he'll give you a Piece of Heart in return.

facts.subject: Gossip Stone
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of a Gossip Stone grants a health-restoring fairy.

evidence.quote: By the way, now that you have Zelda's Lullaby, whenever you see a Gossip Stone, and need health, play the Lullaby in front of the stone. It should grant you a free health-restoring fairy.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Speaking to the cured man in the House of Skulltula after collecting 10 Gold Skulltula tokens rewards the Adult's Wallet, which holds 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Once you gather enough tokens, the curse will be lifted on a family member. We have enough already (need 10), so head into the house....Once inside, talk to the man who isn't a spider, and he'll give you the ADULT'S WALLET, which can hold 200 Rupees.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Dropping down the hole in the fenced area accessible by gliding with a Cucco reveals a small treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Go down the hole here later to find a small treasure chest with a Red Rupee.

facts.subject: Cucco Lady
facts.text: Gathering and returning all Cuccos to the pen for the distraught woman awards Link an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Bringing her all the Cuccos will net you another EMPTY BOTTLE.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Rolling into the lone tree near the entrance of Kakariko Village at night knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Exit the village, then re-enter when night arrives. There's quite a lot of Gold Skulltulas to find. First, roll into the lone tree near the entrance to knock down this Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located at the window on the south wall of the Skulltula House at night.

evidence.quote: Next, head to the south wall of the Skulltula House. There's another one right at the window.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the building under construction in Kakariko Village at night.

evidence.quote: Head up to the building under construction. There's a Gold Skulltula up there within easy reach.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the northern part of Kakariko Village near the entrance to Death Mountain at night.

evidence.quote: Next, head up to the northern part of town, up to where the Death Mountain entrance is. There's yet another one here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on the ladder of the tall lookout tower south of the Death Mountain entrance, which can be killed with two slingshot shots.

evidence.quote: South of here is a tall lookout tower. Another one is on the ladder of the tower. Kill it with two shots from the slingshot, then climb up the ladder to get the token.

facts.subject: Dampé's Gravedigging Tour
facts.text: Paying the gravekeeper 10 Rupees to dig in dirt sections on the path can uncover a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Talk to him while he's standing on a section of dirt and he'll ask for 10 Rupees so he'll dig in that place. What we're looking for is a Piece of Heart. Let him dig once in each section of dirt on the path until the Piece pops out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Dropping bugs into the plot of dirt in the Graveyard causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote: There's also a plot of dirt similar to the ones in Lost Woods. Drop bugs here, making sure to catch another before they disappear, and another Gold Skulltula will pop out.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Pulling the gravestone with flowers in front of it in the Graveyard reveals a hole containing a chest with the Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote: There's one particular grave with flowers in front of it. Pull this gravestone to reveal a hole you can drop down. In here is a treasure chest containing a HYLIAN SHIELD.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Pulling the second gravestone on the left facing away from the Royal Family's Tomb at night reveals a hole where playing the Sun's Song spawns a chest with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Now, facing away from the grave entrance, pull the second left gravestone to reveal another hole. (Make sure it's night, otherwise Navi won't let you pull it.) Fall down this hole, kill the Redead, then play the Sun's Song on the steps to reveal a chest containing a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Darunia
facts.text: Playing Saria's Song for Darunia in Goron City prompts him to dance and give Link the Goron's Bracelet.

evidence.quote: Cheer him up by playing Saria's Song. He'll dance to it, then give you the GORON'S BRACELET, which allows you to pick up the bomb from a bomb flower, as you may have seen throughout the city.

facts.subject: Spinning pot
facts.text: Throwing a bomb into the giant spinning pot in Goron City so that it stops on the happy face yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Now, head to the level just above those circling pot, and grab a bomb from a bomb flower. Time your throw so that the bomb lands into the pot. If it lands on the very happy face, a Piece of Heart pops out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Dropping bugs onto the soft dirt plot revealed after blowing up the boulder outside Goron City causes a Gold Skulltula to emerge.

evidence.quote: Drop down, and you'll see that a plot of dirt has been revealed. Drop some bugs on it (No need to recapture any for right now.) and a Gold Skulltula will pop out.

facts.subject: Large treasure chest
facts.text: Blowing up the wall on the west side of the main room in Dodongo's Cavern reveals a large treasure chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: First, head to the west side of the room. Grab a bomb and blow up the wall here. Behind it is a large treasure chest. Opening it will get you the DUNGEON MAP for this area.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Behind a bombable wall blown up by luring a Baby Dodongo on the southeast path of Dodongo's Cavern is a room containing Keese, a torch, and a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Kill that Baby and it'll blow up the wall. After its blown, head through and open the large steel door behind it. There are a bunch of Keese, a torch, and a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Business Deku Scrub
facts.text: A Business Deku Scrub behind the bombable wall in the Dodongo room sells Deku Sticks for 15 Rupees each.

evidence.quote: Behind the steel door is just a Business Deku Scrub who'll sell Deku Sticks for 15 Rupees a piece.

facts.subject: Business Scrub
facts.text: A Business Scrub on the far left across the lava pool in Dodongo's Cavern sells Deku Shields for 50 Rupees each.

evidence.quote: There's a Business Scrub at the far left on this side. He sells Deku Shields for 50 Rupees each.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on some vines at the top of the lowered bomb flower staircase in Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Once all of them blow, the staircase will lower. Go up it, and find a Gold Skulltula on some vines.

facts.subject: Large treasure chest
facts.text: Opening the large treasure chest guarded by three statues (including an Armos) behind the wall across from the staircase yields the Compass.

evidence.quote: In here, there are three statues surrounding a large treasure chest. The front one is an Armos, a live statue. Touch it to wake it, then throw a bomb at it to kill it....Open the chest to get the COMPASS for this dungeon.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #031 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest, the Gold Skulltula in the room before the Jabu-Jabu's Belly boss is reached by climbing the vine-covered pillar and burning it with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote: How to get: In the room before the boss, climb up the pillar covered in vines
so use Din's Fire as close as possible

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #032
facts.text: Gold Skulltula #032 in Jabu-Jabu's Belly sits right beside the preceding Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #032: [ ] ... How to get: Right by the Gold Skulltula described above.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #032 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest, playing the Song of Time in front of the blue block in the Boomerang room removes the block and reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: play the Song of Time in front of the blue block to remove it

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #033
facts.text: After Bigocto is defeated, the Gold Skulltula is on some vines in the last room of the first floor, just before the boss room.

evidence.quote: After defeating Bigocto, head to the last room in the first floor
(just before the boss room) and you'll find this Gold Skulltula on some vines.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #033 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest, the Gold Skulltula is reached by taking the southwestern exit from Princess Ruto's former room and then crossing the water via a Hookshot structure.

evidence.quote: How to get: In the room where Princess Ruto used to reside in, take the southwestern exit, assuming there is no tentacle blocking the way.
Burn the webbing with Din's Fire and kill the Gold Skulltula there.

facts.subject: Hookshot structure in water
facts.text: With the Lens of Truth on, shooting the invisible Keese and killing the Stingers makes a Hookshot structure appear in the water to use as a stepping stone.

evidence.quote: put on the Lens of Truth and snipe down the
make a Hookshot structure (obviously unusable) appear in the water

facts.text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, proceed to the underground river room after defeating Dark Link and Longshot past the second whirlpool to find and collect the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After defeating Dark Link, head into the underground river room
 that's up next. Note the whirlpool at the beginning, and start Longshotting
 along the river until you just pass the second whirlpool. Look around to find
 a Gold Skulltula. Longshot it and its token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #081
facts.text: In the Water Temple, after obtaining the Longshot and lowering the water level with Zelda's Lullaby, enter the central structure from the main room, Longshot to the platform, and hit the Gold Skulltula located on the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
After getting the Longshot, head to the room where you met Ruto,
 float to the top, and play Zelda's Lullaby to lower the water level. Head back
 to the main room, enter the central structure, and Longshot to the platform up
 there. The Gold Skulltula is on the ceiling, and can easily be reached with
 the Longshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #081 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, navigate past the northern passage on the 1st floor using Pierre, raise geysers via a crystal switch, light torches with Din's Fire, defeat all the Dodongos in the next room, and break one of the crates to uncover the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After getting the Boss Key, sink to the 1st floor in the main room
 and go through the northern passage. At its end, Longshot up, then across the
 water over spikes, and enter the door. In the next room, play your Scarecrow's
 Song near the left edge up here and Longshot to Pierre. Enter the door in the
 alcove up here, then drop down in the next room. Stand on the second geyser
 and shoot the crystal switch to raise the geysers. Use Din's Fire to light all
 but one torch, then go over to that side and light that torch with Din's Fire
 to open the door. In this next room, kill all the Dodongos (bombing them and
 sniping them with arrows from above helps) including the one in the hall to
 open the door ahead. Longshot to it and enter it. Break one of the crates here
 to find a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #082
facts.text: In the Water Temple, the Gold Skulltula is located in the small area with rolling boulders past the northernmost room of the First Floor.

evidence.quote:
In the room after the northern-most room of the First Floor, you'll
 see a small area with boulders rolling by. This Gold Skulltula is nearby.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #082 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, sink to the bottom of the main room after getting Fire Arrows, light three torches in the southern hall with Fire Arrows, Longshot to Pierre, defeat the Stalfos, and check the ceiling of the small room for the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After getting the Fire Arrows, return to the temple and sink to the
 bottom of the main room. Go through the southern hall and surface at the end.
 Find the three torches and shoot them with Fire Arrows to light them, then
 play your Scarecrow's Song. Longshot to Pierre, kill the Stalfos, then look at
 the ceiling in the small room for this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #083
facts.text: At Lake Hylia as Adult Link at night, use the Longshot on a tree branch on the island with the large tree to find Gold Skulltula #083 on top of the tree.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #083: [ ] ... How to get: On the island with the large tree, Longshot to a branch on the tree and you'll see this Skulltula on the top of the tree.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #084
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, enter the east door from the large southern room on B3 and defeat all enemies in the spinning scythe room to open the cell holding Gold Skulltula #084.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #084: [ ] ... How to get: In the southern large room in the third basement floor, go through the east door. Inside the invisible spinning scythe statue room, kill all the enemies to open the cell there. Inside the cell is this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #084 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple B4 southwestern room, use the Lens of Truth to find a hidden block and push it under the ceiling spike traps, then Longshot the Gold Skulltula inside the southern cell.

evidence.quote:
In the small jail cell room (in other words, the southwestern-most
 room in B4), find the block inside a wall using the Lens of Truth, and push it
 towards the ceiling spike traps so that the block will...well...block both of
 them from banging down onto the ground. Enter the southern cell to find this
 Skulltula. You'll have to Longshot it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #085
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, Gold Skulltula #085 is located inside the southern cell of the prison room at the southern end of the fourth basement floor.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #085: [ ] ... How to get: In the prison room at the very south of the fourth basement floor, there's this Skulltula in this room's southern cell.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #085 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple, playing the Sun's Song stuns the four ReDeads through the door past the fan corridors so you can Longshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door at the end of the fan corridors to see four ReDeads.
 Play the Sun's Song to stun them so that you are free to Longshot the Gold
 Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #086
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, Gold Skulltula #086 is located behind the giant skull statue in the room north of the large B4 room.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #086: [ ] ... How to get: In the giant skull statue room north of the large room in the fourth floor, this skulltula is behind the skull statue.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #086 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple, bombing the dirt piles in the room north of the fan room and south of the boat room reveals a hidden Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the room north of the fan room/south of the boat ride room, bomb
 the dirt piles to find a Gold Skulltula hiding in one of them.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #087
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple boat room on B4, push the large block into the indentation, climb the ladder, play the Scarecrow's Song, and Longshot across to reach Gold Skulltula #087.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #087: [ ] ... How to get: In the huge room with a boat on the fourth basement floor, move the large block into the indentation, climb up the ladder from it, turn around, and play the Scarecrow's Song. Longshot across and you'll see this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #087 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple boat ride room, shoot bomb flowers on the west side to drop a bridge, walk halfway across, look down to the right, and Longshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the west side of the boat ride room, find some bomb flowers and
 snipe them to create a bridge. Get on the bridge and stop at about halfway.
 Turn around, and look down to your right to find this Skulltula. Longshot it
 and its token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #088
facts.text: In the Shadow Temple, pass through the west door of the B4 boat room, navigate the invisible maze to its west door, and find Gold Skulltula #088 behind the spinning skulls.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #088: [ ] ... How to get: In the west side of the huge boat room on the fourth floor, take west door. Go through this maze of invisible walls next, and enter its west door. Inside, this Skulltula is behind the spinning skulls.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #088 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple, use the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots to reach an invisible S-shaped platform in the room before the boss and hit the Gold Skulltula with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
In the room just before the boss is a Gold Skulltula crawling
 around on an invisible platform shaped a bit like an S. Get over there with
 the help of the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots, and find a spot where you can
 hit it with the Longshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #089
facts.text: At Gerudo Fortress, Gold Skulltula #089 is crawling on the east cliff side at the very top of the fortress and requires the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #089: [ ] ... How to get: Up at the very top of the fortress, this Skulltula is crawling around on the east cliff side.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #090
facts.text: In the Gerudo Fortress Horseback Archery area, Gold Skulltula #090 is located high on the wall on the far left.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #090: [ ] ... How to get: In the Horseback Archery area, head to the far left of this area to find this Skulltula high on the wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #091
facts.text: In Haunted Wasteland, follow the flag markers past the River of Sand to the ghost guide shrine, where Gold Skulltula #091 is located inside.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #091: [ ] ... How to get: Follow the flag markers after the River of Sand to find a shrine where you'll meet the ghost guide. Head inside to find this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #092
facts.text: At Desert Colossus at night, Gold Skulltula #092 is on a palm tree near the Fairy Fountain grove.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #092: [ ] ... How to get: At night, head towards the Fairy Fountain. The Gold Skulltula is on a palm tree nearby.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #093
facts.text: At Desert Colossus as Young Link, drop bugs from a bottle into the soft dirt patch to make Gold Skulltula #093 emerge.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #093: [ ] ... How to get: Warp to the Collosus as Young Link, and drop some bugs from a bottle onto the plot of dirt nearby to make this Skulltula pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #094
facts.text: In the Spirit Temple 1F circular rooms left of the entrance, Gold Skulltula #094 is on the gate facing the gap in the right-hand room.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #094: [ ] ... How to get: In the circular series of rooms left of the entrance in the first floor, the right room has a gap with a gate on the other side. This Skulltula is on the gate facing the gap.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #094 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Spirit Temple, push or pull the sunface block south of the crystal switch into sunlight to spawn an ice block above, then Longshot up and grab the Gold Skulltula on the other ice block.

evidence.quote:
Push/pull the sunface block south of the crystal switch to the
 sunlight to make an ice block appear above. Longshot up there, then Longshot
 the Gold Skulltula on the other ice block.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #095
facts.text: In the Spirit Temple 1F circular rooms, climb the central rock face to the top and turn around to find Gold Skulltula #095 on the opposite wall.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #095: [ ] ... How to get: In the center of the circular series of rooms left of the entrance in the first floor is a sheer rock face leading to the second floor. Climb to the top and turn around to find this Skulltula on the wall opposite the climbable wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #095 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Spirit Temple, pass east of the entrance past the water jet and enter the west door to find a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
East of the entrance room, past that water jet, enter the west 
 door. Inside, look up at the ceiling to spot this Gold Skulltula. Longshot it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #096
facts.text: In the Spirit Temple en route to the Iron Knuckle miniboss, Gold Skulltula #096 is high on the wall above the door by the staircase leading to the battle.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #096: [ ] ... How to get: While heading to the Iron Knuckle miniboss, this Gold Skulltula is high up on the wall of the door at the staircase leading to the battle.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #096 (Master Quest)
facts.text: In Master Quest Spirit Temple northeast 1F room, play Song of Time, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Storms, and Zelda's Lullaby in sequence inside successive alcoves to unlock the door to the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Requirements: Song of Time, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Storms, Zelda's
 Lullaby, Longshot, Small Key, Megaton Hammer...Now, in this room, each song you
 play in each alcove will open up the next, and the order of songs is actually
 shown in the requirements. So play one song inside an alcove, get into the
 next, play the next song, etc... Afterwards, the door to the Gold Skulltula
 will open.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #097
facts.text: Plant a Magic Bean near the Desert Colossus as Young Link, then return as Adult Link and ride the plant to a large rock where Gold Skulltula #097 is located at night.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #097: [ ] ... How to get: Plant a Magic Bean onto the plot of dirt by the Desert Collosus as Young Link, then return as Adult Link. Ride the plant until you come across a large rock with this Skulltula on it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #098
facts.text: In the rightmost first-floor room with boulders and Silver Rupees, play the Song of Time near the blue block to find Gold Skulltula #098 hiding behind it.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #098: [ ] ... How to get: In the rightmost room of the first floor, the one with boulders and Silver Rupees, play the Song of Time near the blue block to move it. The Gold Skulltula is hiding behind it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #099
facts.text: In the giant statue room, climb the west staircase, play the Scarecrow's Song, and Longshot over to reach Gold Skulltula #099.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #099: [ ] ... How to get: In the giant statue room, climb up the west staircase, play the Scarecrow's Song, and Longshot to him. This Skulltula is here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula #100
facts.text: At Zora's Fountain at night, lift the white boulder on the far right ledge using the Silver Gauntlets and enter the cave tunnel to find Gold Skulltula #100.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #100: [ ] ... How to get: At the ledge far to the right of the entrance is a dry ledge with a white boulder. Lift it with the Gauntlets and drop down the cave to enter a tunnel. Inside is this Skulltula.

facts.subject: Advanced Spin Attack
facts.text: At Death Mountain Trail's summit, bomb the discolored wall to find the Great Fairy of Power, who grants the magic meter and the Advanced Spin Attack.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Death Mountain Trail's summit. Bomb the discolored wall here to
 unveil the entrance to this Great Fairy's Fountain.

Ability given: Advanced Spin Attack...She also gives you the magic meter so you can
 use the Great Fairies' powers, among other magic-consuming items.

facts.subject: Din's Fire
facts.text: At Hyrule Castle Grounds, bomb the boulder in the corner past the gate to access a crawlspace leading to the Great Fairy of Magic who bestows Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Hyrule Castle Grounds. Pass the gate, then bomb the boulder in the
 corner to reveal a crawlspace leading to this Great Fairy Fountain.

Ability given: Din's Fire

facts.subject: Farore's Wind
facts.text: On an island behind Lord Jabu Jabu in Zora's Fountain, bomb the wall near the white rock to reach the Great Fairy who gives Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Zora's Fountain. There's an island behind Lord Jabu Jabu. Plant a
 bomb near the white rock to blow open the whole wall, revealing this Great 
 Fairy Fountain.

Ability given: Farore's Wind

facts.subject: Magic Meter Upgrade
facts.text: Inside Death Mountain Crater from the Goron City entrance, turn right and destroy the rocks with the Megaton Hammer to find the Great Fairy who doubles your magic capacity.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Death Mountain Crater. After getting the Megaton Hammer, enter
 Death Mountain Crater using the Goron City entrance. Turn right, and break the
 rocks with the hammer to reveal the entrance to this Great Fairy Fountain.

Ability given: Isn't an ability, per se, but is actually a magic meter upgrade.

Details: A magic meter upgrade. It doubles your magic capacity, so you can use
 more magic powers at one time.

facts.subject: Nayru's Love
facts.text: At Desert Colossus, bomb the cracked wall between two palm trees to reach the Great Fairy Fountain containing Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Desert Colossus. Find the cracked wall between two palm trees and
 bomb the wall to reveal the entrance to this fountain.

Ability given: Nayru's Love

facts.subject: Defense Upgrade
facts.text: Outside Ganon's Castle, lift the massive black stone with the Golden Gauntlets to enter the Great Fairy of Courage's fountain, which doubles your defense and outlines your hearts in white.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Ganon's Castle. After getting the Golden Gauntlets in the castle,
 head to its grounds and lift the massive black stone out of the way.

Ability given: Isn't an ability, rather, it doubles your defense.

Details: Doubles your defense. Now you can take twice the punishment you used
 to. This also outlines your hearts with white.

facts.subject: Zelda's Lullaby
facts.text: Impa teaches Zelda's Lullaby after speaking to Princess Zelda for the first time, played as Left C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C, Right C.

evidence.quote:
When to get: After speaking to Princess Zelda for the first time, Impa teaches
 you this.

How to play: Left C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C, Right C

facts.subject: Epona's Song
facts.text: Malon teaches Epona's Song (Up C, Left C, Right C, Up C, Left C, Right C) after talking to her three times at Lon Lon Ranch and equipping the Ocarina in front of her.

evidence.quote:
When to get: After visiting Princess Zelda, head into Lon Lon Ranch and talk to
 Malon three times. Equip the Ocarina in front of her (after she says something
 about singing a song together) and she'll teach you this song.

How to play: Up C, Left C, Right C, Up C, Left C, Right C

facts.subject: Saria's Song
facts.text: Saria teaches Saria's Song (Down C, Right C, Left C, Down C, Right C, Left C) at the end of the maze in Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Wolfos to unlock the gate, then head through the evil Deku 
 Scrub-infested maze to the end. Go up some stairs, and talk to Saria and 
 she'll teach you her song.

How to play: Down C, Right C, Left C, Down C, Right C, Left C

facts.subject: Sun's Song
facts.text: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark before the Royal Tomb in Kakariko Graveyard and proceed past the Keese and Redeads to learn the Sun's Song (Right C, Down C, Up C, Right C, Down C, Up C).

evidence.quote:
Stand on the Triforce mark on the ground in front of it, and play Zelda's 
 Lullaby to open the grave. Head down, kill the Keese, head through the door, 
 pass the Redeads, head through the next opening, and read the inscription on 
 the wall...Follow the notes and 
 you'll learn the Sun's Song.

How to play: Right C, Down C, Up C, Right C, Down C, Up C

facts.subject: Song of Time
facts.text: After gathering all three Spiritual Stones, retrieve the Ocarina of Time from the Hyrule Castle moat to telepathically learn the Song of Time (Right C, A, Down C, Right C, A, Down C).

evidence.quote:
After the scene is over, head into the moat to grab the 
 Ocarina, at which point Zelda will telepathically teach you this song.

How to play: Right C, A, Down C, Right C, A, Down C

facts.subject: Song of Storms
facts.text: Playing your Ocarina in front of the windmill man in Kakariko Village as Adult Link teaches the Song of Storms (A, Down C, Up C, A, Down C, Up C).

evidence.quote:
Visit the windmill man in Kakariko Village as Adult Link and he'll
 tell you about the time a young boy with an Ocarina came in and messed up his
 windmill by playing a song. Take out the Ocarina and he'll play that song that
 angers him so. Follow the notes and you'll have learned this song!
How to play: A, Down C, Up C, A, Down C, Up C

facts.subject: Scarecrow's Song
facts.text: Play any custom 8 notes to the scarecrow at Lake Hylia as Young Link, then play the same 8 notes as Adult Link to enable the Scarecrow's Song.

evidence.quote:
Simply play any 8 notes you wish in front of the scarecrow at the
 shore of Lake Hylia, then return as Adult Link and play those same 8 notes and
 the scarecrow will allow you to use this song.

facts.subject: Minuet of Forest
facts.text: Sheik teaches the Minuet of Forest (A, Up C, Left C, Right C, Left C, Right C) upon arriving at the Forest Temple entrance in Sacred Forest Meadow as Adult Link.

evidence.quote:
When to get: Reach the entrance to the Forest Temple in the Sacred Forest
 Meadow as Adult Link, and Shiek will appear to teach you this song.

How to play: A, Up C, Left C, Right C, Left C, Right C

facts.subject: Prelude of Light
facts.text: After completing the Forest Temple, return to the Temple of Time where Sheik teaches the Prelude of Light (Up C, Right C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C).

evidence.quote:
When to get: After clearing the Forest Temple, return to the Temple of Time and
 Shiek will appear to teach you this song, along with allowing you to return to
 the past at your will.

How to play: Up C, Right C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C

facts.subject: Goron Tunic
facts.text: Detonating a bomb as the rolling Goron child rolls over it stops him, and talking to him rewards Link with the heat-resistant Goron Tunic.

evidence.quote:
Plant a bomb in such a way so that it'll
explode right when the small Goron child rolls over it, stopping him. Ask him
about the dragon and what happened to the Goron race, and he'll give you the
Goron Tunic, allowing you to survive in intense heat.

facts.subject: Bolero of Fire
facts.text: After crossing the bridge inside Death Mountain Crater with the Hookshot, Sheik stops Link and teaches the Bolero of Fire (Down C, A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, Right C, Down C).

evidence.quote:
Use the Hookshot to cross the bridge,
and Sheik will stop you, and teach you this song.

How to play: Down C, A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, Right C, Down C

facts.subject: Serenade of Water
facts.text: Obtaining the Iron Boots in the Ice Cavern causes Sheik to appear and teach the Serenade of Water (A, Down C, Right C, Right C, Left C).

evidence.quote:
When to get: Grab the Iron Boots in the Ice Cavern. Sheik will then teach you
this.

How to play: A, Down C, Right C, Right C, Left C

facts.subject: Nocturne of Shadow
facts.text: After clearing the Water Temple, visit Kakariko Village to trigger a cutscene after which Sheik teaches the Nocturne of Shadow (Left C, Right C, Right C, A, Left C, Right C, Down C).

evidence.quote:
When to get: Simply after clearing the Water Temple, visit Kakariko Village and
watch the cinema. After it's over, Sheik will teach you this song.

How to play: Left C, Right C, Right C, A, Left C, Right C, Down C

facts.subject: Requiem of Spirit
facts.text: Entering and exiting the Spirit Temple at the Desert Colossus prompts Sheik to teach the Requiem of Spirit (A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, A).

evidence.quote:
When to get: Simply enter the Spirit Temple inside the Desert Colossus then
exit, and Sheik will teach you this.

How to play: A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, A

facts.subject: Sinking Lure
facts.text: The Sinking Lure becomes available in the Fishing Hole after catching a fish weighing at least 15 lbs.

evidence.quote: After catching a fish of at least 15 lbs. in the Fishing Hole, the Sinking Lure will be available.

facts.subject: Sinking Lure
facts.text: To make the Sinking Lure legal, talk to the Fishing Hole owner while holding it.

evidence.quote: TO MAKE THE SINKING LURE LEGAL: Grab it, and go over to the owner. Say that you want to talk to him and he'll make the Sinking Lure legal.

facts.subject: Hylian Loach
facts.text: The rare Hylian Loach appears randomly in the Fishing Hole, weighing 18 pounds as Young Link or 35 pounds as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: The Hylian Loach is a very rare fish that randomly appears in the Fishing Hole. It weighs 18 pounds as Young Link or 35 pounds as Adult Link.

facts.subject: Fisherman's Hat
facts.text: As Adult Link, casting your line at the fisherman's head can snatch his hat, and casting it into the pond incurs a 50 Rupees fine.

evidence.quote: When you visit the Fishing Hole as Adult Link, the fisherman owning the place now wears a hat. If you cast JUST right, you can snare the hat right off of his head. ... Of course, you can be mean and cast his hat into the pond, but he'll fine you 50 Rupees.

facts.subject: Kokiri Forest Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms near the Gossip Stone near the Lost Woods entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Head near the entrance of Lost Woods to find a Gossip Stone. Play the Song of Storms near it to reveal the Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a treasure chest with a Red Rupee inside.

facts.subject: Lost Woods Business Deku Scrub
facts.text: Bombing the rock outside the Sacred Forest Meadow entrance reveals a cave with Business Deku Scrubs selling Deku Seeds and a Deku Nut Upgrade.

evidence.quote: After exiting the Sacred Forest Meadow, bomb the rock you find there. CONTENTS: Two Business Deku Scrubs.  One sells a Deku Nut Upgrade and one sells Deku Seeds.

facts.subject: Lost Woods Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Blasting the boulder found by turning right and left from the Kokiri Forest entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Enter Lost Woods via Kokiri Forest, turn right, left, and blast the boulder with a bomb. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone, and small chest containing a Blue Rupee

facts.subject: The Forest Stage
facts.text: Following the path right, left, right, left, and left from the Kokiri Forest entrance leads Child Link to the Forest Stage cave hidden in the grass.

evidence.quote: Enter Lost Woods via Kokiri Forest, turn right, left, right, left and left again. ... You must be a child in order to do this, though. CONTENTS: The Forest Stage.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Bombing the foot of the tree near the castle walls past the bridge toward Kakariko Village reveals a hole containing a Gold Skulltula behind cobwebs.

evidence.quote: Face the entrance to Hyrule Castle, then start heading towards the entrance to Kakariko Village. Stop when you get past the little bridge and head to the tree near the castle walls. Plant a bomb at the foot of the tree to reveal the hole. CONTENTS: A Skulltula and Gold Skulltula behind cobwebs.

facts.subject: Hyrule Field Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Blasting the boulder along the wall to the left of the Hyrule Castle entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's some trees here and a boulder. Blast open the boulder to reveal a Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone, small chest containing Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Hyrule Field Secret Cave
facts.text: Bombing the foot of the lone tree near the river left of the castle entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Piece of Heart in a pool of water.

evidence.quote: Keep going left from the previous secret to find a bunch of trees and a river. Plant a bomb at the foot of the lone tree to reveal yet another Secret Cave. CONTENTS: A pool of water with a Piece of Heart down below, and a Blue Tektite.

facts.subject: Hyrule Field Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Breaking the boulder on the other side of the river across from the lone tree reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Go to the other side of the river and blast/break the boulder to reveal this one. CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Bombing the center of a circle of stones near the Gerudo Valley entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Gold Skulltula and a cow behind cobwebs.

evidence.quote: A little right from the entrance to Gerudo Valley, on the same cliff, is a big boulder surrounded by a circle of little stones. Break the boulder first, then plant a bomb in the center of the circle of stones to reveal this Secret Cave. CONTENTS: A Gossip Stone, Skulltula, cow, and Gold Skulltula all behind cobwebs.

facts.subject: Lake Hylia Business Scrub
facts.text: Bombing the center of the square of fences in front of the Lake Hylia entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Business Scrub selling a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: In front of the entrance to Hylia Lake is a square of fences. Plant a bomb right in the center to reveal another Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Business Scrub that sells you a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Lake Hylia Entrance Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: An open hole near the fence square by the Lake Hylia entrance contains a small chest with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's a hole out in the open near the above Secret Cave waiting to be found. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Hyrule Field Mini-Forest Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Breaking the boulder among the trees in Hyrule Field's mini-forest reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's a mini-forest in Hyrule Field. Among the trees is a boulder. Break it to reveal the last Secret Cave here. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms near the tree inside the Castle Fence opens a cave with three bombable walls concealing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms near the tree that's inside the Castle Fence. CONTENTS: Prepare for a long list. There's three bombable walls. Behind one of them are bugs, three pots, eight stones, and a Gossip Stone. Behind another one is a Skullwalltula, and the final one has a Skullwalltula and Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Kakariko Village Well Path Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Bombing between the tree and stairs to the well reveals a Secret Cave where defeating two Redeads awards a small chest with a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: Between the tree and the stairs to the well is where the Secret Cave is. Plant a bomb somewhere between those things. CONTENTS: Two Redeads. Kill them to reveal a small chest with a Huge Rupee inside.

facts.subject: Kakariko Village Potion Shop Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Dropping into the hole near the Potion Shop reveals a Secret Cave with a treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's a hole on the ground near the Potion Shop. Just drop right in. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone, a fish, and a treasure chest with a Red Rupee inside.

facts.subject: Graveyard Secret Grave Chest
facts.text: Pushing gravestones in the Graveyard reveals a hole containing a chest with a Hylian Shield and another containing a Redead and a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: All the secrets here are found by pushing the gravestones. CONTENTS: One hole has a Redead and a Piece of Heart (using Sun's Song) and one has a chest with a Hylian Shield.

facts.subject: Death Mountain Trail Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms inside the rock circle near the Goron City entrance reveals a hole with a chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms in the middle of the circle of rocks on the platform to reveal the hole. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and treasure chest containing a Huge Rupee

facts.subject: Death Mountain Trail Summit Platform Secret Cave
facts.text: Blasting the rock on the platform near the danger sign on the path to the summit reveals a Secret Cave with a cow, Recovery Hearts, and Green Rupees.

evidence.quote: At the place where you jump platforms to reach the summit, there's a rock on one of the platforms. Blast or break it to reveal a Secret Cave. ... CONTENTS: Green Rupees, Recovery Hearts, and a cow

facts.subject: Death Mountain Crater Business Scrubs
facts.text: Breaking the boulder near the Fire Temple entrance with the Megaton Hammer reveals three Business Scrubs selling bombs, Deku Nuts, and Arrows.

evidence.quote: Nearby the entrance to the Fire Temple, there's a boulder that can be broken with the Megaton Hammer. Do so to reveal the secret. CONTENTS: Three Business Scrubs. One sells bombs, one sells Deku Nuts, one sells Arrows.

facts.subject: Death Mountain Crater Entrance Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Blasting the boulder inside the circle of stones near the main entrance reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote: Just inside from the main entrance is a circle of stones with a boulder in the center. Blast the boulder to reveal the secret. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a small chest containing Bombs

facts.subject: Goron City Lava Room Secret Cave Chest
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms in the lava room as Child Link and returning as Adult Link with the Longshot accesses a chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: go to the lava room as Child Link. Play the Song of Storms here, then leave. Come back as Adult Link and you'll be able to use your Longshot to get to the other side where the hole is. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and treasure chest containing a Huge Rupee

facts.subject: Zora's River Business Scrubs
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms in the rock circle near the river entrance reveals Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle each.

evidence.quote: Near the entrance to the River, in the corner where a Cucco is, is a circle of rocks. Play the Song of Storms near it to reveal this Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Two Business Scrubs. One sells Green Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle, and the other sells Red Potions for the same price each bottle.

facts.subject: Zora's River Magic Bean Platform Open Cave Chest
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean plant as Adult Link reaches an elevated platform with an open cave holding a chest with a Red Rupee and a boulder concealing a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Plant a Magic Bean in the sandy patch here near the beginning, then ride it (as Adult Link) to head to a platform with two Secret Caves. ... CONTENTS: The one out in the open has a Gossip Stone and a small chest with a Red Rupee, and the one under the boulder has a Fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Zora's Domain Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms on the flat unsubmerged rock in Zora's Domain reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms on the flat, unsubmerged rock. CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

facts.subject: Lake Hylia Island Secret Grave
facts.text: Pushing the grave on one of the Lake Hylia islands reveals a Secret Cave with three Business Scrubs selling general pick-up items.

evidence.quote: One of the islands here has a grave that can be pushed to reveal this Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Three Business Scrubs which sell general pick-up items.

facts.subject: Gerudo Valley Business Scrubs
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms behind the carpenter's tent reveals Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle each.

evidence.quote: Playing the Song of Storms whilst behind the carpenter's tent will reveal this little secret. CONTENTS: Two Business Scrubs. One sells Green Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle, and the other sells Red Potions for the same price each bottle.

facts.subject: Gerudo Valley Canyon Ledge Secret Cave
facts.text: Lifting the white stone boulder on the canyon ledge with the Silver Gauntlets reveals a pool of water with Rupees guarded by an Octorok.

evidence.quote: Make sure you have at least the Silver Gauntlets before attempting this one. Stand near the canyon and look down, and you should see a small ledge with a white stone. Jump down and pick up the boulder to reveal the secret. CONTENTS: A pool of water with a ton of Rupees.  An Octorok guards this loot.

facts.subject: Gerudo Fortress Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms near the four boxes at the Gerudo Fortress main entrance reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: At the fortress's main entrance are four boxes. Play the Song of Storms near them to reveal this secret. ... CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

facts.subject: Sacred Forest Meadow Secret Shrine Chest
facts.text: Bombing near the Lost Woods entrance across from the Forest Temple reveals a shrine where defeating two Wolfos reveals a small chest with a purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Place a bomb near the entrance to Lost Woods at the other side of the Forest Temple. CONTENTS: A strange shrine with two guardian Wolfos. Kill them both to reveal a small chest containing a purple Rupee.

facts.subject: Sacred Forest Meadow Fairy Fountain
facts.text: A hole on the ground in the middle of the maze leading to the Forest Temple contains a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: There's a hole on the ground in the middle of the maze to the Forest Temple. CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

facts.subject: Desert Colossus Business Scrubs
facts.text: Lifting the boulder near the Spirit Temple entrance using the Silver Gauntlets reveals Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle each.

evidence.quote: There's a boulder that can be lifted near the entrance to the Spirit Temple. Must have at least the Silver Gauntlets. CONTENTS: Two Business Scrubs. One sells Green Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle, and the other sells Red Potions for the same price each bottle.

facts.subject: Amy
facts.text: Amy is one of the Poe sisters in the Forest Temple who must be fought after moving blocks to assemble a picture of her.

evidence.quote: Amy...Description: One of the Poe sisters in the Forest Temple. Aim for her when she appears. Before fighting her, you have to move blocks to form a picture of her.

facts.subject: Anubis
facts.text: Anubis mirrors the player's movements and is vulnerable to fire traps or fire attacks.

evidence.quote: Anubis...Description: Vulnerable to fire, this enemy moves as you move, acting like a mirrored version of yourself. It occasionally fires bursts of fire if you take too long to lure it into the fire trap.

facts.subject: Armos
facts.text: Armos awakens when touched and can only be defeated with a bomb, hopping toward Link before exploding.

evidence.quote: Armos...Description: A live statue which awakes when you touch it. The only way to kill it is with a bomb. After getting hit by one, it hops toward you to try to take you down with it.

facts.subject: Baby Dodongo
facts.text: Baby Dodongo blows up when struck anywhere and can serve as a substitute bomb against bombable objects.

evidence.quote: Baby Dodongo...Description: Obviously a smaller version of the Dodongo. Striking it anywhere will kill it, and it'll blow up. They can be used as bomb substitutes if they are lured to something bombable before you kill them.

facts.subject: Bari
facts.text: Bari is a larger version of Biri equipped with elongated stingers.

evidence.quote: Bari...Description: A larger version of the Biri. Careful of its elongated stingers!

facts.subject: Beamos
facts.text: Beamos fires a continuous beam when it detects Link and can only be destroyed with bombs.

evidence.quote: Beamos...Description: Whenever it spots you, it fires a continuous beam until you get hit or get out of its range. The only way to defeat these is to bomb them to death.

facts.subject: Beth
facts.text: Beth is one of the Poe sisters encountered in the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: Beth...Description: One of the Poe sisters in the Forest Temple. Aim for her when she appears!

facts.subject: Big Deku Baba
facts.text: Big Deku Baba is a larger version of the Fierce Deku Baba found in Kokiri Forest when playing as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: Big Deku Baba...Description: Found in Kokiri Forest as Adult Link, these are simply a much larger version of the Fierce Deku Baba that infested the Deku Tree's innards.

facts.subject: Bigocto
facts.text: Bigocto is the sub-boss of Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly, defeated by stunning it with the Boomerang and slashing its exposed green backside.

evidence.quote: Bigocto: MINI-BOSS OF INSIDE JABU-JABU'S BELLY...Description: A giant Octorok who's weak point is its backside. Stun it with the Boomerang and it'll open its green backside. Slash the green section to harm it. This is the sub-boss for the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Capturing all 10 Big Poes on horseback in Hyrule Field and bringing them to the Poe salesman in ruined Market yields an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Big Poe...Description: A larger and rarer Poe. They appear in Hyrule Field and attempt to chase away from you. You can't catch them unless you have Epona and the Fairy Bow with you. There are 10 in all, and if you capture them all in bottles and give them to the Poe salesman in the destroyed Hyrule Town, you'll get an Empty Bottle.

facts.subject: Big Skulltula
facts.text: Big Skulltula hangs from webs and is vulnerable to strikes on its soft belly when it turns to expose it.

evidence.quote: Big Skulltula...Description: These hang from webs and come down to strike when you're near. ... Their weak spot is their belly: when they show it, strike there to kill them.

facts.subject: Red Rupee
facts.text: A small chest on a low pillar in the spike trap room contains a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open the small chest for a Red Rupee, then pick up a bomb.

facts.subject: Bomb Bag
facts.text: A large treasure chest on the north side of the spike trap room contains the Bomb Bag.

evidence.quote: Jump across, then open the large treasure chest to finally get a BOMB BAG for some BOMBS.

facts.subject: Giant Dodongo Head
facts.text: Dropping bombs into the gaps on the bridge so they explode inside both eyes of the giant Dodongo head opens its mouth.

evidence.quote: Head to the bridge, and drop bombs right at the gaps. If you do it well, the bombs will blow up inside the giant Dodongo head's eyes. Do it on both eyes to open the mouth of the large head.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: A small chest behind a weak wall across the bridge contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Across the bridge is a weak wall with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee behind it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula guarded by an Armos is located behind a bombable weak wall in the corridor beyond the Dodongo head.

evidence.quote: Kill the Armos guarding the Gold Skulltula before getting the Skulltula in this room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 021 out of 100)

facts.subject: Bombs
facts.text: A small chest in the room leading to the boss hole contains Bombs.

evidence.quote: Go through, open the small chest for some Bombs if you need them, and blast open the middle of the floor to reveal a hole.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: Throwing a bomb down King Dodongo's gullet while he inhales will stun him, leaving his head vulnerable to sword slashes.

evidence.quote: Basically avoid this boss until he starts to inhale. When he does, whip out a Bomb and throw it straight down his gullet. This'll stun him, so run up and slash his head with your sword.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: King Dodongo's rolling attack can be avoided by standing on the very edge of the platform next to the lava.

evidence.quote: He can be easily avoided here by standing on the very edge of the platform where it meets the lava.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: King Dodongo can be defeated faster by performing jump strikes with Deku Sticks and repeated shield stabs once he is stunned.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: Just jump strike with Deku Sticks and shield stab (hold R and press B repeatedly while not locked on) after he's stunned to defeat him more quickly.

facts.subject: Heart Container
facts.text: Defeating King Dodongo cools the lava and spawns a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: After defeating him, the lava will cool, a light will appear, and a Heart Container will appear. Grab the Heart Container, (6 hearts now!) and exit using the light.

facts.subject: Goron's Ruby
facts.text: Exiting Dodongo's Cavern causes Darunia to reward Link with the Goron's Ruby and make him a Sworn Brother of the Gorons.

evidence.quote: You'll appear outside Dodongo's Cavern, where Darunia will greet you, give you the Goron's Ruby, and make you a Sworn Brother of the Gorons.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Bombing a discolored section of wall on the left side of the path to Kakariko Village at night reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head down the path that leads to Kakariko Village, and watch for a discolored section of wall on the left side. When you see it, (make sure it's night, remember you can use the Sun's Song to change from day to night and vice versa) bomb it and you'll see a Gold Skulltula there. Kill it, then climb the normal wall to grab the token. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 022 out of 100)

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: A small chest behind a bombable discolored section of wall along the path contains a Purple Rupee worth 50 normal rupees.

evidence.quote: (While getting there, there's another discolored section of wall you can bomb. A small chest containing a Purple Rupee worth 50 normal ones is behind it.)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden inside a crate at the end of the boulder maze on the top level of Goron City.

evidence.quote: At the top level, you can head to a room full of rocks. Use bombs on the brown rocks to break them and try to get through this maze. At the end you should find a Gold Skulltula inside a crate, plus two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 023 out of 100)

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: Two small chests at the end of the boulder maze on the top level of Goron City each contain a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: At the end you should find a Gold Skulltula inside a crate, plus two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each.

facts.subject: Big Bomb Bag
facts.text: Stopping the rolling Goron on the third floor with a bomb rewards Link with the Big Bomb Bag, which holds 30 Bombs.

evidence.quote: Talk to him and he'll give you a BIG BOMB BAG for your effort. This holds 30 Bombs, and trust me, Bombs are important in this game, and you need a lot of them.

facts.subject: Cow
facts.text: A Secret Cave revealed by blowing up boulders on the way to the summit contains a cow that can fill an Empty Bottle with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: The last one reveals a Secret Cave. Drop inside to get some Rupees, Recovery Hearts, and a cow. (What is that doing there?) You can use the cow to fill an Empty Bottle with Lon Lon Milk if you wish.

facts.subject: Great Fairy of Power
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the summit's Great Fairy Fountain summons the Great Fairy of Power, granting a magic meter and the Spin Attack.

evidence.quote: Stand on the Triforce emblem and play Zelda's Lullaby to summon the Great Fairy of Power. She'll teach you a new move that requires magic power. You now have a magic meter. The technique is a powered spinning slash. Hold B until your sword glows yellow, then release to spin around and unleash a magic wave over a long distance.

facts.subject: Bombs
facts.text: Destroying the boulder surrounded by a circle of rocks inside the Crater reveals a Secret Cave containing a small chest with Bombs.

evidence.quote: Anyway, once you enter, find the boulder surrounded by a circle of rocks. Destroy the boulder to reveal a Secret Cave. Drop inside for a small chest with Bombs inside.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Climbing down the wall along the north edge inside Death Mountain Crater leads to an alcove with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Now, head to the north edge, and walk slowly off it. Link should grab the wall, and it turns out to be a climbable wall. There's another Piece of Heart in an alcove here. Collect it to complete another heart! (HEART PIECES: 08 out of 36)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Destroying a crate near the entrance inside Death Mountain Crater reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Before you exit, destroy the crate near the exit to reveal a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 024 out of 100)

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Landing on the chicken pen from the roof where the owl drops Link off allows access to a cage containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Fall off the east side of the house and make it so that you land on top of the chicken pen. Enter the door here and you'll be inside a cage with a Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 09 out of 36)

facts.subject: Stone of Agony
facts.text: Talking to the person in the lower left of the Skulltula House rewards Link with the Stone of Agony.

evidence.quote: Talk to the other guy (lower left person) and he'll reward you with the STONE OF AGONY, an item that activates the Rumble Pak whenever you are near secrets.

facts.subject: Huge Rupee
facts.text: Defeating the two Redeads in the Secret Cave between the village tree and the well stairs spawns a chest with a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Inside are two Redeads. Kill them easily by playing the Sun's Song first, and after they're gone, a chest will appear containing a Huge Rupee, worth a whopping 200 Rupees.

facts.subject: Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Bombing the wall inside the chamber where the Hylian Shield was found opens a path to a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Head to the Graveyard and go back into the chamber that contained the Hylian Shield. Bomb the wall, and follow the hall to reveal a Fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Blasting the boulder near the Goron City warp entrance in the Lost Woods reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Blast the boulder here to reveal a Secret Cave. Inside is a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Deku Nut Upgrade
facts.text: A Business Scrub in a Secret Cave under a boulder in the Lost Woods sells a Deku Nut Upgrade allowing Link to carry 30 Deku Nuts for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Blast it and head down this cave to see a Business Deku Scrub that'll sell you a DEKU NUT UPGRADE for 40 Rupees. Take it if you have the money. (I'm sure you do; we haven't been spending money lately.) The other Business Scrub just sells you Deku Seeds at a very expensive price. This upgrade lets you carry 30 Deku Nuts.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Blasting a boulder near three trees to the left of the drawbridge reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Head to the drawbridge, then head left from it. You'll see three trees and a boulder. Blast the boulder and head down the Secret Cave. There's a small chest with a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Crossing the river to the left in Hyrule Field and blowing up the boulder reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Keep heading left in the Field until you get to a river with some trees. Cross the river and blow up the boulder (careful of the Peahat) and drop in to find another Fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: A Business Scrub in a Secret Cave inside the fenced box formation in southern Hyrule Field sells a Piece of Heart for 10 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Inside is a Business Scrub who'll sell you a Piece of Heart for a very cheap 10 Rupees. You'd be a fool to turn down this deal! (HEART PIECES: 10 out of 36)

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: A Secret Cave near the fenced area contains a small chest with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's another Secret Cave right by here with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Red Rupee
facts.text: Blasting a boulder near a mini-forest in Hyrule Field opens a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Finally, you should be near a mini-forest. Find the boulder here and blast it open for a Secret Cave. (Lots of them in Hyrule Field, as you can see.) Inside is a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

facts.subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
