facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: A small chest located through an opening in the west hall contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Look left and you'll see a smaller opening in the west 
hall. Head inside and open the small chest for another SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: A small chest inside the right cell contains Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Head into the right cell, kill the Skulltula, and open 
the small chest for some DEKU NUTS.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: A treasure chest hidden behind a fake wall to the east contains another Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Head east through the fake wall, turn 
right, and use the Lens of Truth to see another fake wall with a treasure chest 
inside. Open it to get another SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found across a hidden path beyond the unlocked east door in Bottom of the Well.

evidence.quote:
unlock the east door. Kill the bats, use the 
Lens of Truth to uncover a hidden path. Use it to cross the hole, and kill the 
Gold Skulltula at the end. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 061 out of 100)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind the unlocked west door in a room with a Deku Baba and possessed pots.

evidence.quote:
unlock the west door this time. Another Gold Skulltula is here. 
Kill the Deku Baba first, and be careful of the pots. They're possessed and 
will fly towards you. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 062 out of 100)

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: The small chest on the other side of the room with hidden pits contains a Blue Rupee or a replacement Deku Shield.

evidence.quote:
There's
large hidden holes in this room, which is why you need the Lens on. The small
chest at the other side contains a Blue Rupee. (It has a Deku Shield if you
lost yours.)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A room guarded by a Like Like contains a chest with a Blue Rupee and a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Like 
Like quickly before it swallows you. If it does, it may likely take your 
Hylian Shield. If it does, quickly kill it so you can get it back. Open the 
chest for another Blue Rupee, and kill the last Gold Skulltula in this area. 
(GOLD SKULLTULAS: 063 out of 100)

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: Bombing a brown pile of dirt on the left at the end of the west hall uncovers a small chest containing Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Now, head through the west hall, and look 
left at the end. Use the Lens of Truth so you won't fall down the hole, and 
bomb the brown pile of dirt to uncover the last small chest. Open it to get 
some DEKU NUTS.

facts.subject: Song of Time
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time while standing on the edge of the lava room as Young Link removes the block in front.

evidence.quote:
You'll find a lava room. Stand on the edge and play the Song of 
Time to get rid of the block in front of you. Now exit the city. That was 
short, eh? Well, it had to be done while you are Young Link so....

facts.subject: frogs
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the end of the log for the frogs rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Once 
you are on the log's end and have the Ocarina out, play the Song of Storms.  
They will be so pleased with the song that they will give you a Piece of Heart 
for your trouble. Wow! (HEART PIECES: 27 out of 36)

facts.subject: frogs minigame
facts.text: Playing the fixed note sequence A, left C, right C, down C, left C, right C, down C, A, down C, A, down C, right C, left C, A quickly for the frogs awards another Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
A, left C, right C, down C, left C, right C, down C, A, down C, A, down C,
right C, left C, A

Follow these very quickly and the frogs will be so pleased that they're full, 
so they give you yet another Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 28 out of 36)

facts.subject: Secret Cave
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the rock with the Zora near the entrance opens a Secret Cave with a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote:
You see the Zora on 
the rock near the entrance? Stand on the rock he's on and play the Song of 
Storms to open a Secret Cave. Here's a Fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Treasure Box Game Shop
facts.text: Paying 10 Rupees to play the Treasure Box Game at night and using the Lens of Truth to pick the chests with keys awards a Piece of Heart at the end.

evidence.quote:
This is the Treasure Box Game 
Shop. Pay 10 Rupees to play, and head through the door. Now, your job is to 
find the small key that's in one of the two chests and use the key to continue. 
To make this easy, and possible, use the Lens of Truth to find the key. You 
aren't penalized for using it. Do this until you reach the end. Open the 
chest for a Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 29 out of 36)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found along one of the sides of the ruined outer gate of Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Head to the ruined outer gate, and look around one of the sides 
of it to find a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 064 out of 100)

facts.subject: Broken Goron's Sword
facts.text: Giving the Poacher's Saw to the man across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley yields the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Give the Poacher's Saw that you should have and he'll 
give you a BROKEN GORON'S SWORD, which as you can tell is absolutely useless as 
of now.

facts.subject: Secret Cave
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms behind the man's tent opens a Secret Cave with two Business Scrubs selling potions.

evidence.quote:
Before leaving, play the Song of Storms behind the guy's tent to open 
a Secret Cave. Remember what the Secret Cave at the beginning of Zora's River 
had? Well, this is exactly the same. (Two Business Scrubs selling potions at 
an equal price.)

facts.subject: Poe shop
facts.text: Selling 10 Big Poe souls to the buyer in the former guardshack awards 100 points per soul and grants an Empty Bottle upon reaching 1000 points.

evidence.quote:
This creepy 
guy inside buys Poe souls. He gives you a card (which isn't an item, oddly)
and for every Big Poe soul you sell him, he'll give you 100 points on your
card. When you get 1000 points, (and there are 10 Big Poes..how lucky) he
gives you an Empty Bottle as a prize.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poes must be defeated with the Fairy Bow while riding Epona, and their souls collected in Empty Bottles on foot.

evidence.quote:
For all Big Poes, you must be on Epona, and thus 
you have to use the Fairy Bow to kill them. To collect the Big Poe soul, get 
off Epona and walk toward the soul. The game will ask you if you want to keep 
it in one of your Empty Bottles.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poe #1 appears directly ahead after riding forward a bit on Epona.

evidence.quote:
#1: Get on Epona, and go forward a bit. A Big Poe should appear in front of
 you.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poes #2 and #3 hide where the two upper paths join on the Y-shaped path near the stone walls.

evidence.quote:
#2 and #3: See the Y-shaped path on the mini-map? There are two Big Poes
 hiding at the point where the two upper paths join. If you can't find the
 second one, try looking around the nearby stone walls.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poe #4 is found in the middle of the trees within the mini-forest.

evidence.quote:
#4: Head to the mini-forest here, and you'll encounter this one in the middle
 of the trees.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poe #5 appears right after the bottom leg of the Y-shaped path ends when running through the nearby grass.

evidence.quote:
#5: There's another right after the bottom leg of the Y-shaped path ends. If
 it doesn't appear, run through the patch of grass nearby, and it should appear
 then.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poes #6 and #7 hide along the path leading to Gerudo Valley, with one at the fork and the other by the tree at the path's end.

evidence.quote:
#6 and #7: There are two Big Poes hiding at the path leading to Gerudo Valley.
 They're basically one right after the other. One's at the fork, and the other
 is by the tree at the end of the path.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poe #8 rests on the west side of the river within a grove of trees surrounded by water.

evidence.quote:
#8: Up ahead is a grove of trees surrounded by a river. On the west side of
 the river is where this Big Poe rests.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poe #9 hides right by a tree located on the north side of Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote:
#9: On the north side of Lon Lon Ranch is a tree. This Big Poe is hiding right
by it.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Big Poe #10 appears near a lone tree by the river near Kakariko and can be caught by hugging the wall toward the water and passing to the right of the stone pillar.

evidence.quote:
#10: This is the final one that I list for a good reason. It's the hardest to
catch. After going over the tiny bridge leading to Kakariko, head toward the
lone tree on the right, close to the river. This Big Poe should appear..."I found the easiest way to catch the last Big Poe near the entrance to 
Kakariko was to hug the wall with Epona (the wall where the entrance to 
Kakariko is), and then head south toward the water (If the poe appears, just 
wait a few seconds after it disappears). Then turn around once you hit the 
water (back up a bit if need be). You should be facing the little stone pillar 
holding up the cliff. Pass to the RIGHT of it (not to the left, under the 
cliff), and the poe should appear, heading straight toward the tree that you 
bomb as a kid to get a Skulltula. This is probably the most time you'll have to 
shoot at the poe."

facts.subject: Archery Game
facts.text: Paying 20 Rupees to play and win the Archery Game in Kakariko Village awards the Big Quiver.

evidence.quote: Enter, and pay 20 Rupees to play...Win it to get the BIG QUIVER.

facts.subject: rolling Goron
facts.text: Stopping the small rolling Goron with a bomb in Goron City rewards Link with the Goron Tunic for free.

evidence.quote: Once you find him, plant a bomb so that it'll explode as he's running over it...After you do that, he gives you the GORON TUNIC, a special heat-resistant tunic that'll protect Link against extreme heat. You got this free, as opposed to the highly expensive one in the Goron City Shop.

facts.subject: Sheik
facts.text: Sheik teaches the Bolero of Fire across the fallen bridge in Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: You should encounter Sheik. He'll now teach you the BOLERO OF FIRE, a warp to here.

facts.subject: soft dirt patch
facts.text: Dropping a Bottle of Bugs onto the soft dirt patch in Death Mountain Crater releases a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: First, drop a Bottle of Bugs onto the soft dirt patch here to release a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 065 out of 100)

facts.subject: rock
facts.text: Riding the Magic Plant from the soft dirt patch in Death Mountain Crater leads to a rock with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Return here as Adult Link (using the warp) and ride the Magic Plant to a rock with a Piece of Heart on it. (HEART PIECES: 30 out of 36)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Stepping on the switch on the pillars to the left in Darunia's room releases a Goron and reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Jump on the pillars to your left, and step on the switch to release a Goron. Talk to him and he'll leave. Open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: room behind blue block
facts.text: Defeating the Like Like from a distance past the flying floor tiles reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Now, get rid of the Like Like from a distance. (It'll take your shield and Goron Tunic if you don't!) Once it's gone, get the Gold Skulltula and return to the large room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 066 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Stepping on the switch inside the bombed wall room releases a Goron and allows opening the chest behind him for a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Inside, step on the switch to release the Goron. Grab the SMALL KEY from the chest behind him once he leaves, then return once again to the large room.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Moving the blue block with the Song of Time leads to a room where stepping on the switch releases a Goron and yields a Small Key in the chest behind him.

evidence.quote: Return to where the blue block is, move it again with the Song of Time, and head through the door. Step on the switch to release this Goron, and grab the SMALL KEY from the chest behind him.

facts.subject: enclosed area wall
facts.text: Bombing the wall in an enclosed area on the left side of the boulder maze room reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In this next room, look around on the left side of this room and you'll find an enclosed area. Bomb the wall to find a Gold Skulltula. You should hear it. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 067 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Entering an enclosed door along the perimeter of the boulder maze room allows Link to free a Goron and take a Small Key from the chest behind him.

evidence.quote: Go a little more around the perimeter (being careful of the boulders) to see another enclosed area with a door this time. Head into the door, and free the Goron. Get the SMALL KEY behind him as usual.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Freeing the Goron in the cell on the opposite side of the boulder maze room reveals a Small Key in the chest behind him.

evidence.quote: Now, head to the complete opposite side of this room. You'll see another Goron cell. Free him and grab the SMALL KEY behind him.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Shooting the silver eye switch with the Bow unlocks a room containing a large chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Grab the Recovery Hearts if you need them, and shoot the silver eye switch with your Bow. Head through the door that was opened, and open the large chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Pierre
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song at the upper part of the boulder maze room summons Pierre the Scarecrow.

evidence.quote: First, turn right and play your Scarecrow's Song, and Pierre should appear. Hookshot up to him, then Hookshot again to the platform.

facts.subject: grate
facts.text: Climbing up the grate past Pierre's platform leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Go around, climb up the grate, kill the Gold Skulltula, (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 068 out of 100), climb up another grate, and head through the door.

facts.subject: abyss wall
facts.text: Hookshotting the wall facing the abyss on the fifth floor collects a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Welcome to the fifth floor. Do me a favor and don't fall. If you look at the wall facing the "abyss", you'll see a Gold Skulltula. Find a good position and Hookshot it. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 069 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Stepping on the fifth-floor switch lowers fire around a chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: Now, step on the switch, and it'll lower some fire around a chest for a limited time...Now quickly roll to the top and open the chest for a HUGE RUPEE.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Bombing the floor in the upper maze room and dropping down allows freeing a Goron to collect a Small Key from the chest.

evidence.quote: Jump across, eliminate the Torch Slug, and bomb the obvious-looking floor here. Drop down (though I prefer to climb down), head to the end, and free the Goron we saw before. Talk to him to make him leave, and grab the SMALL KEY from the chest.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Jumping to the corner ledge switch opens another Goron cell containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: This switch will open another Goron cell. Head to where the game points you to, talk to the Goron, and grab the SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Entering the door on the right of the fire maze room leads to a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: First, head right, stay towards the right, and enter the door you see there. (This is a maze of fire, so be careful.) Inside the door, open the large chest for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: fake door
facts.text: Bombing the fake door in the fire maze room destroys it and reveals the real door behind it.

evidence.quote: Get some stuff from the pots if you need it, and bomb the door. Yes, I said bomb it. It's a fake one that'll smash down on you if you try to open it. Head through the REAL door behind it and you'll encounter...

facts.subject: Flare Dancer
facts.text: Using the Hookshot pulls the Flare Dancer out of its flaming clothes so it can be damaged with sword slashes or an Advanced Spin Slash.

evidence.quote: In order to be able to hit this dude, you have to Hookshot him right out of its flaming clothes. Once it's out, start punishing it with sword slashes. It'll try to run away from you, but don't chase it. Just charge up your Advanced Spin Slash and release when it gets near you.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Stepping on the smaller switch lowers the fire surrounding the large chest containing the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: Pick off the Fire Keese, and step on the switch. Fire surrounding a chest will lower. Quickly get there using the stairs. (the stairs are more dangerous, but it saves time) Open the large chest for the... finally...MEGATON HAMMER, the ancient hammer used to silence Volvagia from so long ago.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Moving the blue block with the Song of Time and pounding the rusted switch frees a Goron and reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Face the blue block and play the Song of Time to move it. Jump across to the other side and pound the rusted switch to free the Goron below. Drop down, talk to him, and open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: locked door room
facts.text: Shielding against the flying floor tiles and defeating the Like Like from a distance reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In here, shield against the flying floor tiles, and kill the Like Like from a distance. Get the Gold Skulltula here, then continue to the next room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 070 out of 100)

facts.subject: small chest
facts.text: Defeating the second Flare Dancer reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote: You'll encounter another Flare Dancer. Defeat it the same way as before, and open the small chest for some BOMBS.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Pounding the rusty switch releases a Goron and opens a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Head into the next room, pound the rusty switch to release the Goron, and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Pounding Volvagia's head with the Hammer when she reveals herself stuns her so she can be repeatedly struck before retreating.

evidence.quote: Stay away from her(?) hair attack, and go up to her and pound her head down with the Hammer. Keep hitting her with the hammer until she retreats.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Dropping down to grab onto the sides of the platform when Volvagia starts flying causes her to immediately return underground.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: When she starts flying around, drop down the sides slowly and you'll grab onto the sides as if its a grate or vine, or something. Doing this will make her lose her interest in attacking you and will go back underground

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Volvagia drops a Heart Container upon defeat once her head disintegrates.

evidence.quote: Wait until Volvagia's head disintegrates so you can pick up the HEART CONTAINER then exit using the light.

facts.subject: Darunia
facts.text: Darunia reveals himself as the Sage of Fire in the Chamber of Sages and awards Link the Fire Medallion.

evidence.quote: Darunia will show up in the Chamber of Sages with you and reveal to you that he's the Sage of Fire. In exchange for helping the Gorons, he'll give you the FIRE MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Great Fairy Fountain
facts.text: A Great Fairy Fountain is located behind boulders near the Goron City entrance outside the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote: You see the boulders here? A couple of them block the way to a Great Fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Great Fairy
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem inside the Great Fairy Fountain doubles Link's magic power.

evidence.quote: Play the Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem and she'll appear to give you a magic bar enhancement. You now have twice the magic power!

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Smashing the red boulder near the Bomb Flower on Death Mountain Trail at night reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head to where the Bomb Flower was (the one you used in the Past to open Dodongo's Cavern) and you'll see a red boulder. Smash it with the hammer to reveal a Gold Skulltula....Remember that these two Gold Skulltulas don't appear unless it's night.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Smashing the boulder against the wall on Death Mountain Trail where falling rocks were in the past reveals a Gold Skulltula at night.

evidence.quote: at the place where the rocks fell down on you in the Past, smash the boulder that's against the wall to reveal another Gold Skulltula....Remember that these two Gold Skulltulas don't appear unless it's night.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: The giant Goron at the summit of Death Mountain gives Link a Prescription for eye treatment in exchange for the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote: In exchange for the Broken Goron's Sword, (he'll fix it) he'll give you a PRESCRIPTION for eye treatment. Only then will he fix the sword.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located overhead above the fourth Silver Rupee in the first rupee room of the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Right where the fourth Silver Rupee is, look up and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: pot
facts.text: Melt the red ice surrounding the pot using Blue Fire to obtain a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: melt the red ice surrounding the pot with Blue Fire. Inside the pot is a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Melt the large block of red ice near the Blue Fire to reach a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Melt the larger block of red ice and open the large chest inside for the DUNGEON MAP of this Cavern.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Opening the chest behind the red ice to the right reveals the Compass.

evidence.quote: Melt the red ice to the right, and open the chest for this Cavern's COMPASS

facts.subject: red ice
facts.text: Melting the red ice to the left reveals a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: melt the red ice to the left for a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located above the alcove where the Piece of Heart was found in Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Look above where you got the Piece to see a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: White Wolfos
facts.text: Defeating the White Wolfos in the shrine spawns a large chest containing the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: You'll encounter a White Wolfos....Once he's dead, a large chest will appear. Open it to get the IRON BOOTS.

facts.subject: Sheik
facts.text: Sheik appears after obtaining the Iron Boots and teaches Link the Serenade of Water.

evidence.quote: Sheik will appear and teach you the SERENADE OF WATER.

facts.subject: King Zora
facts.text: Thawing King Zora with Blue Fire rewards Link with the Zora Tunic, allowing him to breathe underwater.

evidence.quote: thaw out the Zora King with the Blue Fire....He'll thank you for reviving him, and will give you the ZORA TUNIC. This allows you to breathe underwater.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain
facts.text: Sink to the bottom of Zora's Fountain with the Iron Boots to collect a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Go back to the Fountain and use the Iron Boots to sink to the bottom. Find the Piece of Heart here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall to the left of the Diving Game platform in Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: Head to where the Diving Game was held, look out and to the left, and you'll see a Gold Skulltula on the wall.

facts.subject: Eyeball Frog
facts.text: The Eyeball Frog received from King Zora spoils in three minutes.

evidence.quote: Give the Prescription to the Zora King, and he'll give you a fresh EYEBALL FROG. It'll spoil in three minutes.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: After delivering the World's Greatest Eye Drops to Biggoron and waiting three days with the Claim Check, he presents the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: If you reach the place in time, the Biggoron will give you the CLAIM CHECK. After waiting three days, show him the Claim Check and he'll give you the BIGGORON'S SWORD.

facts.subject: Biggoron's Sword
facts.text: The Biggoron's Sword is carried with two hands, preventing Link from using a shield while wielding it.

evidence.quote: this is so heavy that Link has to carry it with both hands, so you can't shield with it.

facts.subject: Secret Cave
facts.text: Bombing the lone tree surrounded by a river opens a Secret Cave with a Piece of Heart at the bottom of the water.

evidence.quote: Go over to the area where trees are surrounded by a river. Plant a bomb at the lone tree to open a Secret Cave. Head inside, and put on the Iron Boots to sink to the bottom. You'll find a Piece of Heart!

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Rolling into the crate at the bottom of the pool inside the Lakeside Laboratory reveals a Gold Skulltula that must be retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: sink to the bottom of the pool with the Iron Boots. Roll into the crate to reveal a Gold Skulltula. You can't use a sword underwater, so Hookshot it.

facts.subject: Advanced Spin Slash
facts.text: The Advanced Spin Slash is performed by holding B until the sword glows yellow and then releasing it.

evidence.quote: Advanced Spin Slash (Hold B until the sword is yellow, then release)

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Hitting the crystal switch near the water jet with an arrow lowers the jet and allows access to the chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: stand near the water jet, and hit the crystal with an Arrow. Open the large chest while the jet is down to get the COMPASS for this temple.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Defeating all the Spikes in the room above Princess Ruto reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Defeat all the Spikes here to reveal a large chest. Open it for the DUNGEON MAP!

facts.subject: torches
facts.text: Standing behind the lit torch and shooting arrows through the flame lights the unlit torches and unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: stand behind the lit torch, and fire arrows through the fire to the unlit torches. Doing this will make the arrowheads catch on fire and light the torches. Once they're lit, head through the door.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Defeating the Shell Blades with the Hookshot when they open spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Kill the Shell Blades by Hookshotting them when they open, and a chest will appear. Open it to get a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Hookshotting past the Shell Blades leads to a chest at the surface containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Go past the Shell Blades carefully, and open the chest at the surface of the water for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Activating the crystal switch with the Advanced Spin Slash in the south hall room opens the gate guarding a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: use the Advanced Spin Slash to hit the crystal switch, opening the gate. There's a Gold Skulltula here.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Bombing the cracked wall on the east hall's bottom floor leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: rise to the surface to see a cracked wall. Bomb it, then open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Hookshotting the crystal in the central tower and defeating the underwater enemies unlocks a gate leading to a Small Key chest.

evidence.quote: Hookshot the crystal to release a horde of enemies, all which have to be killed with the Hookshot....Once all of them are gone, head to the surface of the water where the gate opened. Open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: water level puzzle
facts.text: To cross the upper room, hit the crystal to raise the water, Hookshot across, hit the crystal to lower water, Hookshot, climb the statue, and cycle the crystal again.

evidence.quote: hit the crystal to raise the water. Hookshot across, then hit the crystal again to lower the water. Hookshot across, climb over the statue, and hit the crystal again. Hookshot across, hit the crystal, get on the statue, and hit the crystal again to get to the upper part of the room.

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: Din's Fire is effective against Dark Link.

evidence.quote: Of course, you COULD use Din's Fire...

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: Dark Link's health equals Link's total health, and each Master Sword blow depletes one full heart of his life.

evidence.quote: Dark Link has as much health as you do, and each Master Sword hit takes off a heart of Dark Link's health.

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: Equipping the Iron Boots during the fight slows down Dark Link's movements.

evidence.quote: you can slow down Shadow Link's movements if you equip the Iron Boots.

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: L- or Z-targeting Dark Link and executing a thrust attack with the Biggoron's Sword will hit him consistently.

evidence.quote: if you L(or Z)-target Dark Link and use the thrust attack with the Biggoron's Sword, it'll hit him every time.

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: The Megaton Hammer can damage Dark Link effectively without requiring sword lockups.

evidence.quote: If you don't have the Biggoron's Sword and don't want to get the Giant's Knife, the Megaton Hammer works just as well on Shadow Link.

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: A Deku Nut will stun Dark Link only once, after which he will dodge subsequent Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote: If you have Deku Nuts, use one to stun Dark Link, then go in for a slash. I've tried this, and it only works once, as afterwards he'll dodge your Deku Nuts to avoid getting stunned.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Right where the fourth Silver Rupee is, look up and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Right where the fourth Silver Rupee is, look up and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: In order to defeat Dark Link, don't Z/L target him; if you target him you'll always endlessly clash swords, but don't target him and he'll have a harder time blocking your attacks.

evidence.quote: MINI-BOSS: Dark Link...in order to defeat him, DON'T Z/L TARGET HIM! If you do target him, you'll always endlessly clash swords...don't target him and he'll actually have a harder time blocking your attacks.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Opening the large chest reveals the Longshot, an upgraded Hookshot that reaches twice as far.

evidence.quote:
open the large chest for the LONGSHOT. It's
an upgraded Hookshot, and reaches twice as far.

facts.subject: blue block
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time removes the blue block behind the chest.

evidence.quote:
Behind the chest is a blue
block. Remove it by playing the Song of Time, and fall through.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found near the third whirlpool in the underground river.

evidence.quote:
Near the third whirlpool is a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS:
079 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Shooting the gold eye switch with an arrow opens a temporary gate to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
hit the gold eye
switch with an arrow to open the nearby gate temporarily. Take off the Iron
Boots and get to where the gate opened. Open the chest for a SMALL KEY

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the ceiling past the west door.

evidence.quote:
Longshot 
to the symbol, and look up at the ceiling to see a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD 
SKULLTULAS: 080 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Pushing the block until hearing a chime and turning right leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
push the block until you hear a chime, then turn right. 
Open the chest for a SMALL KEY

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found at the top of the tower.

evidence.quote:
Longshot to the top and look around to see a Gold Skulltula. Longshot
it. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 081 out of 100)

facts.subject: underwater switch
facts.text: Pushing the block until it drops onto the underwater switch raises the water level.

evidence.quote:
push the block the rest of the
way until it drops down to the underwater switch. This'll raise the water.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found in the water after a boulder passes by.

evidence.quote:
Wait until a boulder passes by,
then equip the Iron Boots and go to the water. Get a Gold Skulltula around
here, (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 082 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Killing the Shell Blade and floating to the top reveals a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the
Shell Blade, then float to the top. Open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: Morpha inflicts three hearts of damage if it grabs Link, and its brain can be snatched away with the Longshot to slash it.

evidence.quote:
if it grabs you, you'll
suffer three hearts of damage. To damage the boss, dodge its attack and its
brain will move around its body. Longshot the brain to snatch it away, and
start slashing it.

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: Using the Longshot between slashes prevents Morpha's brain from escaping.

evidence.quote:
To keep the brain from escaping while you're attacking it,
Longshot between slashes and you should take care of it more quickly.

facts.subject: Heart Container
facts.text: Morpha leaves behind a Heart Container after defeat.

evidence.quote:
After the battle, it'll disappear, so grab the HEART CONTAINER then leave
through the light.

facts.subject: Water Medallion
facts.text: Princess Ruto reveals she is the Sage of Water and gives Link the Water Medallion.

evidence.quote:
Back in the Chamber of Sages, Link meets up with Ruto. She
reveals that she's the Sage of Water. ... She'll give you the WATER MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At night, Longshooting to the tree branch on the island allows Link to get a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Right at the island you are on, make sure it's night, then Longshot to the tree
so you'll stand on its branch. Up here, Longshot the Gold Skulltula on the
tree. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 083 out of 100)

facts.subject: Fire Arrows
facts.text: Shooting an arrow at the rising morning sun from the island's stone quay yields the Fire Arrows.

evidence.quote:
stand on the stone quay on this
island, aim at the sky a little above the two pillars, and wait for morning to
come. As soon as you see the sun coming over the horizon, fire an arrow at
it. If you did it just right, a cinema will show something fall from the sun.
Go over to where it fell and you'll get FIRE ARROWS.

facts.subject: Sun's Song
facts.text: Playing the Sun's Song on the Fire Arrow platform spawns an unbottlable fairy that restores health and magic.

evidence.quote:
If you play the Sun's Song
on this platform where you get the Fire Arrows, a fairy will appear that 
restores health and magic power. You can't bottle the fairy though.

facts.subject: Nocturne of Shadow
facts.text: Sheik teaches Link the Nocturne of Shadow in burning Kakariko Village to enter the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Once you get there, you'll notice everything is 
on fire. Watch the cinema. After it's over, Sheik will teach you the NOCTURNE 
OF SHADOW, the only way to enter the Shadow Temple.

facts.subject: torches
facts.text: Using Din's Fire on the platform above the Graveyard lights all torches at once to open the Shadow Temple entrance.

evidence.quote:
Play the Nocturne of Shadow and you'll warp to a ledge above the graveyard,
unreachable by other means. Go through the entryway to see a room with a bunch
of torches and a platform. Get on the platform and use Din's Fire. This'll
light all the torches at once and will open the large door.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Defeating the Redead and two Keese reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
defeat the
Redead, and the two Keese. Doing this will reveal a large chest containing the
DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Defeating Dead Hand reveals a large chest containing the Hover Boots, which allow hovering over abysses.

evidence.quote:
Go through it and you'll find a Dead Hand, the
same thing you fought at the Bottom of the Well. Defeat it the same way and a
large chest will appear. Open it to get the HOVER BOOTS. These allow you to
hover over an abyss for a very limited time.

facts.subject: bird statue
facts.text: Pushing the bird statue to face the skull statue that does not disappear under the Lens of Truth opens the door ahead.

evidence.quote:
find the skull statue that doesn't disappear. Once you find that one, move the
bird statue by pushing the panel sticking out of it, until the bird is facing
the skull that doesn't disappear. This will open the door ahead.

facts.subject: large chest
facts.text: Defeating the Gibdos behind the fake wall reveals a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Gibdos to make another large chest
appear. Open it for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Collecting the Silver Rupees in the spinning scythe room opens a cell containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
avoid the large spinning scythe statue, and
collect the Silver Rupees in this room. ... This'll open a small cell with
a chest. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Killing all Keese and the Like Like opens a cell containing a Gold Skulltula and a chest with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
There's Keese and a Like Like. ... Once they're all dead, the
cell will open. Inside is a Gold Skulltula and a chest with a Blue Rupee.
(GOLD SKULLTULAS: 084 out of 100)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found in the south cell of the dropping spike platforms room.

evidence.quote: At the south cell is a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 085 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Stepping on the switch at the top portion of the spike room causes a chest to drop containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
step on the switch to make a chest
drop. Go over to it and open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind the skull in the skull room.

evidence.quote:
In here, head behind the skull to find a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 086
out of 100)

facts.subject: skull
facts.text: Dropping a Bomb or bomb flower into the skull on the upper level releases a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
drop
a Bomb or bomb flower into the skull. Doing this will release a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: invisible chest
facts.text: Bombing a cracked lump of dirt reveals an invisible chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
check the corners for a lump of dirt with a crack. Bomb it to reveal an
invisible chest. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing Scarecrow's Song and Longshooting to the scarecrow leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
face the ledge on the other side, then play Scarecrow's Song. Long-
shot to the scarecrow, and get the Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 087 out of
100)

facts.subject: boat
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem makes the boat move across the room.

evidence.quote:
jump to the boat, and play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem to
make the boat move.

facts.subject: spiked walls
facts.text: Casting Din's Fire burns away the closing wooden spiked walls.

evidence.quote:
You'll notice that spiked walls are closing in on you. AAHH! But wait, the
walls are made of wood...Equip Din's Fire and use it to burn away those walls.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Killing the Redead on the right allows Link to open a chest for the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Over
to the right is a different chest. Kill the Redead there, and open the chest
for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Bombing all the skulls on the stairs allows Link to get a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the stairs, and throw bomb flowers into the skulls. ... Once you bomb them all, get the Gold Skulltula here, and go 
back to the previous room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 088 out of 100)

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Killing the invisible Floormaster makes a chest appear containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the invisible Floormaster enemy to make a chest appear.
Open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: bomb flowers
facts.text: Shooting Fire Arrows at the bomb flowers across the gap collapses the structure to form a bridge.

evidence.quote:
Equip Fire Arrows, and
fire them at the bomb flowers across the gap. This'll weaken the structure by
them and will make it fall, creating a bridge.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Shooting Bongo Bongo's hands with arrows causes him to ram Link, allowing Link to see him with the Lens of Truth and stun his eye with an arrow.

evidence.quote:
First of
all, you have to arrow its hands. Do so, and the boss will try to ram you.
Use the Lens of Truth to see him, and put an arrow into his eye. This'll stun
him, so go up to him and slash him until he's dead.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: The Biggoron's Sword with the shield stab technique is effective against Bongo Bongo when he is stunned.

evidence.quote:
The Biggoron's Sword
works best....The Biggoron's Sword with the shield stab technique is your
best friend when he's stunned.

facts.subject: Heart Container
facts.text: Defeating Bongo Bongo causes a Heart Container to appear.

evidence.quote:
After beating this guy, a HEART CONTAINER will appear, and a light. Grab the
Heart, and go into the light.

facts.subject: Shadow Medallion
facts.text: Impa awakens as the Shadow Sage and awards Link the Shadow Medallion.

evidence.quote:
You'll see Impa as the Shadow Sage, and she'll
give you the SHADOW MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Gerudo Valley
facts.text: Breaking the rocks near the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley reveals a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Break all the rocks here to reveal a chest. Open it for a 
PURPLE RUPEE, if you need some money.

facts.subject: Gerudo's Fortress
facts.text: Above the cell in Gerudo's Fortress, Longshot to the treasure chest to obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
You're now above your cell. Smash the crate for a Purple Rupee, and look to
the left. Longshot to the treasure chest and open it for a Piece of Heart.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula can be seen at night on the cliff side above the southern drop in Gerudo's Fortress.

evidence.quote:
Get to the southern cliff wall, and drop down on
the south side. Look up at the cliff side to see a Gold Skulltula at night.

facts.subject: Gerudo Thief
facts.text: Defeating the Gerudo thief that guards the first carpenter drops a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Either way, once she's beaten, she'll drop a SMALL 
KEY. Use it to free the carpenter.

facts.subject: Gerudo Thief
facts.text: Defeating the Gerudo guard in the northern hallway drops a Small Key used to free the second carpenter.

evidence.quote:
Head into the northern hallway here and you'll find another carpenter locked
up. Talk to him and another guard will drop down. Defeat her in the same way
to get a SMALL KEY, and use it to free the carpenter.

facts.subject: Gerudo Guard
facts.text: After freeing all four carpenters, a Gerudo guard gives Link the Gerudo's Membership Card.

evidence.quote:
Free him, and you'll see a Gerudo guard 
watching you. She says that she's been watching you all this time, and she's 
impressed at your stealth skills, so she decides to make you an official member 
of the Gerudo by giving you a Membership Card.

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Hitting the eye switch above the entrance stairs in Gerudo Training Grounds spawns a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this
mini dungeon, climb up the stairs, turn around, and fire an arrow at the eye
switch for a chest containing a BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Stalfos Room
facts.text: Defeating two Stalfos in under a minute spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Inside, you 
have to fight two Stalfos in under a minute. Be quick. After defeating them, a 
chest with a SMALL KEY appears.

facts.subject: Silver Rupee Room
facts.text: The boulder challenge room in Gerudo Training Grounds requires collecting all Silver Rupees within 1 minute and 30 seconds.

evidence.quote: Your next challenge is to collect all the Silver Rupees in under 1:30 minutes.

facts.subject: Statue Room
facts.text: Hitting all of the statue's eyes with the Bow causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote:
In here, jump onto the platform below and hit all the statue's eyes with the 
Bow. Doing this will make a chest with a SMALL KEY appear.

facts.subject: Statue Perimeter Room
facts.text: Smashing statues with the Megaton Hammer uncovers a switch that lowers fire around a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Smash away all the statues with the Megaton Hammer to
find a gold eye switch and a ground switch. Step on the ground switch to lower
the fire in the center. Quickly get the SMALL KEY inside the chest the fire
was protecting, then hit the eye switch with an Arrow.

facts.subject: Underwater Silver Rupee Room
facts.text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees underwater in the pool reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Once you have
them, rise to the top, collect the SMALL KEY inside the chest, and head back to
the lava room.

facts.subject: Dinolfos and Beamos Room
facts.text: Defeating two Dinolfos and bombing the Beamos in the timed room rewards a Small Key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll fight two Dinalfos. Kill them quickly with the Biggoron's Sword,
and bomb the Beamos to clear this timed room.  Collect the SMALL KEY from the
chest.

facts.subject: Lava Room
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time at the ledge button creates blocks allowing Link to climb up and grab a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Get to the ledge with the button and play 
the Song of Time to make some blocks appear. Climb up them, grab the SMALL 
KEY, and head through the opening.

facts.subject: Treasure Room
facts.text: Opening the front chest in the central treasure room yields a Bombchu.

evidence.quote:
We're now in the room that contains the treasure we're looking for, but we
can't get to it yet. Open the chest in front of you for a BOMBCHU, and then
open the chest to the right (when you enter) for some Arrows.

facts.subject: Treasure Room
facts.text: Passing through two locked doors starting on the left leads to a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Go through two locked doors starting at the left, and open the 
chest for a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Treasure Room
facts.text: Continuing through the locked doors of the treasure room leads to a chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Continue through until you reach another chest with a 
RED RUPEE.

facts.subject: Treasure Room Ceiling
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth inside the first locked room reveals a ceiling hole containing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
OK, backtrack 
to the small room you enter when you go through the first locked door from this 
area's entrance, and use the Lens of Truth to find a hole in the ceiling.  
Climb up to it and collect the SMALL KEY in the chest.

facts.subject: Treasure Room
facts.text: Unlocking the final locked door in the central treasure room grants the Ice Arrows from the chest.

evidence.quote:
Head back to the last 
locked door and open the chest for the ICE ARROWS.

facts.subject: Like Like Room
facts.text: Pushing the huge block with the Silver Gauntlets and defeating all Like Likes spawns a chest with a Huge Rupee and another with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Using the Silver Gauntlets from the Spirit Temple, push this huge block until
it drops. Head through the door to encounter a room infested with Like Likes.
Kill them all with the Biggoron's Sword and two chests will appear. One has a
HUGE RUPEE and the other has a BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Like Like Room
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth in the Like Like room reveals a hidden final chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Ignore the chest on the ledge 
(it'll freeze you if you open it) and use the Lens of Truth to find the final 
chest in here, which contains this last key.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is located on the far left of the secluded Horseback Archery area.

evidence.quote: If it's still night, head to the far left of this area and you'll find a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 090 out of 100)

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Scoring 1000 points in Horseback Archery awards a Piece of Heart, with pots worth 100 points, target outer rims worth 30, inner rims worth 60, and center targets worth 100.

evidence.quote: The first goal here is to acquire 1000 points. Easy enough. The pots are worth 100 points, the outer rim of the targets are 30, inner rim is 60, and the very center is 100. Obviously you should hit the pots and the center of the targets. If you successfully get 1000 points, you'll get a Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 35 out of 36)

facts.subject: Horseback Archery
facts.text: Scoring 1500 points in the Horseback Archery minigame rewards the Biggest Quiver, allowing Link to carry 50 arrows.

evidence.quote: the Gerudo offers you another challenge: to get 1500 points....the Gerudo by giving you the BIGGEST QUIVER, which allows you to carry 50 Arrows.

facts.subject: River of Sand
facts.text: To cross the River of Sand in the Haunted Wasteland, hop onto the front crate and Longshot to a crate across the river.

evidence.quote: Simply hop onto the crate ahead and Longshot one of the other crates across the River to cross.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found inside the secret shrine along the flag route in the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote: Anyway, inside are two torches and a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 091 out of 100)

facts.subject: Secret shrine
facts.text: Lighting the two torches inside the Haunted Wasteland secret shrine with Fire Arrows makes a chest appear containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: After getting the spider, light the two torches with Fire Arrows to make a chest appear. Open it for a PURPLE RUPEE.

facts.subject: Poe guide
facts.text: Climbing to the top of the secret shrine and using the Lens of Truth reveals a Poe guide to follow through the desert to the Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote: Crawl back out and climb up to the top and put on the Lens of Truth to find the Poe guide the Gerudo was talking about. Follow this Poe, keeping the Lens of Truth on, until you finally reach a huge monument, called the Desert Colossus.

facts.subject: Great Fairy Fountain
facts.text: Bombing the cracked wall between two palm trees to the right of the Desert Colossus opens a Great Fairy Fountain where the Great Fairy grants Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote: Bomb the cracked wall between those trees and head inside to find another Great Fairy Fountain. You know what to do to summon her. This time she'll give you NAYRU'S LOVE, which protects you from any damage for a few minutes.

facts.subject: Empty grove
facts.text: Playing the Song of Storms on the flat rock at the empty grove south of the Desert Colossus fills the grove with water and creates a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: At this empty grove, play the Song of Storms on the flat rock to fill the grove, creating a Fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found on a palm tree at the oasis grove in Desert Colossus at night.

evidence.quote: At this same place, at night, a Gold Skulltula is on a nearby palm tree. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 092 out of 100)

facts.subject: Sheik
facts.text: Sheik appears outside the Spirit Temple at the Desert Colossus and teaches the Requiem of Spirit.

evidence.quote: Hey, good ole' Sheik appeared. He tells you a few things, then teaches you the REQUIEM OF SPIRIT.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Dropping a Bottle of Bugs into the soft dirt patch outside the Spirit Temple as Young Link uncovers a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Back here, as Young Link, drop a Bottle of Bugs onto the plot of dirt (no need to recapture any bugs) to make a Gold Skulltula pop out. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 093 out of 100)

facts.subject: Armos
facts.text: To defeat the Armos surrounded by a spike trap, plant a bomb near it and touch the Armos to awaken it before the bomb detonates.

evidence.quote: kill the Armos being surrounded by a spike trap. (Plant a bomb by it, then touch the Armos to wake it before the bomb explodes and it'll be gone.)

facts.subject: Crystal switch chest
facts.text: Hitting the crystal switch behind the gate with the Boomerang lowers the gate to reveal a chest containing a Blue Rupee or a replacement Deku Shield.

evidence.quote: Now, use the Boomerang to hit the crystal switch behind the gate. Hitting it will lower the gate, creating a bridge. Open the chest across the bridge for a BLUE RUPEE. (A Deku Shield if you lost your current one....it seems the chests with Blue Rupees contain something you lost.)

facts.subject: Anubis
facts.text: Anubis mimics Link's movements like a mirror and is defeated by hitting a crystal switch to raise fire and positioning across from the fire trap.

evidence.quote: In here you'll encounter a puzzle dealing with an annoying enemy, Anubis. This enemy always mimics your position like a mirror. Its only weakness is fire....If you hit the crystal switch to your right, you'll see some fire rise up. Well, that's where you need Anubis to go. Just move to the opposite platform of the fire and Anubis will move to act like your mirror.

facts.subject: Silver Rupees
facts.text: Collecting five Silver Rupees in the Wallmaster room opens the gate.

evidence.quote: Now, you have to collect five Silver Rupees to open the gate. Two are at the top and you must climb for them, two are at the foot of the gate, and one is behind the torch.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located past the lowered gate in the Wallmaster room.

evidence.quote: Cross the now lowered gate, and kill the Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 094 out of 100)

facts.subject: Torch puzzle chest
facts.text: Lighting the two unlit torches using a Deku Stick from the lit torch behind the gate causes a chest containing a Small Key to drop onto the carpet.

evidence.quote: Now, take a Deku Stick and light it with the lit torch behind the gate, and go to the two unlit ones and light them. This will make a chest fall onto the carpet. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found high on the wall behind Link after climbing the ridges in the enclosed room.

evidence.quote: You're now in an enclosed room with ridges to climb up. Kill the Skullwalltulas first before climbing it. At the top, turn around and kill the Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 095 out of 100)

facts.subject: Boomerang crystal switch chest
facts.text: Hitting the crystal switch with the Boomerang in the room with Lizalfos spawns a chest containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote: Alright, in this room, kill the Skullwalltulas and two Lizalfos, then hit the crystal switch with the Boomerang to make a chest appear. Open it for some BOMBCHUS.

facts.subject: Sun face
facts.text: Sending a Bombchu to detonate the rock with light peering through allows sunlight to illuminate the sun face on the floor and unlock the door.

evidence.quote: Plant a Bombchu and have it scurry over to the rock that has light peering out of it, and it'll blow it up. This'll make the light cover the sun face on the ground, thus activating it and opening the door.

facts.subject: Large treasure chest
facts.text: Casting Din's Fire while standing between the unlit torches on the platform makes a large chest containing the Dungeon Map appear.

evidence.quote: Stand on the platform between them, and use Din's Fire. A large treasure chest will appear in front of you, so open it to get the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Torch puzzle chest
facts.text: Collecting the Silver Rupees at the top of the spiral staircase lights a torch, which can be used with a Deku Stick to light the unlit torches and spawn a Small Key chest.

evidence.quote: Once they're all collected, a torch will light. Get a Deku Stick out and light it with that torch, then start lighting all the unlit torches quickly. Doing so will make a chest containing a SMALL KEY appear.

facts.subject: Sun face block
facts.text: Pushing the block with the sun face into the light unlocks the next door.

evidence.quote: move the block with a sun face on its top over to the light to open the next door.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located above the doorway when turning around after entering the room past the sun block.

evidence.quote: Turn right around and look up to find another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 096 out of 100)

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: Young Link can defeat the Iron Knuckle mini-boss by throwing bombs at him or by using Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote: I think it would be wise to use Nayru's Love right about now....though you can just throw bombs at him if you have enough.

facts.subject: Treasure chest outside
facts.text: Opening the treasure chest outside on the Colossus statue after defeating the Iron Knuckle grants the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Anyway, open the treasure chest next to you to get the SILVER GAUNTLETS.

facts.subject: Arch
facts.text: Riding the Magic Plant as Adult Link allows Link to collect the Piece of Heart resting on the stone arch.

evidence.quote: Before entering, ride the Magic Plant, as there's a Piece of Heart on the arch, and a Gold Skulltula on a big rock. (HEART PIECES: 36 out of 36)

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Riding the Magic Plant at night allows Adult Link to reach a Gold Skulltula on a large rock.

evidence.quote: ride the Magic Plant, as there's a Piece of Heart on the arch, and a Gold Skulltula on a big rock....Also, the game must be nighttime to make the Skulltula appear.

facts.subject: Triforce chest
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the left room spawns a large chest reachable with the Longshot that contains the Compass.

evidence.quote: Next, stand on the Triforce emblem, play Zelda's Lullaby, Longshot to the large chest that appears, and open it for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the blue block moves it to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time in front of the blue block to move it, revealing another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 098 out of 100)

facts.subject: Like Like room chest
facts.text: Defeating the falling Like Like reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: A Like Like falls down and attempts to swallow you. Kill it before it takes your stuff. After it's dead, open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Sun face structure
facts.text: Rotating the central mirror structure toward the sun faces reveals the exit door, drops chests containing a Recovery Heart or a freeze trap, and triggers a Wallmaster.

evidence.quote: move the central structure to each sun face. One of them opens the next door, make sure to find that. Two sun faces drop chests. One has a RECOVERY HEART and another freezes you when you open it. The other summons a Wallmaster.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song across from the staircase lets Link Longshot to Pierre and destroy a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: turn right and play your Scarecrow's Song. Longshot across, and kill the Gold Skulltula here. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 099 out of 100)

facts.subject: Statue hand chest
facts.text: Hovering to the colossus statue's hand and playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark summons a chest with a Small Key reachable with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: use the Hover Boots to get onto the statue's hand, and play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark. Longshot to the chest that appeared and open it for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth in the staircase reveals two chests that both contain a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: In this staircase, use the Lens of Truth to see two chests which both contain a RECOVERY HEART.

facts.subject: Colossus's left hand
facts.text: A chest on the Colossus's left hand contains the Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote: You're now on the Colossus's left hand. Open the chest for a MIRROR SHIELD, allowing you to reflect light and other stuff.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Reflecting light onto the sun face in the Armos room opens a door to a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Angle your shield so that the light will hit the sun face...This'll open the door here. Enter to find a chest with a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Stepping on the platform switch lowers the fire surrounding the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Step on it to lower the fire surrounding the chest. Open it for the BOSS KEY, then exit this room.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Using the Mirror Shield to burn away the sun face in the Lizalfos section causes a chest containing Bombs to appear.

evidence.quote: Head back to the Lizalfos section, and use the Mirror Shield to burn away the sun face. A chest will appear that contains BOMBS.

facts.subject: Armos switch puzzle
facts.text: To solve the pressure switch puzzle, shoot the Armos across from the switch with the Bow so it hops onto the switch.

evidence.quote: To solve this puzzle, head to the right door, aim your Bow towards the Armos across from the switch. Shoot it and it will hop towards you. When it's on the switch, enter the door quickly.

facts.subject: Twinrova, Sorceress Sisters
facts.text: In phase one of the Twinrova fight, reflect each sister's elemental beam with the Mirror Shield toward the opposite sister.

evidence.quote: In order to damage these witches, you must reflect their spells with the Mirror Shield and point it toward the other witch.

facts.subject: Twinrova, Sorceress Sisters
facts.text: In phase two, absorb three projectiles of the same element with the Mirror Shield to fire a beam that stuns Twinrova.

evidence.quote: You must absorb three projectiles OF THE SAME ELEMENT...Once you do, you'll fire a beam of that element, stunning her.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Defeating the boss of the Spirit Temple rewards a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: Watch the funny cutscene, then find the HEART CONTAINER.

facts.subject: Nabooru
facts.text: Nabooru reveals she is a Sage of the Spirit Temple and awards the Spirit Medallion.

evidence.quote: After revealing that Nabooru is indeed a Sage of the Spirit Temple, she gives you the SPIRIT MEDALLION.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus
facts.text: Lifting the white rock to the left of the Spirit Temple reveals a Secret Cave with Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions.

evidence.quote: Right where you appear, you should see a white rock on the left of the screen. Head over there and lift it up to find a Secret Cave, where you'll find Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain
facts.text: Lifting the white boulder on the far right ledge in Zora's Fountain reveals a hole leading to the 100th Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In here, head for the ledge far to the right and lift the white boulder to reveal a hole...At the top is the FINAL Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 100 out of 100)

facts.subject: Zelda
facts.text: In the Temple of Time, Zelda reveals herself and gives Link the Light Arrows before being captured by Ganondorf.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf captures her after she gives you the LIGHT ARROWS.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle
facts.text: A chest in the Shadow trial of Ganon's Castle contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: First, you can Longshot to the chest for a BLUE RUPEE, if you want.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle
facts.text: Stepping on a switch in the Shadow trial causes a large treasure chest to fall containing the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Once on the next platform, go down the platforms to the right and step on a switch to make a large treasure chest fall down. Longshot to it if the platforms are gone, and open it for the GOLDEN GAUNTLETS.

facts.subject: Great Fairy of Courage
facts.text: Lifting the large black stone outside Ganon's Castle leads to the Great Fairy of Courage, who doubles Link's defense when Zelda's Lullaby is played.

evidence.quote: Head inside to find the Great Fairy of Courage. Wake her with the Lullaby and she'll double your defense.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle
facts.text: In the Spirit trial of Ganon's Castle, hitting the crystal switch with a spin slash causes a chest with Bombchus to drop.

evidence.quote: Kill the Torch Slugs, and hit the crystal switch with a basic spin slash (rotate Control Stick then press B) to make a chest fall down. Open it for some BOMBCHUs.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle
facts.text: In the Light trial of Ganon's Castle, killing the Skulltula and bats reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Killing them all will make a chest appear. Ignore the others, as they're trapped ones. Open the one that appeared to get a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark in the Light trial makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark to make another chest appear with a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle
facts.text: In the Water trial block puzzle, push the farther block into the hole, then push the other block right, up, and left to slide it under the red ice within 2 minutes.

evidence.quote: In here, you have 2 minutes to get this puzzle figured out. First, push the further block into the hole. Next, push the other block right (in the perspective from entering the room) then up, then left to make it slide under the red ice.

facts.subject: Ganon's Castle
facts.text: In the Forest trial of Ganon's Castle, defeating the Wolfos causes a chest to appear containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: In here, kill the Wolfos to make a chest appear containing a BLUE RUPEE.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: After collecting 100 Gold Skulltulas, returning to Kakariko Village rewards a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees, which can be received infinitely.

evidence.quote: At the top is the FINAL Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 100 out of 100)...Once you have that, head to Kakariko Village and get your last prize: a HUGE RUPEE. ...ALL THAT WORK FOR 200 RUPEES? AGH! *mumbles* Though...you can return there and he'll give you infinite Huge Rupees.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Defeating the two Stalfos extinguishes the flames around the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Up at the next room you'll face two Stalfos. After
they're gone, the fire around the chest will disappear. Open it for the BOSS
KEY.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: Ganondorf strikes Link with a beam of darkness that prevents Navi from assisting and disables target locking.

evidence.quote:
Ganondorf says a few words, then hits you
with a giant beam of darkness, preventing your Navi friend from helping you.
Uh oh! You can't lock on anymore!

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: When Ganondorf pounds the ground at the start of the battle, quickly roll away to the outer rim to avoid falling.

evidence.quote:
The boss starts out by pounding the ground. Quickly roll away to the outer rim
so you won't fall down.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: Ganondorf's magic spell projectiles can be reflected back at him using sword swipes or Empty Bottles.

evidence.quote:
Ganondorf throws magic spells
that you have to reflect back at him with sword swipes. (Or oddly enough, Empty
Bottles)

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: When Ganondorf raises both arms to charge multiple magic spells, deflect the simultaneous volley using an Advanced Spin Slash.

evidence.quote:
When you see both his arms
raised and energy gathers toward him, he'll fire multiple magic spells at you
simultaneously. In order to deflect those, use the Advanced Spin Slash.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: While Ganondorf is charging his multiple magic spell attack, shooting him directly in the face with a Light Arrow will interrupt him and save magic.

evidence.quote:
Another thing to do is that, when he's charging up
for that multiple magic spell attack, he's open for a Light Arrow to the face.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: Once struck by a reflected spell, shoot Ganondorf with a Light Arrow before he recovers to bring him down, then slash him before he rises.

evidence.quote:
Once
he finally gets hit by a spell, quickly get the Light Arrows out and hit him
with one before he recovers. Once he's hit, he'll lower to the ground. Quickly 
get to him and slash him before he gets back up.

facts.subject: Spin Attack
facts.text: Quick spin slashes can be executed by rotating the control stick and immediately pressing the B button.

evidence.quote: Sword or do quick spin slashes. (Rotate stick then immediately press B)

facts.subject: Princess Zelda
facts.text: During the castle escape, Zelda becomes trapped in fire and Link must defeat Stalfos quickly to free her.

evidence.quote:
At one point she'll be trapped in
fire and you'll have to fight Stalfos. Be quick, as you don't have much time.
Once you free her, continue.

facts.subject: Ganon
facts.text: Ganon can be stunned with Light Arrows or passed by rolling between his legs, leaving his tail exposed to attacks from the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
The way to defeat this monster is to either stun it
by shooting Light Arrows then going behind it, or rolling between its legs.
Either way, slash his tail with the Biggoron's Sword. If you don't have it, use
the Megaton Hammer.

facts.subject: Master Sword
facts.text: Link is able to retrieve the Master Sword after dealing sufficient damage to Ganon.

evidence.quote:
After dealing some damage, you're able to get your Master 
Sword back.

facts.subject: Ganon
facts.text: Once Ganon collapses, Zelda restrains him while the sages empower Link's sword to strike the final blow to Ganon's head.

evidence.quote:
After some more damage, Ganon will 
fall, and Zelda will keep him down, telling you to deal the final blow. The 
sages will power your sword for the final hit. Just head up to his head, and
slash.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: In Master Quest Inside the Deku Tree, a chest reached after following the upper path contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Climb up using the ladder (the vines have Skullwalltulas on them that will knock you off) and follow the path up here, killing the Keese and the Gohma Egg here before it hatches. Open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Rolling into the crate near the Dungeon Map chest breaks it and reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
roll 
into the nearby crate to break it, revealing a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Fairy Slingshot
facts.text: Defeating all the Gohma eggs unlocks the door and spawns a chest in the alcove containing the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
Kill the eggs on both the other ledge and in the
alcove, and on the wall to unlock the door and make a treasure chest appear in
the alcove. Open that to get the FAIRY SLINGSHOT.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Lighting the center torch with a Deku Stick spawns a chest with a Blue Rupee, which holds a Deku Shield if the player lost theirs.

evidence.quote:
lighting it with a Deku Stick only spawns a treasure chest with a Blue
Rupee inside. (Though, chests with Blue Rupees inside usually have Deku Shields
in them if you lost yours.)

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Climbing the vines past the Big Skulltula leads to a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Climb up them, kill the egg, and open the 
chest for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Webbing
facts.text: Floor webbing can be burned by lighting a Deku Stick at a torch, standing on the webbing, and crouching with R to aim the stick downward.

evidence.quote:
See the
torch? Light a Deku Stick, stand on the webbing, and crouch (R) to point the 
stick at the webbing and burn it.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: Stepping on the switch after burning the webbing spawns a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee on the previous ledge.

evidence.quote:
burn the webbing nearby. Step on the switch to make a treasure chest 
appear back on the previous ledge. The chest contains a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Recovery Heart
facts.text: A chest to the left upon entering the room contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: The chest to your left has a Recovery Heart inside.

facts.subject: Spike Trap
facts.text: While taking the moving platform across with a lit Deku Stick, duck to avoid the spiky trap, then light both torches on the other side to open the door.

evidence.quote:
Wait for the platform to get near you, take out a Deku Stick, light it, and
take the platform. Duck to avoid the spiky trap, then quickly light the two
torches here on the other side to make the door ahead open.

facts.subject: Business Scrub
facts.text: Reflecting a nut back at the Business Scrub allows Link to talk to him to purchase Deku Shields.

evidence.quote:
get rid of the Business Scrub by
reflecting one of its nuts and talking to it. (He sells Deku Shields)

facts.subject: Deku Scrubs
facts.text: Reflecting nuts at the three Deku Scrubs in the order of right, left, then center opens the door leading to the boss.

evidence.quote:
reflect a Deku Nut at the right Scrub, then the
left, then the center. Talk to the center Deku Scrub before it runs away, and
he'll give you tips about Queen Gohma before running away and opening the door
to the boss.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the Compass room, blowing up the rocks above the climbable vines with a Bombchu reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
In the Compass room, there's some rocks right above some climbable vines. Use
 a Bombchu to blow them up, then climb up to kill a Gold Skulltula with the
 Boomerang.

facts.subject: Purple Rupee
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time near the blue block in the spike trap room removes it to reveal a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In the room with the spike trap over a pool of water, there's a blue block.
 Play the Song of Time near it to remove it and reveal a chest containing a 
 Purple Rupee.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the gravestones in the four-torch room makes blue blocks appear leading to a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
There's a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling in the room with four torches with
 Keese resting on them. In order to reach it, you must play the Song of Time in
 front of the gravestones to make blue blocks appear leading up to the 
 Skulltula. Boomerang it to retrieve it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Burning the northwest webbing in the four-torch room with a lit Deku Stick leads to a room where a Gold Skulltula token can be collected with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
burn the webbing on the northwest end of the room
 using a lit Deku Stick from the torches and enter the door. Kill all the
 enemies and use the Boomerang to get the Gold Skulltula and its token.

facts.subject: Gossip Stone
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of a Gossip Stone spawns a free healing fairy.

evidence.quote:
(Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of a
Gossip Stone to get a free healing fairy.)

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, carrying a bomb flower from the main pillar to break the opposite cracked wall reveals a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
grab a bomb flower, and go to the other side to break the nearest cracked wall.
Open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Staircase
facts.text: Lighting the wall bomb flower with a Deku Stick and carrying it into the gap in the surrounding bomb flowers detonates the chain reaction to lower the staircase.

evidence.quote:
See the bomb flower on the wall?
Light a Deku Stick using the torch here, and light the bomb flower using the
Deku Stick, then immediately carry the bomb flower to the gap in the bomb
flowers surrounding the staircase to blow them all up and lower the staircase.

facts.subject: Shield stab
facts.text: Holding R while not locked-on and pressing B executes a shield stab repeatedly faster than a normal slash.

evidence.quote: You can hold R while NOT locked-on and press B to stab. You can do this repeatedly faster than a normal slash, and is recommended for defeating bosses in the shortest time possible.

facts.subject: Shield stab
facts.text: A shield stab maintains the attack power of the previous attack performed, such as a jump slash with a Deku Stick.

evidence.quote: It basically has the attack power of the last attack you did. For example, if you used a jump slash for a Deku Stick, then immediately get rid of the stick and do a shield stab, each stab will have the same power of that jump slashed Deku Stick.

facts.subject: Blue Rupee
facts.text: A Blue Rupee is worth 5 Rupees, and 40 Rupees are needed to buy the shield.

evidence.quote: At your right there's a Blue Rupee (worth 5). Collect it. You'll need 40 Rupees to buy that shield.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: A treasure chest inside the boulder maze contains the Kokiri Sword.

evidence.quote: You'll find a treasure chest with the KOKIRI SWORD inside.

facts.subject: Deku Shield
facts.text: The Deku Shield bought from the shop is made of wood and can be burnt completely off by fire or fire-based enemies.

evidence.quote: Now, talk to the shop owner and buy that DEKU SHIELD. Now, this is an okay shield made with very strong wood, but remember, it is still wooden, and can be burnt completely off, rendering you defenseless, so remember that and be careful among fire or fire-based enemies.

facts.subject: Deku Baba
facts.text: Defeating Deku Babas causes them to drop Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote: Go through the path and defeat the Deku Babas. (They shouldn't harm you.) They'll drop some DEKU STICKS.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: Opening the treasure chest reached by climbing the ladder or wall vines awards the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Either way, head over to where the treasure chest is. Open it to get the DUNGEON MAP!

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
