facts.text: Deflecting a Deku Nut back at a Deku Scrub using a shield causes it to run away.

evidence.quote: Shielding against the Deku Nuts fires them back, so deflect the Deku Nut back at the Scrub and it'll run away.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: Opening the treasure chest across the falling platform yields the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Open the chest here to get the FAIRY SLINGSHOT.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: A treasure chest at the top of the ladder to the left of the slingshot chest contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: To the left of the chest is a ladder. Climb it to reach another chest. Open it for a mere RECOVERY HEART.

facts.subject: Skullwalltula
facts.text: Skullwalltulas on the vines can be defeated with 1 Deku Seed from the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Aim up at the spiders (Skullwalltulas) and use the Fairy Slingshot to kill them. It should take one Deku Seed to kill them.

facts.subject: Big Skulltula
facts.text: Big Skulltulas are defeated by striking their stomach.

evidence.quote: Head along this path, defeating any Big Skulltulas you come across (striking the stomach kills them), and come into the door here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Defeating the Gold Skulltula in the side alcove yields a token to collect.

evidence.quote: In this alcove is a Gold Skulltula... Kill the Skulltula and collect the token it leaves behind.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: The treasure chest in the Gold Skulltula alcove contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: The chest here contains another RECOVERY HEART.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: Opening the treasure chest on the opposite side of the raised platform room awards the Compass.

evidence.quote: Head over to the other side with a treasure chest (you may have to hit the switch again to raise the platforms again). Open the chest to get the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Deku Stick
facts.text: A Deku Stick burns out after a few seconds, but pressing A puts it away and extinguishes the flame to save the stick.

evidence.quote: You have to hurry; the Deku Stick will burn out after a few seconds, wasting a stick. Once you are done, press A to put the stick away and burn out the flames, saving the Deku Stick you used.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula found on the vines in the watery room leaves a token when killed.

evidence.quote: There's another Gold Skulltula here. Kill the Skulltula and climb up the vines to get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Killing the Gold Skulltula on the northern grate with a Deku Seed allows Link to collect its token.

evidence.quote: Look over to the northern grate to see another Gold Skulltula. Kill it with a Deku Seed, then jump over to the token.

facts.subject: treasure chest
facts.text: A treasure chest near the unlit torch on the switch platform contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: There's a chest near the unlit torch here which contains another RECOVERY HEART.

facts.subject: underwater switch
facts.text: Diving down to press the switch on the left temporarily lowers the water level to allow riding the moving platform under the spiked log.

evidence.quote: Jump into the water and dive down (holding A) to the switch to the left. When you hit the switch, the water will be lowered temporarily. Use this time to get back onto surface and hop onto the moving platform.

facts.subject: Gohma Larva
facts.text: Gohma Larvae drop down from the ceiling and are killed by hitting them in the eye.

evidence.quote: Gohma Larvae will drop down. Hitting them in the eye will kill them.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Breaking the crate on the west side of the room reveals two Silver Rupees after killing the Beamos with a bomb flower.

evidence.quote:
Now, on the west side of this room, kill the Beamos (with a bomb flower) and 
break the crate to get two Silver Rupees.

facts.subject: Business Scrub
facts.text: An elevator in Dodongo's Cavern leads to a Business Scrub who sells Deku Shields.

evidence.quote:
Ignore the elevator thing, 
it takes you to a Business Scrub who sells Deku Shields.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Collecting the last Silver Rupee by climbing the vine wall opens the door ahead.

evidence.quote:
The last one can be found 
by climbing the vine wall up here. Collecting that last one opens the door 
ahead.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Defeating all the Dodongos opens the door ahead and reveals a treasure chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Kill all the Dodongos (the bomb flower on the center pillar 
should help) to open the door ahead and reveal a treasure chest. Open it for 
the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Pulling three movable blocks under the suspended torches and lighting them with a Deku Stick opens up the room to the north.

evidence.quote:
There are three movable blocks here. What you must do is pull
them so that they are under the torches...Climb back up, light a Deku Stick using that torch, then
go down and light the other torches there. This opens up the room to the north.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Killing all the Gohma Larvae releases the lock and creates a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee or Deku Shield.

evidence.quote:
Killing them all
will release the lock out of here and create a treasure chest containing a Blue
Rupee/Deku Shield.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found inside one of the crates in the Gohma Larvae room.

evidence.quote:
Now, break all the crates in here until you find a Gold
Skulltula.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: A chest above the midair torch room contains a Blue Rupee or Deku Shield.

evidence.quote:
You're back in the midair torch room. Just head through back to the main room,
unless you want to grab the Blue Rupee/Deku Shield that's in the chest up here.

facts.subject: Business Scrub
facts.text: A Business Scrub behind a cracked wall offers a Red Potion for 40 Rupees after having a Deku Nut reflected back at him.

evidence.quote:
(If you want a Red Potion, blow open the 
cracked wall and enter the room revealed. Reflect a Deku Nut back and talk to 
the Business Scrub to get the opportunity for a Red Potion for 40 Rupees.)

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Triggering bomb flower chain reactions on both sides opens the way forward to a treasure chest containing the Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Pick
up a bomb flower there and place it beneath the bomb flowers there to create a
chain reaction and open the way forward. Enter, and open the treasure chest for
the BOMBS, finally.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Blowing up the wall of boulders in the top-right room of the second floor leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Head back to the room you first fought Lizalfos. In other words, the top-right
room of the 2nd floor. See the wall of boulders on one end? Hop over there and
blow them up with your new Bombs. Follow the path up there to find a Gold 
Skulltula.

facts.subject: Dodongo's Cavern
facts.text: Pulling the gravestone in the room past the Armos reveals a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Poe to unlock the way back out, and pull the gravestone to find a
treasure chest holding a Blue Rupee.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time near the blue blocks south of the staircase room makes them disappear, revealing a Gold Skulltula in a corner.

evidence.quote:
- South of the staircase room, on the lower floor, is a room filled with blue
 blocks. Make them disappear by playing the Song of Time near them. The Gold
 Skulltula is in a corner.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the room north of the Poe room, kill all enemies and retrieve the Gold Skulltula using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
- The room north of the Poe room. If it isn't open, use the bomb flower nearby
 and place it under the bomb flowers on the wall to open it. Inside, kill all
 the enemies then use the Boomerang to get the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Returning as Adult Link to the room with tombstones, fire, and Armos, climb to the top of the walls to kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
- In the room with tombstones, fire, and Armos, return as Adult Link. Climb 
 onto the top of the walls over where the Armos' are, and kill the Gold 
 Skulltula up there.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Bombing the boulder in the entrance area reveals a switch bump that spawns a treasure chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the boulder to make a
switch bump appear. Step on it to make a treasure chest appear. Open it for the
DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Shooting one of the cows stuck in the mouth with the Fairy Slingshot spawns a chest with Deku Nuts inside.

evidence.quote:
Now, see the cows stuck in the sides of the mouth? L-Target them
and shoot them with the Fairy Slingshot. One will spawn a chest with Deku Nuts
inside, the other will open the door ahead.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Shooting the cow stuck in the wall spawns a chest on the lower level that contains Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the cow stuck in the wall to make another
chest appear. Can't reach it from here, so take the floating platform down.
Open the chest for some Deku Nuts

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Shooting the cow submerged underwater makes a treasure chest appear in a hidden alcove containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the cow to make a treasure chest appear in a
hidden alcove. Swim down there towards the cow and surface. Open the chest for
the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Shooting the stuck cow in the room after dropping down the hole spawns a treasure chest containing Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Now look for 
another stuck cow. Shoot it to make a treasure chest appear containing Deku 
Nuts.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: A chest located in the trench contains Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote:
Take down the Lizalfos in the hall, then open the
chest when you get to the trench for some more Deku Nuts.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Killing the Like Like and Stingers spawns a chest in an alcove containing the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Like Like 
and the Stingers to create a treasure chest in an alcove. Step on the switch
here to raise the water level, and climb up the vines to reach the chest. Open
it for the BOOMERANG.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Shooting the cows and defeating the resulting Like Likes lights a torch and spawns a treasure chest containing Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the cows to make Like Likes 
appear, so kill those to make a torch light up and a treasure chest to appear.
Open that for some Deku Sticks.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Destroying a high boulder in the wall reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be collected with the Boomerang while raised by a water jet.

evidence.quote:
look for a boulder up in the
wall. Use a Bombchu or well-timed bomb throw to destroy it to reveal a Gold
Skulltula and kill it in the process...step on the switch 
here to make a water jet appear on your feet. At its highest, use your 
Boomerang to get the Skulltula's token.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Shooting the other cow in the ulcer room makes a treasure chest containing Bombchus appear.

evidence.quote: Shoot the other cow here to make a treasure chest with Bombchus inside appear.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Following the lowered ledge above the Compass room leads to a chest containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Jump onto the 
ledge there and it will lower. Follow it, open the chest for a Recovery Heart, 
and enter the door.

facts.subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
facts.text: Shooting the east cow in the room before the boss spawns a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this room, take down the Like Likes, and shoot the east cow to make a 
treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee to appear.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula on the center pillar in the room before the boss can be killed with Din's Fire and retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Now, climb this
pillar here in the center. Use Din's Fire to kill the Gold Skulltula, then L-
Target the token and use the Boomerang to catch it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time by the blue block in the Boomerang trench room makes it disappear, revealing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
- Blue block in trench room/Boomerang room. Play the Song of Time by the blue
 block to make it disappear, revealing a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the southwestern room with invisible enemies, a Gold Skulltula behind webbing across the water can be retrieved with the Boomerang after burning the web with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
- In room where Princess Ruto used to be, take the southwestern door to end up
 in a room with invisible enemies...Afterwards, 
 a Hookshot structure will appear underwater. It's just used to get you to the
 other side, so do so, and use Din's Fire to burn the webbing. Boomerang the
 Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Forest Temple
facts.text: Hookshotting the Big Skulltula and stepping on the switch atop the vines in the first room reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
When up there, Hookshot the Big 
Skulltula and step on the switch to make a treasure chest appear. Open it for a
SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden in the shrubbery above and to the left of the locked door in the first hallway.

evidence.quote:
In this hall, Hookshot all the Big
Skulltulas, then head towards the locked door. Look up and to the left to see a
Gold Skulltula hidden in some shrubbery.

facts.subject: Forest Temple
facts.text: Defeating the Wolfos in the room past the Song of Time block spawns a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the
Wolfos, and the door back will open, and a small chest containing a Small Key
will appear.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the corner of a small path to the left after defeating the Stalfos.

evidence.quote:
Battle the Stalfos and enter the next
room. Take a left and follow the little path to a corner with a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Forest Temple
facts.text: Dropping down in the room with Wallmasters allows Link to open a colorful chest for the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Go through
the hall and Navi will warn about Wallmasters. Drop down and open the colorful
chest for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: Forest Temple
facts.text: Defeating the ReDead in the side room yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Turn right and open that door instead. Kill the ReDead to get a
Small Key.

facts.subject: Forest Temple
facts.text: Defeating all the Stalfos in the downstairs room rewards a treasure chest containing the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote:
Go downstairs and enter the door to enter a battle with some Stalfos. Kill them
all and open the treasure chest for the Fairy Bow.

facts.subject: Forest Temple
facts.text: Shooting the Poe inside the pictures and defeating her rewards a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
snipe the pictures with the Poe
inside them to make the Poe
escape. Fight her and open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Forest Temple
facts.text: Revealing and defeating the second Poe rewards a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Reveal the next Poe and fight
her the same way as last time, and open the chest for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Climbing the vines by the well in the grassy room leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In this grassy room, kill the
Octoroks, then find the well. Climb up the vines by it and kill the Gold 
Skulltula up there.

facts.subject: well
facts.text: Shooting the eye switch inside the well drains the water, allowing access to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
In this other grassy room, kill all the enemies here, then look down the well
here for an eye switch. Shoot it to drain the well, and head down it. Open the
chest for a Small Key.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located down in the trench on the other side of the drained well.

evidence.quote:
Walk clear over to the other side and look down at the
trench to see a Gold Skulltula. Kill it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located right next to the Hookshot mark above the entrance door in the grassy room.

evidence.quote:
Now, look up above the door you 
entered. See the Hookshot mark? There's a Gold Skulltula right next to it. Kill
it and pull yourself up there.

facts.subject: alcove
facts.text: Climbing the vines past the Skullwalltula leads to an alcove with a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
On the last one, look up and kill the 
Skullwalltula, and Hookshot onto the vines. Climb up into the alcove and open
the chest for another Small Key.

facts.subject: checkered floor room
facts.text: Stepping on one of the switches in the falling ceiling room makes a treasure chest containing a bundle of Arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
There are two
switches and a locked door at the end. One switch opens another door back where
you fell down here, and the other makes a treasure chest appear. Open that for
a bundle of Arrows.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Dropping down through the opened door past the falling ceiling room leads to a Deku Baba and a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Now head through that door that was opened. Drop down 
gently, kill the Deku Baba, and open the chest for a Small Key.

facts.subject: Yellow Poe
facts.text: Pushing the blocks to replicate the portrait within a minute causes the Yellow Poe to appear.

evidence.quote:
In this
room, shoot the portrait, then push the blocks so that the top of the blocks
replicate the portrait. Successfully doing that within a minute will make the
Yellow Poe appear.

facts.subject: Meg
facts.text: The real Poe sister among the clones can be identified and shot because she spins as soon as she clones herself.

evidence.quote:
Kill the last Poe by shooting the right one (the one that spins as
soon as she clones herself) and once she's gone, you'll be able to take the
elevator down, so take it.

facts.subject: rotating room
facts.text: A small chest in the rotating room beneath the elevator contains a bundle of arrows.

evidence.quote: - There is a small chest containing a bundle of arrows.

facts.subject: Green Potions
facts.text: Bringing at least one or two Green Potions into the Fire Temple is recommended due to heavy Din's Fire usage depleting magic.

evidence.quote:
NOTE: Before entering, make sure you brought at least one or two Green Potions.
You're going to be using Din's Fire a lot, and the small magic bar you have 
just won't stay filled.

facts.subject: Like Like
facts.text: If a Like Like swallows Link and steals the Goron Tunic and Hylian Shield, killing it returns the Tunic and spawns a chest with the Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote:
If it does, it will take 
your Goron Tunic AND Hylian Shield. If this happens, quickly kill the Like Like
to get your Tunic back, and open the chest that appears for the Hylian Shield.

facts.subject: jail cell
facts.text: Lighting the torches with Din's Fire and a fire arrow opens a jail cell containing a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
If done
fast enough, the jail cell at that other side will open. Climb the ledges to be
able to jump back, and go on that side. Open the chest there for a SMALL KEY.

facts.subject: Iron Knuckle
facts.text: An Iron Knuckle can be defeated easily by backflipping away when it is ready to slash, then landing a jump strike followed by another backflip.

evidence.quote:
To kill it easily, just approach it, and
when it's ready to slash, backflip. Once clear, jump strike then backflip. 
Repeat.

facts.subject: Flare Dancer
facts.text: The Hookshot can be used to pull off the Flare Dancer's clothes, allowing it to be killed with Advanced Spin Slashes.

evidence.quote:
You'll fight a Flare Dancer next. Just use the Hookshot to rip its clothes off,
then kill it with Advanced Spin Slashes.

facts.subject: pedestal
facts.text: Defeating the Flare Dancer spawns a chest on a pedestal containing the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
Once it's killed, the door ahead will
open and a chest will appear on the pedestal. Open it for the MEGATON HAMMER.

facts.subject: Goron jail
facts.text: Pounding the rusted switch with the Megaton Hammer frees a Goron and grants access to a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Pound the rusted switch with your shiny new 
item to open the gate ahead. Talk to the Goron to set him free, then open the
chest that was next to him to get the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located past the rusted switch at the end of the short northern hallway in the large room.

evidence.quote:
At the
end of the short hall is a rusted switch. Pound it, free the Goron, and kill 
the Gold Skulltula there.

facts.subject: jail cell
facts.text: Bombing the discolored wall and lighting the torch with Din's Fire frees a Goron and reveals a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the discolored wall here and open the door. Use Din's Fire to 
light the other torch here, free the Goron, and open the chest for a Small Key.

facts.subject: fire alcove
facts.text: Hookshotting to the torch behind the fire barrier grants access to a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Hookshot into there using the torch, and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

facts.subject: jail cell
facts.text: Breaking the lone crate without small boxes on top inside the southern jail cell reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Break the
only crate that doesn't have small boxes on them to reveal a small chest. Open
it for some Bombs.

facts.subject: hall
facts.text: Stepping on the switch behind the blue switch door frees a Goron and allows opening a chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Step
on the switch in this hall, free the Goron, and open the chest for a Small Key.

facts.subject: cracked floor alcove
facts.text: Dropping through the bombed floor crack in the maze walls leads to a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Bomb it and drop down. Break all the crates down here until you find a rusted
switch. Pound it to open cages both down here and back up in the maze room.
Climb back up after grabbing the COMPASS from the chest down here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Pulling the block away after temporarily putting out the fire reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be killed and collected with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Drop down back to that switch,
step on it, then Hookshot back up. The fire is out. Pull the block away and 
kill the Gold Skulltula with the Hookshot, as the fire will be back shortly.
Get the token with the Hookshot as well.

facts.subject: southern cell
facts.text: Opening the cage in the southern cell with an Advanced Spin Slash and breaking crates reveals a chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Go to the 
cell to the south, and use an Advanced Spin Slash to open the cage. Break the
crates to find a treasure chest. Open it for some Bombs.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Bombing the weak wall in the alcove of the southern hall reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In this little hall, bomb the weak wall in the
alcove down here to find a Gold Skulltula. Kill it, then head back.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the northern room past the fire barrier after moving the blue block with the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: Climb up to itand jump over the fire. Enter the door down here, kill the Lizalfos, and get the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: rising platform
facts.text: Jumping off the rising platform immediately after defeating the Flare Dancer allows Link to grab a Small Key underneath.

evidence.quote:
Once it's killed, get on the platform to make it rise, then immediately jump
off so you can grab the Small Key underneath.

facts.subject: flaming treasure chest
facts.text: Stepping on the switch and Hookshotting back up to the scarecrow allows Link to open the chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Jump
down to the switch, step on it, then Hookshot back up. Open the chest for a
Small Key.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Hookshotting the face on the wall opens the door to the final Gold Skulltula in the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot the face on the wall to open the door, enter it, and find the last 
Gold Skulltula in this temple.

facts.subject: red ice structure
facts.text: Hitting the crystal switch beneath the Skullwalltula spawns a chest inside red ice that yields the Dungeon Map when melted with Blue Fire.

evidence.quote:
Hit that switch to make a treasure chest appear
inside the red ice structure. Drop the Blue Fire onto the red ice to melt it,
and open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

facts.subject: Freezard ledge
facts.text: Defeating the Freezard on the upper ledge reveals a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Go over to the Freezard, kill it, then open the chest it
was guarding for the COMPASS.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Summoning two blue blocks with the Song of Time allows Link to drop Blue Fire onto the red ice encasing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Play the Song of Time to make a blue block appear. Stand on it, then play
the Song of Time again to make another blue block appear. Stand on that, then
drop the Blue Fire on the red ice. Kill the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Gold Skulltulas in patches of soil can be found by catching bugs from under rocks and dropping them on the soil.

evidence.quote: To find the Skulltulas in the patches of soil, catch some bugs from under the rocks and plop them on the soil.

facts.subject: Market
facts.text: Link can easily collect 100 rupees as Young Link by breaking all the pots in the room at the entrance to the Market.

evidence.quote: The easiest way to get rupees to play the minigames and purchase items is to break all the pots in the room at the entrance to the Market as Young Link; you can rack up 100 rupees pretty easily that way.

facts.subject: Kokiri Forest
facts.text: A treasure chest reached by crawling through the tiny hole in the southwest corner of Kokiri Forest contains the Kokiri Sword.

evidence.quote: Enter the tiny hole here and crawl through it.  Go left, and follow the path to the treasure chest while avoiding the boulders.  It contains the Kokiri Sword.

facts.subject: Deku Shield
facts.text: The Deku Shield can be purchased for 40 rupees at the item shop in the northeast corner of Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Collect rupees in the grass, in the house of Mido, and under rocks and bushes until you have 40.  Then, enter the item shop in the northeast corner of this section of the forest and purchase the Deku Shield.

facts.subject: Gohma
facts.text: To defeat Gohma, find it on the ceiling, stun it by shooting its eye with the Slingshot, and slash it with the sword.

evidence.quote: To defeat the Gohma boss, first locate it on the ceiling.  Shoot at its eye with the Slingshot to stun it, then slice it up with your sword.  Repeat until it dies.

facts.subject: Deku Tree
facts.text: A treasure chest around the perimeter of the 2nd floor ledge contains the dungeon map.

evidence.quote: climb up the ladder to the left to the 2nd floor...Go around the perimeter of the ledge and get the map from the chest.

facts.subject: Deku Tree
facts.text: Jumping across the platform in the room past the 2nd floor ledge leads to a treasure chest containing the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Continue around the ledges and go to the next room...Jump across the platform and get the Fairy Slingshot from the chest.

facts.subject: Deku Tree
facts.text: Stepping on the switch and jumping to the opposite ledge on the 3rd floor leads to a chest containing the compass.

evidence.quote: Step on the switch and jump to the ledge on the opposite side, then get the compass from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Stepping on the switch and jumping to the opening in the wall leads to Gold Skulltula (#1) and its token.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch, jump to the first platform, then jump left to the 
  opening in the wall, kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) and get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: On floor B1, defeating Gold Skulltula (#2) on the vines with the Slingshot allows Link to climb up and collect its token.

evidence.quote:
Use the Slingshot to kill the Gold Skulltula (#2) on the vines, then 
  climb up to get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Killing Gold Skulltula (#3) on the metal grating on floor B1 allows Link to jump from a nearby ledge to obtain its token.

evidence.quote:
Find the Gold Skulltula (#3) on the metal grating, kill it, then jump 
  from the nearby ledge to get the token.

facts.subject: Deku Scrubs
facts.text: To access the boss room from floor B2, hit the middle Deku Scrub, then the right-hand one, then the left-hand one.

evidence.quote:
Hit the middle Deku, then the right-hand one, then the left-hand one, and
  go to the next room to get to the boss.

facts.subject: Beamos
facts.text: Target Beamos statues and throw a bomb at them to destroy them.

evidence.quote: The Beamos statues are annoying enemies that shoot lazer beams at you incessantly. Target them and throw a bomb at them to destroy them.

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: When King Dodongo starts breathing in with an open mouth, throw a bomb into its throat to stun it, slash it with your sword, and then sidestep or hide in a corner while it rolls.

evidence.quote: When it starts to breath in and open its mouth, quickly throw a bomb into its throat. Then, while it's stunned, slice it with your sword. Afterwards, sidestep or hide in a corner while it rolls around the room. Repeat the above process until it dies.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula token is located behind the Armos Statue.

evidence.quote: Get 3 Skulltula Tokens (#23-#25)...Kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) behind the Armos Statue.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: The dungeon map is inside a chest behind a bombed fake wall on the west ledge.

evidence.quote: Bomb the fake wall on this side and get the map from the chest.

facts.subject: Stairs
facts.text: Placing the lone bomb flower in-between the other rows blasts all of them and lowers the stairs.

evidence.quote: Pick up the lone bomb flower and place it in-between the other rows to blast all of them and lower the stairs.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula token is found on the vines near the top door after climbing the lowered stairs.

evidence.quote: Climb the stairs and go around, shoot the Gold Skulltula (#2) on the vines near the top door, and climb up to get the token.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest containing Bombs is reached by shooting two eyes to cross platforms.

evidence.quote: Shoot the first eye and jump to the platform, then shoot the second eye in the nitch to the left to get across the other platform; get the Bombs from the chest at the end of the room.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula token is in the room past the bombed fake wall on the opposite side of the hallway.

evidence.quote: Go across this room, then bomb the fake wall on the opposite side, and get the Gold Skulltula (#3) in the room past that wall.

facts.subject: Great Fairy
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby inside the fairy fountain past the blown-up boulder at the top of the rock face summons the Great Fairy to grant the Magic Meter.

evidence.quote: Get Magic Meter (Death Mountain)...Climb up the rock face at the end, and blow up the boulder in the rock wall at the top. Enter at that spot to reach a fairy fountain. Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the fountain to make the Great Fairy appear.

facts.subject: Crate
facts.text: Rolling into the first crate upon entering Death Mountain Crater reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Enter the path to the right of the fairy fountain to enter Death Mountain Crater. Quickly roll into the first crate you see to make a Gold Skulltula pop out, kill it and then get back out.

facts.subject: House
facts.text: Riding the owl down from Death Mountain allows you to drop onto the upper deck of a house and enter through a cracked wall to get a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Talk to the owl at the top of Death Mountain, and he'll give you a ride down the mountain. From where you land, drop down onto the upper deck of this house and enter through the cracked wall. Get the Heart Piece from inside.

facts.subject: Great Fairy
facts.text: Bombing the boulder at the dead end east of the gates and crawling through leads to a Great Fairy's fountain where you learn Din's Fire.

evidence.quote: Enter the Hyrule Castle area from the Market. Climb up the vines and drop down past the gates, then go all the way east to the 'dead end'. Bomb the boulder here and go through the crawlspace to get to another Great Fairy's fountain. This fairy teaches you this fire-producing spell.

facts.subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
facts.text: The 30 Capacity Bomb Bag, Heart Piece #11, and Bombchus are prizes from the Bombchu Game at the Market.

evidence.quote: Get 30 Capacity Bomb Bag (Market)...Get Heart Piece #11 (Market)...Get Bombchus (Market)...These three items are all prizes from the Bombchu Game at the Market, which is now open.

facts.subject: Giant spinning pot
facts.text: Lighting the torches on the bottom floor activates a giant spinning pot, which spits out a Heart Piece when a bomb is thrown into it.

evidence.quote: Light the torches with Din's Fire and a Deku Stick to activate a giant spinning pot. Go up to the next floor and throw a bomb in the pot, and it will spit out a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Crate
facts.text: Rolling into the crate at the end of the boulder-filled room on the top floor reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: On the top floor, bomb the boulders blocking your way, then go past them and through the path there. Make your way through this room, bombing the boulders until you reach the end. Roll into the crate here to find a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Rolling Goron
facts.text: Bombing the giant rolling Goron twice rewards you with a bomb capacity upgrade.

evidence.quote: Bomb the giant Goron rolling around one of the floors in the city twice, and he will give you another bomb capacity upgrade.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: A Deku Scrub sells the 30 Capacity Deku Nut upgrade inside a hole under a boulder on the screen below Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote: - Get 30 Capacity Deku Nut Holder (Lost Woods) ... Now in the woods, go west, west, forward, then west to reach the screen below the Sacred Forest Meadow. Bomb the boulder here and fall through the hole. The Deku Scrub inside sells this upgrade.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub
facts.text: A Deku Scrub in a hole inside the fenced-in area near Lake Hylia sells a Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

evidence.quote: In the middle of the fenced-in area, bomb the ground. Drop in the hole, and the Deku Scrub will sell you this Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

facts.subject: Magic Bean Salesman
facts.text: A man in Zora's River sells Magic Beans at progressively higher prices.

evidence.quote: Go forward and bomb the boulders to continue, then talk to the man farther down. He sells Magic Beans at progressively higher prices.

facts.subject: Ledge
facts.text: Using the chicken near the circle of stones allows you to float across ledges to reach a Heart Piece on a platform.

evidence.quote: Grab the chicken near the circle of stones, hop across to the ledge on the right, go forward and to the left. Jump up around the ledges and use the chicken to float to the ledge just before the Heart Piece. Drop the chicken, then jump to the platform with the Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Ledge
facts.text: Floating down with a chicken to a lower ledge near the end of the river rewards Heart Piece #15.

evidence.quote: - Get Heart Piece #15 (Zora's River) Drop down to the platform below and grab the chicken, then make your way to the end of the river. Use the chicken to float down to the ledge below with the Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Ladder
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on a ladder near the waterfall at the end of the river.

evidence.quote: At the end of the river, drop down near the waterfall. There is a Gold Skulltula on a nearby ladder.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Lighting all torches on the spiraling path and behind the waterfall makes a chest with a Heart Piece appear.

evidence.quote: On the spiraling path that leads to King Zora are many torches, including two behind the waterfall on the bottom floor. Light all of them to make a chest appear with the Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Diving Game
facts.text: Collecting five blue rupees within the time limit in the diving game awards the Silver Scales.

evidence.quote: Dive and get the five blue rupees in the time limit to get the Silver Scales, which enable Link to dive longer.

facts.subject: Underwater
facts.text: Diving below the water near the underwater shortcut from Zora's Domain lets you retrieve a bottle containing a message.

evidence.quote: From the diving game Zora, jump off the cliff again into the water, then swim forward, through an underwater passage, to get to Lake Hylia. Dive to get thebottle sitting nearby below the water...give King Zora the message in a bottle

facts.subject: Tree
facts.text: Rolling into the tree on the platform in the southeast corner of the lake makes a Gold Skulltula fall out.

evidence.quote: Go past Jabu Jabu to the right, and swim to the southeast corner of the lake, onto a platform. Roll into the tree here to make a Gold Skulltula fall out.

facts.subject: Great Fairy
facts.text: Bombing the boulder on the southeast platform opens a cave to a fairy fountain that teaches Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote: Bomb the nearby boulder on this platform to open up a huge cave. Go inside to find another fairy fountain; this one teaches you Farore's Wind.

facts.subject: Jabu Jabu
facts.text: Dropping a bottled fish caught in Zora's Domain in front of Jabu Jabu causes him to suck Link inside.

evidence.quote: Catch a fish in one of your bottles from Zora's Domain, then drop the fish in front of Jabu Jabu in Zora's Fountain. The great fish will suck Link into his mouth.

facts.subject: Barinade
facts.text: Detach Barinade from the wall using the Boomerang, slash it with the sword, hit its main body with the Boomerang to kill the surrounding squids, and finish it off with Boomerang and sword strikes.

evidence.quote: First, detach it from the wall with your Boomerang and slash it with your sword. In the next phase, hit the main body with the Boomerang, then kill all the squids around it. Afterwards it will be undefended, and you can finish it off with the Boomerang and sword.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula token is obtained by shooting the Skulltula and climbing up in the room after falling down the hole with Ruto.

evidence.quote: Get 4 Skulltula Tokens (#30-#33)...In the next room, shoot the Gold Skulltula (#1) and climb up to the token.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Stepping on the switch while carrying Ruto opens the far east door, where defeating enemies awards the Boomerang from a chest.

evidence.quote: Go through the door on the far east here- step on the switch while carrying Ruto to open it- and kill the enemies to get the Boomerang from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A second Gold Skulltula token in the pit room is collected with the Boomerang to the right of the first.

evidence.quote: There is another Gold Skulltula to the right of this one (#3); collect the token with the Boomerang.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Defeating the Armos Statue through the west unlocked door leads to the compass.

evidence.quote: Go through the west unlocked door, then south after that....Kill the Armos Statue and get the compass, then go back north.

facts.subject: Statue head mouth
facts.text: Dropping bombs through gaps on the bridge into both eyes of the statue opens the statue head's mouth.

evidence.quote: Go to the next room and hit the switch, then step onto the bridge and drop...down bombs through both gaps, into the eyes of the statue below....Drop down and enter the statue head's mouth to the next room.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Placing Ruto on the switch on the west side unlocks a door to a tentacle that yields the map from a chest when killed with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Now go back to the west side of the room and place Ruto on the switch, then...go through the unlocked door....Kill the tentacle with the Boomerang and get the map from the chest.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Killing enemies within the time limit through the first door on the left yields the compass from a chest.

evidence.quote: Go back to the previous room and go through the first door on the left....Kill the enemies in the time limit and get the compass from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Dropping into the pit previously blocked by a green tentacle leads to a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote: Go south two rooms, then jump into the pit that was previously blocked by a...green tentacle, with Ruto....Shoot the nearby Gold Skulltula here (#2) and collect the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula token is located on vines after stunning platforms with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Stun the platforms with the Boomerang and jump across to the next room....Shoot the Gold Skulltula (#4) on one of the vines here and climb up to the...token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At night, a Gold Skulltula on the wall opposite the log near Jabu Jabu can be killed to collect its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: There is a Gold Skulltula on the wall opposite the log...kill it and collect...its token with the Boomerang.  Remember that it has to be at night.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: When you have 30 or more Skulltula tokens, the Giant Wallet upgrade becomes available from the House of Skulltula.

evidence.quote: When you have 30 or more Skulltula tokens...available from the House of Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Inside the Deku Tree past a web lit with a Deku Stick and a bombable fake wall, a Gold Skulltula is on the ceiling whose token can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Light the other web on fire with a Deku Stick, and bomb the fake wall past it...Inside, there is a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.  Get the token with the Boomerang.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the window of Talon's house to the left of the entrance, and its token can be collected with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Look up on Talon's house left of the entrance, and there is a Gold Skulltula on the window...Get the token with the Boomerang.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: East of the door to the cow house in the southwest corner of the ranch, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the wall and grab its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: East of the door to the cow house, look on the wall...Shoot the Gold Skulltula and grab the token with the Boomerang.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula appears on the south wall of the graveyard.

evidence.quote: On the south wall of the graveyard, this Gold Skulltula appears.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Inside a bombable wall on the east wall while heading north on Death Mountain, a Gold Skulltula token can be collected.

evidence.quote: On the east wall as you go north, there is a bombable wall...Get the skulltula token inside the joint.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Climbing up the side of the staircase in Dodongo's Cavern allows you to reach a Gold Skulltula in a hole in the wall.

evidence.quote: Climb up the side of the staircase, and you can reach the Gold Skulltula in the hole in the wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on the backside of the scientist's lab, and the Boomerang is required to collect its token.

evidence.quote: On the backside of the scientist's lab, there is a Gold Skulltula...The Boomerang is required to get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Examine the mini-waterfall to the right of the tiny bridge upon entering Gerudo Valley to get the token from the Gold Skulltula there.

evidence.quote: Soon after you enter, examine the mini-waterfall to the right of the tiny bridge...Get the token from the Gold Skulltula there.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Bombing the ground near the lone tree in the northeast corner of Hyrule Field reveals a hole containing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the very northeast corner of Hyrule Field, there is a lone tree on the right side of the river...Bomb the ground near it and fall in the hole, then kill the Gold Skulltula inside.

facts.subject: Zelda
facts.text: Approaching the Market after beating the third dungeon triggers a cutscene in which Zelda tosses the Ocarina into the moat.

evidence.quote: When you approach the Market after beating the third dungeon, a cutscene occurs in which Zelda tosses the Ocarina into the moat.

facts.subject: Zelda
facts.text: Picking up the Ocarina of Time prompts Zelda to teach you the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: When you pick up the Ocarina, Zelda teaches you this song.

facts.subject: Happy Mask Shop
facts.text: Selling the Bunny Hood to the running man at night fills your wallet with rupees, after which the Happy Mask Shop manager gives you the Mask of Truth.

evidence.quote: When he sits down to rest, sell him the Bunny Hood and he will fill your entire wallet with rupees...Talk to the Happy Mask Shop manager and he will give you the Mask of Truth.

facts.subject: Deku Scrubs
facts.text: Wearing the Mask of Truth in the hole near the butterflies in the Lost Woods causes the Deku Scrubs to give you the 40 Capacity Deku Nut Holder upgrade.

evidence.quote: - Get 40 Capacity Deku Nut Holder (Lost Woods)...Wear the Mask of Truth and walk forward, and the Deku Scrubs will give you this Deku Nut upgrade.

facts.subject: Temple of Time
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the Altar in the Temple of Time begins the Adult Link phase of the quest.

evidence.quote: Enter the Temple of Time, from the Market...Play the Song of Time in front of the Altar to begin the second phase of Link's quest.

facts.subject: Rauru
facts.text: The Light Sage Rauru gives Link the Light Medallion upon awakening as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: The Light Sage, Rauru, gives you this medallion when you awake as Adult Link.

facts.subject: Ingo
facts.text: Beating Ingo twice in a race on Epona allows Link to keep her, escaping Lon Lon Ranch by jumping over a side wall.

evidence.quote: He will challenge you to a race- beat him twice on Epona, and he will let you keep her...To escape Lon Lon Ranch afterwards, jump over one of the side walls.

facts.subject: Graveyard
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean platform grown at the soft soil spot in the Graveyard allows you to reach a Heart Piece on the ledge.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean earlier here at the soft soil spot, there is now a bean platform...Ride the platform up and get the Heart Piece from the ledge.

facts.subject: Dampe
facts.text: Completing Dampe's race through the course before the final door closes rewards Link with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: He challenges you to a race- if you can make it through the whole course before the final door closes, Dampe will give you the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Windmill
facts.text: Exiting the Dampe race into the top floor of the Kakariko Village windmill allows Link to jump over to a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: You will emerge into the top floor of a windmill in Kakariko Village...Jump over to the Heart Piece here.

facts.subject: Windmill Man
facts.text: Pulling out the Ocarina in front of the man in the windmill teaches Link the Song of Storms.

evidence.quote: Pull out your Ocarina in front of the man in the windmill, and he will teach you this song.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on the other side of the big white arch at Ganon's Castle, requiring the Hookshot to kill it and get the token.

evidence.quote: On the other side of the big white arch, there's a Gold Skulltula...Use the Hookshot to kill it and get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Climbing the ladder near the gate up to the ledge in Zora's River reveals a Gold Skulltula on the nearby wall.

evidence.quote: Climb up the ladder on the right side near the gate up to the ledge, and the Gold Skulltula is on the wall nearby.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: At the top of the frozen waterfall in Zora's Domain, a Gold Skulltula on the high wall can be killed with the Hookshot to collect its token.

evidence.quote: Go all the way up to the top of the frozen waterfall here...Kill the Gold Skulltula on the high wall and get the token with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain
facts.text: Hopping across the frozen platforms past where Jabu Jabu used to be in Zora's Fountain leads to a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Go past where Jabu Jabu used to be, and hop across the frozen platforms to get this Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall behind some icicles in the spinning fan room of the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: In the spinning fan room, there is a Gold Skulltula on the wall behind some icycles.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: Melting the red ice covering the big chest with blue fire allows you to get the dungeon map in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Jump over to the red ice covering the big chest, and pour the blue fire on it to melt the ice...Get the map from the chest.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: Burning red ice with blue fire reveals a chest containing the compass in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: You can also burn two patches of red ice, one guarding a chest with the compass and the other guarding a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: Burning a patch of red ice with blue fire in the Ice Cavern frees a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: You can also burn two patches of red ice, one guarding a chest with the compass and the other guarding a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the Heart Piece in the Ice Cavern can be killed with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Look on the wall behind the Heart Piece, and kill the Gold Skulltula with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found on a wall across from a pit in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: On one of the walls in this room, across from a pit, is a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Ice Cavern
facts.text: In the Ice Cavern, defeating the enemy in the room past the red ice allows Link to obtain the Iron Boots from a chest.

evidence.quote: Go past the red ice to the next room, kill the enemy and get the Iron Boots from the chest.

facts.subject: Sheik
facts.text: Sheik appears in the Ice Cavern and teaches Link the Serenade of Water, which warps to Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: After that, Sheik appears and teaches you this song, which warps you to Lake Hylia.

facts.subject: King Zora
facts.text: Unfreezing King Zora with blue fire rewards Link with the Zora Tunic.

evidence.quote: Unfreeze him with the blue fire and he will give you the Zora Tunic.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain
facts.text: Sinking to the bottom of Zora's Fountain with the Iron Boots lets Link collect a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Swim to the middle of Zora's Fountain, then sink down with the Iron Boots and get the Heart Piece on the bottom surface.

facts.subject: Cucco Lady
facts.text: Talking to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village rewards Link with the Pocket Egg.

evidence.quote: To begin, go to Kakariko Village and talk to the Cucco Lady...She will give you the Pocket Egg.

facts.subject: Cucco Lady
facts.text: After hatching the egg and using the cucco to wake Talon, talking to the Cucco Lady yields Cojiro.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song twice to pass a day and the egg will hatch...use the cucco in front of the sleeping  Talon...After he leaves, talk to the Cucco Lady again and she will give you the Cojiro.

facts.subject: Lost Woods
facts.text: Trading Cojiro to the man one screen west of the Lost Woods entrance yields the Odd Mushroom.

evidence.quote: From the entrance, go west once...Give the Cojiro to the man to get the Odd Mushroom in return.

facts.subject: Kakariko Village
facts.text: Giving the Odd Mushroom to the witch behind the Kakariko potion shop rewards Link with the Potion.

evidence.quote: Jump down and enter the witch's shop here...Give the Odd Mushroom to her to get the Potion in return.

facts.subject: Lost Woods
facts.text: Giving the Potion to the girl where the man was in the Lost Woods rewards Link with the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote: Return to where the man was in the Lost Woods...Give the Potion to the girl to get the Poacher's Saw in return.

facts.subject: Gerudo Valley
facts.text: Trading the Poacher's Saw to the man outside the tent across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley yields the Broken Goron Sword.

evidence.quote: talk to the man outside the nearby tent...Give him the Poacher's Saw to get the Broken Goron Sword in return.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: Giving the Broken Goron Sword to the huge Goron at the top of Death Mountain yields the Prescription Card.

evidence.quote: Talk to the huge Goron that appears, and give him the Broken Goron Sword to get the Prescription Card in return.

facts.subject: King Zora
facts.text: King Zora gives Link the Eyeball Frog in exchange for the Prescription Card.

evidence.quote: Get to Zora's Domain and talk to King Zora...He will give you the Eyeball Frog in exchange for the Prescription Card.

facts.subject: Lakeside Laboratory
facts.text: The scientist at the Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia gives Link the Eyedrops if delivered in time.

evidence.quote: Stop at the Lakeside Laboratory in the lake and go inside...The scientist will give you the Eyedrops if you make it in time.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: Delivering the Eyedrops to the huge Goron at the top of Death Mountain rewards Link with the Claim Check.

evidence.quote: Give him the Eyedrops to get the Claim Check.

facts.subject: Biggoron
facts.text: Passing 3 days with the Sun's Song allows Link to obtain the Biggoron's Sword from the huge Goron.

evidence.quote: Use the Sun's Song until 3 days have passed, then get the Biggoron's Sword from the huge Goron.

facts.subject: Death Mountain
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean platform at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern allows Link to collect a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern earlier, you can ride the bean platform up at that spot to get a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula climbs on the giant hanging central pedestal in Goron City, collectable with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: In Goron City, look for this Gold Skulltula climbing on the giant hanging central pedestal, and collect the token with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Goron City
facts.text: A big Goron behind a third floor bombable passage in Goron City sells the fragile Giant's Knife for 200 rupees.

evidence.quote: On one of the third floor bombable passages, go through it to find a big Goron...He should be selling this fragile sword for 200 rupees.

facts.subject: Goron City
facts.text: Stopping the rolling Goron with a bomb in Goron City rewards Link with the Goron Tunic, which protects against extreme heat.

evidence.quote: Go down a floor from the top to the rolling Goron, bomb him to make him stop, and talk to him...He will give you the Goron Tunic, which protects against extreme heat.

facts.subject: Sheik
facts.text: Meeting Sheik across the broken bridge in Death Mountain Crater teaches Link the Bolero of Fire.

evidence.quote: Hookshot across the broken bridge, and you'll meet Sheik again...She teaches you this song.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Collecting 50 Skulltula tokens makes a Heart Piece available from the House of Skulltula.

evidence.quote: When you have 50 Skulltula tokens, this Heart Piece becomes available from the House of Skulltula.

facts.subject: Scarecrow
facts.text: Playing the same song to the dancing scarecrow in Lake Hylia as Adult Link unlocks the Scarecrow's Song.

evidence.quote: If you played a song in front of the dancing scarecrow in Lake Hylia as Young Link, go back there and play the same song in front of the scarecrow as Adult Link to learn this song.

facts.subject: Lake Hylia
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean platform next to the scientist's lab in Lake Hylia leads to a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean next to the scientist's lab here earlier, you can ride the bean platform up and get a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Fishing Pond
facts.text: Catching a fish over 10 pounds at the Fishing Pond as Adult Link rewards you with the Golden Scale.

evidence.quote: Use the same technique you used before as Young Link to catch a big fish over 10 pounds, and you will get the Golden Scale.

facts.subject: Lakeside Laboratory
facts.text: Diving to the bottom of the pool in the Lakeside Laboratory with the Golden Scale earns a Heart Piece from the scientist.

evidence.quote: Dive down to the very bottom of the pool with the Golden Scale and the scientist will give you a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Sinking to the bottom of the pool in the Lakeside Laboratory with Iron Boots and rolling into a crate reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Sink to the bottom of the pool in the lab with the Iron Boots, then roll into the nearby crate to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song beneath the high hole in Dodongo's Cavern allows you to Hookshot up and kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the room with the Dodongo Larvae, stand beneath the big hole in the wall above and play the Scarecrow's Song...Hookshot to the scarecrow and kill the Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Hyrule Field
facts.text: Bombing near the gold-leaved tree north of Lon Lon Ranch reveals a hole where sinking to the bottom yields a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Go north of Lon Lon Ranch until you come to a gold-leaved tree...Bomb the ground near it and fall in the hole...Sink down to the bottom to get the Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley, a Gold Skulltula is located behind the carpenter's tent.

evidence.quote: Jump across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley, then look behind the carpenter's tent to find this Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: On a stone pillar past the bridge before Gerudo Fortress, a Gold Skulltula is reachable with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: On a stone pillar past the bridge, before the entrance to Gerudo Fortress, this Gold Skulltula is reachable with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: In the southeast corner of Kokiri Forest by the House of Twins, a Gold Skulltula in the tree can be killed with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Go to the House of Twins in the southeast corner of the forest and look up in the tree...Kill the Gold Skulltula and get the token with the Hookshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Riding the Magic Bean platform where you enter the Forest Stage in the Lost Woods allows Link to kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean in the Lost Woods screen where you enter the Forest Stage, you can ride that platform up here and kill a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Climbing the ladder at the end of the hedges in Sacred Forest Meadow reveals a Gold Skulltula climbing on the left-side wall.

evidence.quote: At the end of the hedges, turn around and climb up the ladder...There is a Gold Skulltula climbing on the left-side wall here, reachable from the top of the hedges.

facts.subject: Sheik
facts.text: Going to where you first met Saria in the Sacred Forest Meadow prompts Sheik to teach you the Minuet of the Forest.

evidence.quote: Go to where you first met Saria as Young Link, and the Sheik will teach you this song.

facts.subject: Poe
facts.text: Poes are defeated by slicing them with the sword or shooting them with arrows after they appear, and the real purple Poe can be spotted by an extra twirl.

evidence.quote: The Poes can be defeated by waiting for them to fully appear, then slicing them with the sword or shooting them with arrows.  The purple Poe makes copies of itself, but the real Poe is easy to spot, because it adds an extra twirl when it appears.

facts.subject: Stalfos
facts.text: Stalfos will regenerate if not dispatched quickly, so damage all of them before killing one.

evidence.quote: The Stalfos will regenerate themselves if you're not quick, so damage all of them before killing one, or they'll raise themselves up again.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: To defeat Phantom Ganon, shoot the copy emerging from a painting in a purple haze with an arrow, then reflect his energy balls back at him and hit him with the sword.

evidence.quote: To defeat the menacing Phantom Ganon: In the first phase, two copies of Ganon run at you on his horse from two of the paintings.  One of them emerges from the painting in a purple haze; shoot that Ganon with an arrow.  When you've done that enough, Ganon will float around the room.  Reflect his energy ball back at him until he's hit, then pound on him with your sword until he dies.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Climb up the vines on the right and shoot the Gold Skulltula with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Go right and climb up the vines, then shoot the Gold Skulltula with your Hookshot (#1).

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Jump across at the top of the vines to find a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote: At the top of the vines, jump over and get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located near one of the main doors.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula (#2) near one of the main doors.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeat the enemies past the north hallway to collect a key from the chest.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies and get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Dungeon Map
facts.text: Defeat the enemy to obtain the dungeon map from the chest.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemy and get the map from the chest, and go to the next room.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Hookshot to the chest on the small island and shoot the nearby Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote: Hookshot to the chest on the small island, then shoot the nearby Gold Skulltula (#3) on the wall.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Go down into the drained well to find a key at the end of the path.

evidence.quote: Go down the drained well, and get the key at the end of the path.

facts.subject: Block puzzle
facts.text: Push and pull the blue block until it sinks, climb the ladder to push the red block, then push the red block from above until it sinks into the floor.

evidence.quote: follow the arrows to a blue block, then pull and push it until it sinks into the ground.  Go through where the block was blocking the path and climb up the ladder.  Push the red block until it stops, then go back around and climb up the blue block, and push the red block until it sinks.

facts.subject: Fairy Bow
facts.text: Defeat the enemies in the room to obtain the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote: Go down to the next room, kill the enemies and get the Fairy Bow.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Shoot the pictures from far away and defeat the red Poe to obtain a key.

evidence.quote: shoot the pictures by standing far away, then kill the red Poe and get the key.

facts.subject: Compass
facts.text: Shoot the pictures and defeat the blue Poe to obtain the compass.

evidence.quote: Shoot the pictures and kill the blue Poe, then get the compass.

facts.subject: Boss Key
facts.text: Drop down in the untwisted hallway room to open the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Drop down and get the Boss Key from the chest, then drop down the hole.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Jump across to the white ledge with hearts to defeat the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote: Jump across to the white ledge with hearts, and kill the Gold Skulltula (#4) on the wall.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Defeat the enemies in the side room to obtain a key from the chest.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies and get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Eye switch
facts.text: Shoot the frozen eye switch with an arrow through the center flames to twist the hallway.

evidence.quote: Shoot the eye with an arrow that passes through the center flames, then go back through the newly-twisted hallway.

facts.subject: Block puzzle
facts.text: Shoot the picture, assemble the blocks within the time limit, and kill the green Poe.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the picture, put the blocks together in the time limit, then kill 
  the green Poe.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Push the rotating walls in the basement to find a Gold Skulltula behind a big Skulltula in an alcove.

evidence.quote:
Push the walls around- one of the holes has a big Skulltula and a Gold 
  Skulltula (#5) behind it.

facts.subject: Prelude of Light
facts.text: Return to the Temple of Time after clearing the Forest Temple to learn the Prelude of Light from Sheik and travel between Young and Adult Link at will.

evidence.quote: Go back to the Temple of Time after beating the Forest Temple, and Sheik will teach you this song.  You can now go back and forth between Young and Adult Link at will.

facts.subject: Lens of Truth
facts.text: Defeat Dead Hand with your sword in the Bottom of the Well to receive the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Go through the crawlspace.  Defeat Dead Hand with your sword to get the Lens of Truth.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Use the Lens of Truth to find a hidden wall alcove with a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote: Use the Lens of Truth to find a tiny hidden room in the wall in front of you, and get the key inside the chest there.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Use the Lens of Truth along the right-hand corridor to find a hidden room with a key in a chest.

evidence.quote: Now go along the right-hand corridor and use the Lens of Truth to find another tiny room with a key in a chest.

facts.subject: Small Key
facts.text: Light the torches to reveal coffins, one of which contains a key.

evidence.quote: Light the torches to uncover the coffins- there is a key inside one of them.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Go through the left-hand locked door in the central room to destroy the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote: Go through the left-hand locked door, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Use the Lens of Truth to cross the invisible platform to the left and defeat the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth to go across the invisible platform to the left, and 
kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Head through the corner crawlspace at the end of the right-hand corridor, unlock the door, use the Lens of Truth past the pits, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
Go along the 
right-hand corridor to its end, and go east through the crawlspace in the 
corner.  Go through the locked door on the other side.  Use the Lens of Truth
to avoid the pits, and go to the next room.  Kill the Gold Skulltula on the
wall here.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Stand on the log in Zora's River as Young Link and play the Song of Storms for the frogs to obtain a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Midway up the river before the bridge, stand on the log sticking out of the water.  Pull out your Ocarina and play the Song of Storms for the frogs to get a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Play five songs for the frogs at Zora's River and then follow their tune on the Ocarina to earn a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Play Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, Song of Time, and Sun Song 
in front of the same frogs for rupees.  Then, follow the tune they give you on
your Ocarina, and they will give you another Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Play the treasure chest game at night as Young Link and use the Lens of Truth to claim the Heart Piece at the end.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Market as Young Link and change it to night, then play the treasure
chest game in the southwest corner of the village.  Use the Lens of Truth to
see through the chests, get the keys, and get the Heart Piece at the end.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Play the Song of Storms next to the tree where Talon was sleeping at Hyrule Castle to reveal a hole containing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Hyrule Castle area as Young Link and go over to where you first met
the sleeping Talon.  Go to the nearby tree and play the Song of Storms next to
it to open a secret hole.  There is a Gold Skulltula inside.

facts.subject: 40 Arrow Quiver
facts.text: Win the archery shooting gallery game in Kakariko Village as Adult Link to receive the 40 Arrow Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: - Get 40 Arrow Quiver (Kakariko Village) At the spot where the building was under construction as Young Link, enter the new building as Adult Link, play the archery game and win to get this upgrade.

facts.subject: Bottle
facts.text: Catch 10 Big Poes from Hyrule Field in bottles and sell them to the Poe dealer in the Market to obtain the fourth Bottle.

evidence.quote:
Collect 10 Big Poes from around Hyrule 
Field in bottles and sell them to him to get the fourth Bottle.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: Shoot Big Poes twice with arrows before they disappear to kill them.

evidence.quote:
To kill the 
Big Poes, shoot them twice with arrows before they disappear.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Jump across to the ledge on the left in Gerudo Fortress at night to find a Gold Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote:
Jump over to the ledge on the left from here- there will be a Gold
Skulltula on the wall, at night of course.

facts.subject: Gerudo Membership Card
facts.text: Save the last carpenter in Gerudo Fortress and the Gerudo swordsman will reward Link with the membership card.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the guard as 
she approaches, then go through and save the last carpenter.  Afterwards, the
Gerudo swordsman will give you the membership card.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Score 1,000 points in the horseback archery game during the daytime at Gerudo Fortress to earn a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Score 
1,000 points to get a Heart Piece.  Keep in mind that you can only play the 
archery game during the day.

facts.subject: 50 Arrow Quiver
facts.text: Score 1,500 points in the horseback archery game to earn the 50 Arrow Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: - Get 50 Arrow Quiver (Gerudo Fortress) Score 1,500 points on the archery game to get this upgrade.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: Drop a bug onto the soft soil patch near the Fire Temple in Death Mountain Crater to uncover a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
There is a nearby soft soil that you can use a bug on to fish
out a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil as Young Link, then ride the bean platform as Adult Link to reach the Heart Piece on the top ledge.

evidence.quote:
Plant a Magic Bean in this same soft soil spot, then come back as Adult Link.
Ride the bean platform and get the Heart Piece on the top ledge.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Ride the bean platform around until it nears a hole in the wall, then jump off to collect the Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Ride this same bean platform around until it nears a hole in the wall with a
Heart Piece.  Jump off at that point to get it.

facts.subject: Big Poe
facts.text: The 10 Big Poes in Hyrule Field appear south of the Market, by Lon Lon Ranch, east of the ranch at the y-shaped wall, south of Kakariko Village, east of the Gerudo Valley path, west of Kokiri Forest, in the southeast field of trees, and in the northwest trees.

evidence.quote:
Collect 10 Big Poes from around Hyrule 
Field in bottles and sell them to him to get the fourth Bottle.  To kill the 
Big Poes, shoot them twice with arrows before they disappear.  Locations of 
the Big Poes in Hyrule Field: 1 just south of the Market, near the sign; 1 
next to the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch; 1 at the y-shaped stone wall east of 
the ranch; 1 just south of the entrance to Kakariko Village; 2 just east of 
the brown path that leads to the Gerudo Valley, 1 west of Kokiri Forest, near 
the grey stone; 2 in the very southeast corner in the field of trees; and 1 
in the northwest corner in the field of trees there.

facts.subject: Megaton Hammer
facts.text: The Megaton Hammer can be used to destroy unbombable boulders or push down rusted switches.

evidence.quote:
The secret item this time is the Megaton Hammer, which is used to 
destroy unbombable boulders or push down rusted switches.

facts.subject: Flare Dancer
facts.text: Defeat the mini-boss by hookshotting the black ball and then slicing the ball with the sword.

evidence.quote:
To defeat the mini-
boss, just hookshot the black ball, then slice up the ball with your sword.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: When Volvagia's head pops out of the lava, pound it once with the Megaton Hammer to stun it, and pound it again to damage it.

evidence.quote:
The boss, Volvagia, is fairly simple: wait for his head to pop up out of the
lava, pound it once with the Megaton Hammer to stun it, then pound it again to
damage it.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest in the cell on the left contains a key obtained after pressing the switch to free the Goron.

evidence.quote:
Jump over to the cell on the left, press the switch to free the Goron, and
  get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest behind a fake wall on the right ledge contains a key obtained after freeing the Goron.

evidence.quote:
Jump to the right side of this room, bomb the fake wall on the ledge and go
  through.
- Free the Goron and get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Goron
facts.text: Freeing the Goron on the left side of the big room rewards a key.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the big room, then go to the left side and go through that door.
- Free the Goron and get the key, then go back to the big room.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found inside the top door on the left side, reached by playing the Song of Time below the blue block.

evidence.quote:
Play the Song of Time below the blue block, then hop up to the top door on
  the left side and go through.
- Kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) inside, then come back out.

facts.subject: Gorons
facts.text: Freeing the two trapped Gorons in this room yields two keys.

evidence.quote:
There are two trapped Gorons here: one through a door and the other in the
  room itself; free both of them and get the two keys.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is revealed by bombing the wall at the point where it can be heard.

evidence.quote:
Along one of the walls in this room you will hear a Gold Skulltula (#2)- 
  bomb the wall at that point to find it.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest through the east door after shooting an eye switch contains the dungeon map.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the eye with an arrow and go through the east door, and get the map
  from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located up grated walls after playing the Scarecrow's song and hookshotting to the scarecrow and targeted platform.

evidence.quote:
Play the Scarecrow's song when you enter, hookshot up to it, then hookshot 
  to the targeted platform and ride it up.
- Go through and up the grated walls to reach a Gold Skulltula (#3).

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall in the room continuing up the grated wall.

evidence.quote:
Continue up the wall, to the next room.
- Shoot the Gold Skulltula on the wall (#4) and get the token.

facts.subject: Goron
facts.text: Dropping down through the cracked floor after bombing it in the boulder room leads to a Goron who gives a key when freed.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the top floor of the boulder room, jump across and bomb the 
  cracked floor, then drop down.
- Free the Goron and get the key, then go back and climb back up.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest inside a cell contains a key after pressing the switch on the ledge to free the Goron.

evidence.quote:
Jump over to the ledge with the switch to free the Goron, then jump over to
  its cell and get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest in the door on the right-hand wall contains the compass.

evidence.quote:
Turn right and go through the door on the right-hand wall.
- Get the compass from the chest, then go back to the previous room.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest on the inside ledge reached after stepping on the switch contains the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch, then run around the inside ledge to the chest and get 
  the Megaton Hammer from it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on the wall in the room beyond the enemies behind the entrance room's right door.

evidence.quote:
Kill the enemies and go to the next room.
- Kill the Gold Skulltula (#5) on the wall and go to the next room.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest beyond the mini-boss contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the mini-boss, go through the next door and get the Boss Key from the
  chest.

facts.subject: Great Fairy
facts.text: The Great Fairy inside the tunnel blocked by boulders across two bridges gives Link the Double Magic meter.

evidence.quote:
From where you leave the temple, turn left and hookshot across the bridge.  Go
left across the next bridge and pound the boulders in front of the tunnel.  Go
inside and the Great Fairy will give you the Double Magic meter.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden under a boulder that must be bashed with the hammer in the falling boulder valley near the peak of Death Mountain.

evidence.quote:
Approach the peak of Death Mountain to the valley with falling boulders.  One
