of the boulders here is covering another Gold Skulltula.  Bash it with the 
hammer.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is covered by a boulder outside Goron City's top exit, through the short tunnel above the Dodongo's Cavern entrance.

evidence.quote:
Head back to Goron City, then leave the city through the top exit.  Go forward 
and then right through the short tunnel above the Dodongo's Cavern entrance 
(where you threw a bomb to open up the entrance as a kid).  Pound the nearby 
boulder with the hammer and kill the Gold Skulltula it was covering.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on a wall inside a grotto near the entrance to Gerudo Valley, found by pounding a boulder, bombing the stone circle, and burning webs with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Go to the entrance to Gerudo Valley in Hyrule Field.  Pound the nearby boulder
surrounded by small rocks, then bomb the circle and fall through the hole.  
Use Din's Fire to destroy the webs and get the Gold Skulltula on a wall.

facts.subject: Water Temple Entrance
facts.text: Hookshotting the diamond object over the Water Temple entrance opens it up.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot the 
diamond object over the entrance, and it will open up for you.

facts.subject: Water Level Stations
facts.text: The first station lowers water to the bottom, the station in the middle column raises water to the middle, and the second-floor west door station raises water to the top.

evidence.quote:
The first station
you find lowers the water level to the bottom.  The station in the middle 
column of the big room raises the water level to the middle.  The station 
accessible from the west door of the second floor raises the water level to
the top.

facts.subject: Dark Link
facts.text: The mini-boss Dark Link guards the dungeon item and can be easily defeated with the sword.

evidence.quote:
The mini-boss guarding the dungeon item is Dark Link, and he is easily
defeatable with the sword.

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: To defeat Morpha, stand on the edges, target the pink orb, avoid the water arm, hookshot the orb, and slice it with the sword.

evidence.quote:
To defeat the boss, Morpha, stand on the
edges and target the pink orb, avoid the arm that thrusts out of the water
and hookshot the orb, then slice it with your sword.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest on the top floor through the door past Ruto contains the map.

evidence.quote:
Float up to the top floor and go through the door.
- Get the map from the chest.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest through the door unlocked by lighting torches with Din's Fire at the bottom of the room contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Drop all the way down, light the torches with Din's Fire, and go through
  the unlocked door.
- Get the key from the chest, then go back to the big room.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind a cage by raising the stairs and spin attacking the crystal.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch to raise the stairs, then spin attack the crystal behind
  the cage and kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) behind it.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest in the room accessed by sinking onto the pipe, shooting the crystal, and hookshotting to the target contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Sink down onto the pipe in the water, shoot the crystal, hookshot to the
  target, get past the gate and float up to the next room.
- Get the key from the chest, then go back to the big room.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest beneath the central column block contains a key after hitting the crystal and killing enemies to open the gate.

evidence.quote:
Sink back down to the bottom and drop down the hole the block was covering.
- Hit the crystal and kill the enemies to open up the gate.
- Float up and get the key from the chest, then go back to the big room.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest behind a bombed wall through the bottom floor's east doorway contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Sink down and go through the east doorway on the bottom floor.
- Float up and bomb the wall, get the key from the chest, and go back to the
  big room.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest on the second floor east room contains the compass after hookshotting to the ceiling and hitting the crystal.

evidence.quote:
Float up to the east doorway on the second floor and go through.
- Hookshot up to the ceiling, hit the crystal and get the compass from the 
  chest.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest in the room beyond the mini-boss contains the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Kill the mini-boss, go to the next room and get the Longshot from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula token is obtained using Iron Boots on the wall after swimming across the rapids past the Song of Time blue block.

evidence.quote:
Swim across the rapids, then use the Iron Boots nearby the Gold Skulltula
  (#2) on the wall and get its token.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest reached by shooting an eye and hookshotting to it contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Swim to the platform across from the pots, shoot the eye, hookshot to the
  chest and get the key.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula token is collected with the Longshot near the ceiling of the center column.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot up to the ceiling in the center column, kill the Gold Skulltula 
  (#3) and get the token with the Longshot.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest through the passage on the second floor reached by shooting the gold eye to the south contains a key.

evidence.quote:
In the second floor of the big room, shoot the gold eye to the south, then
  hookshot across past the closing gate.
- Go through the passage, push the block, and get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind the waterfall beyond the room with the block pushed onto a switch.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch and jump over to the next room.
- Shoot the Gold Skulltula (#4) behind the waterfall and get the token.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest through the locked door below the falling boulders contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Sink down the hole where the boulders drop down to the next room.
- Go through the locked door, then get the Boss Key from the chest.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on the wall in the moving platform room through the west door when the water is at the highest level.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the big room and raise the water to the highest level.
- Go back through the west door to the moving platform room, shoot the Gold 
  Skulltula (#5) on the wall and get the token with the Longshot.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is at the top of a tree near the Water Temple exit, killable at night with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
From where you exit the dungeon, use the Longshot to get to the top of the 
nearby tree at night, and kill the Gold Skulltula there.

facts.subject: Fire Arrows
facts.text: Shooting an arrow at the morning sun while standing on the brown pedestal drops Fire Arrows into Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the brown pedestal on this island in the lake, and wait for the
morning sun to rise.  Shoot an arrow at the sun at that moment, and the Fire
Arrows will drop down and you can swim across to get them.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on the wall near the bridge at the end of Zora's River, retrievable with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Head back to Zora's River and go all the way across the bridge near the end.
Near the bridge, look up and kill the Skulltula on the wall, and get the
token with the Longshot.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: A chest on one of the roofs on top of Gerudo Fortress contains a Heart Piece reached via Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Enter the thieves' hideout in Gerudo Fortress once again, and get to the top
of the outside of the fortress.  Longshot over to the chest on one of the 
roofs and get the Heart Piece from it.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on the big target to the north of the archery game at Gerudo Fortress.

evidence.quote:
Go over to the archery game at the fortress.  There is a Gold Skulltula on
the big target all the way to the north- use the Longshot to get the token.

facts.subject: Nocturne of Shadow
facts.text: Sheik teaches the Nocturne of Shadow in Kakariko Village after completing the Water Temple.

evidence.quote:
Return to Kakariko Village after beating the Water Temple, and Sheik will
teach you this song after the cutscene.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall on top of the roof of Impa's house in southern Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Use the Longshot to get on the roof of Impa's house, in the south section of
the village.  The Gold Skulltula is on the wall up there.

facts.subject: Man on the Roof
facts.text: The man sitting on the roof of a house in Kakariko Village gives Link a Heart Piece when reached with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Longshot over to the man sitting on the roof of one of the houses in the 
village, and he will give you a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Dampe's Ghost Race
facts.text: Racing Dampe's Spirit in the Graveyard and using the Longshot to cross the long gap to finish in under a minute rewards a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Enter the graveyard and race Dampe's Spirit again inside one of the headstone
holes.  At the end, use the Longshot to get across the long gap and reach the
finish in under a minute to get a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple Entrance
facts.text: Using Din's Fire in the chamber down the stairs after playing the Nocturne of Shadow lights all torches and unlocks the entrance to the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Play the Nocturne of Shadow, then go down the stairs to a 
small chamber.  Use Din's Fire to light all the torches and unlock the
entrance.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: To defeat Bongo Bongo, stun the hands with arrows, locate the central eye in the head using the Lens of Truth, shoot the eye with an arrow, and strike it with the sword.

evidence.quote:
When you reach the boss, first shoot the hands with 
arrows to stun them, then use the Lens of Truth to find the central eye in the
head.  Shoot that with an arrow, then slice it up with your sword.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: The dungeon map is inside a chest found by taking the passage to the right revealed with the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth to find a passage to the right; enter and get the map
  from the chest.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: The Hover Boots are in a chest obtained after going through the western door and defeating Dead Hand.

evidence.quote:
Find the door to the west and go through, kill the Dead Hand and get the
  Hover Boots from the chest.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: The compass is inside a chest obtained after going through the fake wall and defeating the enemies.

evidence.quote:
Go through the fake wall on the opposite side, kill the enemies and get the
  compass from the chest.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Collecting all the silver rupees awards a key.

evidence.quote:
Get all the silver rupees and get the key, then go back to the previous 
  room.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the room beyond the platform reached across the invisible platforms past the guillotines.

evidence.quote: Kill all the enemies, then kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) in the room beyond.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is inside the cage on the right side of the falling spike trap room.

evidence.quote: Enter the cage on the right, and kill the Gold Skulltula (#2).

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Climbing the block, jumping right to step on the switch, and jumping back rewards a key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the block at the end to the top, jump to the right and step on the
  switch, then jump back over to the chest and get the key from it.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind the giant statue.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula (#3) behind the giant statue.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Throwing a bomb into the giant statue yields a key.

evidence.quote:
Climb up and throw a bomb into the statue to get a key, then go back to the
  previous room.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Bombing the debris in the southeast corner reveals a hidden chest containing a key when using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the debris in the southeast corner and use the Lens of Truth to get a
  key from the hidden chest, then go through the locked door.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the far wall near the ship and its token can be retrieved with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the Gold Skulltula (#4) on the far wall and get the token with the
  Longshot.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Burning the walls with Din's Fire reveals a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Use Din's Fire to burn the walls and get the Boss Key from the chest.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind the giant rotating statues.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula (#5) behind the giant rotating statues.

facts.subject: Shadow Temple
facts.text: Defeating the enemies in the room beyond the south door reveals a chest with a key.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies and get the key from the chest.

facts.subject: Haunted Wasteland
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is inside the small stone building reached after crossing the quicksand pit with the Hover Boots and following the red flags.

evidence.quote:
Cross the quicksand pit ahead with the
Hover Boots, then follow the single red flags across the desert until you
reach a tiny stone building.  Enter the building and drop down, then kill
the Gold Skulltula inside.

facts.subject: Requiem of Spirit
facts.text: Following the Poe across the desert path using the Lens of Truth leads to Desert Colossus, where entering and exiting the Spirit Temple prompts Sheik to teach the Requiem of Spirit.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Lens of Truth, and follow the Poe.  He will lead you across the
invisible path through the desert until you reach the Desert Colossus, where
the entrance to the Spirit Temple is located.  Enter the dungeon, then exit,
and Sheik will appear and teach you this song.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is on one of the palm trees on the south side of Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote:
Look at the palm trees on the south side of the area, and kill the Gold
Skulltula on one of them.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus
facts.text: Bombing a cracked wall near the northern palm trees reveals a Great Fairy who teaches Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote:
Near the palm trees on the north side of the area, there is a cracked wall.
Bomb it and enter; the Great Fairy inside teaches you this spell.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus
facts.text: Dropping a bottled bug onto the soft soil patch directly in front of the Spirit Temple entrance as Young Link reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Change to Young Link and warp to this area.  Use a bottled bug on the soft
soil spot right in front of the dungeon entrance to get this Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus
facts.text: Riding the magic bean plant as Adult Link to a northern rock platform leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Plant a Magic Bean at that soft soil spot, then return here as Adult Link.
Ride the bean platform over to a rock platform on the north side, where 
there is another Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Desert Colossus
facts.text: Riding the magic bean platform and jumping off onto the stone structure in front of the dungeon entrance yields a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Ride this same bean platform again, and jump off on top of the stone 
structure in front of the dungeon entrance to get the Heart Piece there.

facts.subject: Twinrova
facts.text: Block one sister's fire or ice beam and reflect it at the opposite sister several times until they merge, then absorb three shots of the same element to fire a beam that stuns her for sword attacks.

evidence.quote:
To defeat them, first
target one of the sisters and block the fire or ice ray she shoots, then 
reflect that ray onto the other sister to damage her.  After doing that 
several times, they will merge into one.  Absorb a fire or ice shot three 
times in a row and you will reflect a beam at her.  When she's stunned, slice
her up with your sword until she dies.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Collecting the silver rupees drops the cage door, and lighting the torches spawns a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote:
Collect the silver rupees to make the cage door fall, then light the torches
  and get the key from the chest that appears.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the far side of the cage in the room with silver rupees.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) on the other side of this cage, then go through
  the door to a previous room.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is found at the top of the climbable wall.

evidence.quote: Climb up the wall and shoot the Gold Skulltula (#2) at the top.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Striking the crystal spawns a chest containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
Hit the crystal to get Bombchus from the chest, then use a Bombchu to hit 
  the rock protruding from the wall, and go through the unlocked door.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Dropping down to the left and lighting torches in front of the giant statue spawns a chest with the dungeon map.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to the left, light the torches in front of the giant statue and
  get the map from the chest.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Collecting all silver rupees lights a torch, and lighting all torches with a Deku Stick spawns a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote:
Collect all the silver rupees to light a torch, then light all the torches
  in the room with a Deku Stick, then get the key from the chest that drops.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is positioned above the unlocked door after pulling the sun block into the light.

evidence.quote: Turn around and kill the Gold Skulltula (#3) above the door.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: The Silver Gauntlets are in a chest outside after defeating the Iron Knuckle as Young Link.

evidence.quote: Get the Silver Gauntlets from the chest.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol spawns a chest containing the compass.

evidence.quote:
Play the Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol and get the compass from the
  chest.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the blue block after collecting the silver rupees reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Collect the silver rupees, then play the Song of Time in front of the blue
  block and kill the Gold Skulltula (#4).

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: A key is located in the room following the blue block room.

evidence.quote:
Go to the next room and get the key, then go back two rooms, and go through
  the locked door.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the statue hand with the Triforce symbol allows Hookshotting to a chest holding a key.

evidence.quote:
Play Zelda's Lullaby, then hookshot to the chest
  and get the key from it.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song at the top of the west stairs allows Hookshotting over to Pierre to kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the stairs on the west side of the room to get to the top, play the
  Scarecrow's Song, then hookshot over to him and kill the Gold Skulltula 
  (#5).

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: The Mirror Shield is found inside a chest after defeating an Iron Knuckle.

evidence.quote: Get the Mirror Shield from the chest.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Reflecting light onto the sun symbol in the Armos statue room unlocks a door to a room containing a key.

evidence.quote:
Get the key, then go back to the previous room, and west, then go through
  the locked door.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple
facts.text: Shooting the door left of the flames reveals a golden eye to shoot, allowing Link to Hookshot across and step on a switch for the Boss Key chest.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the door to the left of the flames, then shoot the golden eye behind
  it.  Hookshot to the target and step on the switch, then get the Boss Key
  from the chest.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple Mirror Puzzle
facts.text: Bomb the cracked wall near the first mirror statue, point that mirror through the wall to the second mirror statue, and aim the second mirror to reflect light through the bars.

evidence.quote:
Hit the crystal through the bars, then go through the passage until you 
  reach a mirror statue.  Bomb the cracked wall, then push that mirror 
  statue so that it points to the statue through the wall, then push the 
  second mirror statue so it reflects light through the bars.

facts.subject: Spirit Temple Central Platform
facts.text: Reflecting light with the Mirror Shield onto the sun symbol lowers the central platform.

evidence.quote:
Go back around and reflect the light with your Mirror Shield onto the sun
  symbol to lower the platform.

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Defeating the enemies in the first room to the left yields the first small key.

evidence.quote: Take the door to the left.  Kill the enemies and get the key (#1), then go through the next door.

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals an invisible chest containing the second small key after killing the enemies.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies, then use the Lens of Truth to spot an invisible chest and open it for the key (#2).

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Shooting the statue eyes from the rotating platform allows Link to hookshot to the chest containing the third small key.

evidence.quote: Now drop down in the next room, and shoot the statue eyes from the rotating platform.  Hookshot to the chest and get the key (#3).

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song allows Link to hookshot up to the top ledge to reach the room with the fourth small key.

evidence.quote: Now, play the Scarecrow's Song to hookshot back up to the top ledge, and go through the newly unlocked door.  Get the key (#4), then go back to the previous room

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Pounding the totem poles with the Megaton Hammer reveals a switch that removes flames from the chest holding the fifth small key.

evidence.quote: Pound the totem poles with the Megaton Hammer to find a switch that deflames the chest that holds the key (#5).

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Behind a totem pole is a golden eye that unlocks doors when shot.

evidence.quote: Behind another pole is a golden eye- shoot it to unlock the doors, then go through the door leading to the next area.

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Using the Song of Time, Iron Boots, and Longshot in the underwater room allows Link to collect silver rupees and open a chest for the sixth small key.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time, equip the Iron Boots and drop down into the water, then use the Longshot to collect the silver rupees.  Swim up and get the key (#6) from the chest

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Playing the Song of Time on one of the center platforms creates stepping blocks leading to the seventh small key.

evidence.quote: Hop to one of the center platforms and play the Song of Time creating stepping blocks to key (#7).

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Entering the room opposite the Hookshot target and killing the enemies rewards the eighth small key.

evidence.quote: Now enter the room opposite the one with the Hookshot target.  Kill the enemies here and get key (#8).

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: In the key maze, using the Lens of Truth reveals a passage in the ceiling with a chest containing another key.

evidence.quote: Go through the first locked door to the left, then use the Lens of Truth to spot a passage in the ceiling; climb up and get the key from the chest there.

facts.subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
facts.text: Unlocking all the doors in the key maze leads to a big chest containing the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote: Then, just go through all the locked doors in this room and get the Ice Arrows from the big chest at the end.

facts.subject: Zora's Fountain
facts.text: Lifting the boulder near the Great Fairy cavern entrance with the Silver Gauntlets reveals a hole with the final Gold Skulltula on the wall at the top.

evidence.quote: Go all the way back to Zora's Fountain, then go to the south end of it where the entrance to the Great Fairy cavern is.  Lift up the boulder here with the Silver Gauntlets and drop inside the hole.  Go up the slope and up the ladder, and the final Gold Skulltula is on the wall at the top, to the left.

facts.subject: House of Skulltula
facts.text: Returning to the House of Skulltula after getting all 100 Skulltula tokens yields infinite rupees from the man inside.

evidence.quote: After you get all 100 Skulltula tokens, you can go back to the House of Skulltula and get infinite rupees from the man inside.

facts.subject: Temple of Time
facts.text: Entering the Temple of Time as Adult Link after obtaining all medallions triggers Zelda giving Link the Light Arrows before she is captured.

evidence.quote: Enter the Temple of Time as Adult Link after you have all the medallions. Zelda gives you the final arrow upgrade, but gets captured in the process.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: Ganondorf is defeated by deflecting energy balls back at him from the perimeter, stunning him with a Light Arrow, and slashing him with the sword.

evidence.quote: To defeat him, stand on the perimeter of the room, and deflect his energy balls back at him until he gets hit.  Then, fire a Light Arrow at him, and jump over and slice him up with your sword.

facts.subject: Ganondorf
facts.text: When Ganondorf charges a gigantic orb as the room darkens, release a powered-up spin attack as the orb is launched.

evidence.quote: If he starts to charge a gigantic orb and the room darkens, power up your spin attack and unleash it when the orb is launched at you.

facts.subject: Shadow Barrier
facts.text: A chest on the right side of the Shadow Barrier room contains the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Go back across, shoot the torch again with a Fire Arrow, then jump across the ice platforms to the right and step on the switch there....Get the Golden Gauntlets from the chest.

facts.subject: Great Fairy
facts.text: Lifting the giant pillar outside Ganon's Castle with the Golden Gauntlets reveals a Great Fairy cave that grants Double Defense.

evidence.quote: With the Golden Gauntlets, exit Ganon's Castle, then go under the big arch to the left and go down the valley.  Lift up the giant pillar, then go inside the cave and receive the Double Defense from the Great Fairy.

facts.subject: Forest Barrier
facts.text: Using Din's Fire on the four center torches and a Fire Arrow on the torch above the door unlocks the door in the Forest Barrier.

evidence.quote: Use Din's Fire to light the four center torches and a Fire Arrow on the torch above the door, then go through the door.

facts.subject: Water Barrier
facts.text: The Water Barrier requires blue fire to melt red ice, along with pushing blocks into a hole and beneath the red ice ledge.

evidence.quote: Catch some blue fire in a couple bottles, kill the enemies, drop some blue fire on the red ice, and go through the door....Push the far block into the hole, then push the other block below the ledge with the red ice.

facts.subject: Light Barrier
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol inside the Light Barrier room produces a key.

evidence.quote: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol to get the key, and go through.

facts.subject: Spirit Barrier
facts.text: Hitting the crystal behind the cage grants Bombchus, which must be launched over the cage to strike the far crystal.

evidence.quote: Hit the crystal behind the cage to get Bombchus, then lay a Bombchu so it goes over the cage and hits the far crystal, and go through the next door.

facts.subject: Spirit Barrier
facts.text: Shooting the ceiling with a Fire Arrow allows light to be reflected onto the sun symbols using the Mirror Shield to unlock the door.

evidence.quote: Shoot the ceiling with a Fire Arrow and reflect the light on the sun symbols with the Mirror Shield to unlock the next door.

facts.subject: Central Tower
facts.text: Link obtains the Boss Key in the central tower after killing the Stalfos.

evidence.quote: Make your way up the tower, killing the enemies, then get the Boss Key after killing the Stalfos.

facts.subject: Ganon
facts.text: Ganon is stunned by shooting his head with a Light Arrow or rolling between his legs, after which his tail can be damaged with the Megaton Hammer, Biggoron's Sword, or Master Sword.

evidence.quote: To damage Ganon, shoot its head with a Light Arrow to stun it- or simply roll under its legs- and pound the tail with the Megaton Hammer or slice it with the Biggoron's Sword....Now, battle it the same way as before, but use the Master Sword to damage it this time.

facts.subject: Fairy's Ocarina
facts.text: Saria gives Link the Fairy's Ocarina when he leaves Kokiri Forest to the west.

evidence.quote: When you leave Kokiri Forest to the west, Saria will give this to you.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: In the pot storehouse through the first door to the left in the Market, a Gold Skulltula is found inside the box at the far end.

evidence.quote:
Enter the first door to your left
to reach a pot storehouse.  There are many rupees in the pots here.  Roll
into the box at the far end to find a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Hylian Shield
facts.text: The Hylian Shield can be purchased for 80 rupees at the Bazaar in the southeast corner of the Market.

evidence.quote:
Purchase Hylian Shield (80 rupees) (Market)
Enter the Bazaar at the southeast corner of the market, and pay the money
to get this upgraded shield.

facts.subject: Weird Egg
facts.text: Malon gives Link the Weird Egg next to the vines in the Hyrule Castle area, which soon hatches into a chicken.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the
girl called Malon next to the vines, and she will give you the egg.  This
will hatch into a chicken soon.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Rolling into the lone tree near Malon at Hyrule Castle reveals a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
There is a lone tree right nearby Malon; roll into it and a Skulltula will
pop out for you to kill.

facts.subject: Talon
facts.text: Waking Malon's father with the chicken causes him to run off.

evidence.quote:
Wake
him up with the chicken, and he will run off.

facts.subject: Zelda's Letter
facts.text: Zelda gives Link her letter upon speaking with her in the courtyard.

evidence.quote:
Make your way west, past all the patrolling guards, until you get to
Zelda in the courtyard.  Talk to her and she'll give you this letter.

facts.subject: Zelda's Lullaby
facts.text: Impa teaches Link Zelda's Lullaby when speaking with her upon leaving.

evidence.quote: - Learn "Zelda's Lullaby" (Hyrule Castle) When you talk to Impa as you leave, she will teach you this song.

facts.subject: Epona's Song
facts.text: Malon teaches Link Epona's Song when he speaks to her and pulls out the Fairy Ocarina in the central ringed area.

evidence.quote:
Go to the 
central ringed area, where you will find Malon singing with her horses.  Talk
to her, then pull out your Fairy Ocarina and she will teach you this song.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: In the southwest corner of Lon Lon Ranch, pulling crates aside in a small building reveals a crawlspace leading to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
In the southwest corner of the ranch, there is a small building you can 
enter.  Pull the crates aside to reveal a crawlspace in the northwest corner.  
Go through it to get the Heart Piece on the other side.

facts.subject: Bottle
facts.text: Finding the three Super Cuccos within the time limit in Talon's minigame costs 10 rupees and awards a Bottle.

evidence.quote:
Enter the house to the left of the entrance to find Talon again.  Talk to him
to play a Super Cucco hunting game for 10 rupees.  Locate the three Super 
Cuccos in the room within the time limit to get your first Bottle.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Rolling into the lone tree between the house and the corral at Lon Lon Ranch causes a Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
There is a lone tree in-between the house and the corral area.  Roll into it
to make a Skulltula pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: At night, a Skulltula appears on the wooden post on the far south side of the corral at Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote:
On the far south side of the corral, this Skulltula comes out at night on the
wooded post.  Kill it and get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: At night, a Skulltula appears on the back of the Know-it-all Brother's house next to the Kokiri Sword maze entrance.

evidence.quote:
On the back of the Know-it-all Brother's house, 
which is next to the Kokiri Sword maze entrance, is a Skulltula that appears
at night.

facts.subject: Lost Woods
facts.text: From the Lost Woods entrance, traveling east, west, east, west, forward, west, then east leads to the Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote:
From the entrance, go east, then west, then east, then west, then 
forward, then west, then east to get to the Sacred Forest Meadow.

facts.subject: Saria's Song
facts.text: Saria teaches Link her song in the clearing of the Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote:
Make your way through the linear 
maze, avoiding the Deku Scrubs, and up through the narrow path until you 
reach a clearing.  Saria is waiting here, and she teaches you her song.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Going west from the Lost Woods entrance and playing Saria's Song on the stump earns a Heart Piece from the Skull Kid.

evidence.quote:
From the entrance to the Lost Woods, go west.  Step on the stump and play 
Saria's Song, and the Skull Kid gives you a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Deku Stick Holder
facts.text: Defeating the Deku Scrub past the bridge south of the Skull Kid allows Link to buy the 20 Capacity Deku Stick Holder for 40 rupees.

evidence.quote:
- Get 20 Capacity Deku Stick Holder (40 rupees) (Lost Woods)
From the last Heart Piece, go south.  Drop down and go past the bridge, then
defeat the Deku Scrub.  He sells you the Deku Stick upgrade for 40 rupees.

facts.subject: Deku Seed Holder
facts.text: Shooting the bulls-eye plate three times with the Slingshot in the room east of the Lost Woods entrance awards the 40 Capacity Deku Seed Holder.

evidence.quote:
- Get 40 Capacity Deku Seed Holder (Lost Woods)
From the Lost Woods entrance, go east.  Shoot the bulls-eye plate three times
with the Slingshot to get this Deku Seed upgrade.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Repeating the Ocarina tunes played by the Skull Kids three times correctly awards a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the stump, and play the 
Ocarina for the Skull Kids.  Follow the tunes they play, and do it three 
times correctly to get a Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Bottle
facts.text: Returning all seven chickens to the Cucco Lady's fenced pen in Kakariko Village rewards Link with a Bottle.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the Cucco Lady in the south portion of the village- you 
need to find all seven of her chickens and dump them into her fenced area....When all the chickens are 
returned, the lady will give you a Bottle as a reward.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Paying Dampe 10 rupees to dig at night in the Graveyard can reveal a Heart Piece in one of the holes.

evidence.quote:
At night, go to the Graveyard, southeast from Kakariko Village.  Talk to Dampe
and play his digging game.  Pay him 10 rupees at any spot and he will dig a 
hole.  There is a Heart Piece in one of the spots he can dig.

facts.subject: Sun's Song
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby next to the huge gravestone in the Graveyard reveals a hole where reading the plaque teaches the Sun's Song, allowing the player to switch between day and night at any time.

evidence.quote:
Go to the far east, top-most ledge of the Graveyard, and play Zelda's Lullaby
next to the huge gravestone.  It will disappear and you can jump in the hole....Examine the plaque at the end of the path to learn this
song; you can now switch between day and night at any time.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Pulling aside a small gravestone on the ledge south of the royal tomb reveals a hole with a mummy and a chest containing a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
On the ledge just south of where the huge gravestone was, pull aside the small
gravestones on the left-hand side.  One of them hides a secret hole; jump 
inside it.  Kill the mummy inside, then play the Song of Soul and get the 
Heart Piece from the chest that appears.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Placing a bottled bug on the soft soil in the northwest corner ledge of the Graveyard causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote:
Catch a bug from under a rock with a Bottle, and go up on the ledge to the 
northwest corner of the Graveyard.  Lay a bug on the soft soil, and a Gold 
Skulltula pops out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Rolling into the tree just past the entrance from Hyrule Field in Kakariko Village makes a Gold Skulltula fall out.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the tree just past the entrance from Hyrule Field to make this Gold
Skulltula fall out.

facts.subject: Adult Wallet
facts.text: Collecting 10 Skulltula Tokens unlocks the Adult Wallet inside the House of Skulltula, which allows Link to carry up to 200 rupees.

evidence.quote:
Once you have 10 Skulltula Tokens, enter the House of Skulltula just right of
the entrance from Hyrule Field.  The man inside will give you the Adult 
Wallet, which lets you hold up to 200 rupees.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: At night, a Gold Skulltula can be shot and collected from the tall watchtower in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
At night, go up to the tall watchtower in the village.  Look up and shoot the
Gold Skulltula, then climb up to get the token.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: A Skulltula is on the back of the house located just to the left of the exit leading to Death Mountain.

evidence.quote:
This Skulltula is on the back of the house just to the left of the exit that
leads to Death Mountain.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: A Skulltula is behind one of the brick walls of the building under construction in the center of Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Examine the building under construction in the center of the village.  A 
Skulltula is behind one of the brick walls.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: A Skulltula is found on the back of the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: Look at the back of the House of Skulltula to find this one.

facts.subject: Deku Seed Holder
facts.text: Winning the Archery Game in the northwest corner of the Market awards the 50 Capacity Deku Seed Holder upgrade for the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
- Get 50 Capacity Deku Seed Holder (Market)	
Leave Kakariko Village and go to the Market area.  In the northwest corner of
the market, enter the Archery Game building.  Win the game to get this 
upgrade for the Slingshot.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Luring the white dog to the woman inside the second door of the southwest back alley at night rewards Link with a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Inside the market, play the Sun Song to make it nighttime.  In the main area,
there are a lot of dogs hopping around; approach the white-colored dog so
that it starts to follow you.  Now enter the back alley of the market to the
southwest, and enter the second door.  The woman inside will give you the 
Heart Piece for finding her dog.

facts.subject: Keaton Mask
facts.text: The Keaton Mask becomes available at the Happy Mask Shop after giving Zelda's letter to the guard at the Death Mountain gate, and can be sold to him in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
The Happy Mask Shop in the market opens up after you have spoken to the man
guarding the gate to Death Mountain and given him Zelda's letter.  Inside, 
talk to the store owner to get the Keaton Mask, the first mask.  To sell the
mask, give it to the man guarding the gate in Kakariko Village.

facts.subject: Skull Mask
facts.text: After selling the Keaton Mask, the Skull Mask can be obtained from the Happy Mask Shop and sold to the Skull Kid in the Lost Woods west of the entrance.

evidence.quote:
After selling the Keaton Mask, the Skull Mask is available in the Happy Mask
Shop.  To sell it, enter the Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest.  Go west from the
entrance and talk to the Skull Kid with the mask on.

facts.subject: Deku Stick Holder
facts.text: Navigating east, west, east, west, then west in the Lost Woods, dropping into the hole in tall grass, and wearing the Skull Mask causes Deku Scrubs to give Link the 30 Capacity Deku Stick Holder.

evidence.quote:
- Get 30 Capacity Deku Stick Holder (Lost Woods)
From the Lost Woods entrance, go east, west, east, west, then west again.  
Drop into the hole in the tall grass near the butterflies.  Wear the Skull 
Mask, then step forward in this secret forest stage.  The Deku Scrubs will 
sprout out of the ground and give you this Deku Stick upgrade.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Releasing a bug onto the soft soil behind the item shop in Kokiri Forest makes a Skulltula emerge.

evidence.quote:
Get a bug from under a rock and catch it with your bottle, then go over behind
the item shop in the Kokiri Forest.  Lay the bug onto the soft soil here to
make a Skulltula pop out.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Going west twice from the Lost Woods entrance and putting a bug onto the soft soil near the bridge reveals a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
From the Lost Woods entrance, go west, and west again to the bridge area.  Lay
a bug at the soft soil at the ledge to reveal a Skulltula.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Releasing a bug onto the soft soil in the Lost Woods screen with two Deku Scrubs fetches out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
At the Lost Woods screen with the two Deku Scrubs shooting at you, there is a
soft soil spot.  Use another bug here to fetch out a Skulltula.

facts.subject: Spooky Mask
facts.text: The Spooky Mask from the Happy Mask Shop can be sold to the boy in the Graveyard during the day.

evidence.quote:
Get the Spooky Mask from the Happy Mask Shop.  To sell it, go to the Graveyard
from Kakariko Village during the day, and give this to the boy there.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Catching a big fish of about 10 pounds at the Fishing Pond in Lake Hylia earns a Heart Piece from the owner.

evidence.quote:
If you can catch a big fish (about 10 pounds), the owner will give you
a Heart Piece.  The big fish usually lurks between the log poking out in the
middle of the pond and the three sticks nearby.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Dropping a bug on the soft soil next to the Scientist's Lab in Lake Hylia reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The Scientist's Lab is to the right of the entrance from Hyrule Field.  Use a
bug on the soft soil next to the lab.

facts.subject: Banooru
facts.text: Playing an Ocarina song in front of the dancing scarecrow named Banooru in the scarecrow patch between the lab and the fishing pond sets up notes that become important later.

evidence.quote:
While you are in this area, there is a scarecrow patch in between the lab and
the fishing pond.  Play a song with 
your Ocarina in front of the dancing scarecrow named Banooru, and remember 
the notes you used; it will become important later.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: A Gold Skulltula is located on a small platform deep in Lake Hylia across both bridges.

evidence.quote:
Go all the way across both bridges, then swim to the small platform out deep
in the lake.  Kill the Gold Skulltula there.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Rolling into the tree near the entrance to Zora's River knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Roll into
the tree near the entrance to make a Gold Skulltula fall out.

facts.subject: Stone of Agony
facts.text: Returning to the House of Skulltula with 20 Skulltula Tokens rewards Link with the Stone of Agony, which alerts him when a secret is nearby.

evidence.quote:
Enter the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village again once you have 20 
Skulltula Tokens, and the newly uncursed man inside gives you this item, 
which alerts you when a secret is nearby.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Floating down with a chicken through the giant waterfall on the right near the bridge in Gerudo Valley leads to a Heart Piece in a nook.

evidence.quote:
Near the impassable
bridge, grab the chicken.  Jump off to the right and float down, through the
giant waterfall, into a tiny nook in the wall.  Get the Heart Piece here.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Using a bottled bug on the soft soil spot on the bottom ledge of Gerudo Valley digs up a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Jump into the water from the last Heart Piece, then climb up on the bottom
ledge of the valley.  Use a bottled bug on the soft soil spot here to dig up
a Gold Skulltula.

facts.subject: Piece of Heart
facts.text: Floating to the tiny ledge on the opposite side of Gerudo Valley with a chicken and rolling into the crate yields a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Grab the chicken again, and jump off the cliff to the left.  Float to the 
tiny ledge with the crate on the opposite side of the valley.  Roll into the 
crate and get the Heart Piece.

facts.subject: Power Bracelet
facts.text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby to enter Darunia's room and then playing Saria's Song for him earns Link the Power Bracelet.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to the bottom level of the city, and play
Zelda's Lullaby in front of the big door slab.  Go inside to find Darunia,
leader of the Gorons.  Play Saria's Song for him, and he will give you the
Power Bracelet.

facts.subject: Gold Skulltula Token
facts.text: Throwing a bomb flower over the ledge destroys the boulder blocking Dodongo's Cavern, revealing a soft soil spot where a bug releases a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Pick up the bomb flower and throw it
over the ledge so that it explodes and destroys the boulder blocking the 
entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.  Go back down there, and you will see a soft
soil spot.  Use a bug here to release a Skulltula

evidence.quote: I activated the rumble pak under the core options and now my controller rumbles everytime I enter a room.

facts.subject: Gold 200 rupee chest

evidence.quote: Figures I pick this up right after I already came across that gold 200 rupee chest in Goron mountain

facts.subject: Save and Quit
facts.text: Saving and quitting restarts Young Link at Link's House in Kokiri Forest, or Adult Link at the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote:
One you exit the game after saving the game will either put you at the start of the dungeon or:
- Young link: Link's House[Kokiri Forest] 
- Adult Link: Temple of Time

facts.subject: Fairies
facts.text: Using a fairy does not count towards the death count, acting as an extra life system.

evidence.quote: Don't be afraid to use fairy's as an extra life system, using a fairy doesn't count towards the death count so the more bottles you have the more extra lives you are holding!

facts.subject: Farore's Wind
facts.text: Setting Farore's Wind before entering a boss room shortens runbacks if an attempt fails.

evidence.quote: Before going to a boss, save before you go into the boss room and use Farore's Wind to shorten runbacks.. If you failed the missable, reset the game and go back to the save to try again.

facts.subject: Deku Scrub Merchant
facts.text: A Deku Scrub Merchant across a bridge down a ladder in the Lost Woods sells a Deku Stick Upgrade for 40 rupees.

evidence.quote: After getting the Kokiri Sword and Deku Shield, head up top to the Lost Woods. From there take a left, pass the skull kid on the left side. Climb the ladder down into the room with the bridge leading to a Deku Scub Merchant asking for 40 rupees for the Deku Stick Upgrade.

facts.subject: Queen Gohma
facts.text: Queen Gohma can be defeated in one rotation before retreating to the ceiling by stunning her eye with the slingshot, jump slashing with a Deku Stick for double damage, and mashing the stick button three times.

evidence.quote: Deku Sticks are the key to defeating this boss in one rotation. sticks hold more damage between the Kokiri Sword. As soon as the boss starts, use your sling shot on the bosses eye to stun the boss while on the ground. Jump slash with a stick out to do double damage, then mash the stick button to hit the boss three times with the deku stick.

facts.subject: Spiritual Stone of the Forest
facts.text: The Spiritual Stone of the Forest is received after defeating Gohma in the Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Gohma in the Deku Tree.

facts.subject: Town Shooting Gallery
facts.text: The Town Shooting Gallery costs 20 rupees for 15 bullets to shoot 10 targets, with shooting 8 of 10 targets awarding a free retry.

evidence.quote: Upon entering the Hyrule castle to the left of Malon you will see the Town Shooting Gallery, spend 20 rupees and shoot all the rupees to win. 15 bullets, 10 targets and if you shoot 8/10 you get your next try on the house for free.

facts.subject: Courtyard Guard

evidence.quote:
[Missable] Upon entering Hyrule Courtyard there is a guard on the left you need to talk, get caught leave the area. Once you come back, you should be able to talk to the guard pay a small fee and the gate will be open.

facts.subject: Talon

facts.subject: Castle Guard

evidence.quote:
[Missable] Right before talking to princess Zelda, if you shoot the window to the left with a slingshot a small dialogue will appear.

facts.subject: Princess Zelda

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After Hyrule Courtyard.

facts.subject: Anju

evidence.quote: Talk to Anju at Kakariko Village to help her find her lost seven Cuccos are the village

facts.subject: Super Cucco Catching

evidence.quote: Huge Tip:  You can shield drop the cuccos to drop them faster (that's just pressing shield while holding something). Also, if you've already picked up a cucco a green arrow will be above it, so you know not to pick it up again.

facts.subject: Barn Cow

evidence.quote: After obtaining Epona's Song at Lon Lon Ranch, go to the Barn inside the Ranch and play Epona's Song in front of a cow with an empty bottle.

facts.subject: Happy Mask Shop

evidence.quote: After Handing Zelda's Letter to the Guard at Death Mountain Trail Entrance in Kakariko Village, you locked a side quest for the Happy Mask story in Hyrule Castle.

facts.subject: Butterfly Grotto

facts.subject: King Dodongo
facts.text: King Dodongo can be defeated without using bombs from your bag by throwing bomb flowers, jump slashing with a stick, and cancelling his fire breath with the slingshot.

evidence.quote: [Missable] As soon as you start the fight, turn around and grab a bomb flower run towards the boss to time your throw right. Jump slash with the stick then repeat the process once more to kill the boss, don't worry about getting hit. If the boss is about to fire, us the slingshot to cancel the effect.

facts.subject: Spiritual Stone of Fire
facts.text: The Spiritual Stone of Fire is received upon defeating King Dodongo.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating King Dodongo.

facts.subject: Great Fairy Fountain

evidence.quote: Climb the top of Death Mountain, blow up the rock next to Rauru to enter the fairy Fountain.

facts.subject: Boulder Room

[Missable] On the top of Goron City there is tightrope, slowly make your way around till you see an area with tons of rocks. Use your bombs in that room to reach the chest.

facts.subject: Rolling Goron

evidence.quote: Free all four craftsmen in jail, to roam free in Gerudo's Fortress.

evidence.quote: 1,500 points from the Archery Minigame to obtain the Upgrade.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] Young Link in the Spirit Temple.

facts.subject: Zora Tunic
facts.text: Using blue flame on the shop door in Zora's Domain allows Link to purchase the Zora Tunic for 300 rupees.

evidence.quote: Head back to Zoro's Domain with blue flame from the Ice Carven, use it on the shop door to buy the Zora Tunic for 300 rupees.

facts.subject: King Zora
facts.text: Talking to King Zora while equipped with the Zora Tunic before thawing him from red ice causes him to blow Link a kiss instead of giving a tunic.

evidence.quote: [Missable] Make sure to buy a Zora tunic and equip the Zora tunic before unfreezing the King from red ice. If you talk to the king while wearing the Zora tunic he will blow you a kiss....If you don't wear the Zora tunic, he will give you a Zora tunic instead not a kiss.

facts.subject: Biggoron's Sword
facts.text: Beginning the Biggoron's Sword side quest requires freeing King Zora from red ice and acquiring Epona to jump over the bridge.

evidence.quote:
Requirements

- Free King Zora from the Red Ice. 
- Acquire Epona. [Need to jump over bridge]

facts.subject: Pocket Egg
facts.text: The Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village provides a Pocket Egg that hatches after one night into a Cucco used to wake Talon and receive a blue Cucco.

evidence.quote: 1. Talk to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village, she will give you a Pocket Egg. After one night passes, the egg will hatch. Inside the Kakariko Village is Malon's Father, use the Cucco to walk up Talon. Go back to Cucco Lady to receive a special blue Cucco

facts.subject: Odd Mushroom
facts.text: The Craftsman's son in the Lost Woods gives an Odd Mushroom that must be delivered to the Potion Shop in Kakariko Village within 3 minutes.

evidence.quote: 2. Head to Lost woods, go where you gave the skull mask to lost kid to find the Craftsman's son. He will give you an Odd mushroom, you then have three minutes to travel it the Potion Shop in Kakariko Village.

facts.subject: Poacher's Saw
facts.text: Trading the Old Poultice to Fado in the Lost Woods awards the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote: 4. Head back to the Lost Woods where the Carftsman's son was to find Fado, trade the Old Poultice to receive the Poacher's Saw.

facts.subject: Broken Goron's Sword
facts.text: Trading the Poacher's Saw to the Master Craftsman across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley gives the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote: 5. Use Epona to travel to Gerudo Valley you will need to jump over the broken bridge. You can Talk to the Master Craftsman to trade your Poacher's Saw for Broken Goron's Sword

facts.subject: Eyeball Frog
facts.text: Delivering King Zora's prescription yields the Eyeball Frog, which must be brought to the scientist in Lakeside Laboratory within 3 minutes.

evidence.quote: 7. Once you talked to King Zora and presented the prescription to make the Wolrd's Finest Eye Drops, the king will give you Eyeball Frog. You will have three minutes to deliver the Eyeball frog to the scientist in Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia.

facts.subject: Eye Drops
facts.text: The Lake Hylia scientist gives Eye Drops that must be carried to the Big Goron on Death Mountain within 4 minutes.

evidence.quote: The laboratory is the first building you see, the scientist will then hand you the Eye Drops. Once you received the eye drops you have four minutes to climb back up to reach the big goron on Death Mountain.

facts.subject: Biggoron's Sword
facts.text: Playing the Sun's Song 6 times inside Death Mountain fast-forwards 3 days to claim the Biggoron's Sword from the claim check.

evidence.quote: Once up top you will receive the claim check that makes you wait three games to get the Biggoron sword. If you go inside Death Mountain, play the song of sun six different times. It will fast forward three days, making easy claim for sword.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: During Phantom Ganon's first phase, standing in the middle of corner floor lines protects Link from attack while determining the real painting by the louder footsteps and darker color.

evidence.quote: 1. Look on the floor you will see lines leading the corners, stand in the middle of the those corners by doing so you won't get hit by his attack if you miss the shot. Turn up the volume, you want will see two ganon's inside the painting coming towards you. Once you hear the footsteps coming closer to you, you know that is the real painting what ever is the loudest. You can also tell which is the fake Ganon by the color, the darker Ganon with the whiter whites is the real one. Wait until the portal appears then shoot your arrow, rinse and repeat three times.

facts.subject: Phantom Ganon
facts.text: In Phantom Ganon's second phase, deflect energy balls using an equipped empty bottle until the boss reaches 1 HP.

evidence.quote: 2. Make sure you have an empty bottle equipped and it's easier to hit the ball than you realize. May take a little practice to understand the timing, the bottle has a shorter swing and reach than the master sword, but lingers longer than you would expect. Keep on hitting the boss with the empty bottle until  the boss reaches 1 hp to get your achievement.

facts.subject: Forest Medallion
facts.text: Saria awakens and awards the Forest Medallion after defeating Phantom Ganon.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Phantom Ganon.

facts.subject: Shooting Gallery
facts.text: The adult Shooting Gallery is located in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: The Gallery is in Kakriko Village now, same set up as child link, refer to Sniper Fury for more details.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Volvagia emerges from one of 9 holes in the ground and can be stunned with a hammer jump slash, then damaged with the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: 1. At the start of the fight the boss will come out of a random hole out of the nine placed on the ground, wait for it to spin then run up and Jump slash with hammer to stun it, then biggoron sword to do damage.

facts.subject: Volvagia
facts.text: Hanging off the ledge of the arena when Volvagia burrows underground causes the boss to immediately return underground.

evidence.quote: 2. Jump off the side of the arena as soon as she goes back underground. Link will grab onto the ledge instead of jumping, and when Volvagia can't find you, she'll immediately go back underground.

facts.subject: Fire Medallion
facts.text: Darunia awakens and grants the Fire Medallion after defeating Volvagia.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Volvagia.

facts.subject: Bonooru the Scarecrow
facts.text: Playing a custom song to Bonooru the Scarecrow as Young Link and repeating it as Adult Link unlocks the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre to secret hookshot spots.

evidence.quote: As young Link head to Lake Hylia, talk to Bonooru the Scarecrow and make up a song you will remember on your own. Come back as adult Link to that same scarecrow and play the same song to unlock the "scarecrow" song. Now you play that song and the scarecrow will show in certain places allowing you to hookshot into secret areas.

facts.subject: Morpha
facts.text: Standing in the corner of the map keeps Link out of Morpha's reach while hookshotting its nucleus through tentacles and slashing it with Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: [Missable] As soon as the boss starts, make your way to the corner of the map. If you stay in that corner Morpha will never be able to reach you, use Biggoron's sword to your advantage. Hook shot Morpha as it goes through the tentacles, either spin attack or if you are brave enough as soon you hookshot Morpha go around and keep slashing Morpha in the corner for an easy defeat.

facts.subject: Fire Arrow
facts.text: Shooting an arrow into the rising sun while standing on the stone at Lake Hylia unlocks the Fire Arrow, with Sun's Song allowing retries.

evidence.quote: After obtaining the Water Medallion you will be teleported to Lake Hyila, stand on the stone and shoot an arrow at the sun as it's rising. Doing so will unlock the Fire arrow for you to obtain. If you miss it, just play Sun Song twice to retry.

facts.subject: Lens of Truth
facts.text: The Lens of Truth is located under the well in Kakariko Village after learning the Song of Storms.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] In Kakariko Village after learning the Song of Storms, Under the Well.

facts.subject: Bongo Bongo
facts.text: Equip Hover Boots at the start of Bongo Bongo to target a hand, unequip them to dodge fist attacks, shoot the eye between the hands when it charges, and finish it with Biggoron's Sword jump slashes and crouch stabs.

evidence.quote: The Target to stun Bongo Bongo is in between the hands after shooting both....1. Wear the Hover Boots as soon as the boss starts Z target on the hand from left or right side. Once one hand is down, unequip hover boots to be able to dodge the second hand if it turns into a fist....2. The boss will slam itself on the ground charge forward, I normally shoot just as the hands are about to reach me/when they are right next to me....3. Jump slash with biggoron sword then crouch stab it to death to one-cycle the boss.

facts.text: Story progression continues after defeating Morpha.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After Defeating Morpha.

facts.text: Story progression continues after defeating Bongo Bongo.
